title: README
body:
# ABAP Study · ZC505 교육 실습

> SAP ABAP 교육과정 실습 코드 전체 모음입니다.  
> ALV 기초부터 CDS View / AMDP / ADBC까지 단계별로 구성되어 있습니다.

---

## 폴더 구조 한눈에 보기

```
./
├── ZC505_SUB_01/   ALV 기초 (구석기 → 철기 → 기본형 → Color/Icon/Sort)
├── ZC505_SUB_02/   강의 노트 및 이전 기록 (SQL, 내부테이블, 구조체)
├── ZC505_SUB_03/   Function Group / FM 호출 / ALV Event + Popup
├── ZC505_SUB_04/   Edit ALV / DML / Toolbar Event
├── ZC505_SUB_05/   Tab Strip / Module Pool / BDC / CDS View (MP)
├── ZC505_SUB_06/   ALV Splitter Container
├── ZC505_SUB_07/   FOR ALL ENTRIES / Range / SUBMIT / Hotspot+Splitter
├── ZC505_SUB_08/   Field Symbol / Dynamic ALV / BDC
├── ZC505_SUB_09/   CDS View / AMDP / ADBC
└── ZC505_SUB_10/   개인 프로젝트 / 시험 / 복합 실습
```

---

## 파일 접미사 규칙

각 프로그램 폴더 안에는 Include 단위로 파일이 분리되어 있습니다.

| 접미사 | 역할 |
|--------|------|
| `_top` | 전역 데이터 선언부 (DATA, TYPE, CLASS DEFINITION) |
| `_s01` | Selection Screen 정의 |
| `_c01` | Local Class 구현부 (이벤트 핸들러 등) |
| `_o01` | PBO Module (화면 출력 전 처리) |
| `_i01` | PAI Module (사용자 입력 후 처리) |
| `_f01` | FORM 서브루틴 모음 (실제 로직의 핵심) |
| `screens/` | Screen Painter 화면 정의 (Module Pool 전용) |

---

## ZC505_SUB_01 — ALV 기초

|----------|------|-----------|
| `zc505rlect01` | Report Training 01 | 기본 SELECT + 리스트 출력 |

| `zc505r_note_16~18` | 12월 4일 ~ | 실습 및 과제 |
| `zc505r_note_19~23` | 12월 8일 ~ 9일 | 내부 테이블 / 구조체 |
| `zc505r_note_24~28` | 12월 9일 ~ 10일 | 다양한 SELECT 패턴 |

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_air_info .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~carrid AS air_code a~carrname AS air_name
         b~connid b~airpfrom b~deptime
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM scarr AS a
   INNER JOIN spfli AS b
      ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
   WHERE a~carrid IN so_carr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra       = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt  = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode    = 'D'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

* ITAB 의 필드명이 ref_table에 없는 경우
* ref_table 의 특정 필드와 매핑하고자 할때

  PERFORM make_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat .

*carrid 필드는 key 로 지정
*ITAB 의 AIR_CODE 라는 필드는 SCARR-CARRID 필드를 참조
*CARRID 필드의 DE 와 DO 의 속성을 적용하겠다.
  gs_fcat-key       = 'X'.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = 'AIR_CODE'. "ITAB 의 필드명을 ALV 에 등록
  gs_fcat-ref_table = 'SCARR'.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = 'CARRID'.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

  gs_fcat-key       = 'X'.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = 'SPFLI'.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

  gs_fcat-fieldname = 'AIR_NAME'.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = 'SCARR'.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = 'CARRNAME'.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

  gs_fcat-fieldname = 'AIRPFROM'.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = 'SPFLI'.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

  gs_fcat-fieldname = 'DEPTIME'.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = 'SPFLI'.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_alv
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_alv .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_layout       = gs_layout
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
    CHANGING
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat
      it_outtab       = gt_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable = gs_stable.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_flight .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~carrid a~carrname " scarr
         b~connid b~airpfrom b~airpto b~distance b~distid "spfli
         c~fldate c~price    c~currency
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM scarr AS a
   INNER JOIN spfli AS b
      ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
   INNER JOIN sflight AS c
      ON b~carrid EQ c~carrid
     AND b~connid EQ c~connid
   WHERE a~carrid IN so_carid.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.

  gs_stable-col = 'X'.
  gs_stable-row = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
  'X'   'CARRID'    ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
  'X'   'CONNID'    ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
  'X'   'FLDATE'    ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
  ' '   'CARRNAME'  ' ' 'SCARR'   ' ',
  ' '   'AIRPFROM'  ' ' 'SPFLI'   ' ',
  ' '   'AIRPTO'    ' ' 'SPFLI'   ' ',
  ' '   'PRICE'     ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
  ' '   'CURRENCY'  ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
  ' '   'DISTANCE'  ' ' 'SPFLI'   ' ',
  ' '   'DISTID'    ' ' 'SPFLI'   ' '.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat USING pv_key pv_field pv_text pv_ref_table pv_ref_field.
  "value를 감싸주지 않아서 call by reference
  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'PRICE'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'CURRENCY'. "통화키를 가진 ITAB 의 필드명  .
    WHEN 'DISTANCE'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'DISTID'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid. "메인 프로그램 ID. sy-cprog 도 같다.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
      is_variant      = gs_variant
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.

FORM get_data .

  SELECT a~bukrs a~gjahr a~belnr a~blart a~budat
         b~buzei b~bschl b~koart b~shkzg b~fcsl
         c~ltext AS bltxt
         d~ltext AS bstxt

   INNER JOIN bseg AS b
      ON a~bukrs EQ b~bukrs
     AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr

    LEFT OUTER JOIN t003t AS c
      ON a~blart EQ c~blart
     AND c~spras EQ sy-langu
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tbslt AS d
      ON b~bschl EQ d~bschl
     AND b~umskz EQ d~umskz
     AND d~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE a~bukrs IN so_burks
     AND a~gjahr EQ pa_gjahr.

    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

    'X'  'BUKRS'  ' ' 'BKPF'   ' ',
    'X'  'GJAHR'  ' ' 'BKPF'   ' ',
    'X'  'BELNR'  ' ' 'BKPF'   ' ',
    'X'  'BUZEI'  ' ' 'BSEG'   ' ',

    ' '  'BSTXT'  ' ' 'TBSLT'  'LTEXT',
    ' '  'KOART'  ' ' 'BSEG'   ' ',
    ' '  'SHKZG'  ' ' 'BSEG'   ' ',
    ' '  'FCSL'   ' ' 'BSEG'   ' ',
    ' '  'RFCCUR' ' ' 'BSEG'   ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text

FORM make_fcat USING pv_key pv_field pv_text pv_ref_table pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.

      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'RFCCUR'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_list
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_list .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
      is_variant      = gs_variant
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data

  so_burks-low = '0001'.

FORM modify_screen .

  LOOP AT SCREEN.

    CASE screen-group1.
      WHEN 'GP1'.
        screen-input = 0.
        MODIFY SCREEN.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form change_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM change_data .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CASE gs_data-shkzg.

      WHEN 'H'.
        gs_data-fcsl *= -1.

    ENDCASE.

    gs_data-rfccur = 'KRW'.
    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING fcsl rfccur.

  ENDLOOP.

  CLEAR lv_tabix.

ENDFORM.

    CASE screen-group1.
      WHEN 'GP1'.
        screen-input = 0.
        MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~ebeln a~bukrs a~bstyp a~bsart
         b~ebelp b~matnr b~werks b~menge b~meins
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM ekko AS a
   INNER JOIN ekpo AS b
      ON a~ebeln EQ b~ebeln
   WHERE a~bukrs EQ pa_bukrs
     AND a~ebeln IN so_ebeln.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.

    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = TEXT-g01. "ALV Training .
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.

  gs_stable-col = 'X'.
  gs_stable-row = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
    'X'  'EBELN'  ' ' 'EKKO'  ' ',
    'X'  'EBELP'  ' ' 'EKPO'  ' ',
    ' '  'BSTYP'  ' ' 'EKKO'  ' ',
    ' '  'BSART'  ' ' 'EKKO'  ' ',
    ' '  'BATXT'  ' ' 'T161T' ' ',
    ' '  'MATNR'  ' ' 'EKPO'  ' ',
    ' '  'MAKTX'  ' ' 'MAKT'  ' ',
    ' '  'WERKS'  ' ' 'EKPO'  ' ',
    ' '  'MENGE'  ' ' 'EKPO'  ' ',
    ' '  'MEINS'  ' ' 'EKPO'  ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ENDFORM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat USING pv_key pv_field pv_text pv_ref_table pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'MENGE'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_text .

  CLEAR   : gs_t161t, gs_makt.
  REFRESH : gt_t161t, gt_makt.

  SELECT bsart bstyp batxt
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_t161t
    FROM t161t
   WHERE spras EQ sy-langu.

  SELECT matnr maktx
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_makt
    FROM makt
   WHERE spras EQ sy-langu.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form move_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM move_data .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO gs_data2.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    READ TABLE gt_t161t INTO gs_t161t WITH KEY bsart = gs_data2-bsart
                                               bstyp = gs_data2-bstyp.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      gs_data2-batxt = gs_t161t-batxt.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE gt_makt INTO gs_makt WITH KEY matnr = gs_data2-matnr.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      gs_data2-maktx = gs_makt-maktx.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND gs_data2 TO gt_data2.
    CLEAR  gs_data2.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_list
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_list .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data2
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_Stable = gs_stable.

ENDFORM.

FORM get_flight .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~carrid a~currcode "scarr
         b~connid b~airpfrom b~airpto b~fltype"spfli
         c~fldate c~price  "sflight
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data

        screen-input = 0.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT  a~blart a~budat  "bkpf header
          b~belnr b~buzei b~bschl b~koart "bseg Segment
          b~gsber b~shkzg b~dmbtr b~pswsl
          c~ltext
          d~gtext
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM bkpf AS a
   INNER JOIN bseg AS b
      ON a~bukrs EQ b~bukrs
     AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr
     AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
    LEFT OUTER JOIN t003t AS c
      ON a~blart EQ c~blart
     AND c~spras EQ sy-langu
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tgsbt AS d
      ON b~gsber EQ d~gsber
     AND d~spras EQ sy-langu

  SELECT company plant storage material
         mat_desc serial_no quantity unit
         unit_price price_key use_yn
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM zc505t0032
   WHERE company EQ pa_com

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING pv_key
                      pv_field
                      pv_text
                      pv_ref_table
                      pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'QUANTITY'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum = 'X'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'UNIT'.
    WHEN 'UNIT_PRICE'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum = 'X'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'PRICE_KEY'.
    WHEN 'USE_YN'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat
      it_sort         = gt_sort.

Code listing for: ZC505R0023_F01
Description: Include ZC505R0023_F01 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505R0023_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~ebeln a~bukrs a~bstyp a~bsart
         b~ebelp b~matnr b~werks b~ktmng b~meins
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM ekko AS a
   INNER JOIN ekpo AS b
      ON a~ebeln EQ b~ebeln
   WHERE a~ebeln IN so_ebeln.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-ctab_fname = 'COLOR'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
    'X' 'EBELN' ' '    'EKKO'     ' ',
    'X' 'EBELP' ' '    'EKPO'     ' ',
    ' ' 'BUKRS' ' '    'EKKO'     ' ',
    ' ' 'BSTYP' ' '    'EKKO'     ' ',
    ' ' 'BSART' ' '    'EKKO'     ' ',
    ' ' 'MATNR' ' '    'EKPO'     ' ',
    ' ' 'WERKS' ' '    'EKPO'     ' ',
    ' ' 'KTMNG' ' '    'EKPO'     ' ',
    ' ' 'MEINS' ' '    'EKPO'     ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING pv_key
                      pv_field
                      pv_text
                      pv_ref_table
                      pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'KTMNG'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
    WHEN 'MATNR'.
      gs_fcat-emphasize = 'C510'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat
      it_sort         = gt_sort.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable = gs_stable.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form sort_table
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM sort_table .

  gs_sort-fieldname = 'EBELN'.
  gs_sort-spos      = '01'.
  gs_sort-up        = 'X'.
  gs_sort-subtot    = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_sort TO gt_sort.
  CLEAR  gs_sort.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_color
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_color .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_color TYPE lvc_s_scol.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    IF gs_data-ktmng LE 5000.

      ls_color-fname     = 'KTMNG'.
      ls_color-color-col = 6.
      ls_color-color-int = 0.
      ls_color-color-inv = 0.

      APPEND ls_color TO gs_data-color.
      CLEAR ls_color.

    ENDIF.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING color.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_scarr.
  REFRESH : gt_scarr.

  SELECT carrid carrname currcode url
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_scarr
    FROM scarr
   WHERE carrid IN so_carr
   ORDER BY carrid.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING. "selection Screen 안에서만 쓸 수 있음.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_loop
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM data_loop .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_scarr INTO gs_scarr.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CASE gs_scarr-carrid.
      WHEN 'JL'.
        gs_scarr-carrid   = 'KA'.
        gs_scarr-carrname = 'Korean Air'.
        gs_scarr-currcode = 'KRW'.
        gs_scarr-url      = 'www.korean-air.co.kr'.

        MODIFY gt_scarr FROM gs_scarr INDEX lv_tabix
        TRANSPORTING carrid carrname currcode url.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

  so_carr-option = 'EQ'.

  APPEND so_carr.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gt_mat.
  REFRESH : gt_mat.

  SELECT a~matnr a~mtart a~matkl
         b~werks b~dispo b~ekgrp
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_mat
    FROM mara AS a
   INNER JOIN marc AS b
      ON a~matnr EQ b~matnr
   WHERE a~matnr IN so_matnr
     AND b~werks EQ pa_werks.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form data_desc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM data_desc .

  CLEAR   : gt_makt, gt_t023t, gt_t024d, gt_t024.
  REFRESH : gt_makt, gt_t023t, gt_t024d, gt_t024.

  SELECT matnr maktx
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_makt
    FROM makt
   WHERE spras = sy-langu.

  SELECT matkl wgbez
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_t023t
    FROM t023t

FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~bukrs a~gjahr a~belnr a~blart a~budat
         b~buzei b~bschl b~koart b~shkzg b~dmbtr b~pswsl
         c~ltext AS blart_txt
         d~ltext AS bschl_txt
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM bkpf AS a
   INNER JOIN bseg AS b
      ON a~bukrs EQ b~bukrs
     AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr
     AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
    LEFT OUTER JOIN t003t AS c
      ON  a~blart EQ c~blart
     AND c~spras EQ sy-langu
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tbslt AS d
      ON b~bschl EQ d~bschl
     AND b~umskz EQ d~umskz
     AND d~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE a~bukrs IN so_bukrs
     AND a~gjahr IN so_gjahr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text

FORM data_loop .

  DATA: lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    CLEAR : gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CASE gs_data-shkzg.
      WHEN 'H'.
        gs_data-dmbtr *= -1.

title: ZC505R_NOTE_01 · 20251121 Note 1
body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZC505R_NOTE_01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zc505r_note_01.

* 컨셉을 지역변수로 잡기
* 변수 선언하는 형식
* Data <변수명> Type <Built in> Length <길이> or <Dictionary>.
* CHAR 20 자리를 선언해보자

DATA lv_name TYPE c LENGTH 20. "원시적인 표현
DATA lv_name2(20) TYPE c. "Length 대체 표현
*TYPE 이 생략이 되면 기본 CHAR 타입이 된다.
DATA lv_name3(20). "CHAR type 길이 20 의 표현
DATA lv_name4. "CHAR type 길이 1 자리 (길이생략시 CHAR의 기본길이)

*DATA 가 너무 중복으로 나온다.

DATA : lv_name5(20) VALUE 'CODE1',
       lv_name6(20) VALUE 'CLASS 5',
       lv_name7(30) VALUE '페퍼로니피자 먹고 싶다',
       lv_numc1     TYPE n,
       lv_numc2(5)  TYPE n,
       lv_int1      TYPE i VALUE 1234,
       lv_pack(16)  TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '12343.23'. "소수점을 입력하고 싶을때는 '' 로 묶어주고 DECIMALS 2 작성

lv_numc2 = -1.
lv_int1 = - lv_int1. "-1 을 곱하는 약식 표현, 음수는 무조건 뒤에 붙는다.

*LV_INT1 *= -1. 이것도 가능하다

WRITE :/, lv_numc1, /,lv_numc2, lv_int1, lv_pack.
*WRITE : lv_name5,/, lv_name6,/, lv_name7.

* ACTIVE 된다? -> 에러가 없다는 것

* Data <변수명> LIKE <Local Type>/

DATA : lv_name8 LIKE lv_name5. "클론 똑같이 만들어주는 것이 LIKE 다
*값을 가져오는게 아니라 타입과 길이만 가져온다.

******************************실습1 ****************************************

DATA : lv_char20(20),
       lv_pack2(10)  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
       lv_numc3(8)   TYPE n VALUE '678'.

WRITE : /,lv_char20, lv_pack2, lv_numc3.

*****************************실습2*****************************************
DATA: lv_char10(10) VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJ',
      lv_numc4(10)  TYPE n VALUE '365',
      lv_int2       TYPE i VALUE 25,
      lv_pack3      TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '1.25'.

WRITE : /,lv_char10, lv_numc4, lv_int2, lv_pack3.

**********************************************************************
*ZC505DE_PA_NAME
*Global Data Type 중 Dictionary 를 이용해보자 : 단, Domain은 사용 못함
* 왜냐... 이미 Data Element 가 Domain 과 연결이 되어있을 수 있는 객체이므로

*Like 는 여기 소스 안에서만 돌고 type 은 dictionary 로 가서 확인한다.

DATA : lv_pa_name TYPE zc505de_pa_name,
       lv_matnr   TYPE matnr,
       lv_werks   TYPE werks_d, "data elemental 을 바로 입력
       lv_plant   TYPE zc531t0018-werks. "data elemental 이름이 기억이 안날때 ,
*이걸 가장 많이 사용한다. 왜? 데이터 엘리멘트를 알기가 힘들어서 테이블에 있는 필드를 입력한다.

lv_pa_name = '안녕'.

WRITE : /,lv_pa_name.

***************************실습3*******************************************

DATA : lv_count(3)  TYPE n,
       lv_descr(50),
       lv_qty       TYPE p DECIMALS 3,
       lv_material  TYPE matnr,
       lv_plant2    TYPE werks_d,
       lv_lgort     TYPE t001l-lgort.

*lv 는 로컬 데이터 타입  , 프로그램 안에서만 존재함 , gs 는 글로벌 전체에서 사용가능

DATA : lv_count2    LIKE lv_count,
       lv_descr2    LIKE lv_descr,
       lv_qty2      LIKE lv_qty,
       lv_material2 LIKE lv_material,
       lv_werks2    LIKE lv_plant2,
       lv_lgort2    LIKE lv_lgort.

WRITE : /, lv_plant2, lv_descr2, lv_qty2, lv_material2, lv_werks2, lv_lgort2.

* 가지고 올때는 이렇게
*for( let ls_data of lt_data )
* lt_data 의 필드 구조는 ls_data 가 정의한 장본인이다..
* 따라서  lt_data 의 필드구조와  ls_data  의 필드구조는 동일하다.

* 그럼 이제 저 스크립트의 문법을 ABAP 으로 표현해보자

*for(let ls_data of lt_data)랑 같다.

*  WRITE: /, ls_data-carrid, ls_data-carrname, ls_data-currkey, ls_data-price.

REPORT zc505r_note_11 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.

* 기본 변수 선언 - 집계 결과 저장
DATA : lv_cnt TYPE i,
       lv_sum TYPE sflight-price,
       lv_max TYPE sflight-price,
       lv_min TYPE sflight-price,
       lv_avg TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

* 변수 하나만 받는 경우
SELECT COUNT( * )
        INTO lv_cnt
        FROM sflight.
* 여러개의 변수에 받는 경우
SELECT COUNT( * ) SUM( price ) MAX( price )
       MIN( price ) AVG( price )
  INTO ( lv_cnt, lv_sum, lv_max, lv_min, lv_avg )
  FROM sflight.

WRITE : lv_cnt, lv_sum, lv_max, lv_min, lv_avg.


*********************************************************************
TABLES : sflight. " -> DATA sflight TYPE sflight. 가장  위에 올릴 것.
*내부적으로 sflight 구조 하나를 자동 선언한 효과

*DATA : gs_flight TYPE sflight,
*       gv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
**********************************************************************
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF BLOCK bl1 WITH FRAME TITLE TEXT-t01.

*  SELECT-OPTIONS : so_carr FOR gs_flight-carrid,
*                   so_car FOR gv_carrid.

*기존에 선언된 아이만 데리고 올 수 있다.
  "  - 기본적으로 LOW, HIGH 두 값 존재 (interval)
  "  - 다중 입력 가능
    "  - IN 조건으로 WHERE carrid IN so_car 형태로 사용


  SELECT-OPTIONS : so_car3 FOR sflight-carrid, "기본 형태: 값 여러 개 입력 가능, 범위도 가능
                   so_car4 FOR sflight-carrid NO INTERVALS, "high 값 입력 불가. "즉, 단일 값 여러 개만 입력 가능
                   so_car5 FOR sflight-carrid NO-EXTENSION, "NO-EXTENSION → 추가 행 입력 불가 (▶ 버튼 없앰)
                   so_car6 FOR sflight-carrid NO INTERVALS NO-EXTENSION. "parameter 처럼 보이게 하기!.

body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZC505R_NOTE_15
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zc505r_note_15 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.

DATA:BEGIN OF ls_post,
       bukrs TYPE bkpf-bukrs, "텍스트 필드 추가
       butxt TYPE t001-butxt,
       belnr TYPE bkpf-belnr,
       gjahr TYPE bkpf-gjahr,
       hkont TYPE bseg-hkont, "텍스트 필드 추가
       txt20 TYPE skat-txt20,
       dmbtr TYPE bseg-dmbtr,
       waers TYPE bkpf-waers,
       bschl TYPE bseg-bschl,
     END OF ls_post,

     lt_post  LIKE TABLE OF ls_post,

     ls_t001  TYPE t001,
     lt_t001  LIKE TABLE OF ls_t001,
     ls_skat  TYPE skat,
     lt_skat  LIKE TABLE OF ls_skat, "텅텅 비어있는 상태
     lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

CLEAR   : ls_post, ls_t001, ls_skat.
REFRESH : lt_post, lt_t001, lt_skat.

SELECT a~bukrs a~belnr a~gjahr a~waers
       b~hkont b~dmbtr b~bschl
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_post
  FROM bkpf AS a
 INNER JOIN bseg AS b
    ON a~bukrs EQ b~bukrs
   AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr
   AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
ORDER BY a~bukrs a~belnr DESCENDING a~gjahr. "SQL 통한 정렬

*ITAB 을 정렬
SORT lt_post BY bukrs belnr DESCENDING gjahr.

IF sy-subrc NE 0.
  MESSAGE s001.
  STOP.
ENDIF.

* lt_post 의 butxt, txt20 필드를 lt_t001 과 lt_skat itab을
* 이용해서 내역을 가져올거임
* 텍스트를 가져야할 itab 에 레코드를 미리 채워놔야함. 그래야 읽을 수 있다. 인터널 테이블 선언해봐야 데이터가 없음.

SELECT bukrs butxt
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_t001
  FROM t001. "얘는 텍스트 테이블이 아니라서 언어키 없음

*ktopl 은 'Int' 로 합시다.
SELECT saknr txt20
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_skat
  FROM skat "텍스트 테이블 기본 조건 언어키가 PK로 와야한다.
 WHERE spras = sy-langu "언어를 WHERE 로 빼는게 좋다. ITAB 에 넣으면 오래 걸린다. 미리 WHERE 에서 거르는게 좋다.
   AND ktopl = 'INT'.
*이제 텍스트를 가진 ITAB이 준비됐으니 ls_post 가
*텍스트 itab 을 이용해서 butxt, txt20 필드를 채워보자

LOOP AT lt_post INTO ls_post.
*butxt 채우기
*ls_post 의 어떤 필드로 lt_t001을 read 해야 할지 코딩

  lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

  READ TABLE lt_t001 INTO ls_t001 WITH KEY bukrs = ls_post-bukrs."ls_t001 의 bukrs 는 = ls_post-bukrs.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    ls_post-butxt = ls_t001-butxt. "post 값을 채우는게 목표

    MODIFY lt_post FROM ls_post INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING butxt.

  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_skat INTO ls_skat WITH KEY saknr = ls_post-hkont.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    ls_post-txt20 = ls_skat-txt20.

    MODIFY lt_post FROM ls_post INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING txt20.

  ENDIF.

*txt20 필드 채우기.

ENDLOOP.






*LOOP WHERE 구문을 사용해보자.

*gjahr 이 2025 인것만 찍어보자

*LOOP AT lt_post INTO ls_post WHERE gjahr EQ '2025'
*                               AND bschl EQ '40'. "OR AND 조건 사용 가능
*  WRITE : ls_post-gjahr, ls_post-belnr, ls_post-bschl,/. "2025만 뽑아온게 아니라 전체 레코드를 보고 찾은거임.
*
*ENDLOOP.


*where을 사용하지 말고 continue 사용해서 값 찍어보기
WRITE : '**********************************************************************',/.

LOOP AT lt_post INTO ls_post.

  IF ls_post-gjahr NE '2025' OR
     ls_post-bschl NE '40'.

    CONTINUE.

  ENDIF.

  WRITE : ls_post-gjahr, ls_post-belnr, ls_post-bschl,/.

ENDLOOP.


WRITE : '**********************************************************************',/.
*Internal Table 에서 특정조건의 레코드 한건을 읽어보자
*Loop 구문의 WHERE 는 READ TABLE 구문에서는 WITH KEY 구문, 여긴 무조건 and
READ TABLE lt_post INTO ls_post WITH KEY gjahr ='2025'
                                         bschl ='40'.

*READ TABLE 은 한번만 읽고 끝난다. 위에서 정렬을 했기 때문에 가장 위에 있는 값을 불러옴
*정렬 안했으면 어떤 값을 들고올지 모른다.

IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
  WRITE : ls_post-gjahr, ls_post-belnr, ls_post-bschl,/.
ENDIF.

*cl_demo_output=>display( lt_post ).

IF sy-subrc NE 0. "if 는 바로 앞에 것만 확인함.
  MESSAGE s001.

*MTART 텍스트 테이블 채우기
SELECT mtart mtbez

" 여기에는 if subrc 0 을 하면 안된다. 데이터가 있든 없든 출력하는게 목표, 데이터가 없어서 멈춰버리면 안된다.

SELECT mbrsh mbbez

* lt_post 의 butxt, txt20 필드를 lt_t001 과 lt_skat itab을

SELECT bukrs butxt
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_t001
  FROM t001. "얘는 텍스트 테이블이 아니라서 언어키 없음

*ktopl 은 'Int' 로 합시다.

  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_skat
  FROM skat "텍스트 테이블 기본 조건 언어키가 PK로 와야한다.

*txt20 필드 채우기.

REPORT zc505r_note_18 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.


DATA : BEGIN OF ls_bkpf,
         bukrs          TYPE bkpf-bukrs,
         belnr          TYPE bkpf-belnr,
         buzei          TYPE bseg-buzei,
         gjahr          TYPE bkpf-gjahr,
         blart          TYPE bkpf-blart,
         ltext          TYPE t003t-ltext, "텍스트 테이블
         budat          TYPE bkpf-budat,
         bldat          TYPE bkpf-bldat,
         bschl          TYPE bseg-bschl,
         koart          TYPE bseg-koart,
         koart_text(50),
         shkzg          TYPE bseg-shkzg,
         shkzg_text(20),
         dmbtr          TYPE bseg-dmbtr,
       END OF ls_bkpf,

       lt_bkpf  LIKE TABLE OF ls_bkpf,
       lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

*테이블, 변수 클리어
CLEAR   : ls_bkpf, lv_tabix.
REFRESH : lt_bkpf.

SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF BLOCK bl1 WITH FRAME TITLE TEXT-t01.

  PARAMETERS : pa_gjahr TYPE bkpf-gjahr OBLIGATORY DEFAULT '2010'."필수 입력, 기본값 '2010' 으로 설정

SELECTION-SCREEN END OF BLOCK bl1.

*INITIALIZATION. "초기값 설정
*  pa_gjahr = '2010'.
*
*START-OF-SELECTION.

  SELECT a~bukrs a~belnr a~gjahr a~blart a~budat a~bldat "bkpf 테이블
         b~buzei b~bschl b~koart b~shkzg b~dmbtr
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_bkpf
    FROM bkpf AS a
   INNER JOIN bseg AS b "HEADER 을 LEFT로 조인 실행
      ON a~bukrs EQ b~bukrs
     AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr
     AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
    LEFT OUTER JOIN t003t AS c
      ON a~blart EQ c~blart
   WHERE a~gjahr EQ pa_gjahr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT lt_bkpf INTO ls_bkpf.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CASE ls_bkpf-koart.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ls_bkpf-koart_text = 'Asset'.
      WHEN 'D'.
        ls_bkpf-koart_text = 'Customers'.
      WHEN 'K'.
        ls_bkpf-koart_text = 'Suppliers'.
      WHEN 'M'.
        ls_bkpf-koart_text = 'Material'.
      WHEN 'S'.
        ls_bkpf-koart_text = 'G/L Account'.
    ENDCASE.
    "shkzg 가 H, S 일때 아래의 값으로 변경

title: ZC505R_NOTE_22 · 인터널 테이블 스트럭처 개념
body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZC505R_NOTE_22
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zc505r_note_22 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.

TYPES : gty_marc  TYPE marc, "Structure . gty = Structure type .
        gtt_marc  TYPE TABLE OF marc, "ITAB --> Table Type .
        gtt_marc2 TYPE TABLE OF gty_marc, "Table Type,  Like 로 적으면 에러, 여긴 TYPE 만 가능
*        gtt_marc3 TYPE gtt_marc,  "이러면 에러가 난다. data 랑 다름
        gty_marc2 TYPE LINE OF gtt_marc, "Structure Type . Line of 를 적어주지 않으면 에러 발생.

        BEGIN OF gty_line,
          belnr TYPE bkpf-belnr,
          gjahr TYPE bkpf-gjahr,
          bukrs TYPE bkpf-bukrs,
        END OF gty_line. "type 로 선언했기 때문에 변수로 사용이 불가핟.
*types는 저장 기능은 없다. 변수가 아님. 설계도라고 생각하기.
* 이걸 가지고 실행하는건 데이터

* TYPES 를 언제쓸까? 자주 사용하는 타입들이 중복될때 그걸 묶어서 INCLUDE TYPE 해준다. 그럼 편리하다.

*Types 를 이용한 객체 선언
DATA: gs_marc  TYPE gty_marc, " Like 는 데이터를 선언한 것을 가져올때 쓰는것, 그래서 type을 써야한다.
      gt_marc  TYPE TABLE OF gty_marc, "ITAB  .
      gt_marc2 TYPE gtt_marc, "ITAB, 밑에 있는  gt_mara3 LIKE gt_mara 랑 같다.
      gs_marc2 TYPE LINE OF gtt_marc, "Structure, 테이블을 참조하는 스트럭쳐를 선언하고 싶을때 .

      BEGIN OF gs_list,
        matnr TYPE gty_marc-matnr, "Types 에 있기 때문에 Like 불가  .
        werks TYPE marc-werks.
        INCLUDE TYPE gty_line. " INCLUDE STRUCTURE 불가.
*       INCLUDE TYPE scarr. "scarr 은 테이블이지만 들어간다. 하지만 딕셔너리에 있는 걸 사용할때는 INCLUDE STRUCTURE 를 사용할 것
        INCLUDE STRUCTURE scarr.
DATA : mara  TYPE mara-matnr,
      END OF gs_list.


* 인터널 테이블, 스트럭처 개념  .
DATA : gs_mara  TYPE mara,             "Structure    .
       gt_mara  LIKE TABLE OF gs_mara, "ITAB  .
       gt_mara2 TYPE TABLE OF mara, "ITAB   .
       gs_mara2 LIKE gs_mara,       "Structure  .
       gt_mara3 LIKE gt_mara,       "ITAB . LIKE 는 똑같이 복사한다. 그래서 TABLE OF 를 쓰지 않아도 테이블이 된다.
       gs_mara3 LIKE LINE OF gt_mara. " LINE OF 가 없으면 ITAB, 적어주면 Structure 가 된다. line 구조만 가져오고 싶음

body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZC505R_NOTE_23
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zc505r_note_23 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.

DATA : gs_scarr   TYPE scarr,
       gt_scarr   LIKE TABLE OF gs_scarr,
       gt_scarr_h LIKE TABLE OF gs_scarr WITH HEADER LINE,
       lv_tabix   TYPE sy-tabix.

gt_scarr_h-carrid = '10'.
CLEAR : gs_scarr, gt_scarr, gt_scarr_h[]. "gt_scarr_h 는 header 를 클리어 하는 것. [] 를 붙이면 body 도 클리어 가능
REFRESH : gt_scarr, gt_scarr_h. "Refresh = ITAB 전용, 그래서 gt_Scarr_h 라고 넣으면 자동으로 body 를 클리어한다.

*Refresh 는 헤더 청소를 못 함 body만 청소 가능.
*clear 는 전부 본다. header 랑 body .

SELECT carrid carrname currcode url
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_scarr_h
  FROM scarr.

IF sy-subrc NE 0.
  MESSAGE s001.
  STOP.
ENDIF.

*gt_scarr_h 에 있는 레코드에서 carrid 필드의 값이 'JL' 인 경우
*'KA' 로 바꾸고 carrname 을 'Korean Air'로 바꿀것

LOOP AT gt_scarr_h.

  lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

  CASE gt_scarr_h-carrid.
    WHEN 'JL'.
      gt_scarr_h-carrid = 'KA'.
      gt_scarr_h-carrname = 'Korean Air'.

      MODIFY gt_scarr_h INDEX lv_tabix TRANSPORTING carrid carrname.
  ENDCASE.

ENDLOOP.

cl_demo_output=>display( gt_scarr_h[] ).

REPORT zc505r_tomato1 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.

TABLES :mast, stko.

DATA : BEGIN OF gs_mat,
         matnr  TYPE mast-matnr,
         maktx  TYPE makt-maktx,
         werks  TYPE mast-werks,
         name1  TYPE t001w-name1,
         stlty  TYPE stko-stlty,
         stlan  TYPE mast-stlan,
         stlnr  TYPE stko-stlnr,
         stlkn  TYPE stpo-stlkn,
         stlal  TYPE stko-stlal,
         stkoz  TYPE stko-stkoz,
         andat  TYPE stko-andat,
         postp  TYPE stpo-postp,
         ptext  TYPE t418t-ptext,
         bmein  TYPE stko-bmein,
         stpoz  TYPE stpo-stpoz,
         idnrk  TYPE stpo-idnrk,
         maktx2 TYPE makt-maktx,
         menge  TYPE stpo-menge,
         posnr  TYPE stpo-posnr,
       END OF gs_mat,

       gt_mat   LIKE TABLE OF gs_mat,
       lv_space TYPE stpo-postp.

CLEAR   : gs_mat, lv_space.
REFRESH : gt_mat.


SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF BLOCK bl1 WITH FRAME TITLE TEXT-001.

  PARAMETERS : pa_werk TYPE mast-werks OBLIGATORY DEFAULT '0001'.

  SELECT-OPTIONS : so_ma FOR mast-matnr,  "인터널 테이블
                   so_st FOR stko-stlnr.

               pa_ra2 RADIOBUTTON GROUP rb1,
               pa_ra3 RADIOBUTTON GROUP rb1.

    lv_space = 'C'.

  WHEN pa_ra2.

    lv_space = 'L'.

ENDCASE.

       b~stlty b~stlnr b~stlal b~stkoz b~andat b~bmein "stko

FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~matnr a~mtart a~matkl
         b~werks b~pstat
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM mara AS a
    INNER JOIN marc AS b
      ON a~matnr EQ b~matnr
   WHERE a~matnr IN so_matnr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_matnr_desc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_matnr_desc .

  DATA : lv_code,
         lv_msg(100),
         lv_tabix    TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    call function 'ZC505FM_GET_MAKTX'
      EXPORTING " program - >funtion / 오른쪽에서 왼쪽으로 데이터가 들어감.
        iv_matnr = gs_data-matnr
        iv_spras = sy-langu
      IMPORTING "Funtion -> Program / 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 데이터를 받아온다.
        ev_maktx = gs_data-maktx
        pe_code  = lv_code
        pe_msg   = lv_msg.

*      EXCEPTIONS
*        matnr_required = 1
*        data_not_found = 2
*        OTHERS         = 3.

*    CASE sy-subrc.
*      WHEN 0.
*        MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
*        TRANSPORTING maktx.
*    ENDCASE.

    CASE lv_code.
      WHEN 'S'.
        MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
        TRANSPORTING maktx.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

FORM get_data .

  DATA : lt_data     LIKE gt_data, "ITAB
         lt_post     TYPE zc505tt003, "gt_data 와 et_data 필드 구조가 다르기 때문에 동일한 구조를 가진 itab 을 선언
         lv_code,
         lv_msg(100),
         lcl_posting TYPE REF TO zc505cl001.

  CLEAR   : gs_data, lv_code, lv_msg.
  REFRESH : gt_data, lt_data, lt_post.

*  PERFORM get_posting   TABLES lt_data
*                      CHANGING lv_code lv_msg.

*  CALL FUNCTION 'ZC505FM_GET_POSTING'
*    EXPORTING "EXPORTING = 보내는 방향 pa_bukrs  ──▶ iv_bukrs
*      iv_bukrs = pa_bukrs "Program → Function (보낸다)
*      iv_gjahr = pa_gjahr
*    IMPORTING "IMPORTING = 받는 방향
*      ev_code  = lv_code "Function → Program (받는다)
*      ev_msg   = lv_msg "함수가 처리한 결과(code, msg)를 내가 받겠다”
*    TABLES
*      et_data  = gt_data.
*함수와 프로그램이 같은 내부테이블을 공유
*사실상 CHANGING과 같은 방향 (양방향)

  IF lcl_posting IS NOT BOUND.
    CREATE OBJECT lcl_posting.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD lcl_posting->get_posting
    EXPORTING
      iv_bukrs = pa_bukrs
      iv_gjahr = pa_gjahr
    IMPORTING
      ev_code  = lv_code
      ev_msg   = lv_msg
    CHANGING
      et_data  = lt_post.

"펑션이랑 메소드는 필드 구조를 똑같이 해야함.

  IF lv_code NE 'S'.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_post to gt_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_text

*& <--  p2        text

FORM get_text .

  DATA : lv_code,
         lv_msg(100),
         lv_tabix    TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.
    CLEAR: lv_code, lv_msg.
    call function 'ZC505FM_GET_BLART_LTEXT'
      EXPORTING
        iv_blart = gs_data-blart
        iv_spras = sy-langu
      IMPORTING
        ev_ltext = gs_data-ltext
        ev_code  = lv_code
        ev_msg   = lv_msg.

    CASE lv_code.
      WHEN 'S'.
        MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
        TRANSPORTING ltext.
    ENDCASE.

    call function 'ZC505FM_GET_GSBER_GTEXT'
      EXPORTING
        iv_gsber = gs_data-gsber
        iv_spras = sy-langu
      IMPORTING
        ev_gtext = gs_data-gtext
        ev_code  = lv_code
        ev_msg   = lv_msg.

    CASE lv_code.
      WHEN 'S'.
        MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
        TRANSPORTING gtext.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

FORM make_fcat  USING pv_key
                      pv_field
                      pv_text
                      pv_ref_table
                      pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.

*& Form get_posting
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DATA
*&      <-- LV_CODE
*&      <-- LV_MSG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_posting  TABLES   pt_data LIKE gt_data
                  CHANGING pv_code
                           pv_msg.

  SELECT a~blart a~budat
         b~belnr b~buzei b~bschl b~koart
         b~gsber b~shkzg b~dmbtr b~pswsl
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE pt_data
    FROM bkpf AS a
   INNER JOIN bseg AS b
      ON a~bukrs EQ b~bukrs
     AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr
     AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
   WHERE a~bukrs EQ pa_bukrs
     AND a~gjahr EQ pa_gjahr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    pv_code = 'E'.
    pv_msg  = 'Data not found'.
  ELSE.
    pv_code = 'S'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*& Form set_color
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_color .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_color TYPE lvc_s_scol.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

*    gs_data-status = icon_transport.

    CASE gs_data-budat.
      WHEN '20101204'.
        ls_color-fname = 'BUDAT'.
        ls_color-color-col = 3.
        ls_color-color-int = 0.
        ls_color-color-inv = 0.
        APPEND ls_color TO gs_data-color.
    ENDCASE.

    CASE gs_data-pswsl.

      WHEN 'KRW'.
        gs_data-pswsl  = '원화'.
        ls_color-fname = 'DMBTR'.
        ls_color-color-col = 4.
        ls_color-color-int = 0.
        ls_color-color-inv = 0.
        APPEND ls_color TO gs_data-color.

      WHEN 'EUR'.
        gs_data-pswsl  = '유로'.
        ls_color-fname = 'DMBTR'.
        ls_color-color-col = 3.
        ls_color-color-int = 0.
        ls_color-color-inv = 0.
        APPEND ls_color TO gs_data-color.

    ENDCASE.


    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING pswsl color.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'. "행배경 줄무늬
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.  "컬럼폭 자동 최적화
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.  "행단위 선택

  gs_stable-row = 'X'. "행 유지
  gs_stable-col = 'X'. "컬럼 유지

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'STATUS'  TEXT-f01        ''  ' ',
     'X' 'CARRID'     ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
     'X' 'CONNID'     ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
     'X' 'FLDATE'     ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
     ' ' 'PRICE'      ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
     ' ' 'CURRENCY'   ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
     ' ' 'PLANETYPE'  ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
     ' ' 'SEATSMAX'   ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
     ' ' 'SEATSOCC'   ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
     ' ' 'PAYMENTSUM' ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',

     ' ' 'SEATSOCC_B' ' '   'SFLIGHT'  ' ',

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key pv_field pv_text pv_ref_table pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'PRICE'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'CURRENCY'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
    WHEN 'PAYMENTSUM'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'CURRENCY'.
*      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
    WHEN 'STATUS'.
      gs_fcat-icon = 'X'.
    WHEN OTHERS.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat
      it_sort         = gt_sort.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING

  gs_sort-subtot    = 'X'.

  gs_sort-up        = 'X'.

FORM set_icon .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    gs_data-status = icon_ws_plane.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING status.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

Description: Include ZC505R0029_F01 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  CASE 'X'.
    WHEN rb_func.
      PERFORM get_data_function.

    WHEN rb_meth.
      PERFORM get_data_method.

    WHEN rb_form.
      PERFORM get_data_form.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_function
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_function .

  DATA : lv_code,
         lv_msg(100),
         lt_data        TYPE zc505tt006.

  call function 'ZC505FM_GET_EKKO'
    EXPORTING
      iv_bukrs = pa_bukrs
    IMPORTING
      ev_code  = lv_code
      ev_msg   = lv_msg
    TABLES
      et_data  = lt_data
      it_ebeln = so_ebeln.

  IF lv_code NE 'S'.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.

  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Function 화면입니다.'.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_data TO gt_data.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_method
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_method .

  DATA : lv_code,
         lv_msg(100),
         lt_data        TYPE zc505tt006,

         lcl_purchasing TYPE REF TO zc505cl002.

  IF lcl_purchasing IS NOT BOUND.

    CREATE OBJECT lcl_purchasing.

  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD lcl_purchasing->get_purchasing_info
    EXPORTING
      iv_bukrs = pa_bukrs
      it_ebeln = so_ebeln[]
    IMPORTING
      ev_code  = lv_code
      ev_msg   = lv_msg
    CHANGING
      et_data  = lt_data.

  IF lv_code NE 'S'.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.

  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Method 화면입니다.'.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_data TO gt_data.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_form
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_form .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~ebeln a~bukrs a~bstyp a~bsart
         b~ebelp b~matnr b~werks b~ktmng b~meins
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM ekko AS a
   INNER JOIN ekpo AS b
      ON a~ebeln EQ b~ebeln
   WHERE a~bukrs EQ pa_bukrs
     AND a~ebeln IN so_ebeln.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Form 화면입니다.'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_init
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_init .

  pa_bukrs = '0001'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Purchasing'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.
  gs_layout-ctab_fname = 'COLOR'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'STATUS' TEXT-f01 '' '', "Status
     'X' 'EBELN' ' ' 'EKKO' ' ',
     'X' 'EBELP' ' ' 'EKPO' ' ',
     ' ' 'BUKRS' ' ' 'EKKO' ' ',
     ' ' 'BSTYP' ' ' 'EKKO' ' ',
     ' ' 'BSART' ' ' 'EKKO' ' ',
     ' ' 'MATNR' ' ' 'EKPO' ' ',
     ' ' 'WERKS' ' ' 'EKPO' ' ',
     ' ' 'KTMNG' ' ' 'EKPO' ' ',
     ' ' 'MEINS' ' ' 'EKPO' ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING pv_key pv_field pv_text pv_ref_table pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'MATNR'.
      gs_fcat-emphasize = 'C510'.
    WHEN 'KTMNG'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_color
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_color .

  DATA : ls_color TYPE lvc_s_scol,
         lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  CLEAR  : ls_color, lv_tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    IF gs_data-ktmng LE 5000.

      ls_color-fname     = 'KTMNG'.
      ls_color-color-col = '3'.
      ls_color-color-int = '0'.
      ls_color-color-inv = '0'.

      APPEND ls_color TO gs_data-color.
      CLEAR  ls_color.

    ENDIF.

    IF gs_data-meins EQ 'EA'.

      gs_data-status = icon_transport.

    ELSE.

      gs_data-status = icon_flight.

    ENDIF.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING status color.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_sort
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_sort .

  gs_sort-fieldname = 'EBELN'.
  gs_sort-spos      = '01'.
  gs_sort-up        = 'X'.
  gs_sort-subtot    = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_sort TO gt_sort.
  CLEAR  gs_sort.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat
      it_sort         = gt_sort.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form radio_uc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM radio_uc .

  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'UC'.

      CLEAR gt_data.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_scarr
    FROM scarr

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = TEXT-f01. "'ALV Custom Training'
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'CARRID'   ' ' 'SCARR'  ' ',
     ' ' 'CARRNAME' ' ' 'SCARR'  ' ',
     ' ' 'CURRCODE' ' ' 'SCARR'  ' ',
     ' ' 'URL'      ' ' 'SCARR'  ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING pv_key
                      pv_field
                      pv_text
                      pv_ref_table
                      pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER'.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  IF gcl_grid IS NOT BOUND.

    CREATE OBJECT gcl_handler.

  ENDIF.

*  SET HANDLER : gcl_handler->handle_double_click FOR gcl_grid.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_scarr
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

    EXPORTING

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

                                   ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR : gs_scarr.

  READ TABLE gt_scarr INTO gs_scarr INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  MESSAGE i000 WITH gs_scarr-url.

ENDFORM.

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT carrid connid fldate planetype
         price paymentsum currency
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM sflight

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.

  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.

  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

     'X' 'CARRID'     ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
     'X' 'CONNID'     ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
     'X' 'FLDATE'     ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
     ' ' 'PLANETYPE'  ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
     ' ' 'PRICE'      ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&      --> P_

  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.

    WHEN 'PRICE' OR 'PAYMENTSUM'.

    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

      i_default       = 'X'

    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.

    EXPORTING

    WHEN 'CARRID'.
      MESSAGE i000 WITH gs_data-carrid.
    WHEN 'PLANETYPE'.
      MESSAGE i000 WITH gs_data-planetype.
  ENDCASE.

  pa_pwerk = '0001'.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~aufnr a~gstrp a~gltrp a~plnbez a~gmein
         b~posnr b~matnr b~psmng b~amein b~bwtar
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM afko AS a
   INNER JOIN afpo AS b
      ON a~aufnr EQ b~aufnr
   WHERE a~plnbez IN so_pln
     AND b~pwerk EQ pa_pwerk.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'AUFNR'    ' '  'AFKO'  ' ',
     'X' 'POSNR'    ' '  'AFPO'  ' ',
     ' ' 'GSTRP'    ' '  'AFKO'  ' ',
     ' ' 'GLTRP'    ' '  'AFKO'  ' ',
     ' ' 'PLNBEZ'   ' '  'AFKO'  ' ',
     ' ' 'GAMNG'    ' '  'AFKO'  ' ',  "QUAN
     ' ' 'GMEIN'    ' '  'AFKO'  ' ',  "UNIT
     ' ' 'MATNR'    ' '  'AFPO'  ' ',
     ' ' 'PSMNG'    ' '  'AFPO'  ' ',  "QUAN
     ' ' 'AMEIN'    ' '  'AFPO'  ' ',  "UNIT
     ' ' 'BWTAR'    ' '  'AFPO'  ' '.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING pv_key pv_field pv_text pv_ref_table pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'GAMNG'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'GMEIN'.
    WHEN 'PSMNG'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'AMEIN'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_double_click FOR gcl_grid.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_double_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW
*&      --> E_COLUMN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_double_click  USING   ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                  ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR : gs_data.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'AUFNR'.
      SET PARAMETER ID 'ANR' FIELD gs_data-aufnr.

      CALL TRANSACTION 'CO03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

    WHEN 'MATNR'.
      SET PARAMETER ID 'MAT' FIELD gs_data-matnr.

      CALL TRANSACTION 'MM03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

  _clear : gs_scarr gt_scarr.

  SELECT a~carrid a~carrname "scarr
         b~connid b~airpfrom b~airpto b~distance b~distid
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_scarr
    FROM scarr AS a

Description: Include ZC505R0042_F01 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505R0042_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_init
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_init .

  pa_bukrs = '0001'.
  pa_gjahr = '2010'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  SELECT a~blart a~budat "BKPF
         b~belnr b~buzei b~bschl b~koart b~gsber "BSEG
         b~shkzg b~hkont b~dmbtr b~pswsl
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM bkpf AS a
   INNER JOIN bseg AS b
      ON a~bukrs EQ b~bukrs
     AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr
     AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr
   WHERE a~bukrs EQ pa_bukrs
     AND a~gjahr EQ pa_gjahr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Company info'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
    'X' 'BELNR' ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    'X' 'BUZEI' ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'BLART' ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    ' ' 'BUDAT' ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    ' ' 'BSCHL' ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'KOART' ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'GSBER' ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'SHKZG' ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'HKONT' ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'DMBTR' ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'PSWSL' ' ' 'BSEG' ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key
                       pv_field
                       pv_text
                       pv_ref_table
                       pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'BELNR'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DMBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'PSWSL'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  IF gcl_handler IS NOT BOUND.
    CREATE OBJECT gcl_handler.
  ENDIF.

  SET HANDLER : gcl_handler->handle_hotspot_click FOR gcl_grid,
                gcl_handler->handle_double_click  FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot_click  USING  ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                  ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL. "소계/합계 행 더블클릭 방지
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index. ""실제 클릭된 행 데이터 가져오기

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname. "'BELNR' 컬럼을 클릭했을때만 동작
    WHEN 'BELNR'.
      PERFORM move_fb03 USING gs_data-belnr.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_double_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW
*&      --> E_COLUMN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_double_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                   ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.


  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'HKONT'.
      PERFORM move_faglb03 USING gs_data-hkont.
  ENDCASE.

  CLEAR gs_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form move_faglb03
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_DATA_HKONT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM move_faglb03  USING  pv_hkont.

  SET PARAMETER ID : 'ACC' FIELD gs_data-hkont,
                     'BUK' FIELD pa_bukrs,
                     'GJR' FIELD pa_gjahr.

  CALL TRANSACTION 'FAGLB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form move_fb03
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_DATA_BELNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM move_fb03  USING    p_gs_data_belnr.

  SET PARAMETER ID : 'BLN' FIELD gs_data-belnr,
                     'BUK' FIELD pa_bukrs,
                     'GJR' FIELD pa_gjahr.

  CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
