*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_airline_data .

  CLEAR   : gs_airline.
  REFRESH : gt_airline.

  SELECT a~carrid a~carrname a~url
         b~connid b~fldate b~planetype b~price b~currency
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_airline
    FROM scarr AS a
   INNER JOIN sflight AS b
      ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
   WHERE a~carrid IN so_carr
     AND b~connid IN so_conn.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
    'X' 'CARRID   ' ' ' 'SCARR' ' ',
    'X' 'CONNID   ' ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
    'X' 'FLDATE   ' ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
    ' ' 'CARRNAME ' ' ' 'SCARR' ' ',
    ' ' 'PLANETYPE' ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',
    ' ' 'PRICE    ' ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ',  "CURR
    ' ' 'CURRENCY ' ' ' 'SFLIGHT' ' ', "CUKY
    ' ' 'URL      ' ' ' 'SCARR' ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key pv_field pv_text pv_ref_table pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'PRICE'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'CURRENCY'.
    WHEN 'PLANETYPE'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_airline_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_airline_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot_click FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_double_click FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_airline
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                    ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_airline INTO gs_airline INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'PLANETYPE'.

      PERFORM get_saplane USING gs_airline-planetype.

      IF gt_saplane IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Airline Plane not found'.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      CALL SCREEN '0101' STARTING AT 20 3.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_double_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW
*&      --> E_COLUMN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_double_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                   ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_airline INTO gs_airline INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'PLANETYPE'.
      EXIT.
    WHEN OTHERS.
      PERFORM get_sbook USING gs_airline-carrid
                              gs_airline-connid
                              gs_airline-fldate.

      IF gt_sbook IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Flight Booking not found'.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      CALL SCREEN '0102' STARTING AT 20 3.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_saplane
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_AIRLINE_PLANETYPE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_saplane  USING   pv_planetype.

  CLEAR   : gs_saplane.
  REFRESH : gt_saplane.

  SELECT planetype seatsmax tankcap
         cap_unit weight wei_unit
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_saplane
    FROM saplane
   WHERE planetype EQ pv_planetype.

ENDFORM.

FORM get_sbook  USING pv_carrid

FORM delete_data .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_airline INTO gs_airline.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    IF gs_airline-carrid NE 'AA'.

      DELETE gt_airline INDEX sy-tabix.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

*"*"Local Interface:
*"  IMPORTING

*"  EXPORTING
*"     REFERENCE(PE_CARRNAME) TYPE  S_CARRNAME
*"     REFERENCE(PE_CODE) TYPE  CHAR1

  SELECT SINGLE carrname
    INTO pe_carrname
    FROM scarr

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    pe_code    = 'E'.
    pe_msg     = 'Data not found'.
  ELSE.
    pe_code    = 'S'.
  ENDIF.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& Form get_idol

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_idol .

  _clear gs_idol gt_idol.

  SELECT group_id member_id member_name
         member_gender member_addr member_phone
         erdat erzet ernam aedat aezet aenam "Timestamp
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_idol
    FROM zc505t0040
   WHERE group_id EQ pa_grp. "aa

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .
  "db 에서 가져온 데이터 pk 는 수정 못하게
  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_idol INTO gs_idol.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_idol-style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'GROUP_ID'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_idol-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'MEMBER_ID'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_idol-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_idol FROM gs_idol INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
   'X' 'GROUP_ID'      ' ' 'ZC505T0040'  ' ' ' ',
   'X' 'MEMBER_ID'     ' ' 'ZC505T0040'  ' ' 'X',
   ' ' 'MEMBER_NAME'   ' ' 'ZC505T0040'  ' ' 'X',
   ' ' 'MEMBER_GENDER' ' ' 'ZC505T0040'  ' ' 'X',
   ' ' 'MEMBER_ADDR'   ' ' 'ZC505T0040'  ' ' 'X',
   ' ' 'MEMBER_PHONE'  ' ' 'ZC505T0040'  ' ' 'X'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field
                        pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.

FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.

FORM exclude_toolbar .

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_detail         TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo       TO gt_exclude.

ENDFORM.

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_idol.

  gs_idol-group_id = pa_grp.
*  gs_idol-member_id = gs_

  APPEND gs_idol TO gt_idol.
  CLEAR  gs_idol.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows "*삭제하기 위한 선택한 행의 번호를 가져오기
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING. "인터널 테이블의 row 를 삭제할때는 역순으로 지워야함.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row. "선택한 행을 읽어야하니까 gt_row 가 들어오는게 맞다.
* 삭제할 레코드를 gt_class_del로 옮기기.
    " 삭제 대상 데이터를 별도 ITAB에 보관 (DB DELETE용)
    READ TABLE gt_idol INTO gs_idol INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      APPEND gs_idol TO gt_idol_del.
      CLEAR  gs_idol.

      DELETE gt_idol INDEX gs_row-index.    " 원본 ITAB에서 해당 인덱스의 행 삭제, 인덱스 밀림을 방지
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid. "삭제할때만 refresh_grid 를 하기 위해서 여기에 넣는다.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  "그릇을 만들고 style

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0040, "Style 필드 때문에 바로 못쓴다. DB에 없는 필드가 섞여 있음
         lt_save LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del  LIKE TABLE OF ls_save.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data. "사용자가 ALV에서 수정한 값들을 gt_idol에 반영

  IF gt_idol_del IS NOT INITIAL. "삭제 대상이 있는지 확인.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_idol_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0040 FROM TABLE lt_del. "style 이 생겨서 안 맞음.

*    DELETE zc505t0040 FROM TABLE gt_idol_del.

*    IF lt_del IS NOT INITIAL. "?  .
*
*    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_idol INTO gs_idol. "TIME

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_idol TO ls_save.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "erdat 생성 날짜

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE. "기존에 있었을 경우
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL. "lt_save 가 초기값이 아니면 ~

    MODIFY zc505t0040 FROM TABLE lt_save. " pk 있으면 update, 없으면 insert

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0 . "방금 실행한 DB 명령으로 레코드 수 영향 받은게 0보다 많으면
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT. "DB 확정
      REFRESH gt_idol_del.

      MESSAGE s002.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant
      i_save               = 'A'
      i_default            = 'X'
      is_layout            = gs_layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_idol
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text

MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.

  CASE gv_okcode.
    WHEN 'REFRESH'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM get_idol.
      PERFORM set_style.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

    ' '  'EKGRP'   ' '  'ZC505T0042'  ' '  'X',

FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant
      i_save               = 'A'
      i_default            = 'X'
      is_layout            = gs_layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_mat
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR : gs_mat.

  gs_mat-werks = pa_werks.

  APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat.
  CLEAR gs_mat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .
  "db 에서 가져온 데이터 pk 는 수정 못하게
  "이거 조금 헷갈림

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_mat INTO gs_mat.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_mat-style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'MATNR'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_mat-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_mat FROM gs_mat INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0042, "style 테이블
         lt_save LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del  LIKE TABLE OF ls_save.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_mat_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_mat_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0042 FROM TABLE lt_del. " 여기 헷갈림

  ENDIF.

  "KEY 값이 없으면 저장이 안되게
  LOOP AT gt_mat INTO gs_mat.

    IF gs_mat-matnr IS NOT INITIAL.

      MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_mat TO ls_save.
      APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
      CLEAR : gs_mat, ls_save.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.


*  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_mat TO lt_save. "데이터 전달

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY zc505t0042 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

      REFRESH gt_mat_del.
      MESSAGE s002.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row. " 선택한 행을 읽기

    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat_del.
      CLEAR  gs_mat.

      DELETE gt_mat INDEX gs_row-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form exclude_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_toolbar .

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_detail         TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_refresh        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

ENDFORM.

  CLEAR gs_mat.

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .
  "db 에서 가져온 데이터 pk 는 수정 못하게
  "이거 조금 헷갈림

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_mat INTO gs_mat.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_mat-style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'MATNR'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_mat-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_mat FROM gs_mat INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0042, "style 테이블
         lt_save LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del  LIKE TABLE OF ls_save.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_mat_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_mat_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0042 FROM TABLE lt_del. " 여기 헷갈림

  ENDIF.

  "KEY 값이 없으면 저장이 안되게
  LOOP AT gt_mat INTO gs_mat.

    IF gs_mat-matnr IS NOT INITIAL.

      MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_mat TO ls_save.
      APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
      CLEAR : gs_mat, ls_save.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.


*  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_mat TO lt_save. "데이터 전달

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY zc505t0042 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

      REFRESH gt_mat_del.
      MESSAGE s002.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row. " 선택한 행을 읽기

    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat_del.
      CLEAR  gs_mat.

      DELETE gt_mat INDEX gs_row-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.

  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM zc505t0007.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Capital info'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.


  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'CAPITAL'      ' ' 'ZC505T0007' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'CAPITAL_DESC' ' ' 'ZC505T0007' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'COUNTRY'      ' ' 'ZC505T0007' ' ' 'X'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field
                        pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left
      extension = 5000.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant
      i_save               = 'A'
      i_default            = 'X'
      is_layout            = gs_layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style. "루프 돌때마다 빈값으로 만들어주기

    CLEAR ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'CAPITAL'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form exclude_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_toolbar .

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_detail         TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_refresh        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_data.

  APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
  CLEAR  gs_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0007,
         lt_save LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del  LIKE TABLE OF ls_save.

  CALL METHOD : gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

*delete
  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.
    DELETE zc505t0007 FROM TABLE lt_del.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    IF gs_data-capital IS NOT INITIAL.

      MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

      IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "이게 초기값이면

        ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
        ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
        ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

      ELSE.
        ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
        ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
        ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

      ENDIF.

      APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
      CLEAR  ls_save.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0007 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

      REFRESH gt_data_del.
      MESSAGE s002.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.             " Indexes of Selected Rows

"gt_row 가 선택하지 않으면 메세지 + exit.
  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.
"지우기 전에 sort 로 정리
  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.
"loop 돌리기 선택한 row를 찾아
  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0. "헷갈
      APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_del.
      CLEAR  gs_data.

      DELETE gt_data INDEX gs_row-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.

  LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

ENDMODULE.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.

  CASE gv_okcode.
    WHEN 'REFRESH'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM get_data.
      PERFORM set_style.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM create_row.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

    WHEN 'DELETE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM delete_row.

    WHEN 'SAVE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM save_data.

      PERFORM get_data.
      PERFORM set_style.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

  ENDCASE.

ENDMODULE.

  pa_class = 'CL5'.

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  IF pa_class IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input class Number' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

  DATA : lv_class TYPE zc531tclass-class.

*입력된 class 넘버가 유효한지 체크
  SELECT SINGLE class
    INTO lv_class
    FROM zc531tclass
   WHERE class = pa_class.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Invalid Class number' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_class .

  _clear gs_class gt_class.

  SELECT class cl_num name phone gender
         erdat  erzet ernam aedat aezet aenam
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_class
    FROM zc505t0002
   WHERE class EQ pa_class
   ORDER BY cl_num.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Student Info'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
      'X'  'CLASS'  ' ' 'ZC505T0002' ' ' ' ',
      'X'  'CL_NUM' ' ' 'ZC505T0002' ' ' 'X',
      ' '  'NAME'   ' ' 'ZC505T0002' ' ' 'X',
      ' '  'PHONE'  ' ' 'ZC505T0002' ' ' 'X',
      ' '  'GENDER' ' ' 'ZC505T0002' ' ' 'X'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_class INTO gs_class.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_class-style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'CL_NUM'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_class-style.
    CLEAR ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_class FROM gs_class INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

*& <--  p2        text

FORM exclude_toolbar .

*  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_detail         TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_refresh        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_mb_paste          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field
                        pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                           " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                   " Parent Container

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_data_changed FOR gcl_grid.

*ALV가 뭔가 수정하고 있음을 감지시킴
  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                " Event ID

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant             " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                    " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'                    " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout              " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude             " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_class                " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.                " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable             " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.             " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_class.

  gs_class-class = pa_class.
  gs_class-mark  = 'X'. "abap_true

  APPEND gs_class TO gt_class.
  CLEAR  gs_class.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  DATA : lv_cnt TYPE i,
         ls_del LIKE LINE OF gt_class_del. "이거의 장점 gt_class_del 이 바뀌어도 괜찮   .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.
  CLEAR : lv_cnt , ls_del.

*행번호 가져오기
  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                " Indexes of Selected Rows

*ITAB 의 행의 개수를 알아내는 법
*  DESCRIBE TABLE gt_row LINES lv_cnt.
  lv_cnt = lines( gt_row ). "lines 는 내부함수

*  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
  IF lv_cnt < 1. "행이 선택되지 않았을때.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.


*정렬

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_class INTO gs_class INDEX gs_row-index.


    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      "append 는 구조가 달라서 못함
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_class TO ls_del.

      APPEND ls_del TO gt_class_del.
      CLEAR  ls_del.

      DELETE gt_class INDEX gs_row-index. "gs_row-index 지우기 alv 화면
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING   pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.
  "인스턴스 LVC_T_MODI
  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.
*pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells , 이건 인터널 테이블이다.
  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi. "어디 바뀐지 알고 싶음, MARK 에 'X' 넣기

    READ TABLE gt_class INTO gs_class INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_class-mark = 'X'.

    MODIFY gt_class FROM gs_class INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505t0002,
         lt_save   TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0002,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save.
  CLEAR lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_class_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    DELETE zc505t0002 FROM TABLE gt_class_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_class INTO gs_class WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_class TO ls_save.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum. "시스템 현재 날짜
*      ls_save-erdat = sy-datlo. "현지 날짜
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit. "시스템 현재시간
*      ls_save-erzet = sy-timlo. "현지 시간
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum. "시스템 현재 날짜
*      ls_save-aedat = sy-datlo. "현지 날짜
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit. "시스템 현재시간
*      ls_save-aezet = sy-timlo. "현지 시간
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0002 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    REFRESH gt_class_del. "del 를 했으니까 클리어 해준다. 또 해줄 수 있음.

    PERFORM clear_mark.

    MESSAGE s002.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_class INTO gs_class WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CLEAR gs_class-mark.

    MODIFY gt_class FROM gs_class INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

*  MESSAGE i000 WITH gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ). "returning 값을 던져줌

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.

    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  DATA : lv_cnt TYPE i,
         ls_del LIKE LINE OF gt_class_del. "이거의 장점 gt_class_del 이 바뀌어도 괜찮   .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.
  CLEAR : lv_cnt , ls_del.

*행번호 가져오기
  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                " Indexes of Selected Rows

*ITAB 의 행의 개수를 알아내는 법
*  DESCRIBE TABLE gt_row LINES lv_cnt.
  lv_cnt = lines( gt_row ). "lines 는 내부함수

*  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
  IF lv_cnt < 1. "행이 선택되지 않았을때.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.


*정렬

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_class INTO gs_class INDEX gs_row-index.


    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      "append 는 구조가 달라서 못함
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_class TO ls_del.

      APPEND ls_del TO gt_class_del.
      CLEAR  ls_del.

      DELETE gt_class INDEX gs_row-index. "gs_row-index 지우기 alv 화면
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.

FORM handle_data_changed  USING   pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.
  "인스턴스 LVC_T_MODI
  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.
*pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells , 이건 인터널 테이블이다.
  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi. "어디 바뀐지 알고 싶음, MARK 에 'X' 넣기

    READ TABLE gt_class INTO gs_class INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_class-mark = 'X'.

    MODIFY gt_class FROM gs_class INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505t0002,
         lt_save   TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0002,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save.
  CLEAR lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_class_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    DELETE zc505t0002 FROM TABLE gt_class_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_class INTO gs_class WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_class TO ls_save.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum. "시스템 현재 날짜
*      ls_save-erdat = sy-datlo. "현지 날짜
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit. "시스템 현재시간
*      ls_save-erzet = sy-timlo. "현지 시간
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum. "시스템 현재 날짜
*      ls_save-aedat = sy-datlo. "현지 날짜
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit. "시스템 현재시간
*      ls_save-aezet = sy-timlo. "현지 시간
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0002 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    REFRESH gt_class_del. "del 를 했으니까 클리어 해준다. 또 해줄 수 있음.

    PERFORM clear_mark.

    MESSAGE s002.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_class INTO gs_class WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CLEAR gs_class-mark.

    MODIFY gt_class FROM gs_class INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

*  MESSAGE i000 WITH gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ). "returning 값을 던져줌

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.

    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM init_param .

  pa_werks = '0001'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.

  SELECT matnr werks ekgrp dispo beskz
         erdat erzet ernam
         aedat aezet aenam
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM zc505t0042
   WHERE werks EQ pa_werks
   ORDER BY matnr werks.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Matarial Info'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'MATNR' ' ' 'ZC505T0042' ' ' 'X', "이거 개념 헷갈림 EDIT
     'X' 'WERKS' ' ' 'ZC505T0042' ' ' ' ',
     ' ' 'EKGRP' ' ' 'ZC505T0042' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'DISPO' ' ' 'ZC505T0042' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'BESKZ' ' ' 'ZC505T0042' ' ' 'X'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field
                        pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form exclude_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_toolbar .

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_refresh        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_mb_paste          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                           " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                  " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_data_changed FOR gcl_grid. "이거 빼먹음

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                  " Event ID


  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant
      i_save               = 'A'                "
      i_default            = 'X'
      is_layout            = gs_layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable               " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.              " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_data.

  gs_data-werks = pa_werks.
  gs_data-mark  = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_data TO  gt_data.
  CLEAR  gs_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style ."이걸 왜했는지 헷갈림

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'MATNR'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled. " 이거 헷갈림

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'WERKS'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled. " 이거 헷갈림

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .
  DATA lv_cnt TYPE i.


  _clear gs_row gt_row.
  CLEAR lv_cnt.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  lv_cnt = lines( gt_row ). "행의 개수 파악

  IF lv_cnt < 1.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_del. "여기 헷갈림
      CLEAR gs_data.

      DELETE gt_data INDEX gs_row-index. "여기 헷갈림
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505t0042,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save.
  CLEAR lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0042 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0042 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    REFRESH gt_data_del. " 이거 이해 안돼

    PERFORM clear_mark. "지워주고

    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.

  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING    pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_param
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  DATA : lv_werks TYPE zc505t0042-werks.

  IF pa_werks IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE werks
    INTO lv_werks
    FROM t001w
    WHERE werks EQ pa_werks.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Invalid value' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  DATA : lv_korks TYPE zc505t0043-kokrs.

  IF pa_kokrs IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'input data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE kokrs
    INTO lv_korks
    FROM tka01
    WHERE kokrs EQ pa_kokrs.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Invalid value' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.
  REFRESH gt_data_del.

  SELECT a~kokrs a~kostl a~bukrs a~kosar a~verak
         a~wrbtr a~waers a~bkzer
         a~erdat a~erzet a~ernam
         a~aedat a~aezet a~aenam
         b~ltext
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM zc505t0043 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN cskt AS b
      ON  a~kokrs EQ b~kokrs
     AND a~kostl EQ b~kostl
     AND b~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE a~kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
   ORDER BY a~kokrs.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'KOKRS' ' ' 'ZC505T0043' ' ' ' ',
     'X' 'KOSTL' ' ' 'ZC505T0043' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'LTEXT' ' ' 'CSKT'       ' ' ' ',
     ' ' 'BUKRS' ' ' 'ZC505T0043' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'KOSAR' ' ' 'ZC505T0043' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'VERAK' ' ' 'ZC505T0043' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'WRBTR' ' ' 'ZC505T0043' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'WAERS' ' ' 'ZC505T0043' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'BKZER' ' ' 'ZC505T0043' ' ' 'X'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key
                       pv_field
                       pv_text
                       pv_ref_table
                       pv_ref_field
                       pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'WRBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
    WHEN 'BKZER'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.               " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                  " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_data_changed FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                 " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant                 " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout                " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude                 " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_data               " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.               " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable               " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_data.

  gs_data-kokrs = pa_kokrs.
  gs_data-mark  = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
  CLEAR  gs_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.            " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_data TO  gt_data_del.
      CLEAR gs_data.

      DELETE gt_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form exclude_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_toolbar .

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_refresh        TO gt_exclude.

MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.


  CASE gv_okcode.

    WHEN 'REFRESH'.              "조회/새로고침 버튼

      PERFORM refresh_grid.      "ALV 즉시 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.               "삭제 버튼
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM delete_row.        "선택 행 삭제 처리

      PERFORM get_data.          "DB 기준 재조회

      PERFORM refresh_grid.      "ALV 재표시

WHEN 'TOGGLE'.

  PERFORM toggle_display.

  ENDCASE.
