*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505R0053_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_init
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_init .

  pa_werks = '0001'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_param
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  DATA : lv_werks TYPE ZC505t0044-werks.

  IF pa_werks IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE werks
    INTO lv_werks
    FROM t001w
   WHERE werks = pa_werks.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Invalid data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.
  REFRESH gt_data_del.

  SELECT a~werks a~mtart a~flref a~envop
         a~kkref a~vmtpo a~menge a~meins
         a~erdat a~erzet a~ernam
         a~aedat a~aezet a~aenam
         b~mtbez
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM ZC505t0044 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN t134t AS b
      ON a~mtart EQ b~mtart
     AND b~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE werks   EQ pa_werks
   ORDER BY erdat erzet.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Materail Type Information'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'WERKS' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' ' ',
     'X' 'MTART' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'MTBEZ' ' ' 'T134T     ' ' ' ' ',
     ' ' 'FLREF' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'ENVOP' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'KKREF' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'VMTPO' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'MENGE' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'MEINS' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'ERDAT' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'ERZET' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key
                       pv_field
                       pv_text
                       pv_ref_table
                       pv_ref_field
                       pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'MENGE'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
    WHEN 'ENVOP'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox   = 'X'.
      gs_fcat-emphasize  = 'C500'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                           " Control Extension


  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.  " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_data_changed FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                  " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant                 " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                      " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'                     " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout                 " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude               " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_data                " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.               " Field Catalog


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                 " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_data.

  gs_data-werks = pa_werks.
  gs_data-mark  = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
  CLEAR  gs_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

*  REFRESH : gt_data_del. "????

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, Select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_del.
      CLEAR  gs_data.

      DELETE gt_data INDEX gs_row-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE ZC505t0044,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save. " 이거 까먹
  CLEAR : lv_commit. " 이거 까먹음.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE ZC505t0044 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

    CHECK gs_data-mtart IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "이거 못외움

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY ZC505t0044 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_data_del. " 이거 까먹음
    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  " 이거 조금 헷갈림

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.
    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

*    ls_style-fieldname = 'WERKS'.
*    ls_style-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.
*
*    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
*    CLEAR  ls_style.
*
    ls_style-fieldname = 'MTART'.
    ls_style-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.                " Ready for Input Status

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING  pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi,
         lv_mtbez TYPE t134t-mtbez.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE. " LOOP 로 돌아감
    ENDIF.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'MTART'.

        SELECT SINGLE mtbez
          INTO lv_mtbez
          FROM t134t
         WHERE mtart = ls_modi-value
           AND spras EQ sy-langu.

        CALL METHOD pcl_changed->modify_cell
          EXPORTING
            i_row_id    = ls_modi-row_id          " Row ID
            i_fieldname = 'MTBEZ'                 " Field Name
            i_value     = lv_mtbez.               " Value

    ENDCASE.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.


  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form exclude_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_toolbar .

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_refresh        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_mb_paste          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  DATA : lv_werks TYPE ZC505t0044-werks.

  IF pa_werks IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE werks
    INTO lv_werks
    FROM t001w
   WHERE werks = pa_werks.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Invalid data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.
  REFRESH gt_data_del.

  SELECT a~werks a~mtart a~flref a~envop
         a~kkref a~vmtpo a~menge a~meins
         a~erdat a~erzet a~ernam
         a~aedat a~aezet a~aenam
         b~mtbez
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM ZC505t0044 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN t134t AS b
      ON a~mtart EQ b~mtart
     AND b~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE werks   EQ pa_werks
   ORDER BY erdat erzet.

ENDFORM.

     'X' 'WERKS' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' ' ',

     ' ' 'MTBEZ' ' ' 'T134T     ' ' ' ' ',

*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key
                       pv_field
                       pv_text
                       pv_ref_table
                       pv_ref_field
                       pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'MENGE'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
    WHEN 'ENVOP'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox   = 'X'.
      gs_fcat-emphasize  = 'C500'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                           " Control Extension


  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.  " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_data_changed FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                  " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant                 " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                      " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'                     " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout                 " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude               " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_data                " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.               " Field Catalog


ENDFORM.

FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                 " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_data.

  gs_data-werks = pa_werks.
  gs_data-mark  = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
  CLEAR  gs_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

*  REFRESH : gt_data_del. "????

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, Select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_del.
      CLEAR  gs_data.

      DELETE gt_data INDEX gs_row-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE ZC505t0044,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save. " 이거 까먹
  CLEAR : lv_commit. " 이거 까먹음.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE ZC505t0044 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

    CHECK gs_data-mtart IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "이거 못외움

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY ZC505t0044 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_data_del. " 이거 까먹음
    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  " 이거 조금 헷갈림

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.
    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

*    ls_style-fieldname = 'WERKS'.
*    ls_style-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.
*
*    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
*    CLEAR  ls_style.
*
    ls_style-fieldname = 'MTART'.
    ls_style-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.                " Ready for Input Status

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING  pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi,
         lv_mtbez TYPE t134t-mtbez.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE. " LOOP 로 돌아감
    ENDIF.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'MTART'.

        SELECT SINGLE mtbez
          INTO lv_mtbez
          FROM t134t
         WHERE mtart = ls_modi-value
           AND spras EQ sy-langu.

        CALL METHOD pcl_changed->modify_cell
          EXPORTING
            i_row_id    = ls_modi-row_id          " Row ID
            i_fieldname = 'MTBEZ'                 " Field Name
            i_value     = lv_mtbez.               " Value

    ENDCASE.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.


  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& Form set_init

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_init .

  pa_werks = '0001'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_param
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  DATA : lv_werks TYPE ZC505t0044-werks.

  IF pa_werks IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE werks
    INTO lv_werks
    FROM t001w
   WHERE werks = pa_werks.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Invalid data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.
  REFRESH gt_data_del.

  SELECT a~werks a~mtart a~flref a~envop
         a~kkref a~vmtpo a~menge a~meins
         a~erdat a~erzet a~ernam
         a~aedat a~aezet a~aenam
         b~mtbez
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM ZC505t0044 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN t134t AS b
      ON a~mtart EQ b~mtart
     AND b~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE werks   EQ pa_werks
   ORDER BY erdat erzet.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Materail Type Information'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'WERKS' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' ' ',
     'X' 'MTART' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'MTBEZ' ' ' 'T134T     ' ' ' ' ',
     ' ' 'FLREF' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'ENVOP' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'KKREF' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'VMTPO' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'MENGE' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'MEINS' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'ERDAT' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X',
     ' ' 'ERZET' ' ' 'ZC505T0044' ' ' 'X'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key
                       pv_field
                       pv_text
                       pv_ref_table
                       pv_ref_field
                       pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'MENGE'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
    WHEN 'ENVOP'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox   = 'X'.
      gs_fcat-emphasize  = 'C500'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                           " Control Extension


  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.  " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_changed_finished FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                  " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant                 " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                      " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'                     " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout                 " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude               " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_data                " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.               " Field Catalog


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                 " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_data.

  gs_data-werks = pa_werks.
  gs_data-mark  = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
  CLEAR  gs_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

*  REFRESH : gt_data_del. "????

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, Select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_del.
      CLEAR  gs_data.

      DELETE gt_data INDEX gs_row-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE ZC505t0044,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save. " 이거 까먹
  CLEAR : lv_commit. " 이거 까먹음.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE ZC505t0044 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

    CHECK gs_data-mtart IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "이거 못외움

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY ZC505t0044 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_data_del. " 이거 까먹음
    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  " 이거 조금 헷갈림

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.
    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

*    ls_style-fieldname = 'WERKS'.
*    ls_style-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.
*
*    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
*    CLEAR  ls_style.
*
    ls_style-fieldname = 'MTART'.
    ls_style-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.                " Ready for Input Status

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING  pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi,
         lv_mtbez TYPE t134t-mtbez.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE. " LOOP 로 돌아감
    ENDIF.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'MTART'.

        SELECT SINGLE mtbez
          INTO lv_mtbez
          FROM t134t
         WHERE mtart = ls_modi-value
           AND spras EQ sy-langu.

        CALL METHOD pcl_changed->modify_cell
          EXPORTING
            i_row_id    = ls_modi-row_id          " Row ID
            i_fieldname = 'MTBEZ'                 " Field Name
            i_value     = lv_mtbez.               " Value

    ENDCASE.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.


  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form exclude_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_toolbar .

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_refresh        TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_mb_paste          TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo       TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_modi TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi.
*  lv_mtbez TYPE t134t-mtbez.
*
*  IF pv_modified IS INITIAL.
*    EXIT.
*  ENDIF.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL. "밑에 수행하려고 체크

  LOOP AT pt_modi INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'MTART'.

        SELECT SINGLE mtbez
          INTO gs_data-mtbez "인터널 테이블이 끝난 상태라 가능하다.
          FROM t134t
         WHERE mtart = ls_modi-value
           AND spras = sy-langu.

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark mtbez.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.

    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, Select rows' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_del.
      CLEAR  gs_data.

      DELETE gt_data INDEX gs_row-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE ZC505t0044,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save. " 이거 까먹
  CLEAR : lv_commit. " 이거 까먹음.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE ZC505t0044 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

    CHECK gs_data-mtart IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "이거 못외움

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY ZC505t0044 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_data_del. " 이거 까먹음
    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  " 이거 조금 헷갈림

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.
    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

*    ls_style-fieldname = 'WERKS'.
*    ls_style-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.
*
*    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
*    CLEAR  ls_style.
*
    ls_style-fieldname = 'MTART'.
    ls_style-style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.                " Ready for Input Status

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING  pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi,
         lv_mtbez TYPE t134t-mtbez.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE. " LOOP 로 돌아감
    ENDIF.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'MTART'.

        SELECT SINGLE mtbez
          INTO lv_mtbez
          FROM t134t
         WHERE mtart = ls_modi-value
           AND spras EQ sy-langu.

        CALL METHOD pcl_changed->modify_cell
          EXPORTING
            i_row_id    = ls_modi-row_id          " Row ID
            i_fieldname = 'MTBEZ'                 " Field Name
            i_value     = lv_mtbez.               " Value

    ENDCASE.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.


  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude.
  APPEND cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL. "밑에 수행하려고 체크

          INTO gs_data-mtbez "인터널 테이블이 끝난 상태라 가능하다.
          FROM t134t
         WHERE mtart = ls_modi-value
           AND spras = sy-langu.

  DATA : lv_tablx TYPE sy-tabix,

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'KOSTL'.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505t0043,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save.
  CLEAR lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD : gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0043 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.
*
*    IF gs_data-kostl IS INITIAL.
*      CONTINUE.
*    ENDIF.

    CHECK gs_data-kostl IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0043 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_data_del.

    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark = 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED_>MT_MOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING  pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi,
         lv_ltext TYPE cskt-ltext.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.

        SELECT SINGLE ltext
         INTO lv_ltext
         FROM cskt
        WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ ls_modi-value.

        CALL METHOD pcl_changed->modify_cell
          EXPORTING
            i_row_id    = ls_modi-row_id    " Row ID
            i_fieldname = 'LTEXT'           " Field Name
            i_value     = lv_ltext.         " Value

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.                " Ready for Input Status


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.

        SELECT SINGLE ltext
          INTO gs_data-ltext
          FROM cskt
          WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ gs_data-kostl.

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark ltext.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar USING  pt_object TYPE ttb_button.

  DATA : ls_toolbar TYPE stb_button.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'CREATE'.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_insert_row.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Create'.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Create'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0. "nomal

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_object.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'DELETE'.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_delete_row.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Delete'.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Delete'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0. "nomal

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_object.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_object.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'TOGGLE'.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_toggle_display_change.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Toggle'.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Toggle'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0. "nomal

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_object.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.


  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.               "행 추가 버튼

      PERFORM create_row.        "신규 행 추가(내부테이블)
      PERFORM refresh_grid.      "ALV 즉시 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.               "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_row.        "선택 행 삭제 처리

    WHEN 'TOGGLE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM toggle_display.

  ENDCASE.


ENDFORM.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tablx = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'KOKRS'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'KOSTL'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tablx
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505t0043,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save.
  CLEAR lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD : gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0043 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.
*
*    IF gs_data-kostl IS INITIAL.
*      CONTINUE.
*    ENDIF.

    CHECK gs_data-kostl IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0043 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_data_del.

    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark = 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED_>MT_MOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING  pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi,
         lv_ltext TYPE cskt-ltext.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.

        SELECT SINGLE ltext
         INTO lv_ltext
         FROM cskt
        WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ ls_modi-value.

        CALL METHOD pcl_changed->modify_cell
          EXPORTING
            i_row_id    = ls_modi-row_id    " Row ID
            i_fieldname = 'LTEXT'           " Field Name
            i_value     = lv_ltext.         " Value

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.                " Ready for Input Status


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.

        SELECT SINGLE ltext
          INTO gs_data-ltext
          FROM cskt
          WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ gs_data-kostl.

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark ltext.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar USING  pt_object TYPE ttb_button.

  DATA : ls_toolbar TYPE stb_button.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'CREATE'.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_insert_row.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Create'.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Create'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0. "nomal

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_object.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'DELETE'.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_delete_row.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Delete'.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Delete'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0. "nomal

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_object.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_object.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'TOGGLE'.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_toggle_display_change.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Toggle'.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Toggle'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0. "nomal

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_object.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.


  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.               "행 추가 버튼

      PERFORM create_row.        "신규 행 추가(내부테이블)
      PERFORM refresh_grid.      "ALV 즉시 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.               "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_row.        "선택 행 삭제 처리

    WHEN 'TOGGLE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM toggle_display.

  ENDCASE.


ENDFORM.

  IF pa_kokrs IS INITIAL.

    STOP.
  ENDIF.

    INTO lv_korks

FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.
  REFRESH gt_data_del.

  SELECT a~kokrs a~kostl a~bukrs a~kosar a~verak
         a~wrbtr a~waers a~bkzer
         a~erdat a~erzet a~ernam
         a~aedat a~aezet a~aenam
         b~ltext
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM zc505t0043 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN cskt AS b
     ON  a~kokrs EQ b~kokrs
     AND a~kostl EQ b~kostl
     AND b~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE a~kokrs EQ pa_kokrs

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505t0043,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit.

  _clear ls_save lt_save.
  CLEAR lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD : gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0043 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.
*
*    IF gs_data-kostl IS INITIAL.
*      CONTINUE.
*    ENDIF.

    CHECK gs_data-kostl IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0043 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_data_del.

    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark = 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED_>MT_MOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING  pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi,
         lv_ltext TYPE cskt-ltext.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.

        SELECT SINGLE ltext
         INTO lv_ltext
         FROM cskt
        WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ ls_modi-value.

        CALL METHOD pcl_changed->modify_cell
          EXPORTING
            i_row_id    = ls_modi-row_id    " Row ID
            i_fieldname = 'LTEXT'           " Field Name
            i_value     = lv_ltext.         " Value

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.                " Ready for Input Status


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.

        SELECT SINGLE ltext
          INTO gs_data-ltext
          FROM cskt
          WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ gs_data-kostl.

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark ltext.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING   pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button. "header 가 없음

  DATA : ls_toolber TYPE stb_button.

  ls_toolber-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

  ls_toolber-function  = 'CREATE'.
  ls_toolber-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolber-icon      = icon_insert_row.
  ls_toolber-text      = 'Create'.
  ls_toolber-quickinfo = 'Create'.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

  ls_toolber-function  = 'DELETE'.
  ls_toolber-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolber-icon      = icon_delete_row.
  ls_toolber-text      = 'Delete'.
  ls_toolber-quickinfo = 'Delete'.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

  ls_toolber-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

  ls_toolber-function  = 'TOGGLE'.
  ls_toolber-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolber-icon      = icon_toggle_display_change.
  ls_toolber-text      = 'Toggle'.
  ls_toolber-quickinfo = 'Toggle'.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING  pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm. "char 은 안해도 된다.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.               "행 추가 버튼
      PERFORM create_row.        "신규 행 추가(내부테이블)
      PERFORM refresh_grid.      "ALV 즉시 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.               "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_row.        "선택 행 삭제 처리

    WHEN 'TOGGLE'.
      PERFORM toggle_display.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0043 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.
*
*    IF gs_data-kostl IS INITIAL.
*      CONTINUE.
*    ENDIF.

    CHECK gs_data-kostl IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE.

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0043 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_data_del.

    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark = 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_data_changed
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED_>MT_MOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_data_changed  USING  pcl_changed TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data_protocol.

  DATA : ls_modi  TYPE lvc_s_modi,
         lv_ltext TYPE cskt-ltext.

  LOOP AT pcl_changed->mt_mod_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.

        SELECT SINGLE ltext
         INTO lv_ltext
         FROM cskt
        WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ ls_modi-value.

        CALL METHOD pcl_changed->modify_cell
          EXPORTING
            i_row_id    = ls_modi-row_id    " Row ID
            i_fieldname = 'LTEXT'           " Field Name
            i_value     = lv_ltext.         " Value

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.                " Ready for Input Status


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.

        SELECT SINGLE ltext
          INTO gs_data-ltext
          FROM cskt
          WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ gs_data-kostl.

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark ltext.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING   pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button. "header 가 없음

  DATA : ls_toolber TYPE stb_button.

  ls_toolber-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

  ls_toolber-function  = 'CREATE'.
  ls_toolber-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolber-icon      = icon_insert_row.
  ls_toolber-text      = 'Create'.
  ls_toolber-quickinfo = 'Create'.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

  ls_toolber-function  = 'DELETE'.
  ls_toolber-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolber-icon      = icon_delete_row.
  ls_toolber-text      = 'Delete'.
  ls_toolber-quickinfo = 'Delete'.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

  ls_toolber-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

  ls_toolber-function  = 'TOGGLE'.
  ls_toolber-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolber-icon      = icon_toggle_display_change.
  ls_toolber-text      = 'Toggle'.
  ls_toolber-quickinfo = 'Toggle'.

  APPEND ls_toolber TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolber.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING  pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm. "char 은 안해도 된다.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.               "행 추가 버튼
      PERFORM create_row.        "신규 행 추가(내부테이블)
      PERFORM refresh_grid.      "ALV 즉시 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.               "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_row.        "선택 행 삭제 처리

    WHEN 'TOGGLE'.
      PERFORM toggle_display.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

  pa_burks = '0001'.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  DATA : lv_bukrs TYPE bkpf-bukrs.

  IF pa_burks IS INITIAL OR pa_gjahr IS INITIAL.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.

  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE bukrs
    INTO lv_bukrs
    FROM t001
   WHERE bukrs EQ pa_burks.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Invalid data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.

  SELECT a~blart a~budat "bkpf
         b~belnr b~buzei b~bschl b~koart
         b~gsber b~hkont b~shkzg b~dmbtr b~pswsl
         c~ltext
         d~gtext
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM bkpf AS a
   INNER JOIN bseg AS b
      ON a~bukrs EQ b~bukrs
     AND a~belnr EQ b~belnr
     AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
    LEFT OUTER JOIN t003t AS c
      ON a~blart EQ c~blart
     AND c~spras EQ sy-langu
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tgsbt AS d
      ON b~gsber EQ d~gsber
     AND d~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE a~bukrs EQ pa_burks
     AND a~gjahr EQ pa_gjahr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key
                       pv_field
                       pv_text
                       pv_ref_table
                       pv_ref_field.


  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.

*& <--  p2        text

FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                           " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                 " Parent Container

  IF gcl_handler IS NOT BOUND.

    CREATE OBJECT gcl_handler.

  ENDIF.

  SET HANDLER : gcl_handler->handle_on_button_click FOR gcl_grid,
                gcl_handler->handle_double_click     FOR gcl_grid,
                gcl_handler->handle_changed_finished FOR gcl_grid,
                gcl_handler->handle_toolbar          FOR gcl_grid,
                gcl_handler->handle_user_command     FOR gcl_grid.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant               " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                      " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'                      " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout                " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude               " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_data                  " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.                 " Field Catalog


ENDFORM.

FORM handle_hotspot_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL. "여기 틀림

  CASE pv_comm.
