FORM set_param .

  LOOP AT SCREEN.

    CASE screen-name.
      WHEN 'PA_BURKS'.
        screen-input = 0.
        MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

    CHECK gs_data-buzei EQ '0001'.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'BELNR'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_button.

    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

    CASE gs_data-buzei.
      WHEN '0001'.
        ls_style-fieldname = 'BELNR'.
        ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_button.

        INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
        CLEAR  ls_style.

        MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
        TRANSPORTING style.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_comm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_comm.
    WHEN 'CREATE'.
      PERFORM create_row.
    WHEN 'REFRESH'.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable             " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

  MESSAGE s000 WITH '새로고침 되었습니다.'.

ENDFORM.

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_row .

  CLEAR gs_data.

  APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
  CLEAR  gs_data.

ENDFORM.

*& <--  p2        text

FORM set_param .

  LOOP AT SCREEN.

    CASE screen-name.
      WHEN 'PA_BURKS'.
        screen-input = 0.
        MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    REFRESH gs_data-style.

    CHECK gs_data-buzei EQ '0001'.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'BELNR'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_button.

    INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

    CASE gs_data-buzei.
      WHEN '0001'.
        ls_style-fieldname = 'BELNR'.
        ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_button.

        INSERT ls_style INTO TABLE gs_data-style.
        CLEAR  ls_style.

        MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
        TRANSPORTING style.

                                    ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-row_id.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'BELNR'.

      SET PARAMETER ID : 'BLN' FIELD gs_data-belnr,
                         'BUK' FIELD pa_burks,
                         'GJR' FIELD pa_gjahr.

      CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

  ENDCASE.

body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZC505R_DNOTE_02
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zc505r_dnote_02 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.

DATA : BEGIN OF gs_class,
         class  TYPE zc505t0002-class,
         cl_num TYPE zc505t0002-cl_num,
         name   TYPE zc505t0002-name,
         phone  TYPE zc505t0002-phone,
         gender TYPE zc505t0002-gender,
       END OF gs_class,

       gt_class LIKE TABLE OF gs_class.

DEFINE _clear.

  CLEAR   &1.
  REFRESH &2.

END-OF-DEFINITION.
**********************************************************************

_clear gs_class gt_class.

SELECT class cl_num name phone gender
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_class
  FROM zc505t0002.

IF sy-subrc NE 0.
  MESSAGE s001.
  LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
ENDIF.

*PERFORM updata_data.

PERFORM delete_data.

FORM updata_data .
*gt_class 에 있는 phone 을 '11111111' 로 바꿔보자
  DATA : ls_update TYPE zc505t0002,
         lt_update TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0002,
         lv_tabix  TYPE sy-tabix.

  _clear ls_update lt_update.

  LOOP AT gt_class INTO gs_class.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    gs_class-phone = '11111111'.

    MODIFY gt_class FROM gs_class INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING phone.

  ENDLOOP.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_class TO lt_update.

  IF lt_update IS NOT INITIAL.

    UPDATE zc505t0002 FROM TABLE lt_update.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT. "맨 마지막에 여러번 x
      MESSAGE s002.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      MESSAGE s004 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

*03 지수 -> 로제
  UPDATE zc505t0002 SET name = '로제'
   WHERE class  = 'CL5'
     AND cl_num = '03'.

*IF sy-sybrc = 0.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s002.
  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s004 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

**********************************************************************
FORM delete_data .

  DATA : ls_del TYPE zc505t0002,
         lt_del TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0002.

  _clear ls_del lt_del.

* gender 가 'F' 인 레코드를 삭제해보자

  LOOP AT gt_class INTO gs_class WHERE gender EQ 'F'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_class TO ls_del.

    APPEND ls_del TO lt_del.
    CLEAR  ls_del.

  ENDLOOP.

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'B'. "한개만 선택
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Student Info'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
    'X' 'CLASS'  ' ' 'ZC505T0002'  ' ',
    'X' 'CL_NUM' ' ' 'ZC505T0002'  ' ',
    ' ' 'NAME'   ' ' 'ZC505T0002'  ' ',
    ' ' 'PHONE'  ' ' 'ZC505T0002'  ' ',
    ' ' 'GENDER' ' ' 'ZC505T0002'  ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .


  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER'.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                  " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant          " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                 " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout           " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_input            " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.            " Field Catalog


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_data .

  CLEAR   gs_row.
  REFRESH gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                  " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select row' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_row INTO gs_row INDEX 1. "한개밖에 없다.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_input INTO gs_input INDEX gs_row-index.
  "바로 스크린으로 들어간다.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_student
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_student .

  CLEAR   gs_input.
  REFRESH gt_input.

  SELECT class cl_num name phone gender
         erdat erzet ernam aedat aezet
         aenam
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_input
    FROM zc505t0002
   ORDER BY class cl_num.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0002. "한줄만 넣을거라 table 이 필요 없다.
  CLEAR ls_save.

  IF gs_input-class IS INITIAL OR gs_input-cl_num IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Class and Student no is required field'
    DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_input TO ls_save.

  IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

    ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
    ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
    ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

  ELSE.

    ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
    ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
    ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

  ENDIF.

  MODIFY zc505t0002 FROM ls_save. "테이블이 아님.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    PERFORM get_student.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.

    MESSAGE s002.
  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s004 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                 " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  IF gs_input-class IS INITIAL OR
     gs_input-cl_num IS INITIAL.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Class and Student no is required field'
    DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.

  ENDIF.

  DELETE FROM zc505t0002
   WHERE class = gs_input-class
     AND cl_num = gs_input-cl_num.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s003.
    PERFORM get_student.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.

  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s005 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .


  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER'.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                  " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant          " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                 " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout           " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_input            " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.            " Field Catalog


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_data .

  CLEAR   gs_row.
  REFRESH gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                  " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select row' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_row INTO gs_row INDEX 1. "한개밖에 없다.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_input INTO gs_input INDEX gs_row-index.
  "바로 스크린으로 들어간다.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_student
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_student .

  CLEAR   gs_input.
  REFRESH gt_input.

  SELECT class cl_num name phone gender
         erdat erzet ernam aedat aezet
         aenam
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_input
    FROM zc505t0002
   ORDER BY class cl_num.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0002. "한줄만 넣을거라 table 이 필요 없다.
  CLEAR ls_save.

  IF gs_input-class IS INITIAL OR gs_input-cl_num IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Class and Student no is required field'
    DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_input TO ls_save.

  IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

    ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
    ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
    ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

  ELSE.

    ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
    ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
    ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

  ENDIF.

  MODIFY zc505t0002 FROM ls_save. "테이블이 아님.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    PERFORM get_student.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.

    MESSAGE s002.
  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s004 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                 " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  IF gs_input-class IS INITIAL OR
     gs_input-cl_num IS INITIAL.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Class and Student no is required field'
    DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.

  ENDIF.

  DELETE FROM zc505t0002
   WHERE class = gs_input-class
     AND cl_num = gs_input-cl_num.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s003.
    PERFORM get_student.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.

  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s005 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'MATNR' ' '  'ZC505T0018'  ' ',

     ' ' 'MTART' ' '  'ZC505T0018'  ' ',
     ' ' 'MENGE' ' '  'ZC505T0018'  ' ',
     ' ' 'MEINS' ' '  'ZC505T0018'  ' ',

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.

  SELECT matnr werks mtart
         menge meins dmbtr waers
         erdat erzet ernam
         aedat aezet aenam
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM zc505t0018
   ORDER BY matnr werks.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING  pv_key
                       pv_field
                       pv_text
                       pv_ref_table
                       pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'MENGE'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
    WHEN 'DMBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER'. " Name of the Screen CustCtrl Name to Link Container To

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout        " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data          " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_data .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'choose a row.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  IF lines( gt_row ) > 1.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '행을 한 개만 선택하세요'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_row INTO gs_row INDEX 1.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

ENDFORM.

*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0018.

  IF gs_data-matnr IS INITIAL OR gs_data-werks IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'key field required' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

  IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.

    ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
    ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
    ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

  ELSE.

    ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
    ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
    ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

  ENDIF.

  MODIFY zc505t0018 FROM ls_save.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s002. "Data was saved successfully

    PERFORM get_data.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable        " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.           " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  IF gs_data-matnr IS INITIAL OR gs_data-werks IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'key field required'
    DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  DELETE FROM zc505t0018
  WHERE matnr EQ gs_data-matnr
    AND werks EQ gs_data-werks.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s003. "Data was deleted successfully

    PERFORM get_data.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.

  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s005 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_matnr .
  "Material Type 값을 f4 서치헬프로 제공할것
  DATA : BEGIN OF ls_mtart, "받아줄 그릇을 만들기
           mtart TYPE t134-mtart,
           vmtpo TYPE t134-vmtpo,
           vprsv TYPE t134-vprsv,
           mtbez TYPE t134t-mtbez,
         END OF ls_mtart,

         lt_mtart LIKE TABLE OF ls_mtart.

  SELECT a~mtart a~vmtpo a~vprsv "데이터를 가져와준다.
         b~mtbez
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_mtart
    FROM t134 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN T134t AS b
      ON a~mtart EQ b~mtart
     AND b~spras EQ sy-langu.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield     = 'MTART'
      dynpprog     = sy-repid
      dynpnr       = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield  = 'GS_DATA-MTART'
      window_title = 'Material Types'
      value_org    = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab    = lt_mtart.

ENDFORM.

*& Form clear_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_data .

  CLEAR gs_data.

ENDFORM.

*& Form get_input_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_input_data .

  IF gs_data-matnr IS INITIAL OR
     gs_data-werks IS INITIAL.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'input key field' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.

  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data WITH KEY matnr = gs_data-matnr
                                           werks = gs_data-werks.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    CLEAR : gs_data-mtart,
            gs_data-menge,
            gs_data-meins,
            gs_data-dmbtr,
            gs_data-waers.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

    EXPORTING

    EXPORTING

FORM move_right_table .

  DATA : BEGIN OF ls_text,
           line TYPE tdline,
         END OF ls_text,

         lt_text LIKE TABLE OF ls_text.

  REFRESH : lt_text.

    IMPORTING
      table               = lt_text                  " text as R/3 table
    EXCEPTIONS
      potential_data_loss = 1.          " Potential data loss: use get_text_as_stream instead

  CHECK lt_text IS NOT INITIAL.

  CALL METHOD gcl_text_r->set_text_as_r3table
    EXPORTING
      table = lt_text.                " table with text

ENDFORM.

    EXPORTING

FORM read_text_table .

  DATA : ls_data TYPE zc505t0049,

         BEGIN OF ls_text,
           line TYPE tdline,
         END OF ls_text,

         lt_text LIKE TABLE OF ls_text.

  CLEAR   : ls_text, ls_data.
  REFRESH : lt_text.

  IF gv_seq IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input Sequence' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE seq description
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_data
    FROM zc505t0049
   WHERE seq = gv_seq.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CHECK ls_data-description IS NOT INITIAL. "desc 가 있을때만 아래 로직 수행

  SPLIT ls_data-description AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>newline INTO TABLE lt_text.

  CALL METHOD gcl_text_r->set_text_as_r3table
    EXPORTING
      table = lt_text.                 " table with text


* 문자열 나누기 : SPLIT ..
* 1. SPLIT <변수> AT <구분자> INTO <변수1> <변수2> ...<변수N>.
* --> 구분자에 의해서 나눠지는 문자열들을 차례대로 <변수1> ~ <변수N> 까지 넣어준다.
*     INTO 이후에 나열된 변수보다 많은 경우 나머지 문자열은 무시된다.
*     나눠지는 문자열이 나열된 변수보다 적은 경우 나머지 변수 무시된다.
*2. SPLIT <변수> AT <구분자> INTO TABLE <ITAB>
* --> 구분자에 의해서 나눠지는 문자열들을 <ITAB> 에 차례대로 APPEND 해준다.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_text_stream
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_text_stream .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0049,

         BEGIN OF ls_text,
           line TYPE tdline,
         END OF ls_text,

         lt_text LIKE TABLE OF ls_text.

  CLEAR   ls_text.
  REFRESH lt_text.


  IF gv_seq IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input Sequence' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD gcl_text_l->get_text_as_stream
    IMPORTING
      text = lt_text.                 " text as stream with carrige retruns and linefeeds

  IF lt_text IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input description' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  ls_save-seq = gv_seq.

  LOOP AT lt_text INTO ls_text.

    ls_save-description = ls_save-description && ls_text-line.

  ENDLOOP.

  MODIFY zc505t0049 FROM ls_save.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s002.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

  SELECT SINGLE seq description
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_data
    FROM zc505t0049
   WHERE seq EQ gv_seq.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CHECK ls_data-description IS NOT INITIAL. "desc 가 있을때만 아래 로직 수행

  CALL METHOD gcl_text_r->set_textstream
    EXPORTING
      text = ls_data-description.                " Text as String with Carriage Returns and Linefeeds

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_text_stream_test .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0049,
         lt_save LIKE TABLE OF ls_save.

  IF gv_seq IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input Sequence' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD gcl_text_l->get_textstream
    IMPORTING
      text = ls_save-description.

  cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). "must 느낌, 무조건 get_textstream 이랑 같이 와야한다.

  CHECK ls_save-description IS NOT INITIAL.

  ls_save-seq = gv_seq.

  MODIFY zc505t0049 FROM ls_save.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s002.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_text_table
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_text_table .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0049,

         BEGIN OF ls_text,
           line TYPE tdline,
         END OF ls_text,

         lt_text LIKE TABLE OF ls_text.

  CLEAR   ls_text.
  REFRESH lt_text.

  IF gv_seq IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input Sequence' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD gcl_text_l->get_text_as_r3table
    IMPORTING
      table               = lt_text                 " text as R/3 table
    EXCEPTIONS
      potential_data_loss = 1.                " Potential data loss: use get_text_as_stream instead

  IF lt_text IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input Description' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  ls_save-seq = gv_seq.

  LOOP AT lt_text INTO ls_text.

    CASE sy-tabix.
      WHEN 1. "처음에는 ## 을 넣어주기 싫어서 case 사용 r3table 에서는 이런 작업이 필요
        CONCATENATE ls_save-description ls_text-line INTO ls_save-description.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        CONCATENATE ls_save-description ls_text-line INTO ls_save-description "빈 그릇에 누적 ++
        SEPARATED BY cl_abap_char_utilities=>newline. "이게 ## 의 값을 가지고 있음.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP."앞에 ##을 지우고 싶음 문자열 자르기

  MODIFY zc505t0049 FROM ls_save.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s002.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

FORM delete_data .

  "key 값을 읽어서 db 테이블에서 삭제. where 조건으로 맞춘다. dbcnt 로 변경이 일어났을때만 commit else -> rollback

  IF gv_seq IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input Sequence' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.

  DELETE FROM zc505t0049
   WHERE seq EQ gv_seq.

  IF sy-dbcnt EQ 0.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Delete failed'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  MESSAGE s003.

* --> 구분자에 의해서 나눠지는 문자열들을 차례대로 <변수1> ~ <변수N> 까지 넣어준다.

*2. SPLIT <변수> AT <구분자> INTO TABLE <ITAB>
* --> 구분자에 의해서 나눠지는 문자열들을 <ITAB> 에 차례대로 APPEND 해준다.

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0049,

         BEGIN OF ls_text,
           line TYPE tdline,
         END OF ls_text,

         lt_text LIKE TABLE OF ls_text.

  CLEAR   ls_text.

*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM posting .

  DATA : lv_wrbtr_s(20),
         lv_wrbtr_h(20),
         lv_msg(100).

  CLEAR   : gs_bdcdata, gs_messtab, gs_param.
  REFRESH : gt_bdcdata, gt_messtab.

* Option 설정
  gs_param-dismode = 'N'.  " A : 모든 Screen 표시 (개발/디버깅용)
  " N : Screen 미표시 (실운영, 백그라운드)
  " E : 에러 발생 시에만 Screen 표시

  gs_param-nobinpt = 'X'.  " X : Batch Input 세션 생성 안 함 (CALL TRANSACTION)
  " SPACE : Batch Input 세션 생성 (SM35에서 실행)

  gs_param-updmode = 'S'.  " S : Synchronous Update (즉시 DB 반영, 안정적)

  CLEAR : lv_wrbtr_h, lv_wrbtr_s.

"수량은 char 로 변환해서 사용해야함.
"BDC는 화면에 입력되는 문자열 그대로 필요
  WRITE : gs_posting-s_wrbtr TO lv_wrbtr_s CURRENCY gs_posting-waers,
          gs_posting-h_wrbtr TO lv_wrbtr_h CURRENCY gs_posting-waers.
"공백 제거
  CONDENSE lv_wrbtr_s NO-GAPS.
  CONDENSE lv_wrbtr_h NO-GAPS.

  PERFORM make_bdcdata USING : 'X'    'SAPMF05A'    '0100',
                               ' '    'BDC_OKCODE'  '/00',
                               ' '    'BKPF-BLDAT'  sy-datum,
                               ' '    'BKPF-BLART'  gs_posting-blart,
                               ' '    'BKPF-BUKRS'  gs_posting-bukrs,
                               ' '    'BKPF-WAERS'  gs_posting-waers,
                               ' '    'RF05A-NEWBS' gs_posting-s_bschl,
                               ' '    'RF05A-NEWKO' gs_posting-s_hkont,

                               'X'    'SAPMF05A'    '0300',
                               ' '    'BDC_OKCODE'  '/00',
                               ' '    'BSEG-WRBTR'  lv_wrbtr_s,
                               ' '    'RF05A-NEWBS' gs_posting-h_bschl,
                               ' '    'RF05A-NEWKO' gs_posting-h_hkont,

                               'X'    'SAPMF05A'    '0300',
                               ' '    'BDC_OKCODE'  '=BU',
                               ' '    'BSEG-WRBTR'  lv_wrbtr_h.

  CALL TRANSACTION 'FB01' USING         gt_bdcdata
                          OPTIONS FROM  gs_param
                          MESSAGES INTO gt_messtab.

  READ TABLE gt_messtab INTO gs_messtab WITH KEY msgid = 'F5'
                                                 msgnr = '312'.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

    CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD'
      EXPORTING
        msgid               = gs_messtab-msgid
        msgnr               = gs_messtab-msgnr
        msgv1               = gs_messtab-msgv1
        msgv2               = gs_messtab-msgv2
        msgv3               = gs_messtab-msgv3
        msgv4               = gs_messtab-msgv4
      IMPORTING
        message_text_output = lv_msg.

    CONDENSE lv_msg.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Posting failed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_bdcdata
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_bdcdata  USING  pv_begin pv_fnam pv_fval.

  CASE pv_begin.
    WHEN 'X'.
      gs_bdcdata-dynbegin = pv_begin.
      gs_bdcdata-program  = pv_fnam.
      gs_bdcdata-dynpro   = pv_fval.

    WHEN OTHERS.
      gs_bdcdata-fnam = pv_fnam.
      gs_bdcdata-fval = pv_fval.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_bdcdata TO gt_bdcdata.
  CLEAR  gs_bdcdata.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          SAPMZC5050009_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
              zebra      = 'X'
              cwidth_opt = 'A'
              sel_mode   = 'B'
              grid_title = TEXT-t02
              smalltitle = 'X'
                   ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                row = 'X'
                col = 'X'
                     ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name   = 'ZC505CDSV0017'                 " Structure name (structure, table, view)
      i_bypassing_buffer = 'X'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat        = gt_fcat.                 " Field Catalog with Field Descriptions

  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.
      WHEN 'GROUP_ID' OR 'MEMBER_ID' OR 'MEMBER_NAME' OR
           'MEMBER_GENDER' OR 'MEMBER_ADDR' OR 'MEMBER_PHONE'.

      WHEN 'ERDAT' OR 'ERZET' OR 'ERNAM' OR 'AEDAT' OR 'AEZET' OR 'AENAM'.
        <fs_fcat>-no_out = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER'.     " Name of the Screen CustCtrl Name to Link Container To

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report  = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'A1'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant         " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout          " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_idol            " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.           " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_idol
    FROM zc505cds0017
   ORDER BY group_id, member_id.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0040.

  IF gs_idol-group_id IS INITIAL OR
     gs_idol-member_Id IS INITIAL.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.

  ENDIF.

  IF gs_idol-erdat IS INITIAL.

    gs_idol-erdat = sy-datum.
    gs_idol-erzet = sy-uzeit.
    gs_idol-ernam = sy-uname.

  ELSE.

    gs_idol-aedat = sy-datum.
    gs_idol-aezet = sy-uzeit.
    gs_idol-aenam = sy-uname.

  ENDIF.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_idol TO ls_save.

  MODIFY zc505t0040 FROM ls_save.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    PERFORM get_data.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.

    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s004 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_data .

  CLEAR gs_row.
  REFRESH gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select row'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  IF lines( gt_row ) > 1.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Please select a one row.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_row INTO gs_row INDEX 1.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  READ TABLE gt_idol INTO gs_idol INDEX gs_row-index.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_data .

  CLEAR gs_idol.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  DATA : lcl_conn    TYPE REF TO cl_sql_connection,
         lcl_sql     TYPE REF TO cl_sql_statement,
         lx_sql_exec TYPE REF TO cx_root,
         lr_param    TYPE REF TO data,
         lv_sql      TYPE string,
         lv_msg      TYPE string.

  TRY.

      lcl_conn = cl_sql_connection=>get_connection( ). "1번째, 일을 할 친구 -> 2번 statement

      CREATE OBJECT lcl_sql
        EXPORTING
          con_ref = lcl_conn.

      lv_sql = | DELETE                  | && "어떻게 일할지 3번
               |   FROM ZC505T0040       | &&
               |  WHERE MANDT     = ?    | &&
               |    AND GROUP_ID  = ?    | &&
               |    AND MEMBER_ID = ?    |.

      GET REFERENCE OF sy-mandt INTO lr_param.
      lcl_sql->set_param( lr_param ).

      GET REFERENCE OF gs_idol-group_id INTO lr_param.
      lcl_sql->set_param( lr_param ).

      GET REFERENCE OF gs_idol-member_id INTO lr_param.
      lcl_sql->set_param( lr_param ).

      lcl_sql->execute_update( lv_sql ).
      lcl_conn->commit( ).
      lcl_conn->close( ).
      "lr_data, 메모리 주소 공유, 저장된 데이터만 뽑아서 온다. get_refrence /  set_parameter 가 끌어와준다.
      PERFORM get_data.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

    CATCH cx_sql_exception INTO lx_sql_exec. "에러 발생시 처리하는곳

      lv_msg = lx_sql_exec->get_text( ). "에러 메시지 받는다

      IF lcl_conn IS BOUND.

        TRY.
            lcl_conn->rollback( ).
            lcl_conn->close( ).
          CATCH cx_sql_exception.

        ENDTRY.

      ENDIF.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      EXIT.

  ENDTRY.

  CLEAR gs_idol. "delete 하고 gs_idol 클리어

ENDFORM.

              zebra      = 'X'
              cwidth_opt = 'A'
              sel_mode   = 'B'
              grid_title = TEXT-t02
              smalltitle = 'X'
                   ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                row = 'X'
                col = 'X'
                     ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name   = 'ZC505CDSV0017'                 " Structure name (structure, table, view)
      i_bypassing_buffer = 'X'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat        = gt_fcat.                 " Field Catalog with Field Descriptions

  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.
      WHEN 'GROUP_ID' OR 'MEMBER_ID' OR 'MEMBER_NAME' OR
           'MEMBER_GENDER' OR 'MEMBER_ADDR' OR 'MEMBER_PHONE'.

      WHEN 'ERDAT' OR 'ERZET' OR 'ERNAM' OR 'AEDAT' OR 'AEZET' OR 'AENAM'.
        <fs_fcat>-no_out = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER'.     " Name of the Screen CustCtrl Name to Link Container To

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report  = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'A1'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant         " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout          " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_idol            " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.           " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_idol
    FROM zc505cds0017
   ORDER BY group_id, member_id.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0040.

  IF gs_idol-group_id IS INITIAL OR
     gs_idol-member_Id IS INITIAL.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.

  ENDIF.

  IF gs_idol-erdat IS INITIAL.

    gs_idol-erdat = sy-datum.
    gs_idol-erzet = sy-uzeit.
    gs_idol-ernam = sy-uname.

  ELSE.

    gs_idol-aedat = sy-datum.
    gs_idol-aezet = sy-uzeit.
    gs_idol-aenam = sy-uname.

  ENDIF.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_idol TO ls_save.

  MODIFY zc505t0040 FROM ls_save.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    PERFORM get_data.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.

    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s004 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_data .

  CLEAR gs_row.
  REFRESH gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select row'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  IF lines( gt_row ) > 1.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Please select a one row.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_row INTO gs_row INDEX 1.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  READ TABLE gt_idol INTO gs_idol INDEX gs_row-index.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_data .

  CLEAR gs_idol.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  DATA : lcl_conn    TYPE REF TO cl_sql_connection,
         lcl_sql     TYPE REF TO cl_sql_statement,
         lx_sql_exec TYPE REF TO cx_root,
         lr_param    TYPE REF TO data,
         lv_sql      TYPE string,
         lv_msg      TYPE string.

  TRY.

      lcl_conn = cl_sql_connection=>get_connection( ). "1번째, 일을 할 친구 -> 2번 statement

      CREATE OBJECT lcl_sql
        EXPORTING
          con_ref = lcl_conn.

      lv_sql = | DELETE                  | && "어떻게 일할지 3번
               |   FROM ZC505T0040       | &&
               |  WHERE MANDT     = ?    | &&
               |    AND GROUP_ID  = ?    | &&
               |    AND MEMBER_ID = ?    |.

      GET REFERENCE OF sy-mandt INTO lr_param.
      lcl_sql->set_param( lr_param ).

      GET REFERENCE OF gs_idol-group_id INTO lr_param.
      lcl_sql->set_param( lr_param ).

      GET REFERENCE OF gs_idol-member_id INTO lr_param.
      lcl_sql->set_param( lr_param ).

      lcl_sql->execute_update( lv_sql ).
      lcl_conn->commit( ).
      lcl_conn->close( ).
      "lr_data, 메모리 주소 공유, 저장된 데이터만 뽑아서 온다. get_refrence /  set_parameter 가 끌어와준다.
      PERFORM get_data.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

    CATCH cx_sql_exception INTO lx_sql_exec. "에러 발생시 처리하는곳

      lv_msg = lx_sql_exec->get_text( ). "에러 메시지 받는다

      IF lcl_conn IS BOUND.

        TRY.
            lcl_conn->rollback( ).
            lcl_conn->close( ).
          CATCH cx_sql_exception.

        ENDTRY.

      ENDIF.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      EXIT.

  ENDTRY.

  CLEAR gs_idol. "delete 하고 gs_idol 클리어

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          SAPMZCEXAM01_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  DATA ls_fcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.


  gs_layout = VALUE #(
                        zebra      = 'X'
                        cwidth_opt = 'A'
                        sel_mode   = 'D'
                        grid_title = TEXT-t01
                        smalltitle = 'X'
                     ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                       row  = 'X'
                       col  = 'X'
                      ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'ZC505T0048'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat.


  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.

      WHEN 'AUFNR'.       "핫스팟 (예: 생산오더 클릭)
        <fs_fcat>-hotspot  = 'X'.
        <fs_fcat>-coltext  = 'Production Order'.

      WHEN 'ERDAT' OR 'ERZET' OR 'ERNAM' OR 'AEDAT' OR 'AEZET' OR 'AENAM'.
        <fs_fcat>-no_out = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

  gt_fcat = VALUE #( BASE gt_fcat

  ( key       = 'X'
   fieldname = 'ICON'
   coltext   = 'ICON'
   col_pos   = 1
   icon      = 'X')
  ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER'.          " layout 커스텀 컨테이너에 적은 name을 입력

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                  " Parent Container


  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot_click  FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_double_click   FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant              " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                     " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                     " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout               " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data                 " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.                " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_double_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW
*&      --> E_COLUMN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_double_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                   ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL. " 합계/소계/헤더 행 더블클릭 방지

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0. " gs_data 에서 데이터를 못 읽으면 exit.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.

    WHEN 'MATNR'.
      SET PARAMETER ID 'MAT' FIELD gs_data-matnr.

      CALL TRANSACTION 'MM03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN. "TCODE 로 이동,AND SKIP~ / ENTER 기능

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  SELECT aufnr, posnr, matnr, pwerk,
         gstrp, gltrp, rsnum, gamng,
         gmein, erdat, erzet, ernam,
         aedat, aezet, aenam,
         CASE
           WHEN aufnr IS NOT INITIAL THEN '@06@'
           ELSE @space
         END AS icon
    FROM zc505t0048
    ORDER BY aufnr, posnr
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data.

*  gt_data = CORRESPONDING #( lt_data ).


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid . "화면을 다시 그려준다.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable              " 스크롤 위치 및 커서 고정
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_data .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows     "어디 행을 선택했는지 봐준다.
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.                 " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select row'. "GT_ROW 가 선택하지 않고 DISPLAY 눌렀을때 안내 메세지 및 EXIT
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  IF lines( gt_row ) > 1. "다중 행 선택 후 display를 막아준다.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Please select a one row.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_row INTO gs_row INDEX 1.     "READ TABLE 로 한행만 가져온다.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.    "sy-subrc 가 0 아 아니면 아래 로직 수행하지 않는다.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zc505t0048.

  IF gs_data-aufnr IS INITIAL OR
     gs_data-posnr IS INITIAL. "KEY 값이 없으면 EXIT.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field'
    DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

    EXIT.

  ENDIF.

  IF gs_data-gamng IS NOT INITIAL. "수량이 입력이 되어있는데 단위가 없으면 EXIT 처리 후 안내 메세지.

    IF gs_data-gmein IS INITIAL.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH '단위를 입력하세요' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      EXIT.

    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

  IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.         "신규 데이터인 경우

    ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.          "생성일
    ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.          "생성시간
    ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.          "생성자

  ELSE.                                "기존 데이터인 경우

    ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.          "변경일
    ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.          "변경시간
    ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.          "변경자

  ENDIF.

  MODIFY zc505t0048 FROM ls_save.  "DB 테이블에 반영 (Insert or Update)

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.                "변경이 일어나면 commit 아니면 rollback

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    PERFORM get_data.              "DB 불러오기
    PERFORM refresh_grid.          "화면 재갱신

    MESSAGE s002.                  "Data was saved successfully

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.                 "아닐 시 ROLLBACK , 에러메세지 표시
    MESSAGE s004 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. "Data save failed

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_data .

  CLEAR gs_data.    "화면 상에 올려진건 gs_data이기 때문에 clear로 해결

  MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Clear successfully'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  IF gs_data-aufnr IS INITIAL OR "PK 를 사용하여 DELETE 를 해준다.
     gs_data-posnr IS INITIAL.   "AUFNR 또는 POSNR 이 초기값이면 EXIT.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Required key field'
    DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

    EXIT.

  ENDIF.

  DELETE FROM zc505t0048
   WHERE aufnr EQ gs_data-aufnr   "KEY 값을 이용해서 DELETE
     AND posnr EQ gs_data-posnr.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.     "sy-subrc 가 0이면 commit 아니면 rollback

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    MESSAGE s003.          "Data was deleted successfully
    PERFORM get_data.      "DB를 받아온다.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.  "화면 갱신

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s005 DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. "Data deletion failed

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                    ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL. " 합계/소계/헤더 행 클릭 방지. " 초기값이면 아래를 통과하지 않고 로직을 벗어난다.

  DATA(ls_data) = VALUE #( gt_data[ ps_row-index ] OPTIONAL ). "read table gt_data into gs_data index ps_row-index.

  CHECK ps_col-fieldname EQ 'AUFNR'.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.

    WHEN 'AUFNR'.         "AUFNR 필드 클릭시

      SET PARAMETER ID 'ANR' FIELD ls_data-aufnr.    "PARAMETER 세팅

      CALL TRANSACTION 'CO03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN. "CO03 조회

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          SAPMZCEXAM01_I01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Module  EXIT_0100  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
MODULE exit_0100 INPUT.

  CALL METHOD : gcl_grid->free, gcl_container->free.   "생성된 grid 와 container 를 메모리에서 해제

  FREE: gcl_grid, gcl_container. "객체 변수 초기화

  CASE gv_okcode.

    WHEN 'EXIT'.          "Exit 면 프로그램 종료
      LEAVE PROGRAM.

    WHEN OTHERS.          "현재 화면을 닫고 이전으로 이동
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

  ENDCASE.

ENDMODULE.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0100  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.

  CASE gv_okcode.

    WHEN 'REFRESH'.             "조회/새로고침 버튼
      CLEAR gv_okcode.          "OKCODE_ CLEAR , 재사용 방지

      PERFORM get_data.         "DB 를 다시 가져온다.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.     "ALV 화면 갱신

    WHEN 'DISPLAY'.             "레코드를 위에 올려준다.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM display_data.

    WHEN 'SAVE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM save_data.        " 저장

    WHEN 'CLEAR'.               " gs_data 클리어해준다.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM clear_data.

    WHEN 'DELETE'.              "삭제
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM delete_data.

  ENDCASE.

body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505R0059_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_airline
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_airline .

  REFRESH : gt_scarr.

  SELECT carrid carrname currcode url
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_scarr
    FROM scarr
*      UP TO 5 ROWS
   WHERE carrid IN so_carr
   ORDER BY carrid.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_schedule
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_schedule .

  REFRESH : gt_spfli.

  SELECT carrid connid airpfrom airpto deptime arrtime
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_spfli
    FROM spfli
   WHERE carrid IN so_carr
   ORDER BY carrid connid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'Splitter Container Training'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat_top USING :
    'X'  'CARRID'     ' ' 'SCARR'  ' ',
    ' '  'CARRNAME'   ' ' 'SCARR'  ' ',
    ' '  'CURRCODE'   ' ' 'SCARR'  ' ',
    ' '  'URL'        ' ' 'SCARR'  ' '.

  PERFORM make_fcat_bot USING :
    'X'  'CARRID'     ' ' 'SPFLI'  ' ',
    'X'  'CONNID'     ' ' 'SPFLI'  ' ',
    ' '  'AIRPFROM'   ' ' 'SPFLI'  ' ',
    ' '  'AIRPTO'     ' ' 'SPFLI'  ' ',
    ' '  'DEPTIME'    ' ' 'SPFLI'  ' ',
    ' '  'ARRTIME'    ' ' 'SPFLI'  ' '.

  PERFORM make_fcat_mid USING :
  'X'  'CARRID'     ' ' 'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
  'X'  'CONNID'     ' ' 'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
  'X'  'FLDATE'     ' ' 'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
  ' '  'PRICE'      ' ' 'SFLIGHT'  ' ',
  ' '  'CURRENCY'   ' ' 'SFLIGHT'  ' '.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_top
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_top  USING  pv_key
                           pv_field
                           pv_text
                           pv_ref_table
                           pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_top.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_bot
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_bot  USING  pv_key
                           pv_field
                           pv_text
                           pv_ref_table
                           pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_bot.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_split
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_split .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left   " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                         " Control Extension
*상위 컨테이너를 나눈다.
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_splitter
    EXPORTING
      parent  = gcl_container                   " Parent Container
      rows    = 3                   " 몇 개의 가로(행) 분할할 것인지
      columns = 1.                  " 몇 개의 세로(열) 분할할 것인지

*1행 1열  컨테이너  .
  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 1                 " Row
      column    = 1                " Column
    RECEIVING
      Container = gcl_container_top. "gt_scarr

*2행 1열  컨테이너  .
  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 2                 " Row
      column    = 1                " Column
    RECEIVING
      Container = gcl_container_bot. "gt_scarr

*3행 1열  컨테이너  .
  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 3                 " Row
      column    = 1                " Column
    RECEIVING
      Container = gcl_container_mid. "gt_sflight

*1행 1열  grid   .
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_top
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_top.                 " Parent Container
*1행 1열  grid  .
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_bot
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_bot.                 " Parent Container

*1행 1열  grid  .
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_mid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_mid.                 " Parent Container

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->set_row_height
    EXPORTING
      id     = 1                   " Row ID
      height = 30.                 " Height

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->set_row_height
    EXPORTING
      id     = 2                   " Row ID
      height = 20.                 " Height

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'TOP'.       "구분자

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_top->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant            " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                   " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                   " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout             " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_scarr              " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_top.          " Field Catalog

  gs_variant-handle = 'BOT'.       "구분자

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_bot->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant            " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                   " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                   " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout             " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_spfli              " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_bot.          " Field Catalog

  gs_variant-handle = 'MID'.       "구분자

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_mid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant            " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                   " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                   " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout             " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_sflight              " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_mid.          " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_sflight
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_sflight .

  REFRESH : gt_sflight.

  SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_sflight
    FROM sflight
   WHERE carrid IN so_carr
   ORDER BY carrid connid fldate.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_mid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_mid  USING  pv_key
                           pv_field
                           pv_text
                           pv_ref_table
                           pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'PRICE'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'CURRENCY'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_mid.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_split .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.               " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_splitter
    EXPORTING
      parent  = gcl_container                   " Parent Container
      rows    = 1                   " Number of Rows to be displayed
      columns = 2.                   " Number of Columns to be Displayed

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 1                  " Row
      column    = 1                 " Column
    RECEIVING
      container = gcl_container_up.                 " Container

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 1                  " Row
      column    = 2                 " Column
    RECEIVING
      container = gcl_container_down.                 " Container

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_up
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_up.                  " Parent Container

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_down
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_down.                  " Parent Container

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->set_column_width
    EXPORTING
      id    = 1                   " Row ID
      width = 60.                 " Height

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_double_click FOR gcl_grid_up.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'UP'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_up->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant                  " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout                " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_scarr                 " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_up.                 " Field Catalog

  gs_variant-handle = 'DN'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_down->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant                  " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout                " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_spfli                 " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_down.                 " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_double_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW
*&      --> E_COLUMN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_double_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                   ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_scarr INTO gs_scarr INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM get_schedule USING gs_scarr-carrid.

  IF gt_spfli IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH gs_scarr-carrid 'Schedule not found'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_schedule
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_SCARR_CARRID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_schedule  USING  pv_carrid TYPE scarr-carrid.

  _clear gs_spfli gt_spfli.

  SELECT carrid connid airpfrom airpto deptime arrtime
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_spfli
    FROM spfli
   WHERE carrid EQ pv_carrid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_down->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                  " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'UP'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_up->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant                  " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout

      is_layout       = gs_layout                " Layout

    EXPORTING

      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant

                                   ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_scarr INTO gs_scarr INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM get_schedule USING gs_scarr-carrid.

  IF gt_spfli IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH gs_scarr-carrid 'Schedule not found'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_SCARR_CARRID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_schedule  USING  pv_carrid TYPE scarr-carrid.

  _clear gs_spfli gt_spfli.

  SELECT carrid connid airpfrom airpto deptime arrtime
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_spfli
    FROM spfli
   WHERE carrid EQ pv_carrid.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                  " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
