*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505R0062_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.

  DATA : lr_bukrs TYPE RANGE OF bkpf-bukrs,
         lr_gjahr TYPE RANGE OF bkpf-gjahr,

         ls_bukrs LIKE LINE OF lr_bukrs,
         ls_gjahr LIKE LINE OF lr_gjahr.

  IF pa_bukrs IS NOT INITIAL.

    ls_bukrs-low    = pa_bukrs.
    ls_bukrs-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_bukrs-option = 'EQ'.

    APPEND ls_bukrs TO lr_bukrs.
    CLEAR  ls_bukrs.

  ENDIF.

  IF pa_gjahr IS NOT INITIAL.

    ls_gjahr-low    = pa_gjahr.
    ls_gjahr-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_gjahr-option = 'EQ'.

    APPEND ls_gjahr TO lr_gjahr.
    CLEAR  ls_gjahr.

  ENDIF.

  SELECT bukrs gjahr belnr budat
         blart bktxt xrueb
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM bkpf
   WHERE bukrs IN lr_bukrs
     AND gjahr IN lr_gjahr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.

    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'ALV Splitter Training'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.
*  gs_layout-ctab_fname = 'COLOR'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat_data  USING :
    'X' 'BUKRS'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    'X' 'GJAHR'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    ' ' 'BELNR'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    ' ' 'BUDAT'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    ' ' 'BLART'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    ' ' 'BKTXT'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    ' ' 'XRUEB'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' '.

  PERFORM make_fcat_acc USING :
    'X' 'BELNR'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    'X' 'BUZEI'  ' ' 'BSEG' ' ', "KEY 라서 위에 올림
    ' ' 'BLDAT'  ' ' 'BKPF' ' ',
    ' ' 'BSCHL'  ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'KOART'  ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'SHKZG'  ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'DMBTR'  ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',  "CURR
    ' ' 'PSWSL'  ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',  "CUKY
    ' ' 'SGTXT'  ' ' 'BSEG' ' ',
    ' ' 'KOKRS'  ' ' 'BSEG' ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_data  USING  pv_key
                            pv_field
                            pv_text
                            pv_ref_table
                            pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'BELNR'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.
    WHEN 'XRUEB'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_data.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_acc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_acc  USING   pv_key
                            pv_field
                            pv_text
                            pv_ref_table
                            pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'DMBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'PSWSL'.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_acc.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_split
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_split .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left   " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                         " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_splitter
    EXPORTING
      parent  = gcl_container                   " Parent Container
      rows    = 2
      columns = 1.

*1행 1열  컨테이너  .
  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 1                 " Row
      column    = 1                " Column
    RECEIVING
      Container = gcl_container_data.

*2행 1열  컨테이너  .
  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 2                 " Row
      column    = 1                " Column
    RECEIVING
      Container = gcl_container_acc.
*1행 1열  grid   .
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_data
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_data.                 " Parent Container

*1행 1열  grid  .
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_acc
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_acc.                 " Parent Container

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->set_row_height
    EXPORTING
      id     = 1                " Row ID
      height = 40.              " Height

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'AA'. "구분자

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot_click FOR gcl_grid_data.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_data->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant            " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                   " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                   " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout             " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data              " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_data.          " Field Catalog

  gs_variant-handle = 'BB'. "구분자
  gs_layout-ctab_fname ='COLOR'. "COLOR 은 아래 acc grid 에만 적용

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_acc->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant            " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                   " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                   " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout             " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_acc              " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_acc.          " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                    ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  REFRESH gt_acc. "클릭했을때 아래 정보 클리어

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  PERFORM get_acc USING gs_data-bukrs
                        gs_data-gjahr
                        gs_data-belnr.

  IF gt_acc IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH gs_data-belnr 'DATA IS NOT FOUND' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM set_color.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_data->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                  " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_acc->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                  " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_color
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_color .

  DATA : ls_color TYPE lvc_s_scol,
         lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_acc   LIKE LINE OF gt_acc.

  LOOP AT gt_acc INTO ls_acc.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CLEAR ls_color.
    REFRESH ls_acc-color.

    CASE ls_acc-pswsl.

      WHEN 'KRW'.

        ls_color-fname = 'PSWSL'.
        ls_color-color-col = 5.
        ls_color-color-int = 1.
        ls_color-color-inv = 0.

      WHEN 'EUR'.

        ls_color-color-col = 6.
        ls_color-color-int = 1.
        ls_color-color-inv = 0.

    ENDCASE.

    APPEND ls_color TO ls_acc-color.
    CLEAR  ls_color.

    MODIFY gt_acc FROM ls_acc INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING color.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_acc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_DATA_BUKRS
*&      --> GS_DATA_GJAHR
*&      --> GS_DATA_BELNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_acc  USING    pv_bukrs TYPE bkpf-bukrs
                       pv_gjahr TYPE bkpf-gjahr
                       pv_belnr TYPE bkpf-belnr.

  _clear gs_acc gt_acc.

  SELECT a~belnr a~bldat
         b~buzei b~bschl b~koart b~shkzg b~dmbtr
         b~pswsl b~sgtxt b~kokrs
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_acc
    FROM bkpf AS a
   INNER JOIN bseg AS b
      ON a~belnr EQ b~belnr
   WHERE a~bukrs EQ pv_bukrs
     AND a~gjahr EQ pv_gjahr
     AND a~belnr EQ pv_belnr.

ENDFORM.

                            pv_text
                            pv_ref_table
                            pv_ref_field.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING

      extension = 5000.                         " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_splitter
    EXPORTING

    EXPORTING
      row       = 1                 " Row
      column    = 1                " Column
    RECEIVING
      Container = gcl_container_data.

*2행 1열  컨테이너  .
  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 2                 " Row
      column    = 1                " Column
    RECEIVING
      Container = gcl_container_acc.
*1행 1열  grid   .

    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_data.                 " Parent Container

*1행 1열  grid  .

    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_acc.                 " Parent Container

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->set_row_height
    EXPORTING
      id     = 1                " Row ID
      height = 40.              " Height

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'AA'. "구분자

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot_click FOR gcl_grid_data.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_data->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant            " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                   " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                   " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout             " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data              " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_data.          " Field Catalog

  gs_variant-handle = 'BB'. "구분자
  gs_layout-ctab_fname ='COLOR'. "COLOR 은 아래 acc grid 에만 적용

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_acc->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant            " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                   " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'                   " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout             " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_acc              " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_acc.          " Field Catalog

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                    ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  REFRESH gt_acc. "클릭했을때 아래 정보 클리어

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  PERFORM get_acc USING gs_data-bukrs
                        gs_data-gjahr
                        gs_data-belnr.

  IF gt_acc IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH gs_data-belnr 'DATA IS NOT FOUND' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM set_color.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_data->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                  " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_acc->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                  " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_color
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_color .

  DATA : ls_color TYPE lvc_s_scol,
         lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_acc   LIKE LINE OF gt_acc.

  LOOP AT gt_acc INTO ls_acc.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CLEAR ls_color.
    REFRESH ls_acc-color.

    CASE ls_acc-pswsl.

      WHEN 'KRW'.

        ls_color-fname = 'PSWSL'.
        ls_color-color-col = 5.
        ls_color-color-int = 1.
        ls_color-color-inv = 0.

      WHEN 'EUR'.

        ls_color-color-col = 6.
        ls_color-color-int = 1.
        ls_color-color-inv = 0.

    ENDCASE.

    APPEND ls_color TO ls_acc-color.
    CLEAR  ls_color.

    MODIFY gt_acc FROM ls_acc INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING color.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_acc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_DATA_BUKRS
*&      --> GS_DATA_GJAHR
*&      --> GS_DATA_BELNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_acc  USING    pv_bukrs TYPE bkpf-bukrs
                       pv_gjahr TYPE bkpf-gjahr
                       pv_belnr TYPE bkpf-belnr.

  _clear gs_acc gt_acc.

  SELECT a~belnr a~bldat
         b~buzei b~bschl b~koart b~shkzg b~dmbtr
         b~pswsl b~sgtxt b~kokrs
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_acc
    FROM bkpf AS a
   INNER JOIN bseg AS b
      ON a~belnr EQ b~belnr
   WHERE a~bukrs EQ pv_bukrs
     AND a~gjahr EQ pv_gjahr
     AND a~belnr EQ pv_belnr.

ENDFORM.

body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZC505RLECT08
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zc505rlect08 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.

DATA : BEGIN OF gs_data,
         carrid   TYPE spfli-carrid,
         connid   TYPE spfli-connid,
         airpfrom TYPE spfli-airpfrom,
         aripto   TYPE spfli-airpto,
       END OF gs_data,

       gt_data LIKE TABLE OF gs_data. "ALV 용 ITAB

*******프로그램 개발
*SPFLI 테이블을 select 할 시점
*근데 나는 특정 itab 에 있는 레코드만 select 하고싶음

*ITAB 선언
DATA : BEGIN OF ls_master,
         carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
         currcode TYPE scarr-currcode,
       END OF ls_master,

       lt_master LIKE TABLE OF ls_master.

*ls_masetr 에 있는 레코드의 carrid 필드와 매치되는
*레코드를 spfli 에서 select 하고싶음. ->JOIN 하고 싶음
*ITAB 과 DB 테이블 레코드를 받고 싶음

*레코드 입력
ls_master-carrid   = 'DL'.
ls_master-currcode = 'USD'.

APPEND ls_master TO lt_master.
CLEAR  ls_master.

ls_master-carrid   = 'AA'.
ls_master-currcode = 'USD'.

APPEND ls_master TO lt_master.
CLEAR  ls_master.

ls_master-carrid   = 'AA'.
ls_master-currcode = 'USD'.

APPEND ls_master TO lt_master.
CLEAR  ls_master.

ls_master-carrid   = 'LH'.
ls_master-currcode = 'USD'.

APPEND ls_master TO lt_master.
CLEAR  ls_master.

SORT lt_master BY carrid. "itab 정렬
DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_master COMPARING carrid. "SORT 먼저
"JOIN 필드 기준으로 중복제거, 값이 있을때만 로직 수행
IF lt_master IS NOT INITIAL.

  SELECT a~carrid a~connid a~airpfrom a~airpto
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM spfli AS a
   INNER JOIN sflight AS b
      ON a~carrid = b~carrid
     AND a~connid = b~connid
*   INNER JOIN lt_master AS b 불가능
     FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_master " AS b 가 불가능하다.. 그 뜻은 itab의 필드는 select 못한다는뜻
   WHERE b~carrid = lt_master-carrid.

ENDIF.

*상황
*ALV 출력용 ITAB gt_data 기준으로 sflight 를 select 할 상황이 나왔다.
*for all entries 로 붙어야하는데 이것을 사용하기 위해서는 중복제거 필수
*중복제거하다가 gt_data  의 레코드가 손실이 될 위험이 생길 수 있으니
*for all entries 로 join 할 필드만 따로 써야함. -> 그릇 만들기

*gt_data 의 carrid , connid 기준으로 sflight select

DATA : BEGIN OF ls_key,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid TYPE sflight-connid,
       END OF ls_key,

       lt_key     LIKE TABLE OF ls_key,
       lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data TO lt_key. "그릇 만들고 record 전송

SORT lt_key BY carrid connid.
DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_key COMPARING carrid connid.

IF lt_key IS NOT INITIAL.

  SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight
    FROM sflight
     FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_key
   WHERE carrid EQ lt_key-carrid
     AND connid EQ lt_key-connid.

ENDIF.
**********************************************************************
**********************************************************************
**********************************************************************


** 문자열 결합
** CONCATENATE 구문
** 사용가능 타입 : C, N, D, T, STRING 만 가능 / I 불가  .

DATA : lv_char(20)   VALUE 'CODE1 CLASS 5     ',
       lv_numc(4)    TYPE n VALUE '7',
       lv_pack       TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '234.04',
       lv_int        TYPE i VALUE 70,
       lv_result(50).

CONCATENATE sy-datum lv_char lv_numc INTO lv_result
SEPARATED BY space. "구분, 공백

WRITE : lv_result .

CLEAR lv_result.

lv_result = sy-datum && lv_char && lv_numc && sy-datum.

WRITE : /.

lv_result = | 코드| && lv_numc.

WRITE lv_result.

lv_result = |오늘 날짜는 { sy-datum } 시간은 { sy-uzeit }|.
WRITE lv_result.
CONCATENATE sy-datum lv_char lv_numc INTO lv_result
RESPECTING BLANKS SEPARATED BY space.
"ABAP 은 의미없는 공백은 지우지만 RESPECTING BLANKS.은 공백 존중
WRITE : /, lv_result .

lv_result = lv_char && space && lv_numc && space && lv_int.
WRITE : /, lv_result.

lv_result = |{ lv_char } { lv_numc } { lv_int }|.
WRITE : / , lv_result.

*변수에 WRITE 했을때 효과

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505RLECT11_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_dynamic_list
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_dynamic_list .

  DATA : lt_mara    TYPE TABLE OF mara, "data 선언
         lt_marc    TYPE TABLE OF marc,
         lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS : <lft_itab> TYPE ANY TABLE.

  REFRESH  : lt_mara, lt_marc, lt_sflight.
  UNASSIGN : <lft_itab>. "Clear

  CASE pa_tab.
    WHEN 'MARA'.
      ASSIGN lt_mara TO <lft_itab>.

    WHEN 'MARC'.
      ASSIGN lt_marc TO <lft_itab>.

    WHEN 'SFLIGHT'.
      ASSIGN lt_sflight TO <lft_itab>.

  ENDCASE.

  IF <lft_itab> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH pa_tab 'Table name is wrong' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lft_itab>
    UP TO 10 ROWS
    FROM (pa_tab).

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

  cl_demo_output=>display( <lft_itab> ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_dynamic_list_2
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_dynamic_list_2 .

  DATA : lt_mara    TYPE TABLE OF mara, "data 선언
         lt_marc    TYPE TABLE OF marc,
         lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight,
         lv_tabname TYPE dd03l-tabname.
  "dd02l
  FIELD-SYMBOLS : <lft_itab> TYPE ANY TABLE.

  CLEAR    : lv_tabname.
  REFRESH  : lt_mara, lt_marc, lt_sflight.
  UNASSIGN : <lft_itab>. "Clear

  CASE pa_tab.
    WHEN 'MARA'.
      lv_tabname = 'LT_MARA'.

    WHEN 'MARC'.
      lv_tabname = 'LT_MARC'.

    WHEN 'SFLIGHT'.
      lv_tabname = 'LT_SFLIGHT'.

  ENDCASE.

  ASSIGN (lv_tabname) TO <lft_itab>.

*IF SY-SUBRC NE 0 , 이것도 가능
  IF <lft_itab> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH pa_tab 'Table name is wrong' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lft_itab>
    UP TO 10 ROWS
    FROM (pa_tab).

  ENDIF.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form write_field_dynamic_itab
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_field_dynamic_itab .

  DATA : lt_mara    TYPE TABLE OF mara, "data 선언
         lt_marc    TYPE TABLE OF marc,
         lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight,
         lv_tabname TYPE dd03l-tabname.
  "dd02l
  FIELD-SYMBOLS : <lft_itab>  TYPE ANY TABLE,
                  <lfs_itab>  TYPE any, "스트럭쳐
                  <lfv_field> TYPE any.

  CLEAR    : lv_tabname.
  REFRESH  : lt_mara, lt_marc, lt_sflight.
  UNASSIGN : <lft_itab>, <lfs_itab>, <lfv_field>. "Clear

  CASE pa_tab.
    WHEN 'MARA'.
      lv_tabname = 'LT_MARA'.

    WHEN 'MARC'.
      lv_tabname = 'LT_MARC'.

    WHEN 'SFLIGHT'.
      lv_tabname = 'LT_SFLIGHT'.

  ENDCASE.

  ASSIGN (lv_tabname) TO <lft_itab>.

  IF <lft_itab> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH pa_tab 'Table name is wrong' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lft_itab>
    FROM (pa_tab).

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

*dynamic itab 에서 필드 뽑는법
  LOOP AT <lft_itab> ASSIGNING <lfs_itab>.

    UNASSIGN <lfv_field>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 2 OF STRUCTURE <lfs_itab> TO <lfv_field>.

    IF <lft_itab> IS ASSIGNED.
      WRITE : <lfv_field>.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  cl_demo_output=>display( <lft_itab> ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form write_field_dynamic_itab_2
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_field_dynamic_itab_2 .

  DATA : lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight,
         lv_field   TYPE fieldname.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS : <lft_itab>  TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                  <lfs_itab>  TYPE any,
                  <lfv_field> TYPE any.

  REFRESH : lt_sflight.
  UNASSIGN : <lfs_itab>, <lft_itab>, <lfv_field>.

  ASSIGN ('LT_SFLIGHT') TO <lft_itab>.

  lv_field = 'CARRID CONNID FLDATE PRICE'.

  SELECT (lv_field)
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lft_itab>
    FROM sflight.

*  lv_field = 'CARRID'.
*  READ TABLE <lft_itab> ASSIGNING <lfs_itab> WITH KEY (lv_field) = 'AA'.

*MODIFY , INDEX 사용 X, ITAB 구조를 바로 바꿔준다
  LOOP AT <lft_itab> ASSIGNING <lfs_itab>.

    UNASSIGN <lfv_field>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <lfs_itab> TO <lfv_field>.

    IF <lfv_field> IS ASSIGNED.

      CASE <lfv_field>.
        WHEN 'JL'.
          <lfv_field> = 'KA'.

      ENDCASE.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

*  cl_demo_output=>display( <lft_itab> ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form field_control_dynamic_itab
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM field_control_dynamic_itab .

  DATA : lt_fagl   TYPE TABLE OF faglflext,
         ls_fagl   LIKE LINE OF lt_fagl,
         lv_field  TYPE fieldname,
         lv_mon(2) TYPE n.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS : <lfv_field> TYPE any.

*clear
  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_fagl
    FROM faglflext
   WHERE ryear = '2026'.

*HSL01 ~ HSL12 필드에 10,000 을 더하는 로직

  DATA : lv_name(50),
         lv_num(2) TYPE n.

  LOOP AT lt_fagl INTO ls_fagl.

    DO 12 TIMES.
      lv_mon = sy-index.

      CLEAR lv_field.
      UNASSIGN <lfv_field>.

*     ASSIGN 구문을 사용할때는 할당하고자 하는 변수(스트럭쳐,ITAB등)
*     FULL NAME 을 줘야한다.

      CONCATENATE 'LS_FAGL-HSL' lv_mon INTO lv_field.

      ASSIGN (lv_field) TO <lfv_field>. " () 를 안하면 그냥 lv_field 가 된다, 구조를 받음.
      " 값을 주고 싶을때 ()

*      ASSIGN COMPONENT : Structure 에만 사용 가능
*         CONCATENATE 'HSL' lv_mon INTO lv_field.
*         ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field OF STRUCTURE ls_fagl TO <lfv_field>.

      IF <lfv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        <lfv_field> = <lfv_field> + 10000.
      ENDIF.

    ENDDO.

  ENDLOOP.

** 공통사항 : ASSING 대상은 반드시 해당 FORM 또는 TOP 에 DATA 로 선언이 되어 있는 것만 가능하다.
*
*  ASSIGN lt_fagl TO <lt_itab>.    "--> lt_fagl itab 과 필드심볼 동일화
*  ASSIGN lv_matnr TO <lv_field>.  "--> lv_matnr 필드가 필드심볼과 동일화
*  ASSIGN ls_fagl TO <lfs_itab>.   "--> ls_fagl 스트럭쳐가 필드심볼과 동일화
*  ASSIGN (lv_var) TO <fs>.        "--> lv_var 변수 안의 값이 필드심볼과 동일화
** ASSIGN 구문을 사용할때는 필드심볼에 할당할 대상의 FULL NAME 이 와야한다.
*
*  ASSIGN COMPONENT <필드> OF STRUCTURE <structure> TO <fs>.
*  "--> ASSIGN COMPONET 는 스트럭쳐에만 사용 가능.

ENDFORM.

FORM get_data .

  SELECT *
     INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data
     FROM zc505cds0004
    WHERE carrid EQ @pa_car
      AND connid EQ @pa_con
      AND fldate EQ @pa_fld.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

  "필수 입력이라 DEFAULT 값 설정
  pa_car = 'AA'.
  pa_con = '0017'.
  pa_fld = '20250731'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
      'X'  'STATUS'   'STATUS' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      'X'  'CARRID'   ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      'X'  'CONNID'   ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      'X'  'FLDATE'   ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      'X'  'BOOKID'   ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'CARRNAME' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'CITYFROM' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'CITYTO' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'PRICE' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'CURRCODE ' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'SMOKER' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'LUGGWEIGHT' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'WUNIT' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' ,
      ' '  'FORCURKEY' ' ' 'ZC505CDS0004' ' ' .

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.

    WHEN 'PRICE'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'CURRCODE'.
    WHEN 'FORCURAM'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'FORCURKEY'.
    WHEN 'LUGGWEIGHT'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'WUNIT'.
    WHEN 'SMOKER'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox = 'X'.
    WHEN 'STATUS'.
      gs_fcat-icon = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                       " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout        " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data           " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout2
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout2 .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'ZC505CDS0004'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat.

  DELETE gt_fcat INDEX 1.

  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.

      WHEN 'STATUS'.
        <fs_fcat>-key  = 'X'.
        <fs_fcat>-icon = 'X'.
        <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'STATUS'.
        <fs_fcat>-col_pos = 1.

      WHEN 'CARRID' OR 'CONNID' OR 'FLDATE' OR 'BOOKID'.
        <fs_fcat>-key = 'X'.

*      WHEN 'PRICE'.
*        <fs_fcat>-cfieldname = 'CURRCODE'.

*      WHEN 'LUGGWEIGHT'.
*        <fs_fcat>-qfieldname = 'WUNIT'.

      WHEN 'SMOKER'.
        <fs_fcat>-checkbox = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data
    FROM zc505cds0005
    UP TO 50 ROWS
   WHERE carrier     EQ @pa_car
     AND connect_no  EQ @pa_con

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'ZC505CDS0005'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat.

  DELETE gt_fcat INDEX 1.

  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.

      WHEN 'CARRIER' OR 'CONNECT_NO' OR 'FLIGHT_DATE' OR 'BOOKING_ID'.

      WHEN 'AIRPLANE_TYPE'.
        <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'AIRPLANE_TYPE'.

  CASE gv_pressed.

    WHEN 'SECOND'.

  ENDCASE.

  IF gcl_container_f IS BOUND.

  IF gcl_container_b IS BOUND.

    FREE : gcl_grid_b, gcl_container_b.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  RANGES : lr_carrid FOR scarr-carrid,
           lr_connid FOR sflight-connid,
           lr_fldate FOR sflight-fldate.

  REFRESH : lr_carrid, lr_connid, lr_fldate, gt_data.

  IF pa_car IS NOT INITIAL.

    lr_carrid[] = VALUE #(
                  (
                  sign   = 'I'
                  option = 'EQ'
                  low    = pa_car
                  )
                        ).

  ENDIF.

  IF pa_con IS NOT INITIAL.

    lr_connid[] = VALUE #(
                    (
                  sign   = 'I'
                  option = 'EQ'
                  low    = pa_con
                    )
                        ).

  ENDIF.

  IF pa_fld IS NOT INITIAL.

    lr_fldate-sign   = 'I'.
    lr_fldate-option = 'EQ'.
    lr_fldate-low    = pa_fld.

    APPEND lr_fldate.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT status, carrid, connid, fldate, carrname,
         cityfrom, cityto, price, currcode
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data
    FROM zc505cds0014
*      UP TO 300 ROWS
   WHERE carrid IN @lr_carrid
     AND connid IN @lr_connid
     AND fldate IN @lr_fldate
   ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s001.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
              zebra      = 'X'
              cwidth_opt = 'A'
              sel_mode   = 'B'
              grid_title = TEXT-t02
              smalltitle = 'X'
                   ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                row = 'X'
                col = 'X'
                     ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'ZC505CDSV0014'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat.

  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.

      WHEN 'STATUS'.
        <fs_fcat>-key = 'X'.
        <fs_fcat>-col_pos = 1.
        <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Status'.
        <fs_fcat>-icon    = 'X'.

      WHEN 'CARRID'.
        <fs_fcat>-hotspot = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                       " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot       FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_double_click  FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                 " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout        " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data           " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                              ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO DATA(gs_data) INDEX ps_row-index.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  PERFORM get_sbook_data USING gs_data-carrid
                               gs_data-connid
                               gs_data-fldate.

  IF gt_sbook IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL SCREEN '0101' STARTING AT 20 3.




ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_double_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW
*&      --> E_COLUMN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_double_click  USING     ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                    ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO DATA(gs_data) INDEX ps_row-index.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'FLDATE'.
      PERFORM get_sflight USING gs_data-carrid
                                gs_data-connid
                                gs_data-fldate.

      CALL SCREEN '0102' STARTING AT 20 3.

    WHEN OTHERS.
      EXIT.

  ENDCASE.

  IF gt_sflight IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout_pop
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout_pop .

  gs_layout = VALUE #( BASE gs_layout
            grid_title = 'SBOOK INFO'
            smalltitle = 'X'
            no_toolbar = 'X'
                 ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'SBOOK'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat_sbook.

  LOOP AT gt_fcat_sbook ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.

      WHEN 'CARRID' OR 'CONNID' OR 'FLDATE' OR 'BOOKID'.
        <fs_fcat>-key = 'X'.

      WHEN 'LUGGWEIGHT' OR 'WUNIT' OR 'FORCURAM' OR 'FORCURKEY'.

      WHEN 'INVOICE'.
        <fs_fcat>-checkbox = 'X'.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        <fs_fcat>-no_out = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout_pop2
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout_pop2 .

  gs_layout = VALUE #( BASE gs_layout
            grid_title = 'SFLIGHT INFO'
            smalltitle = 'X'
            no_toolbar = 'X'
                 ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat_sflight.

  LOOP AT gt_fcat_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.

      WHEN 'CARRID' OR 'CONNID' OR 'FLDATE' OR
           'PRICE' OR 'WUNIT' OR 'CURRENCY' OR 'PLANETYPE'.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        <fs_fcat>-no_out = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_sflight
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_sflight  USING    pv_carrid TYPE scarr-carrid
                           pv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                           pv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate..

* ADBC 관련
  DATA : lcl_conn    TYPE REF TO cl_sql_connection,
         lcl_sql     TYPE REF TO cl_sql_statement,
         lcl_result  TYPE REF TO cl_sql_result_set,
         lr_data     TYPE REF TO data,
         lx_sql_exec TYPE REF TO cx_root,
         lv_sql      TYPE string,
         lv_msg      TYPE string.

  CLEAR   : gs_sflight.
  REFRESH : gt_sflight.

  TRY.

      lcl_conn = cl_sql_connection=>get_connection( ).

      CREATE OBJECT lcl_sql
        EXPORTING
          con_ref = lcl_conn.

      lv_sql = | SELECT CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE,   | &&
               | PRICE, CURRENCY, PLANETYPE       | &&
               |   FROM SFLIGHT                   | &&
               |  WHERE MANDT  = '{ sy-mandt }'   | &&
               |    AND CARRID = '{ pv_carrid }'  | &&
               |    AND CONNID = '{ pv_connid }'  | &&
               |    AND FLDATE = '{ pv_fldate }'  | .

      lcl_result = lcl_sql->execute_query( lv_sql ).

      GET REFERENCE OF gs_sflight INTO lr_data.

* Structure 형태로 받으려고 set_param_struct 메소드 호출함
      lcl_result->set_param_struct( lr_data ).

      lcl_result->next( ). "Structure 형태로 하나 받으므로 next 메소드 호출
      lcl_result->close( ).

  DATA : lcl_connection TYPE REF TO cl_sql_connection,

         lcl_result     TYPE REF TO cl_sql_result_set,
         lr_data        TYPE REF TO data,
         lr_param       TYPE REF TO data,
         lv_sql         TYPE string,
         lx_sql_except  TYPE REF TO cx_root,
         lv_msg         TYPE string.

  TRY.

      lcl_connection = cl_sql_connection=>get_connection( ).

      CREATE OBJECT lcl_statement
        EXPORTING
          con_ref = lcl_connection.

      lv_sql = | SELECT a.AUFNR, a.AUART, a.BUKRS, a.WERKS, c.MATNR,         |
            && |        b.GSTRP, c.POSNR, b.GLTRP, b.RSNUM, c.PSMNG, c.AMEIN |
            && |   FROM AUFK AS a                                            |
            && |  INNER JOIN afko as b                                       |
            && |  on a.aufnr = b.aufnr                                       |
            && |  INNER JOIN afpo as c                                       |
            && |  on a.aufnr = c.aufnr                                       |
            && |  WHERE a.MANDT = ?                                          | "? 은 파라미터 자리가 된다.
            && |    AND a.BUKRS = ?                                          | .

      GET REFERENCE OF sy-mandt INTO lr_param. "lr_parma 이 mandt 포인터, 그래서 set+

      GET REFERENCE OF pa_buk INTO lr_param.
      lcl_statement->set_param( lr_param ).
       "받아올 장소를 저장한다.
      lcl_result = lcl_statement->execute_query( lv_sql ).
      "lr_data, 메모리 주소 공유, 저장된 데이터만 뽑아서 온다. get_refrence /  set_parameter 가 끌어와준다.
      GET REFERENCE OF gt_product INTO lr_data.

      lcl_result->set_param_table( lr_data ).
      lcl_result->next_package( ).

      lcl_result->close( ).

    CATCH cx_sql_exception INTO lx_sql_except.

      lv_msg = lx_sql_except->get_text( ).

      IF lcl_connection IS BOUND.
        TRY.
            lcl_connection->close( ).
          CATCH cx_sql_exception.

        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      EXIT.

  ENDTRY.

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
              zebra      = 'X'
              cwidth_opt = 'A'
              sel_mode   = 'B'
              grid_title = TEXT-t02
              smalltitle = 'X'
              ctab_fname = 'COLOR'
                   ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                row = 'X'
                col = 'X'
                     ).

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
      'X' 'BUKRS'  ' ' 'BKPF'  ' ' ,
      'X' 'GJAHR'  ' ' 'BKPF'  ' ' ,
      'X' 'BELNR'  ' ' 'BKPF'  ' ' ,
      'X' 'BUZEI'  ' ' 'BSEG'  ' ' ,
      ' ' 'BUDAT'  ' ' 'BKPF'  ' ' ,
      ' ' 'BSCHL'  ' ' 'BSEG'  ' ' ,
      ' ' 'DMBTR'  ' ' 'BSEG'  ' ' ,
      ' ' 'PSWSL'  ' ' 'BSEG'  ' ' .

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_color
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_color .

  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_data>).

    IF <lfs_data>-bschl = 40.
      <lfs_data>-color = VALUE lvc_t_scol(
                            ( fname = 'BSCHL'
                              color = VALUE #( col = 5 int = 1 inv = 0 ) )
                                ).

    ENDIF.

    IF <lfs_data>-pswsl EQ 'EUR'.
      <lfs_data>-pswsl = 'KRW'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field.


  DATA(gs_fcat) = VALUE lvc_s_fcat(
                      key       = pv_key
                      fieldname = pv_field
                      coltext   = pv_text
                      ref_table = pv_ref_table
                      ref_field = pv_ref_field
                             ).

  CASE pv_field.

    WHEN 'DMBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'PSWSL'.

    WHEN 'BELNR'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.

  ENDCASE.

  gt_fcat = VALUE #( BASE gt_fcat ( gs_fcat ) ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.               " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                  " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout        " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data           " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                              ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO DATA(gs_data) INDEX ps_row-index.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.

    WHEN 'BELNR'.

      SET PARAMETER ID :
        'BLN' FIELD gs_data-belnr,
        'BUK' FIELD pa_bukrs,
        'GJR' FIELD pa_gjahr.

      CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

  REFRESH gt_data.

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
              zebra      = 'X'
              cwidth_opt = 'A'
              sel_mode   = 'D'
              grid_title = TEXT-t02
              smalltitle = 'X'
                   ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                row = 'X'
                col = 'X'
                     ).

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
    'X' 'MATNR'  ' ' 'MARA'  ' ' ,
    'X' 'WERKS'  ' ' 'MARC'  ' ' ,
    ' ' 'MAKTX'  ' ' 'MAKT'  ' ' ,
    ' ' 'VPSTA'  ' ' 'MARA'  ' ' ,
    ' ' 'MBRSH'  ' ' 'MARA'  ' ' ,
    ' ' 'MBBEZ'  ' ' 'T137T' ' ' ,
    ' ' 'MEINS'  ' ' 'MARA'  ' ' ,
    ' ' 'EKGRP'  ' ' 'MARC'  ' ' ,
    ' ' 'DISMM'  ' ' 'MARC'  ' ' ,
    ' ' 'BESKZ'  ' ' 'MARC'  ' '.

*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING     pv_key
                          pv_field
                          pv_text
                          pv_ref_table
                          pv_ref_field.


  gs_fcat = VALUE #(
            key       = pv_key
            fieldname = pv_field
            coltext   = pv_text
            ref_table = pv_ref_table
            ref_field = pv_ref_field
                   ).

  CASE pv_field.

    WHEN 'WERKS'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.

*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                       " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot       FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_double_click  FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                 " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout        " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data           " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot  USING  ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                            ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  REFRESH : gt_marc.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

*  READ TABLE gt_data INTO DATA(gs_data) INDEX ps_row-index.

  DATA(ls_data) = VALUE #( gt_data[ ps_row-index ] OPTIONAL ).

  CHECK ls_data IS NOT INITIAL.

  CHECK ps_col-fieldname EQ 'WERKS'.

  PERFORM get_marc_data USING ls_data-matnr
                              ls_data-werks.

  IF gt_marc IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL SCREEN '0101' STARTING AT 20 3.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_double_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text

FORM handle_double_click  USING  ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                 ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

*  DATA(ls_data) = VALUE #( gt_data[ ps_row-index ] OPTIONAL ).

  DATA(ls_data) = gt_data[ ps_row-index ].

  CHECK ls_data IS NOT INITIAL.

  CHECK ps_col-fieldname EQ 'MATNR'.

  PERFORM get_mara_data USING ls_data-matnr.

  IF gt_mara IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data not found'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL SCREEN '0102' STARTING AT 20 3.


ENDFORM.

*& Form get_marc_data

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_DATA_MATNR
*&      --> LS_DATA_WERKS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_marc_data  USING    pv_matnr TYPE marc-matnr
                             pv_werks TYPE marc-werks.

  SELECT *
    FROM zc505cds0018
    INTO TABLE @gt_marc
   WHERE matnr EQ @pv_matnr
     AND werks EQ @pv_werks.

ENDFORM.

FORM set_fcat_layout_pop .

        no_toolbar = 'X'

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_mara_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_DATA_MATNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_mara_data  USING  pv_matnr TYPE mara-matnr.

  REFRESH: gt_mara.

  DATA : lcl_connection TYPE REF TO cl_sql_connection, "DB 연결
         lcl_statement  TYPE REF TO cl_sql_statement, "SQL 실행
         lcl_result     TYPE REF TO cl_sql_result_set, "결과 받기
         lr_data        TYPE REF TO data,
         lv_sql         TYPE string,
         lx_sql_except  TYPE REF TO cx_root,
         lv_msg         TYPE string.

  TRY.
      lcl_connection = cl_sql_connection=>get_connection( ). " DB CONNECTION 정보 얻기

      CREATE OBJECT lcl_statement
        EXPORTING
          con_ref = lcl_connection.                          " Database Connection

      lv_sql =   | SELECT A.MATNR, B.MAKTX, A.MTART, C.MTBEZ, A.MATKL, D.MBBEZ | &&
                 |   FROM MARA AS A                                            | &&
                 |   LEFT OUTER JOIN MAKT AS B                                 | &&
                 |     ON A.MATNR = B.MATNR                                    | &&
                 |    AND B.SPRAS = '{ sy-langu }'                             | &&
                 |    AND B.MANDT = '{ sy-mandt }'                             | &&
                 |   LEFT OUTER JOIN T134T AS C                                | &&
                 |     ON A.MTART = C.MTART                                    | &&
                 |    AND C.SPRAS = '{ sy-langu }'                             | &&
                 |    AND C.MANDT = '{ sy-mandt }'                             | &&
                 |   LEFT OUTER JOIN T137T AS D                                | &&
                 |     ON A.MBRSH = D.MBRSH                                    | &&
                 |    AND D.SPRAS = '{ sy-langu }'                             | &&
                 |    AND D.MANDT = '{ sy-mandt }'                             | &&
                 |  WHERE A.MANDT  = '{ sy-mandt  }'                           | &&
                 |    AND A.MATNR  = '{ pv_matnr }'                            |.

      lcl_result = lcl_statement->execute_query( lv_sql ).

      GET REFERENCE OF gt_mara INTO lr_data.

      lcl_result->set_param_table( lr_data ).


      lcl_result->next_package( ).

      lcl_result->close( ).

    CATCH cx_sql_exception INTO lx_sql_except.

      lv_msg = lx_sql_except->get_text( ).
      lcl_result->close( ).

      MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      EXIT.

  ENDTRY.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505R0072_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_param

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_param .

  pa_car = 'AA'.
  pa_con = '0017'.
  pa_fld = '20250731'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  PERFORM get_sflight.
  PERFORM get_sbook.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_sflight
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_sflight .

  REFRESH: gt_sflight.

  DATA : lcl_statement TYPE REF TO cl_sql_statement.

  TRY.
      DATA(lcl_connection) = cl_sql_connection=>get_connection( ). " DB CONNECTION 정보 얻기

      CREATE OBJECT lcl_statement
        EXPORTING
          con_ref = lcl_connection.                          " Database Connection

      DATA(lv_sql) =   | SELECT *                          | &&
                       |   FROM SFLIGHT                    | &&
                       |  WHERE MANDT  = '{ sy-mandt  }'   | &&
                       |    AND CARRID  = '{ pa_car }'     | &&
                       |    AND CONNID  = '{ pa_con }'     | &&
                       |    AND FLDATE  = '{ pa_fld }'     |.


      DATA(lcl_result) = lcl_statement->execute_query( lv_sql ).

      GET REFERENCE OF gt_sflight INTO DATA(lr_data).

      lcl_result->set_param_table( lr_data ).

      lcl_result->next_package( ).

      lcl_result->close( ).

    CATCH cx_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql_except).

      DATA(lv_msg) = lx_sql_except->get_text( ).
      lcl_result->close( ).

      MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      EXIT.

  ENDTRY.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_sbook
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_sbook .

  CALL METHOD zc505cl_amdp_04=>modify_sbook
    EXPORTING
      iv_carrid = pa_car
      iv_connid = pa_con
      iv_fldate = pa_fld
    IMPORTING
      et_list   = DATA(lt_sbook).

  CHECK lt_sbook IS NOT INITIAL.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_sbook TO gt_sbook.

*  PERFORM set_desc. 방법 1
  PERFORM set_desc_test. "방법 2


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
                   zebra = 'X'
                   cwidth_opt = 'A'
                   sel_mode = 'D'
                     ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                    row = 'X'
                    col = 'X'
                      ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout_1
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout_1 .

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'                 " Structure name (structure, table, view)
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat_1.                 " Field Catalog with Field Descriptions

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen_1
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen_1 .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container_1
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER_1'.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_1
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_1.

  gs_variant-report  = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'A1'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant                 " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout                " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_sflight               " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_1.                 " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout_2
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout_2 .

  PERFORM make_fcat_sbook USING :
         'X'  'CARRID'         ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         'X'  'CONNID'         ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         'X'  'FLDATE'         ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         'X'  'BOOKID'         ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'CUSTOMID'       ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'CUSTTYPE'       ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'CUSTTYPE_DESC'  TEXT-m01  'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'LUGGWEIGHT'     ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'WUNIT'          ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'INVOICE'        ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'CLASS'          ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'CLASS_DESC'     TEXT-m02  'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'FORCURAM'       ''        'SBOOK'  '',
         ' '  'FORCURKEY'      ''        'SBOOK'  ''.

ENDFORM.

    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER_2'.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_2
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_2.

  gs_variant-report  = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'A2'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_2->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant
      i_save          = 'A'
      i_default       = 'X'
      is_layout       = gs_layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_sbook
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_2.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_sbook
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_sbook  USING   pv_key
                              pv_field
                              pv_text
                              pv_ref_table
                              pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.

    WHEN 'LUGGWEIGHT'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'WUNIT'.

    WHEN 'FORCURAM'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'FORCURKEY'.

    WHEN 'INVOICE'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox = 'X'.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_2.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_desc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_desc .

  DATA : lv_value TYPE dd07v-domvalue_l,
         lv_text  TYPE dd07v-ddtext.


  LOOP AT gt_sbook ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sbook>).

    lv_value = <fs_sbook>-class.

    CALL FUNCTION 'C_DIC_DOMAIN_VALUE_TEXT_READ'
      EXPORTING
        name  = 'S_CLASS'
        spras = sy-langu
        value = lv_value
      IMPORTING
        text  = lv_text.

    <fs_sbook>-class_desc = lv_text.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_desc_test
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_desc_test .

  DATA lt_dom TYPE TABLE OF dd07v.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DD_DOMVALUES_GET'
    EXPORTING
      domname   = 'S_CLASS'
      text      = 'X'
      langu     = sy-langu
    TABLES
      dd07v_tab = lt_dom.

*DOMVALUE_L	도메인 값
*DDTEXT	설명 텍스트

  LOOP AT gt_sbook ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sbook>).

    <fs_sbook>-class_desc =
      VALUE #( lt_dom[ domvalue_l = <fs_sbook>-class ]-ddtext OPTIONAL ).

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

*& Form get_data
