*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  REFRESH : gt_mat_del.

  SELECT *
    FROM zc505t0022
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_mat
   WHERE matnr IN so_mat
     AND auart EQ pa_aua.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
              zebra      = 'X'
              cwidth_opt = 'A'
              sel_mode   = 'B'
              grid_title = TEXT-t02 "Material with Sale Org
              smalltitle = 'X'
              stylefname = 'STYLE'
                   ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                row = 'X'
                col = 'X'
                     ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'ZC505T0022'                 " Structure name (structure, table, view)
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat.

  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.

      WHEN 'AUART'.

        <fs_fcat>-edit = ' '.

      WHEN 'ERDAT' OR 'ERZET' OR 'ERNAM'
            OR 'AEDAT' OR 'AEZET' OR 'AENAM'.

        <fs_fcat>-no_out = 'X'.

      WHEN OTHERS.

        <fs_fcat>-edit = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

*  gcl_container = NEW #( side = gcl_container->dock_at_left
*                         extension = 5000 ).

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.              " Control Extenson


  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                " Parent Container

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_toolbar          FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_user_command     FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_changed_finished FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.   " Event ID

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout        " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude       " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_mat           " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING  pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button.

  pt_toolbar = VALUE #( BASE pt_toolbar
              (
                 function = 'CREATE'
                 butn_type = 0
                 icon = icon_insert_row
                 text = 'Create'
                 quickinfo = 'Create'
                 )
              (
                  function  = 'DELETE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_delete_row
                  text      = 'Delete'
                  quickinfo = 'Delete'
                 )

          ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING   pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.
      PERFORM create_data.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

    WHEN 'DELETE'.
      PERFORM delete_data.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING  pv_modified
                                     pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_modi>).

    READ TABLE gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) INDEX <fs_modi>-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    <fs_mat>-mark = 'X'.

  ENDLOOP.

*  LOOP AT pt_good_cells ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_modi>).
*
*    ASSIGN gt_mat[ <fs_modi>-row_id ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>).
*
*    IF <fs_mat> IS ASSIGNED.
*      <fs_mat>-mark = 'X'.
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_data .

  CLEAR gs_mat.

  gs_mat = VALUE #(
            mark = 'X'
            matnr = so_mat
            auart = pa_aua
                  ).

  APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat.
  CLEAR gs_mat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = DATA(lt_row).

  IF lt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '삭제할 행을 먼저 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_row BY index DESCENDING.

*  LOOP AT lt_row ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
*
*    READ TABLE gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) INDEX <fs_row>-index.
*
*    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*      APPEND <fs_mat> TO gt_mat_del.
*
*      DELETE gt_mat INDEX <fs_row>-index.
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ENDLOOP.


*  LOOP AT lt_row INTO DATA(ls_row).
*
*    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX ls_row-index.
*
*    gs_mat = VALUE #( gt_mat[ ls_row-index ] OPTIONAL ).
*
*    IF gs_mat IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*      APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat_del.      "삭제할 레코드를 gt_mat_del 에 옮겨준다.
*      CLEAR  gs_mat.
*
*      DELETE gt_mat INDEX ls_row-index. "gt_mat 에서 해당 레코드를 지워준다.
*
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT lt_row INTO DATA(ls_row).

    ASSIGN gt_mat[ ls_row-index ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>).

    IF <fs_mat> IS ASSIGNED.

      APPEND <fs_mat> TO gt_mat_del.
      DELETE gt_mat INDEX ls_row-index.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .
*  ALV Grid에서 특정 컬럼을 수정 불가 처리

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_mat>).

    <lfs_mat>-style = VALUE #( "lvc_t_styl

      ( fieldname = 'MATNR'
        style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled )

      ( fieldname = 'AUART'
        style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled )

    ).

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : lv_commit,
         lt_save   TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0022,
         ls_save   LIKE LINE OF lt_save,
         lt_del    TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0022.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_mat_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    lt_del = CORRESPONDING #( gt_mat_del ).

    DELETE zc505t0022 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
    lv_commit = 'X'.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) WHERE mark IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF <fs_mat>-matnr IS INITIAL OR <fs_mat>-auart IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    ls_save = CORRESPONDING zc505t0022( <fs_mat> ).

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. " 신규 데이터
      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.
    ELSE.                        " 기존 데이터 수정
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0022 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_mat_del.

    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    CLEAR <fs_mat>-mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_param
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_param .

  pa_aua = 'AA'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form exclude_alv
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_alv .

  gt_exclude = VALUE #(
                             ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo )        "DUNO 제거
                             ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut )         "CUT
                             ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_mb_paste )           "PASTE
                             ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row )    "COPY_ROW
                             ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row )  "APPNED_ROW
                             ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row )  "DELETE_ROW
                             ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row )  "INSERT_ROW
                         ).

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = DATA(lt_row).

  IF lt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '삭제할 행을 먼저 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_row BY index DESCENDING.

*  LOOP AT lt_row ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
*
*    READ TABLE gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) INDEX <fs_row>-index.
*
*    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*      APPEND <fs_mat> TO gt_mat_del.
*
*      DELETE gt_mat INDEX <fs_row>-index.
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ENDLOOP.


*  LOOP AT lt_row INTO DATA(ls_row).
*
*    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX ls_row-index.
*
*    gs_mat = VALUE #( gt_mat[ ls_row-index ] OPTIONAL ).
*
*    IF gs_mat IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*      APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat_del.      "삭제할 레코드를 gt_mat_del 에 옮겨준다.
*      CLEAR  gs_mat.
*
*      DELETE gt_mat INDEX ls_row-index. "gt_mat 에서 해당 레코드를 지워준다.
*
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT lt_row INTO DATA(ls_row).

    ASSIGN gt_mat[ ls_row-index ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>).

    IF <fs_mat> IS ASSIGNED.

      APPEND <fs_mat> TO gt_mat_del.
      DELETE gt_mat INDEX ls_row-index.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .
*  ALV Grid에서 특정 컬럼을 수정 불가 처리

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_mat>).

    <lfs_mat>-style = VALUE #( "lvc_t_styl

      ( fieldname = 'MATNR'
        style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled )

      ( fieldname = 'AUART'
        style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled )

    ).

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : lv_commit,
         lt_save   TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0022,
         ls_save   LIKE LINE OF lt_save,
         lt_del    TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0022.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_mat_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    lt_del = CORRESPONDING #( gt_mat_del ).

    DELETE zc505t0022 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
    lv_commit = 'X'.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) WHERE mark IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF <fs_mat>-matnr IS INITIAL OR <fs_mat>-auart IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    ls_save = CORRESPONDING zc505t0022( <fs_mat> ).

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. " 신규 데이터
      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.
    ELSE.                        " 기존 데이터 수정
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zc505t0022 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_mat_del.

    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    CLEAR <fs_mat>-mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505RLECT16_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_table
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_table .

  CLEAR   : gs_data.
  REFRESH : gt_data.

  DATA : lcl_statement TYPE REF TO cl_sql_statement,   " SQL 실행 객체
*         lcl_connection TYPE REF TO cl_sql_connection,  " DB 커넥션
*         lcl_result    TYPE REF TO cl_sql_result_set,  " SELECT 결과
         lr_data       TYPE REF TO data,               " 동적 결과 수신
         lv_sql        TYPE string,                    " SQL 문자열
         lx_sql_exept  TYPE REF TO cx_root,             " 예외 객체
         lv_msg        TYPE string.                    " 메시지

  TRY.  "TRY–CATCH 없으면 덤프(ST22)
*DB Connection 연결정보 얻기
      DATA(lcl_connection) = cl_sql_connection=>get_connection( ). "DEFAULT CONNECTION 얻기

*SQL 을 실행할 객체에 CONNECTION 전달
      CREATE OBJECT lcl_statement
        EXPORTING
          con_ref = lcl_connection.

*실행할 SQL 구문 작성
      lv_sql = | SELECT CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE, CURRENCY| &&
               |   FROM SFLIGHT                                | &&
               |  WHERE MANDT  = '{ sy-mandt }'                | &&
               |    AND CARRID = '{ pa_carr }'                 |.

*SQL 을 실행하고 결과 받기
      DATA(lcl_result) = lcl_statement->execute_query( lv_sql ).

*결과를 받기 위해서 Any Data 와 itab 을 동기화 시킴 ( Call bt reference )
      GET REFERENCE OF gt_data INTO lr_data.

FORM get_data .

  DATA : lr_carrid TYPE RANGE OF scarr-carrid,
         lr_fldate TYPE RANGE OF sbook-fldate.

  IF pa_car IS NOT INITIAL.

    lr_carrid = VALUE #( BASE lr_carrid
                      ( low    = pa_car
                        sign   = 'I'
                        option = 'EQ' )
                       ).

  ENDIF.

  IF pa_fld IS NOT INITIAL.

    lr_fldate = VALUE #( BASE lr_fldate
                      ( low    = pa_fld
                        sign   = 'I'
                        option = 'EQ' )
                       ).

  ENDIF.

  SELECT *
    FROM zc505cds0025
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data
   WHERE carrid IN @lr_carrid
     AND fldate IN @lr_fldate
   ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

  IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s001. "Data not found
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
                        zebra      = 'X'
                        cwidth_opt = 'A'
                        sel_mode   = 'D'
                        grid_title = 'Airline'
                        smalltitle = 'X'
                     ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                       row  = 'X'
                       col  = 'X'
                      ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'ZC505CDSV0025'                 " Structure name (structure, table, view)
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat_data.                 " Field Catalog with Field Descriptions

  LOOP AT gt_fcat_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.

      WHEN 'CARRNAME'.
        <fs_fcat>-col_pos = 2.

      WHEN 'SMOKER'.
        <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Smoker'.
        <fs_fcat>-hotspot = 'X'.
        <fs_fcat>-do_sum = 'X'.

      WHEN 'FLDATE'.

        <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Fldate'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

*  append

  PERFORM make_fcat   USING :
  'X' 'ICON'       'Icon' 'ICON' ' ',
*  'X' 'CARRID'     ' ' 'SCARR' ' ',
*  'X' 'FLDATE'     ' ' 'SBOOK' ' ',
  'X' 'BOOKID'     ' ' 'SBOOK' ' ',
  ' ' 'CUSTOMID'   ' ' 'SBOOK' ' ',
  ' ' 'CUSTTYPE'   ' ' 'SBOOK' ' ',
  ' ' 'LUGGWEIGHT' ' ' 'SBOOK' ' ',
  ' ' 'WUNIT'      ' ' 'SBOOK' ' ',
  ' ' 'CLASS'      ' ' 'SBOOK' ' ',
  ' ' 'ORDER_DATE' ' ' 'SBOOK' ' '.
*  ' ' 'SMOKER'     ' ' 'SBOOK' ' '.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.               " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_splitter
    EXPORTING
      parent  = gcl_container                   " Parent Container
      rows    = 1                   " Number of Rows to be displayed
      columns = 2.                   " Number of Columns to be Displayed

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 1                  " Row
      column    = 1                 " Column
    RECEIVING
      container = gcl_container_data.                 " Container

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->get_container
    EXPORTING
      row       = 1                  " Row
      column    = 2                 " Column
    RECEIVING
      container = gcl_container_smoker.                 " Container

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_data
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_data.                  " Parent Container

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_smoker
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_smoker.                  " Parent Container

  CALL METHOD gcl_splitter->set_column_width
    EXPORTING
      id    = 1                   " Row ID
      width = 40.                 " Height

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot_click FOR gcl_grid_data.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'UP'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_data->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant                  " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout                " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_data                 " Output Table
      it_sort         = gt_sort
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_data.                 " Field Catalog

  gs_variant-handle = 'DN'.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_smoker->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant      = gs_variant                  " Layout
      i_save          = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default       = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout       = gs_layout                " Layout
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_smoker                 " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_smoker.                 " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.

FORM get_smoker  USING pv_carrid TYPE scarr-carrid
                       pv_connid TYPE sbook-connid
                       pv_fldate TYPE zc505cds0025-fldate.

FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field
                        pv_edit.

  gs_fcat = VALUE #(
            key       = pv_key
            fieldname = pv_field
            coltext   = pv_text
            ref_table = pv_ref_table
            ref_field = pv_ref_field

*

  CASE pv_field.  "필드별 제어

*       <fs_mat>-stlal IS INITIAL OR
*       <fs_mat>-stlnr IS INITIAL OR
*       <fs_mat>-stlal IS INITIAL.
*
*      MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field'
*      DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*
*      CONTINUE.
*    ENDIF.
*  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT gt_mat INTO gs_mat WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    IF gs_mat-matnr IS INITIAL OR  "key 값이 비어져있을때 들어가는 것을 방지해준다.
       gs_mat-werks IS INITIAL OR
       gs_mat-stlal IS INITIAL OR
       gs_mat-stlnr IS INITIAL OR
       gs_mat-stlal IS INITIAL.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field'
      DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CONTINUE. "Exit 을 사용하면 올바른 데이터들도 COMMIT 을 거치지 않고 loop 밖으로 나간다.
      "continue. 사용, 다시 올라가서 루프 실행
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_save) = CORRESPONDING zc505t0047( gs_mat ). "#이 안된다. 경로를 못 읽음
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_mat TO ls_save.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.              "신규 데이터인 경우

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.               "생성일
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.               "생성시간
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.               "생성자

    ELSE.                                     "기존 데이터인 경우

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.               "변경일
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.               "변경시간
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.               "변경자

    ENDIF.

*    lt_save = VALUE zc505t0047 ( LS_SAVE ).


    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.                  "lt_save 에 값이 있으면

    MODIFY zc505t0047 FROM TABLE lt_save.     "DB 테이블에 반영 (Insert or Update)

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.            "확정

    REFRESH gt_mat_del.             "삭제 테이블 초기화

    PERFORM clear_mark.             "다음 변경 확인을 위한 표시 해제
    MESSAGE s002.                   "Data was saved successfully

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.                   "아닐 시 ROLLBACK , 에러메세지 표시
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_mat INTO gs_mat WHERE mark EQ 'X'.
    "체크(mark='X')된 행만 대상으로 반복

    CLEAR gs_mat-mark. "현재 행 클리어

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_mat FROM gs_mat INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark. "해당 인덱스의 행에서 mark 필드만 수정

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING  pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button. "ALV 화면에 표시될 목록

  DATA : ls_toolbar TYPE stb_button. "APEEND 를 위한 STRUCTURE 선언, 버튼 1개씩 받을 수 있다.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'CREATE'.         " USER_COMMAND 로 전달
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.                " 0 = 일반 버튼
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_insert_row.  " 아이콘
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Create'.         " 툴바 버튼 텍스트
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Create'.         " 마우스 툴팁

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'DELETE'.          " USER_COMMAND 로 전달
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.                 " 0 = 일반 버튼
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_delete_row.   " 아이콘
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Delete'.          " 툴바 버튼 텍스트
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Delete'.          " 마우스 툴팁

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.              "행 추가 버튼
      PERFORM create_data.      "신규 행 추가
      PERFORM refresh_grid.     "ALV 에 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.              "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_data.      "선택 행 삭제

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL. "pv_modified 변경이 감지되면 체크 변경이 이루어지지 않으면 아래 로직을 안탄다.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_mat-mark = 'X'. "변경된 값에 MARK 를 넣어 SAVE 로직 안 LOOP를 통해 변경될 수 있게 해준다.

    MODIFY gt_mat FROM gs_mat INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.   "mark 수정

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid. " ALV 화면 갱신

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_data .

  CLEAR gs_mat.

  gs_mat-mark  = abap_true. " 변경을 감지하여 save 를 해주고 싶기 때문에 mark 에 ture 값을 준다.
  gs_mat-werks = pa_werks.  "새로 들어가는 행에 selection screen에서 적은 값을 초기값으로 넣어준다.

  APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat.  "gt_mat 에 append
  CLEAR  gs_mat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.                    "gs_row, gt_row clear

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows  " 어떤 행이 선택되는지 알기 위해 method 호출
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.              " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.                    "만약 사용자가 행을 선택하지 않고 delete를 눌렀을때 알려주는 안내 메세지
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows'.
    EXIT.                                  "exit  불필요한 로직 수행을 막는다.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.         "ITAB 의 ROW 를 지울 때는 역순으로 삭제해야한다. DESENDING 정렬

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat_del.      "삭제할 레코드를 gt_mat_del 에 옮겨준다.
      CLEAR  gs_mat.

      DELETE gt_mat INDEX gs_row-index. "gt_mat 에서 해당 레코드를 지워준다.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.                 "ALV는 모르는 상태 REFRESH 로 알려준다.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_method
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_method .

  DATA : lt_mat  TYPE zc505tt0047,        "class 는 function 보다 민감. 필드를 맞춰주기 위한 그릇 생성
         lcl_mat TYPE REF TO zc505cl003.  "어디서 받는지 알려줘야한다.

  IF lcl_mat IS NOT BOUND.                "lc_mat객체가 만들어지지 않았을때만 create object 실행
    CREATE OBJECT lcl_mat.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD lcl_mat->get_material_data
    EXPORTING
      iv_werks = pa_werks
    CHANGING
      et_data  = lt_mat.

  CHECK lt_mat IS NOT INITIAL.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_mat TO gt_mat.   "gt_mat 으로 select 한 db 전송

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_function
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_function .

  DATA : lt_mat TYPE zc505tt0047. "table type

  call function 'ZC505FM_GET_MATERIALS'
    EXPORTING
      iv_werks = pa_werks
    TABLES
      et_data  = lt_mat.

  CHECK lt_mat IS NOT INITIAL.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_mat TO gt_mat.   "gt_mat 으로 select 한 db 전송

ENDFORM.

FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container

      extension = 5000.                       " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                " Parent Container

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_toolbar          FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_user_command     FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_changed_finished FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event     "event 가 더 민감하게 받을 수 있게 함수 사용

*      DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*
*      CONTINUE.
*    ENDIF.
*  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT gt_mat INTO gs_mat WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    IF gs_mat-matnr IS INITIAL OR  "key 값이 비어져있을때 들어가는 것을 방지해준다.
       gs_mat-werks IS INITIAL OR
       gs_mat-stlal IS INITIAL OR
       gs_mat-stlnr IS INITIAL OR
       gs_mat-stlal IS INITIAL.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field'
      DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CONTINUE. "Exit 을 사용하면 올바른 데이터들도 COMMIT 을 거치지 않고 loop 밖으로 나간다.
      "continue. 사용, 다시 올라가서 루프 실행
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_save) = CORRESPONDING zc505t0047( gs_mat ). "#이 안된다. 경로를 못 읽음
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_mat TO ls_save.

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL.              "신규 데이터인 경우

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.               "생성일
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.               "생성시간
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.               "생성자

    ELSE.                                     "기존 데이터인 경우

      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.               "변경일
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.               "변경시간
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.               "변경자

    ENDIF.

*    lt_save = VALUE zc505t0047 ( LS_SAVE ).


    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.                  "lt_save 에 값이 있으면

    MODIFY zc505t0047 FROM TABLE lt_save.     "DB 테이블에 반영 (Insert or Update)

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.            "확정

    REFRESH gt_mat_del.             "삭제 테이블 초기화

    PERFORM clear_mark.             "다음 변경 확인을 위한 표시 해제
    MESSAGE s002.                   "Data was saved successfully

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.                   "아닐 시 ROLLBACK , 에러메세지 표시
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_mat INTO gs_mat WHERE mark EQ 'X'.
    "체크(mark='X')된 행만 대상으로 반복

    CLEAR gs_mat-mark. "현재 행 클리어

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_mat FROM gs_mat INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark. "해당 인덱스의 행에서 mark 필드만 수정

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING  pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button. "ALV 화면에 표시될 목록

  DATA : ls_toolbar TYPE stb_button. "APEEND 를 위한 STRUCTURE 선언, 버튼 1개씩 받을 수 있다.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'CREATE'.         " USER_COMMAND 로 전달
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.                " 0 = 일반 버튼
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_insert_row.  " 아이콘
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Create'.         " 툴바 버튼 텍스트
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Create'.         " 마우스 툴팁

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'DELETE'.          " USER_COMMAND 로 전달
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.                 " 0 = 일반 버튼
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_delete_row.   " 아이콘
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Delete'.          " 툴바 버튼 텍스트
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Delete'.          " 마우스 툴팁

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.              "행 추가 버튼
      PERFORM create_data.      "신규 행 추가
      PERFORM refresh_grid.     "ALV 에 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.              "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_data.      "선택 행 삭제

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL. "pv_modified 변경이 감지되면 체크 변경이 이루어지지 않으면 아래 로직을 안탄다.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_mat-mark = 'X'. "변경된 값에 MARK 를 넣어 SAVE 로직 안 LOOP를 통해 변경될 수 있게 해준다.

    MODIFY gt_mat FROM gs_mat INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.   "mark 수정

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid. " ALV 화면 갱신

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_data .

  CLEAR gs_mat.

  gs_mat-mark  = abap_true. " 변경을 감지하여 save 를 해주고 싶기 때문에 mark 에 ture 값을 준다.
  gs_mat-werks = pa_werks.  "새로 들어가는 행에 selection screen에서 적은 값을 초기값으로 넣어준다.

  APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat.  "gt_mat 에 append
  CLEAR  gs_mat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.                    "gs_row, gt_row clear

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows  " 어떤 행이 선택되는지 알기 위해 method 호출
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.              " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.                    "만약 사용자가 행을 선택하지 않고 delete를 눌렀을때 알려주는 안내 메세지
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows'.
    EXIT.                                  "exit  불필요한 로직 수행을 막는다.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.         "ITAB 의 ROW 를 지울 때는 역순으로 삭제해야한다. DESENDING 정렬

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat_del.      "삭제할 레코드를 gt_mat_del 에 옮겨준다.
      CLEAR  gs_mat.

      DELETE gt_mat INDEX gs_row-index. "gt_mat 에서 해당 레코드를 지워준다.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.                 "ALV는 모르는 상태 REFRESH 로 알려준다.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_method
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_method .

  DATA : lt_mat  TYPE zc505tt0047,        "class 는 function 보다 민감. 필드를 맞춰주기 위한 그릇 생성
         lcl_mat TYPE REF TO zc505cl003.  "어디서 받는지 알려줘야한다.

  IF lcl_mat IS NOT BOUND.                "lc_mat객체가 만들어지지 않았을때만 create object 실행
    CREATE OBJECT lcl_mat.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD lcl_mat->get_material_data
    EXPORTING
      iv_werks = pa_werks
    CHANGING
      et_data  = lt_mat.

  CHECK lt_mat IS NOT INITIAL.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_mat TO gt_mat.   "gt_mat 으로 select 한 db 전송

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_function
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_function .

  DATA : lt_mat TYPE zc505tt0047. "table type

  call function 'ZC505FM_GET_MATERIALS'
    EXPORTING
      iv_werks = pa_werks
    TABLES
      et_data  = lt_mat.

  CHECK lt_mat IS NOT INITIAL.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_mat TO gt_mat.   "gt_mat 으로 select 한 db 전송

ENDFORM.

*& <--  p2        text

FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_mat gt_mat.               "DB 를 받기 전 gs_mat gt_mat clear

  REFRESH gt_mat_del.                 "사용자가 삭제했다가 SAVE 전에 REFRESH 를 하면 삭제 후보 테이블을 비워줘야한다.

  CASE 'X'.                           "RADIO 버튼이 눌러졌을때 'X'. 밑에 로직 수행

    WHEN rb_fun.                      "function 을 통한 db 불러오기
      PERFORM get_data_function.

    WHEN rb_mth.                      "method 로 db 불러오기
      PERFORM get_data_method.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text

FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
                zebra      = 'X'
                cwidth_opt = 'A'
                sel_mode   = 'B'
                grid_title = TEXT-t02 "Bill Of Materials Master
                smalltitle = 'X'
                stylefname = 'STYLE'
                     ).

  gs_stable = VALUE #(
                row = 'X'
                col = 'X'
                     ).

  PERFORM make_fcat USING :
     'X' 'MATNR'       ' ' 'ZC505T0047'  ' ' 'X', "KEY
     'X' 'WERKS'       ' ' 'ZC505T0047'  ' ' ' ', "KEY
     'X' 'STLAN'       ' ' 'ZC505T0047'  ' ' 'X', "KEY
     'X' 'STLNR'       ' ' 'ZC505T0047'  ' ' 'X', "KEY
     'X' 'STLAL'       ' ' 'ZC505T0047'  ' ' 'X', "KEY
     ' ' 'LOSBS'       ' ' 'ZC505T0047'  ' ' 'X', "QUAN
     ' ' 'LOSVN'       ' ' 'ZC505T0047'  ' ' 'X', "QUAN
     ' ' 'BMEIN'       ' ' 'ZC505T0047'  ' ' 'X'. "UNIT

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field
                        pv_edit.

  gs_fcat = VALUE #(
            key       = pv_key
            fieldname = pv_field
            coltext   = pv_text
            ref_table = pv_ref_table
            ref_field = pv_ref_field
            edit      = pv_edit
                   ).

  CASE pv_field.  "필드별 제어

    WHEN 'LOSBS' OR 'LOSVN'. "LOSBS 와 LOSVN 필드에 UNIT 연결
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'BMEIN'.

  ENDCASE.

*  gt_fcat = VALUE #( BASE gt_fcat
*          (
*          key       = pv_key
*          fieldname = pv_field
*          coltext   = pv_text
*          ref_table = pv_ref_table
*          ref_field = pv_ref_field
*          edit      = pv_edit
*          )
*                 ).

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.

FORM exclude_toolbar .

  gt_exclude = VALUE #(
                           ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo )        "DUNO 제거
                           ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut )         "CUT
                           ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_mb_paste )           "PASTE
                           ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row )    "COPY_ROW
                           ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row )  "APPNED_ROW
                           ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row )  "DELETE_ROW
                           ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row )  "INSERT_ROW
                       ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                       " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                " Parent Container

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_toolbar          FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_user_command     FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_changed_finished FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event     "event 가 더 민감하게 받을 수 있게 함수 사용
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.   " Event ID

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout        " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude       " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_mat           " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lfs_mat>).

    <lfs_mat>-style = VALUE #( "lvc_t_styl

      ( fieldname = 'STLAL'
        style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled )

      ( fieldname = 'MATNR'
        style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled )

      ( fieldname = 'STLAN'
        style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled )

      ( fieldname = 'STLNR'
        style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled )

    ).

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid . "화면을 다시 그려준다.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable              " 스크롤 위치 및 커서 고정
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : lt_save   TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0047,
         lt_del    TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0047,
         lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  "삭제 처리 (gt_mat_del -> lt_del)
  IF gt_mat_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    lt_del = CORRESPONDING #( gt_mat_del ).

    DELETE zc505t0047 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) WHERE mark IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF <fs_mat>-matnr IS INITIAL OR <fs_mat>-werks IS INITIAL OR
       <fs_mat>-stlal IS INITIAL OR <fs_mat>-stlnr IS INITIAL.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH '필수 키 값을 입력하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CONTINUE.

    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_save) = CORRESPONDING zc505t0047( <fs_mat> ). "경로 지정

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. " 신규 데이터
      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.
    ELSE.                        " 기존 데이터 수정
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.                  "lt_save 에 값이 있으면

    MODIFY zc505t0047 FROM TABLE lt_save.     "DB 테이블에 반영 (Insert or Update)

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.            "확정

    REFRESH gt_mat_del.             "삭제 테이블 초기화

    PERFORM clear_mark.             "다음 변경 확인을 위한 표시 해제
    MESSAGE s002.                   "Data was saved successfully

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.                   "아닐 시 ROLLBACK , 에러메세지 표시
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    CLEAR <fs_mat>-mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING  pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button. "ALV 화면에 표시될 목록

  "BASE pt_toolbar 을 적지 않으면 기존에 있는 것들이 날아간다.
  "APPEND 를 하지 않아도 되게 때문에 불필요한 선언 및 clear 생략할 수 있음.
  pt_toolbar = VALUE #( BASE pt_toolbar
                (
                  function  = 'CREATE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_insert_row
                  text      = 'Create'
                  quickinfo = 'Create'
                 )

                (
                  function  = 'DELETE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_delete_row
                  text      = 'Delete'
                  quickinfo = 'Delete'
                 )
                      ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.              "행 추가 버튼
      PERFORM create_data.      "신규 행 추가
      PERFORM refresh_grid.     "ALV 에 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.              "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_data.      "선택 행 삭제

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL. "pv_modified 변경이 감지되면 체크 변경이 이루어지지 않으면 아래 로직을 안탄다.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_mat-mark = 'X'. "변경된 값에 MARK 를 넣어 SAVE 로직 안 LOOP를 통해 변경될 수 있게 해준다.

    MODIFY gt_mat FROM gs_mat INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.   "mark 수정

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid. " ALV 화면 갱신

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_data .

  CLEAR gs_mat.

  gs_mat = VALUE #(
                mark = 'X'
                werks = pa_werks
                  ).

  APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat.  "gt_mat 에 append
  CLEAR  gs_mat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  DATA: lt_row TYPE lvc_t_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = lt_row.

  IF lt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '삭제할 행을 먼저 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT lt_row ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).

    READ TABLE gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) INDEX <fs_row>-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      APPEND <fs_mat> TO gt_mat_del.

      DELETE gt_mat INDEX <fs_row>-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_method

FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING

      extension = 5000.                       " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                " Parent Container

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_toolbar          FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_user_command     FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_changed_finished FOR gcl_grid.

    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout        " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude       " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_mat           " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog

FORM refresh_grid . "화면을 다시 그려준다.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable              " 스크롤 위치 및 커서 고정
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : lt_save   TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0047,
         lt_del    TYPE TABLE OF zc505t0047,
         lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  "삭제 처리 (gt_mat_del -> lt_del)
  IF gt_mat_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    lt_del = CORRESPONDING #( gt_mat_del ).

    DELETE zc505t0047 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) WHERE mark IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF <fs_mat>-matnr IS INITIAL OR <fs_mat>-werks IS INITIAL OR
       <fs_mat>-stlal IS INITIAL OR <fs_mat>-stlnr IS INITIAL.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH '필수 키 값을 입력하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CONTINUE.

    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_save) = CORRESPONDING zc505t0047( <fs_mat> ). "경로 지정

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. " 신규 데이터
      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.
    ELSE.                        " 기존 데이터 수정
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.                  "lt_save 에 값이 있으면

    MODIFY zc505t0047 FROM TABLE lt_save.     "DB 테이블에 반영 (Insert or Update)

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.            "확정

    REFRESH gt_mat_del.             "삭제 테이블 초기화

    PERFORM clear_mark.             "다음 변경 확인을 위한 표시 해제
    MESSAGE s002.                   "Data was saved successfully

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.                   "아닐 시 ROLLBACK , 에러메세지 표시
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  LOOP AT gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    CLEAR <fs_mat>-mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING  pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button. "ALV 화면에 표시될 목록

  "BASE pt_toolbar 을 적지 않으면 기존에 있는 것들이 날아간다.
  "APPEND 를 하지 않아도 되게 때문에 불필요한 선언 및 clear 생략할 수 있음.
  pt_toolbar = VALUE #( BASE pt_toolbar
                (
                  function  = 'CREATE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_insert_row
                  text      = 'Create'
                  quickinfo = 'Create'
                 )

                (
                  function  = 'DELETE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_delete_row
                  text      = 'Delete'
                  quickinfo = 'Delete'
                 )
                      ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.              "행 추가 버튼
      PERFORM create_data.      "신규 행 추가
      PERFORM refresh_grid.     "ALV 에 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.              "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_data.      "선택 행 삭제

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL. "pv_modified 변경이 감지되면 체크 변경이 이루어지지 않으면 아래 로직을 안탄다.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_mat INTO gs_mat INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_mat-mark = 'X'. "변경된 값에 MARK 를 넣어 SAVE 로직 안 LOOP를 통해 변경될 수 있게 해준다.

    MODIFY gt_mat FROM gs_mat INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark.   "mark 수정

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid. " ALV 화면 갱신

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_data .

  CLEAR gs_mat.

  gs_mat = VALUE #(
                mark = 'X'
                werks = pa_werks
                  ).

  APPEND gs_mat TO gt_mat.  "gt_mat 에 append
  CLEAR  gs_mat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  DATA: lt_row TYPE lvc_t_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = lt_row.

  IF lt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '삭제할 행을 먼저 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT lt_row ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).

    READ TABLE gt_mat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mat>) INDEX <fs_row>-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      APPEND <fs_mat> TO gt_mat_del.

      DELETE gt_mat INDEX <fs_row>-index.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text

*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_method .

         lcl_mat TYPE REF TO zc505cl003.  "어디서 받는지 알려줘야한다.

  IF lcl_mat IS NOT BOUND.                "lc_mat객체가 만들어지지 않았을때만 create object 실행
    CREATE OBJECT lcl_mat.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD lcl_mat->get_material_data
    EXPORTING
      iv_werks = pa_werks
    CHANGING
      et_data  = lt_mat.

  CHECK lt_mat IS NOT INITIAL.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_mat TO gt_mat.   "gt_mat 으로 select 한 db 전송

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_function .

  DATA : lt_mat TYPE zc505tt0047. "table type

  call function 'ZC505FM_GET_MATERIALS'
    EXPORTING

REPORT zc505rlect13 MESSAGE-ID zc505m.

DATA : BEGIN OF ls_scarr,
         carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
         carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
         currcode TYPE scarr-currcode,
         url      TYPE scarr-url,
         connid   TYPE spfli-connid,
       END OF ls_scarr,

       lt_scarr  LIKE TABLE OF ls_scarr,
       lt_scarr3 LIKE TABLE OF ls_scarr,
       lv_carrid TYPE scarr-carrid VALUE 'DL'.

SELECT carrid carrname currcode url
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_scarr
  FROM scarr.

LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO ls_scarr.

ENDLOOP.

lt_scarr3 = lt_scarr.

*신문법*********************************************************************

SELECT carrid, carrname, currcode, url
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_scarr2)
  FROM scarr
 WHERE carrid   = @lv_carrid
   AND currcode = 'USD'.

LOOP AT lt_scarr2 INTO DATA(ls_scarr2).

ENDLOOP.

DATA(lt_scarr4)  = lt_scarr2.
DATA(lv_connid)  = ls_scarr-connid.
DATA(lv_carrid2) = lv_carrid.

**********************************************************************

DATA : lv_carrid3  TYPE scarr-carrid,
       lv_currcode TYPE scarr-currcode.

SELECT SINGLE carrid currcode
  INTO ( lv_carrid3, lv_currcode )
  FROM scarr.

READ TABLE lt_scarr INTO ls_scarr WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.

LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO ls_scarr.

ENDLOOP.

*신문법*********************************************************************

SELECT SINGLE carrid, currcode
  INTO (@DATA(lv_carrid4), @DATA(lv_currcode2))
  FROM scarr.
*Structure 바로 선언하면서 사용
READ TABLE lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr3) WITH KEY carrid ='AA'.

LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr4).

ENDLOOP.

**********************************************************************
*스트럭쳐에 값 할당
TYPES : BEGIN OF lty_matnr,
          matnr TYPE mara-matnr,
          mtart TYPE mara-mtart,
          werks TYPE marc-werks,
        END OF lty_matnr.

DATA : BEGIN OF ls_matnr,
         matnr TYPE mara-matnr,
         mtart TYPE mara-mtart,
         werks TYPE marc-werks,
       END OF ls_matnr,

       lt_matnr LIKE TABLE OF ls_matnr.

CLEAR   : ls_matnr.

ls_matnr-matnr = 'RTX0001'.
ls_matnr-mtart = 'FERT'.
ls_matnr-werks = '0001'.


ls_matnr-matnr = 'STEEL01'.
ls_matnr-mtart = 'HALB'.

*신문법**********************************************************************

ls_matnr = VALUE #( "받기 전에 CLEAR
                    matnr = 'RTX0001' mtart = 'FERT' werks = '0001'
                   ).

ls_matnr = VALUE #( BASE ls_matnr "명시적 필드만 바꾸고 나머지는 유지
                    matnr = 'STEEL01' mtart = 'HALB'
                   ).

CLEAR : ls_matnr.
REFRESH : lt_matnr.

ls_matnr-matnr = 'RTX0001'.
ls_matnr-mtart = 'FERT'.
ls_matnr-werks = '0001'.

APPEND ls_matnr TO lt_matnr.
CLEAR  ls_matnr.


ls_matnr-matnr = 'STEEL01'.
ls_matnr-mtart = 'HALB'.
ls_matnr-werks = '0001'.

APPEND ls_matnr TO lt_matnr.
CLEAR  ls_matnr.

ls_matnr-matnr = 'ALUMI100'.
ls_matnr-mtart = 'ROH'.
ls_matnr-werks = '0001'.

APPEND ls_matnr TO lt_matnr.
CLEAR  ls_matnr.

*신문법

lt_matnr = VALUE #( "Structure 가 필요없음
                    ( matnr = 'RTX0001' mtart = 'FERT' werks = '0001' )
                    ( matnr = 'STEEL01' mtart = 'HALB' werks = '0001' )
                  ).

lt_matnr = VALUE #( BASE lt_matnr
                    ( matnr = 'ALUMI100' mtart = 'ROH' werks = '0001' )
                  ).

*MOVE-CORRESPONDING
DATA : ls_mat LIKE ls_matnr,
       lt_mat LIKE lt_matnr.

MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_matnr TO ls_mat.
MOVE-CORRESPONDING lt_matnr TO lt_mat.

*신문법
ls_mat = CORRESPONDING #( ls_matnr ).
lt_mat = CORRESPONDING #( lt_matnr ).

READ TABLE lt_matnr INTO ls_matnr WITH KEY matnr ='STEEL01'
                                           mtart = 'HALB'.

*신문법
*얘는 SUBRC 가 0으로 나온다.
CLEAR ls_matnr.

ls_matnr = 'afadf'.
ls_matnr = VALUE #( lt_matnr[ matnr = 'STEEL01'
                              mtart = 'HALB' ] OPTIONAL ).
"클리어를 왜?,,
IF ls_matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
  MESSAGE s001.
ENDIF.

READ TABLE lt_matnr INTO ls_matnr INDEX 2.

*신문법
CLEAR ls_matnr.
ls_matnr = VALUE #( lt_matnr[ 2 ] OPTIONAL ).

**********************************************************************
DATA : ls_spfli TYPE spfli,
       lt_spfli LIKE TABLE OF ls_spfli.

SELECT carrid connid airpfrom airpto
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_spfli
  FROM spfli.

LOOP AT lt_spfli INTO ls_spfli.

  CASE ls_spfli-carrid.
    WHEN 'JL'.
      ls_spfli-carrid = 'KA'.

      MODIFY lt_spfli FROM ls_spfli INDEX sy-tabix TRANSPORTING carrid.

  ENDCASE.

ENDLOOP.

*신문법
SELECT CASE carrid
       	WHEN 'JL' THEN 'KA'
        ELSE carrid
       END AS carrid, connid, airpfrom, airpto,
       concat_with_space( carrid, connid, 2 ) AS aaa,
       concat( carrid, connid ) AS bbb
  FROM spfli
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_spfli2).

**********************************************************************

*FAE  .
DATA : BEGIN OF ls_key,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid TYPE sflight-connid,
       END OF ls_key,

       lt_key LIKE TABLE OF ls_key,
       lt_fli TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

SORT lt_key BY carrid connid.
DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_key COMPARING carrid connid.

IF lt_key IS NOT INITIAL.

  SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_fli
    FROM sflight
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_key " AS 불가
   WHERE carrid = lt_key-carrid
     AND connid = lt_key-connid
     AND currency = 'USD'.

ENDIF.

*신문법  INITIAL 체크 안해도 된다.
SORT lt_key BY carrid connid.
DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_key COMPARING carrid connid.

SELECT b~carrid, b~connid, a~fldate, a~price, a~currency
  FROM sflight AS a
 INNER JOIN @lt_key AS b
    ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
   AND a~connid EQ b~connid
 WHERE a~currency EQ 'USD'
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_fli.

**********************************************************************
DATA : ls_fli LIKE LINE OF lt_fli,
       lv_max TYPE sflight-price,
       lv_avg TYPE dmbtr.

SORT lt_fli BY price DESCENDING.

READ TABLE lt_fli INTO ls_fli INDEX 1.

IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
  lv_max = ls_fli-price.
ENDIF.

*신문법*********************************************************************

SELECT MAX( a~price ) AS max_price, AVG( a~price ) AS avg_price
  FROM @lt_fli AS a
  INTO ( @lv_max, @lv_avg ).

*나중에 찾아서 연습해보기,,지금은 너무 졸령
*SELECT SINGLE COALESCE( carrid, '없음' ) as carrid
*  INTO @DATA(lv_col)
*  FROM scarr
* WHERE carrid = @space.

**********************************************************************

*서브쿼리 사용
SELECT carrid fldate connid price currency
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_fli
  FROM sflight AS a
 WHERE fldate EQ ( SELECT MAX( fldate )
                    FROM sflight
                   WHERE carrid EQ a~carrid ).

**********************************************************************
*INLINE VIEW : FROM 절에 서브쿼리를 둔 경우...
*
*SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
*  FROM sfli

WITH +sflight AS ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
                     FROM sflight
                    WHERE carrid IN ( 'AA', 'DL' )
                  ),
     +schedule AS ( SELECT carrid, connid, airpfrom
                      FROM spfli
                     WHERE carrid IN ( 'AA', 'DL' )
                  )


SELECT a~carrid, a~connid, b~fldate, b~price
  FROM +schedule AS a
 INNER JOIN +sflight AS b
    ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
   AND a~connid EQ b~connid
 WHERE a~carrid EQ 'AA'
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_ddd).

cl_demo_output=>display( lt_ddd ).

**********************************************************************
*IF

DATA : lv_num      TYPE i VALUE 10,
       lv_char(10).

IF lv_num > 5.
  lv_char = '크다'.
ELSE.
  lv_char = '작다'.
ENDIF.

*신문법
" COND — 조건 표현식 (IF의 신문법 버전)
lv_char = COND #( WHEN lv_num > 5 THEN '일단 크다'
                  ELSE '작아' ).

"LET … IN — 임시 변수 선언
lv_char = COND #( LET vNum = 7 IN
                  WHEN vNum > 5 THEN '일단 커'
                  ELSE '작아,,,,').

MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_char.

*BREAK-POINT.

      ls_spfli-carrid = 'KA'.

      MODIFY lt_spfli FROM ls_spfli INDEX sy-tabix TRANSPORTING carrid.

  ENDCASE.

ENDLOOP.

*신문법
SELECT CASE carrid
       	WHEN 'JL' THEN 'KA'
        ELSE carrid
       END AS carrid, connid, airpfrom, airpto,
       concat_with_space( carrid, connid, 2 ) AS aaa,
       concat( carrid, connid ) AS bbb
  FROM spfli
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_spfli2).

**********************************************************************

*FAE  .
DATA : BEGIN OF ls_key,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid TYPE sflight-connid,
       END OF ls_key,

       lt_key LIKE TABLE OF ls_key,
       lt_fli TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

SORT lt_key BY carrid connid.
DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_key COMPARING carrid connid.

IF lt_key IS NOT INITIAL.

  SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_fli
    FROM sflight
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_key " AS 불가
   WHERE carrid = lt_key-carrid
     AND connid = lt_key-connid
     AND currency = 'USD'.

ENDIF.

*신문법  INITIAL 체크 안해도 된다.
SORT lt_key BY carrid connid.
DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_key COMPARING carrid connid.

SELECT b~carrid, b~connid, a~fldate, a~price, a~currency
  FROM sflight AS a
 INNER JOIN @lt_key AS b
    ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
   AND a~connid EQ b~connid
 WHERE a~currency EQ 'USD'
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_fli.

**********************************************************************
DATA : ls_fli LIKE LINE OF lt_fli,
       lv_max TYPE sflight-price,
       lv_avg TYPE dmbtr.

SORT lt_fli BY price DESCENDING.

READ TABLE lt_fli INTO ls_fli INDEX 1.

IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
  lv_max = ls_fli-price.
ENDIF.

*신문법*********************************************************************

SELECT MAX( a~price ) AS max_price, AVG( a~price ) AS avg_price
  FROM @lt_fli AS a
  INTO ( @lv_max, @lv_avg ).

*나중에 찾아서 연습해보기,,지금은 너무 졸령
*SELECT SINGLE COALESCE( carrid, '없음' ) as carrid
*  INTO @DATA(lv_col)
*  FROM scarr
* WHERE carrid = @space.

**********************************************************************

*서브쿼리 사용
SELECT carrid fldate connid price currency
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_fli
  FROM sflight AS a
 WHERE fldate EQ ( SELECT MAX( fldate )
                    FROM sflight
                   WHERE carrid EQ a~carrid ).

**********************************************************************
*INLINE VIEW : FROM 절에 서브쿼리를 둔 경우...
*
*SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
*  FROM sfli

WITH +sflight AS ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
                     FROM sflight
                    WHERE carrid IN ( 'AA', 'DL' )
                  ),
     +schedule AS ( SELECT carrid, connid, airpfrom
                      FROM spfli
                     WHERE carrid IN ( 'AA', 'DL' )
                  )


SELECT a~carrid, a~connid, b~fldate, b~price
  FROM +schedule AS a
 INNER JOIN +sflight AS b
    ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
   AND a~connid EQ b~connid
 WHERE a~carrid EQ 'AA'
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_ddd).

cl_demo_output=>display( lt_ddd ).

DATA : lv_num      TYPE i VALUE 10,
       lv_char(10).

IF lv_num > 5.
  lv_char = '크다'.
ELSE.
  lv_char = '작다'.
ENDIF.

*신문법
" COND — 조건 표현식 (IF의 신문법 버전)
lv_char = COND #( WHEN lv_num > 5 THEN '일단 크다'
                  ELSE '작아' ).

lv_char = COND #( LET vNum = 7 IN
                  WHEN vNum > 5 THEN '일단 커'
                  ELSE '작아,,,,').

MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_char.
