*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field
                        pv_edit.

  gs_fcat = VALUE #(
            key       = pv_key            "컬럼 고정 key
            fieldname = pv_field          "itab 의 필드명
            coltext   = pv_text           "화면에 보일 컬러명
            ref_table = pv_ref_table      "참조 테이블
            ref_field = pv_ref_field      "참조 필드
            edit      = pv_edit           "수정 가능 여부 -> X 가 수정 가능
                   ).

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'SMENG'.                        "통화키 연결
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.

    WHEN 'NETWR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERK'.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
*  CLEAR  gs_fcat. " gs_fcat VALUE 로 계속 덮어씌우기 때문에 CLEAR 를 해주지 않았다.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING    pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button.
  "신문법 사용하여 선언 및 clear 생략
  pt_toolbar = VALUE #( BASE pt_toolbar   "BASE pt_toolbar 작성해 기존 toolbar 보존
                (
                  function  = 'CREATE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_insert_row
                  text      = 'Create'
                  quickinfo = 'Create'
                 )

                (
                  function  = 'DELETE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_delete_row
                  text      = 'Delete'
                  quickinfo = 'Delete'
                 )
                      ).
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.              "행 추가 버튼
      PERFORM create_data.      "신규 행 추가
      PERFORM refresh_grid.     "ALV 에 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.              "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_data.      "선택 행 삭제

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL. "pv_modified 변경이 감지되면 체크, 변경이 이루어지지 않으면 아래 로직을 안탄다.
  "필드 심볼 사용하여 modify 생략.
  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO DATA(ls_modi). "인라인 선언

    READ TABLE gt_ship ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_ship>) INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0. "continue 랑 같은 동작 sy-subrc 가 eq 일때만 아래 로직 수행

    <fs_ship>-mark = 'X'. "변경된 값에 MARK 를 넣어 SAVE 로직 안 LOOP를 통해 변경될 수 있게 해준다.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid. " ALV 화면 갱신

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_data .

  gs_ship = VALUE #(
              mark = 'X'         "변경 감지 'X' 추가
              tknum = pa_tknum   "초기값으로 넣어준다.
                   ).

  APPEND gs_ship TO gt_ship.
  CLEAR  gs_ship.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable        " 스크롤 위치 및 커서 고정
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = DATA(lt_row).                  " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF lt_row IS INITIAL.  " 만약 사용자가 행을 선택하지 않고 delete를 눌렀을때 알려주는 안내 메세지
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First Select rows'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_row BY index DESCENDING. " "ITAB 의 ROW 를 지울 때는 역순으로 삭제해야한다. DESENDING 정렬

  LOOP AT lt_row INTO DATA(ls_row).

    gs_ship = VALUE #( gt_ship[ ls_row-index ] OPTIONAL ).

    CHECK gs_ship IS NOT INITIAL.

    APPEND gs_ship TO gt_ship_del.  "삭제할 레코드를 gt__del 에 옮겨준다.
    CLEAR gs_ship.

    DELETE gt_ship INDEX ls_row-index. "gt_mat 에서 해당 레코드를 지워준다.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505tship,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    TYPE TABLE OF zc505tship,
         lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data. ""변화 감지

  IF gt_ship_del IS NOT INITIAL.  "삭제 테이블에 있는 데이터를 제거

    lt_del = CORRESPONDING #( gt_ship_del ).

    DELETE zc505tship FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.  " 0 이상이면 commit 에 'X' 를 넣어준다.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_ship INTO gs_ship WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    IF gs_ship-tknum IS INITIAL OR gs_ship-tpnum IS INITIAL.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CONTINUE.                                    "KEY 값이 입력되지 않았을 경우 저장 방지

    ENDIF.

    ls_save = CORRESPONDING zc505tship( gs_ship ). "gs_ship 은 다른 곳에서 사용이 되고 있을수 있다. ls_save 로 옮겨주고 append 실행

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.              "lt_save 에 값이 있으면
    MODIFY zc505tship FROM TABLE lt_save. "DB 테이블에 반영 (Insert or Update)

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.                      " 0 이상이면 commit 에 'X' 를 넣어준다.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_ship_del.
    PERFORM clear_mark.                   "다음 변경 확인을 위한 표시 해제
    MESSAGE s002.                         "Data was saved successfully

  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .
  "필드 심볼 사용하여 로직 단순화
  LOOP AT gt_ship ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_ship>) WHERE mark EQ 'X'.
    "체크(mark='X')된 행만 대상으로 반복
    CLEAR <fs_ship>-mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant       " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'              " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout        " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude       " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_ship          " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.         " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_toolbar .
  "불필요한 툴바 제거
  gt_exclude = VALUE #(
                         ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo )        "UNDO 제거
                         ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut )         "CUT
                         ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_mb_paste )           "PASTE
                         ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row )    "COPY_ROW
                         ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row )  "APPNED_ROW
                         ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row )  "DELETE_ROW
                         ( cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row )  "INSERT_ROW
                     ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field
                        pv_edit.

  gs_fcat = VALUE #(
            key       = pv_key            "컬럼 고정 key
            fieldname = pv_field          "itab 의 필드명
            coltext   = pv_text           "화면에 보일 컬러명
            ref_table = pv_ref_table      "참조 테이블
            ref_field = pv_ref_field      "참조 필드
            edit      = pv_edit           "수정 가능 여부 -> X 가 수정 가능
                   ).

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'SMENG'.                        "통화키 연결
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.

    WHEN 'NETWR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERK'.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
*  CLEAR  gs_fcat. " gs_fcat VALUE 로 계속 덮어씌우기 때문에 CLEAR 를 해주지 않았다.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING    pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button.
  "신문법 사용하여 선언 및 clear 생략
  pt_toolbar = VALUE #( BASE pt_toolbar   "BASE pt_toolbar 작성해 기존 toolbar 보존
                (
                  function  = 'CREATE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_insert_row
                  text      = 'Create'
                  quickinfo = 'Create'
                 )

                (
                  function  = 'DELETE'
                  butn_type = 0
                  icon      = icon_delete_row
                  text      = 'Delete'
                  quickinfo = 'Delete'
                 )
                      ).
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING    pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.              "행 추가 버튼
      PERFORM create_data.      "신규 행 추가
      PERFORM refresh_grid.     "ALV 에 반영

    WHEN 'DELETE'.              "삭제 버튼
      PERFORM delete_data.      "선택 행 삭제

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL. "pv_modified 변경이 감지되면 체크, 변경이 이루어지지 않으면 아래 로직을 안탄다.
  "필드 심볼 사용하여 modify 생략.
  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO DATA(ls_modi). "인라인 선언

    READ TABLE gt_ship ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_ship>) INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0. "continue 랑 같은 동작 sy-subrc 가 eq 일때만 아래 로직 수행

    <fs_ship>-mark = 'X'. "변경된 값에 MARK 를 넣어 SAVE 로직 안 LOOP를 통해 변경될 수 있게 해준다.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid. " ALV 화면 갱신

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_data .

  gs_ship = VALUE #(
              mark = 'X'         "변경 감지 'X' 추가
              tknum = pa_tknum   "초기값으로 넣어준다.
                   ).

  APPEND gs_ship TO gt_ship.
  CLEAR  gs_ship.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_grid
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_grid .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable        " 스크롤 위치 및 커서 고정
      i_soft_refresh = space.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = DATA(lt_row).                  " Indexes of Selected Rows

  IF lt_row IS INITIAL.  " 만약 사용자가 행을 선택하지 않고 delete를 눌렀을때 알려주는 안내 메세지
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First Select rows'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_row BY index DESCENDING. " "ITAB 의 ROW 를 지울 때는 역순으로 삭제해야한다. DESENDING 정렬

  LOOP AT lt_row INTO DATA(ls_row).

    gs_ship = VALUE #( gt_ship[ ls_row-index ] OPTIONAL ).

    CHECK gs_ship IS NOT INITIAL.

    APPEND gs_ship TO gt_ship_del.  "삭제할 레코드를 gt__del 에 옮겨준다.
    CLEAR gs_ship.

    DELETE gt_ship INDEX ls_row-index. "gt_mat 에서 해당 레코드를 지워준다.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505tship,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    TYPE TABLE OF zc505tship,
         lv_commit.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data. ""변화 감지

  IF gt_ship_del IS NOT INITIAL.  "삭제 테이블에 있는 데이터를 제거

    lt_del = CORRESPONDING #( gt_ship_del ).

    DELETE zc505tship FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.  " 0 이상이면 commit 에 'X' 를 넣어준다.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_ship INTO gs_ship WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    IF gs_ship-tknum IS INITIAL OR gs_ship-tpnum IS INITIAL.

      MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CONTINUE.                                    "KEY 값이 입력되지 않았을 경우 저장 방지

    ENDIF.

    ls_save = CORRESPONDING zc505tship( gs_ship ). "gs_ship 은 다른 곳에서 사용이 되고 있을수 있다. ls_save 로 옮겨주고 append 실행

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.              "lt_save 에 값이 있으면
    MODIFY zc505tship FROM TABLE lt_save. "DB 테이블에 반영 (Insert or Update)

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.                      " 0 이상이면 commit 에 'X' 를 넣어준다.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_ship_del.
    PERFORM clear_mark.                   "다음 변경 확인을 위한 표시 해제
    MESSAGE s002.                         "Data was saved successfully

  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .
  "필드 심볼 사용하여 로직 단순화
  LOOP AT gt_ship ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_ship>) WHERE mark EQ 'X'.
    "체크(mark='X')된 행만 대상으로 반복
    CLEAR <fs_ship>-mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

REPORT zc505tomanote01.

SELECT carrid, connid, price, 'CLASS 5' AS class,
  ( price * -1 ) AS price_negative,
  div( 30, 2 ) AS mok,   "몫
  mod( 10, 3 ) AS remain, "나머지
  abs( -1000 ) AS abs
  FROM sflight

Description: [C5] GET airline info abap basic 
FUNCTION zc505fm_get_airline.
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------
*"*"Local Interface:
*"  IMPORTING
*"     REFERENCE(IV_CARRID) TYPE  SCARR-CARRID
*"  EXPORTING
*"     REFERENCE(EV_CODE) TYPE  CHAR1
*"     REFERENCE(EV_MSG) TYPE  CHAR100
*"  TABLES
*"      ET_DATA STRUCTURE  ZC505T0045
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------

*       Global data declarations

  SELECT a~carrid a~mealnumber a~mlcnt a~meins
         b~mealtype
         c~text
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE et_data
    FROM zc505t0045 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmeal AS b
      ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
     AND a~mealnumber EQ b~mealnumber
   LEFT OUTER JOIN zmealt AS c
      ON a~carrid EQ c~carrid
     AND a~mealnumber EQ c~mealnumber
   WHERE a~carrid EQ iv_carrid
   ORDER BY a~carrid a~mealnumber.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    ev_code = 'E'.
    ev_msg  = 'Data not found'.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZC505TOMATO02_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_param
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  DATA : lv_carrid TYPE zc505t0045-carrid.

  IF pa_carr IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'input carrid data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE carrid
    INTO lv_carrid
    FROM scarr
   WHERE carrid EQ pa_carr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'invalied data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  CASE 'X'.
    WHEN rb_func.
      PERFORM get_data_function.

    WHEN rb_meth.
      PERFORM get_data_method.

    WHEN rb_form.
      PERFORM get_data_form.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'. "줄무늬 표시
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'. "컬럼 폭 자동 조절
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'. "다중 행 선택
  gs_layout-grid_title = 'ALV Grid Title'.
  gs_layout-smalltitle = 'X'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.
  gs_layout-ctab_fname = 'COLOR'.
*  gs_layout-s_dragdrop = 'X'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
    EXPORTING
      i_structure_name = 'ZC505T0045'
    CHANGING
      ct_fieldcat      = gt_fcat.

  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).

    CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.
      WHEN 'CARRID'.
*        <fs_fcat>-key       = 'X'.
        <fs_fcat>-edit       = ' '.
      WHEN 'MEALNUMBER'.
        <fs_fcat>-lzero      = 'X'.
        <fs_fcat>-edit       = 'X'.
      WHEN 'MEALTYPE'.

      WHEN 'ERDAT' OR 'ERZET' OR 'ERNAM' OR 'AEDAT' OR 'AEZET' OR 'AENAM'.
        <fs_fcat>-no_out = 'X'.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        <fs_fcat>-edit   = 'X'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

  "서브루틴?

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container
    EXPORTING
      side      = gcl_container->dock_at_left     " Side to Which Control is Docked
      extension = 5000.                           " Control Extension

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container.                 " Parent Container


  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_toolbar          FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_user_command     FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_changed_finished FOR gcl_grid,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_double_click     FOR gcl_grid.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid->mc_evt_modified.                 " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant               " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                      " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'                      " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout                " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude               " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_data                  " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat.                 " Field Catalog

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING  pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button.

  DATA ls_toolbar TYPE stb_button.

  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'CREATE'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_insert_row.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Create'.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Create'.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'DELETE'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_delete_row.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Delete'.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Delete'.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'TOGGLE'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_toggle_display_change.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Toggle'.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Toggle'.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command

*& text

*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING  pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.


  CASE pv_ucomm.
    WHEN 'CREATE'.
      PERFORM create_row.
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

    WHEN 'DELETE'.
      PERFORM delete_row.

    WHEN 'TOGGLE'.
      PERFORM toggle_view.

    WHEN OTHERS.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& text

*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.

  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL.


  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_data-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505t0045,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit,
         lv_tabix  TYPE sy-tabix.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0045 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

    IF gs_data-mlcnt IS NOT INITIAL.

      IF gs_data-meins IS INITIAL.

        MESSAGE s000 WITH 'adfadf'.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

    ENDIF.
    "루프안에서 한줄을 읽는다. SELECT SINGLE gt

    CHECK gs_data-mealnumber IS NOT INITIAL. "KEY 값 없으면 저장 막음

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "erdat 생성 날짜 / 기존재 유무 판단을 위해

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE. "기존에 있었을 경우
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY zc505t0045 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL. "lv_commit 이 비어있지 않으면

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    gv_save_ok = 'X'.

    REFRESH gt_data_del.


    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    gv_save_ok = space.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.

*& Form get_data_form
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_form .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.
  REFRESH gt_data_del.

*  SELECT a~carrid a~mealnumber a~mlcnt a~meins
*         a~erdat a~erzet a~ernam
*         a~aedat a~aezet a~aenam
*         b~mealtype
*         c~text
*    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
*    FROM zc505t0045 AS a
*    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmeal AS b
*      ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
*     AND a~mealnumber EQ b~mealnumber
*    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmealt AS c
*      ON a~carrid EQ c~carrid
*     AND a~mealnumber EQ c~mealnumber
*     AND c~sprache EQ sy-langu
*   WHERE a~carrid EQ pa_carr
*   ORDER BY a~carrid a~mealnumber.

  SELECT a~carrid, a~mealnumber, a~mlcnt,
         a~meins,  a~erdat,         a~erzet,
         a~ernam, a~aedat,         a~aezet,
         a~aenam, b~mealtype,         c~text,
         CASE
           WHEN a~mlcnt = 0 THEN @icon_red_light
           WHEN a~mlcnt < 10 THEN @icon_yellow_light
           ELSE @icon_green_light
         END AS icon
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data
    FROM zc505t0045 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmeal  AS b
      ON a~carrid     = b~carrid
     AND a~mealnumber = b~mealnumber
    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmealt AS c
      ON a~carrid     = c~carrid
     AND a~mealnumber = c~mealnumber
     AND c~sprache    = @sy-langu
   WHERE a~carrid     = @pa_carr
   ORDER BY a~carrid, a~mealnumber.

ENDFORM.

         WHERE carrid EQ pa_carr

           AND sprache EQ sy-langu.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CLEAR ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'MEALNUMBER'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_data-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    CLEAR   ls_color.
    REFRESH gs_data-color.

    IF gs_data-mlcnt IS NOT INITIAL AND gs_data-meins IS INITIAL.

      ls_color-fname = 'MEINS'.
      ls_color-color-col = 5.
      ls_color-color-int = 0.
      ls_color-color-inv = 0.

      APPEND ls_color TO gs_data-color.
      CLEAR  ls_color.

    ENDIF.


    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style color.

  ENDLOOP.

*  IF line_exists( gt_data[ meins = 'EA' ] ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_row
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_row .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_del.
      CLEAR  gs_data.

      DELETE gt_data INDEX gs_row-index.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save   TYPE zc505t0045,
         lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lv_commit,
         lv_tabix  TYPE sy-tabix.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_data_del IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data_del TO lt_del.

    DELETE zc505t0045 FROM TABLE lt_del.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_data TO ls_save.

    IF gs_data-mlcnt IS NOT INITIAL.

      IF gs_data-meins IS INITIAL.

        MESSAGE s000 WITH 'adfadf'.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

    ENDIF.
    "루프안에서 한줄을 읽는다. SELECT SINGLE gt

    CHECK gs_data-mealnumber IS NOT INITIAL. "KEY 값 없으면 저장 막음

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "erdat 생성 날짜 / 기존재 유무 판단을 위해

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE. "기존에 있었을 경우
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY zc505t0045 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL. "lv_commit 이 비어있지 않으면

    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    gv_save_ok = 'X'.

    REFRESH gt_data_del.


    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    gv_save_ok = space.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE mark = 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_data-mark.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_data FROM gs_data INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

FORM toggle_view .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.

    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING

ENDFORM.

FORM handle_double_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                   ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.

  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'CARRID'.

      CALL SCREEN '0101' STARTING AT 20 3.

    WHEN OTHERS.
      EXIT." 이거를 위에 적는게 맞을까?
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

*& Form get_data_form
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_form .

  _clear gs_data gt_data.
  REFRESH gt_data_del.

*  SELECT a~carrid a~mealnumber a~mlcnt a~meins
*         a~erdat a~erzet a~ernam
*         a~aedat a~aezet a~aenam
*         b~mealtype
*         c~text
*    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
*    FROM zc505t0045 AS a
*    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmeal AS b
*      ON a~carrid EQ b~carrid
*     AND a~mealnumber EQ b~mealnumber
*    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmealt AS c
*      ON a~carrid EQ c~carrid
*     AND a~mealnumber EQ c~mealnumber
*     AND c~sprache EQ sy-langu
*   WHERE a~carrid EQ pa_carr
*   ORDER BY a~carrid a~mealnumber.

  SELECT a~carrid, a~mealnumber, a~mlcnt,
         a~meins,  a~erdat,         a~erzet,
         a~ernam, a~aedat,         a~aezet,
         a~aenam, b~mealtype,         c~text,
         CASE
           WHEN a~mlcnt = 0 THEN @icon_red_light
           WHEN a~mlcnt < 10 THEN @icon_yellow_light
           ELSE @icon_green_light
         END AS icon
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data
    FROM zc505t0045 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmeal  AS b
      ON a~carrid     = b~carrid
     AND a~mealnumber = b~mealnumber
    LEFT OUTER JOIN zmealt AS c
      ON a~carrid     = c~carrid
     AND a~mealnumber = c~mealnumber
     AND c~sprache    = @sy-langu
   WHERE a~carrid     = @pa_carr
   ORDER BY a~carrid, a~mealnumber.

ENDFORM.

  call function 'ZC505FM_GET_AIRLINE'
    EXPORTING
      iv_carrid = pa_carr
    TABLES
      et_data   = gt_data.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  _clear gs_cost gt_cost.
  REFRESH gt_cost_del.

  SELECT  a~kokrs   a~kostl  a~bukrs  a~kosar
          a~verak  a~wrbtr  a~waers  a~bkzer
          a~erdat  a~erzet  a~ernam  a~aedat
          a~aezet  a~aenam
          b~ltext
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_cost
    FROM zc522t0033 AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN cskt AS b
      ON a~kokrs EQ b~kokrs
     AND a~kostl EQ b~kostl
     AND b~spras EQ sy-langu
   WHERE a~kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
   ORDER BY a~kokrs a~kostl.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_parm
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_parm .

  pa_kokrs = '0001'.

  pa_bukrs = '0001'.
*  pa_gjahr = 2010.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_param
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_param .

  DATA : lv_korks TYPE zc522t0033-kokrs.

  IF pa_kokrs IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Input key field' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE kokrs
    INTO lv_korks
    FROM tka01
    WHERE kokrs EQ pa_kokrs.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Invalied data' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_layout .

  gs_layout-zebra      = 'X'.
  gs_layout-cwidth_opt = 'A'.
  gs_layout-sel_mode   = 'D'.
  gs_layout-stylefname = 'STYLE'.

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_1
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_1  USING  pv_key
                         pv_field
                         pv_text
                         pv_ref_table
                         pv_ref_field
                         pv_edit.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-edit      = pv_edit.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'WRBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
    WHEN 'BKZER'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox  = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_1.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen_1
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen_1 .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container_1
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER_1'.                " Name of the Screen CustCtrl Name to Link Container To

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_1
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_1.                 " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report  = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'A1'.

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_changed_finished FOR gcl_grid_1,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_toolbar          FOR gcl_grid_1,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_user_command     FOR gcl_grid_1.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid_1->mc_evt_modified.                 " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant                 " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout                " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude
    CHANGING
      it_outtab            = gt_cost                 " Output Table
      it_fieldcatalog      = gt_fcat_1.                 " Field Catalog


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix,
         ls_style TYPE lvc_s_styl.

  LOOP AT gt_cost INTO gs_cost.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    CLEAR ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'KOKRS'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_cost-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    ls_style-fieldname = 'KOSTL'.
    ls_style-style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_disabled.

    APPEND ls_style TO gs_cost-style.
    CLEAR  ls_style.

    MODIFY gt_cost FROM gs_cost INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_OBJECT_>MT_TOOLBAR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_toolbar  USING    pt_toolbar TYPE ttb_button.

  DATA : ls_toolbar TYPE stb_button.

  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 3.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'REFRESH'.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_refresh.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Refresh'.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Refresh'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  CHECK gv_screen = '0101'. "0101 이 아니면 REFRESH 까지만 그린다.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'CREATE'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_insert_row.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Create'.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Create'.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'DELETE'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_delete_row.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Delete'.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Delete'.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 3.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

  ls_toolbar-function  = 'TOGGLE'.
  ls_toolbar-butn_type = 0.
  ls_toolbar-icon      = icon_toggle_display_change.
  ls_toolbar-text      = 'Toggle'.
  ls_toolbar-quickinfo = 'Toggle'.

  APPEND ls_toolbar TO pt_toolbar.
  CLEAR  ls_toolbar.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING  pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'REFRESH'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM get_data.
      PERFORM set_style.
      PERFORM refresh_data.

      CHECK gv_screen = '0101'. "0101 이 아니면 REFRESH 까지만 그린다.

    WHEN 'SAVE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM save_data.
      PERFORM get_data.
      PERFORM set_style.
      PERFORM refresh_data.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM create_data.
      PERFORM refresh_data.

    WHEN 'DELETE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM delete_data.
    WHEN 'TOGGLE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM toggle_display.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.
*CSKT

  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_cost INTO gs_cost INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_cost-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.
        SELECT SINGLE ltext
          INTO gs_cost-ltext
          FROM cskt
          WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ gs_cost-kostl.

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_cost FROM gs_cost INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark ltext.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_data.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form exclude_toolbar
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exclude_toolbar .

  APPEND : cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_check          TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_cut        TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy       TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_refresh        TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_mb_paste          TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_undo       TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_insert_row TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_delete_row TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_copy_row   TO gt_exclude,
           cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_fc_loc_append_row TO gt_exclude.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA: ls_save   TYPE zc522t0033,
        lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
        lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
        lv_commit.

  CLEAR ls_save.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_row IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_cost_del TO lt_del.
    DELETE zc522t0033 FROM TABLE lt_del.
    MESSAGE s003.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.

      lv_commit = 'X'.

    ENDIF.

  ELSE.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_cost INTO gs_cost WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_cost TO ls_save.

    CHECK gs_cost-kostl IS NOT INITIAL. "KEY 값 없으면 저장 막음

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "erdat 생성 날짜

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE. "기존에 있었을 경우
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY zc522t0033 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_cost_del.

    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_data .

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->refresh_table_display
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable                " With Stable Rows/Columns
      i_soft_refresh = space.                 " Without Sort, Filter, etc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_data .

  CLEAR gs_cost.

  gs_cost-kokrs = pa_kokrs.
  gs_cost-mark  = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_cost TO gt_cost.
  CLEAR  gs_cost.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

*삭제하기 위한 선택한 행의 번호를 가져오자
  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING. "인터널 테이블의 row 를 삭제할때는 역순으로 지워야한다.
*ITAB 에서 선택한 행을 삭제해야한다.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

* 삭제할 레코드를 gt_class_del로 옮기기.
    READ TABLE gt_cost INTO gs_cost INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_cost TO gt_cost_del.
      CLEAR  gs_cost.

      DELETE gt_cost INDEX gs_row-index.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_data. "삭제할때만 refresh_grid 를 하기 위해서 여기에 넣는다.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form clear_mark
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM clear_mark .

  DATA : lv_tabix TYPE sy-tabix.

  LOOP AT gt_cost INTO gs_cost WHERE mark = 'X'.

    CLEAR gs_cost-mark.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

    MODIFY gt_cost FROM gs_cost INDEX lv_tabix
    TRANSPORTING mark.

  ENDLOOP.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form toggle_display
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM toggle_display .

  DATA : lv_mode TYPE i.

  CASE gcl_grid_1->is_ready_for_input( ).
    WHEN '0'.
      lv_mode = 1.
    WHEN '1'.
      lv_mode = 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->set_ready_for_input
    EXPORTING
      i_ready_for_input = lv_mode.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_2
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_2  USING  pv_key
                         pv_field
                         pv_text
                         pv_ref_table
                         pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'DMBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'PSWSL'.
    WHEN 'BELNR'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_2.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form display_screen_2
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM display_screen_2 .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container_2
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CONTAINER_2'. " Name of the Screen CustCtrl Name to Link Container To

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_2
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_container_2.                 " Parent Container

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.
  gs_variant-handle = 'A2'.

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_changed_finished   FOR gcl_grid_2,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_toolbar            FOR gcl_grid_2,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_user_command       FOR gcl_grid_2,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_double_click       FOR gcl_grid_2,
                lcl_event_handler=>handle_hotspot_click      FOR gcl_grid_2.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_2->register_edit_event
    EXPORTING
      i_event_id = gcl_grid_2->mc_evt_modified.                 " Event ID

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_2->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      is_variant           = gs_variant                 " Layout
      i_save               = 'A'                 " Save Layout
      i_default            = 'X'              " Default Display Variant
      is_layout            = gs_layout                 " Layout
      it_toolbar_excluding = gt_exclude                 " Excluded Toolbar Standard Functions

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_user_command
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_UCOMM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_user_command  USING  pv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.

  CASE pv_ucomm.

    WHEN 'REFRESH'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM get_data.
      PERFORM set_style.
      PERFORM refresh_data.

      CHECK gv_screen = '0101'. "0101 이 아니면 REFRESH 까지만 그린다.

    WHEN 'SAVE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM save_data.
      PERFORM get_data.
      PERFORM set_style.
      PERFORM refresh_data.

    WHEN 'CREATE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM create_data.
      PERFORM refresh_data.

    WHEN 'DELETE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM delete_data.
    WHEN 'TOGGLE'.
      CLEAR gv_okcode.

      PERFORM toggle_display.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_changed_finished
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_MODIFIED
*&      --> ET_GOOD_CELLS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_changed_finished  USING    pv_modified
                                       pt_good_cells TYPE lvc_t_modi.
*CSKT

  DATA : ls_modi TYPE lvc_s_modi.

  CHECK pv_modified IS NOT INITIAL.

  LOOP AT pt_good_cells INTO ls_modi.

    READ TABLE gt_cost INTO gs_cost INDEX ls_modi-row_id.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    gs_cost-mark = 'X'.

    CASE ls_modi-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KOSTL'.
        SELECT SINGLE ltext
          INTO gs_cost-ltext
          FROM cskt
          WHERE spras EQ sy-langu
          AND kokrs EQ pa_kokrs
          AND kostl EQ gs_cost-kostl.

    ENDCASE.

    MODIFY gt_cost FROM gs_cost INDEX ls_modi-row_id
    TRANSPORTING mark ltext.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_data.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA: ls_save   TYPE zc522t0033,
        lt_save   LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
        lt_del    LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
        lv_commit.

  CLEAR ls_save.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->check_changed_data.

  IF gt_row IS NOT INITIAL.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_cost_del TO lt_del.
    DELETE zc522t0033 FROM TABLE lt_del.
    MESSAGE s003.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.

      lv_commit = 'X'.

    ENDIF.

  ELSE.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT gt_cost INTO gs_cost WHERE mark EQ 'X'.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_cost TO ls_save.

    CHECK gs_cost-kostl IS NOT INITIAL. "KEY 값 없으면 저장 막음

    IF ls_save-erdat IS INITIAL. "erdat 생성 날짜

      ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    ELSE. "기존에 있었을 경우
      ls_save-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_save-aezet = sy-uzeit.
      ls_save-aenam = sy-uname.

    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_save TO lt_save.
    CLEAR  ls_save.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_save IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY zc522t0033 FROM TABLE lt_save.

    IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
      lv_commit = 'X'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  IF lv_commit IS NOT INITIAL.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    REFRESH gt_cost_del.

    PERFORM clear_mark.
    MESSAGE s002.

  ELSE.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'Data was not changed' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_data .

  _clear gs_row gt_row.

*삭제하기 위한 선택한 행의 번호를 가져오자
  CALL METHOD gcl_grid_1->get_selected_rows
    IMPORTING
      et_index_rows = gt_row.

  IF gt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'First, select rows'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_row BY index DESCENDING. "인터널 테이블의 row 를 삭제할때는 역순으로 지워야한다.
*ITAB 에서 선택한 행을 삭제해야한다.

  LOOP AT gt_row INTO gs_row.

* 삭제할 레코드를 gt_class_del로 옮기기.
    READ TABLE gt_cost INTO gs_cost INDEX gs_row-index.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      APPEND gs_cost TO gt_cost_del.
      CLEAR  gs_cost.

      DELETE gt_cost INDEX gs_row-index.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  PERFORM refresh_data. "삭제할때만 refresh_grid 를 하기 위해서 여기에 넣는다.

ENDFORM.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW
*&      --> E_COLUMN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_double_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                   ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  IF ps_row-rowtype IS NOT INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_company INTO gs_company INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'HKONT'.

      SET PARAMETER ID : 'ACC' FIELD gs_company-hkont,
                         'BUK' FIELD pa_bukrs,
                         'GJR' FIELD pa_gjahr.

      CALL TRANSACTION 'FAGLB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot_click  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                                    ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

  READ TABLE gt_company INTO gs_company INDEX ps_row-index.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'BELNR'.

      SET PARAMETER ID : 'BLN' FIELD gs_company-belnr.

      CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

  ENDCASE.

title: README.md
body:
# Masterpack · SAP FI 프로젝트

SAP CODE 1기 교육 프로젝트의 FI 중심 ABAP 프로그램과 SAPUI5/Fiori 애플리케이션을 모았습니다. QM 관련 프로그램도 함께 포함되어 있습니다.

[프로젝트 소개 및 구현 화면](https://sherlock0105.github.io/project.html) · [SAP 포트폴리오](https://sherlock0105.github.io/)

## 저장소 구성

| 폴더 | 기능 설명 | 구분 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ze3_fi_asset/`](ze3_fi_asset/) | 고정자산 조회 | UI5 화면 |
| [`ze3_fi_bpmaster/`](ze3_fi_bpmaster/) | 고객·공급업체 마스터 관리 | UI5 화면 |
| [`ze3_fi_employee/`](ze3_fi_employee/) | 사원 정보 등록 및 급여 지급 | UI5 화면 |
| [`ze3_fi_financial/`](ze3_fi_financial/) | 재무제표 조회 | UI5 화면 |
| [`ze3_fi_hbk_rate/`](ze3_fi_hbk_rate/) | 외화통장 보유액 조회 및 환율 평가 | UI5 화면 |
| [`ze3_fi_post_search/`](ze3_fi_post_search/) | 전표 조회 | UI5 화면 |
| [`ze3_qm_display/`](ze3_qm_display/) | 완제품 폐기 현황 | UI5 화면 |
| [`ze3_qm_insp/`](ze3_qm_insp/) | 완제품 품질 검사 | UI5 화면 |
| [`ze3fi0002/`](ze3fi0002/) | 외화평가 및 환손익 분석 | ABAP 프로그램 |
| [`ze3qm0001/`](ze3qm0001/) | 완제품 품질 검수 | ABAP 프로그램 |
| [`zre3fi0001/`](zre3fi0001/) | 환율 API 수신 | ABAP 프로그램 |
| [`zre3fi0003/`](zre3fi0003/) | 전표 조회 및 역분개 | ABAP 프로그램 |
| [`zre3fi0007/`](zre3fi0007/) | 감가상각 자동 처리 (배치) | ABAP 프로그램 |
| [`zre3fi0008/`](zre3fi0008/) | 자산 관리 및 감가상각 | ABAP 프로그램 |
| [`zre3fi0009/`](zre3fi0009/) | 외화평가 자동 처리 (배치) | ABAP 프로그램 |
| [`zre3fi0010/`](zre3fi0010/) | 재무상태표 | ABAP 프로그램 |

전표 조회 및 역분개는 **[zre3fi0003/](zre3fi0003/)** 폴더입니다. 역분개는 기존 전표의 회계 처리를 취소하기 위해 반대 내용의 전표를 만드는 기능입니다.

## 코드 살펴보기

UI5 앱은 각 폴더의 `webapp/controller/`, `webapp/view/`, `webapp/manifest.json`에서 화면 로직과 서비스 연결을 확인할 수 있습니다. ABAP 폴더의 HTML 파일은 소스 열람용으로 내보낸 자료이며, `screens/`에는 화면 정의가 있습니다.

## 로컬 실행 예시

Node.js와 npm을 준비한 후 재무상태표 앱 폴더에서 실행합니다.

```bash
cd ze3_fi_financial
npm install
npm run start-mock
```

이 명령은 해당 앱에 정의된 모의 서비스 실행 방식입니다. 실제 업무 데이터 조회에는 SAP 백엔드와 앱별 서비스 설정이 필요하며, 모의 데이터의 범위는 앱마다 다릅니다. ABAP 프로그램은 관련 DDIC 객체와 화면이 구성된 SAP 개발 환경에서 실행합니다.

## 관련 저장소

- [SAPUI5 / Fiori 학습 모음](https://github.com/sherlock0105/ui5_fiori)
- [ABAP 학습 모음](https://github.com/sherlock0105/ABAP-STUDY)

<core:FragmentDefinition
    xmlns="sap.m"
    xmlns:core="sap.ui.core">

    <Dialog id="contractDialog"
        title="근로계약서"
        contentWidth="680px"
        resizable="true"
        draggable="true">
        <content>
            <ScrollContainer vertical="true" horizontal="false" height="78vh">
                <VBox class="contractDoc">

                    <!-- 헤더 -->
                    <VBox alignItems="Center" class="contractHdr">
                        <Text text="주 식 회 사  Masterpack" class="contractCo"/>
                        <Text text="근  로  계  약  서" class="contractHdrTitle"/>
                    </VBox>

                    <!-- 사원 정보 -->
                    <VBox class="contractInfoSection">
                        <HBox class="contractRow">
                            <Text text="사  원  번  호" class="contractLbl"/>
                            <Text text="{contract>/Pernr}" class="contractVal"/>
                        </HBox>
                        <HBox class="contractRow">
                            <Text text="성            명" class="contractLbl"/>
                            <Text text="{contract>/Pernam}" class="contractVal"/>
                        </HBox>
                        <HBox class="contractRow">
                            <Text text="부            서" class="contractLbl"/>
                            <Text text="{contract>/Btrtl}" class="contractVal"/>
                        </HBox>
                        <HBox class="contractRow">
                            <Text text="직            급" class="contractLbl"/>
                            <Text text="{contract>/Grade}" class="contractVal"/>
                        </HBox>
                        <HBox class="contractRow">
                            <Text text="입    사    일" class="contractLbl"/>
                            <Text text="{contract>/Eindt}" class="contractVal"/>
                        </HBox>
                    </VBox>

                    <!-- 급여 조건 -->
                    <VBox class="contractSalaryBox">
                        <Text text="[ 급  여  조  건 ]" class="contractSalaryHdr"/>
                        <HBox class="contractRow">
                            <Text text="급여 시작일" class="contractLblSm"/>
                            <Text text="{contract>/Begda}" class="contractVal"/>
                        </HBox>
                        <HBox class="contractRow">
                            <Text text="기  본  급" class="contractLblSm"/>
                            <Text text="{contract>/BetrFormatted}" class="contractVal contractAmtVal"/>
                        </HBox>
                        <HBox class="contractRow">
                            <Text text="코스트센터" class="contractLblSm"/>
                            <Text text="{contract>/Kostl}" class="contractVal"/>
                        </HBox>
                    </VBox>

body:
<mvc:View controllerName="zpe3.fi.financial.zpe3fifinancial.controller.FinancialView"
    xmlns:mvc="sap.ui.core.mvc"
    xmlns="sap.m"
    xmlns:core="sap.ui.core"
    xmlns:viz="sap.viz.ui5.controls"
    xmlns:vizData="sap.viz.ui5.data"
    xmlns:vizFeeds="sap.viz.ui5.controls.common.feeds"
    xmlns:t="sap.ui.table"
    displayBlock="true">

    <Page id="page" showHeader="false"
          busy="{view>/busy}" busyIndicatorDelay="0"
          enableScrolling="true"
          class="sapUiNoContentPadding fxPage">

        <content>

            <VBox class="psPageHeader">
                <VBox class="psPageHeaderContent">
                    <Title class="psPageHeaderTitle" text="재무제표 조회" level="H3"/>
                    <Text class="psPageHeaderSub" text="Financial Statement — BS · PL · CF"/>
                </VBox>
            </VBox>

            <!-- ══ 검색 바 ══ -->
            <Toolbar id="idSearchBar" class="fxSearchBar">
                <Label text="회사코드" design="Bold" class="fxFilterLabel"/>
                <Input id="idBukrs" value="{view>/bukrs}" width="72px" maxLength="4"
                       editable="false" class="sapUiTinyMarginEnd"/>
                <Label text="회계연도" design="Bold" class="fxFilterLabel"/>
                <Select id="selYear" selectedKey="{view>/gjahr}" change="onYearChange"
                        items="{ path:'view>/years', templateShareable:false }">
                    <core:Item key="{view>key}" text="{view>text}"/>
                </Select>
                <Button text="조회" type="Emphasized" press="onSearch"
                        icon="sap-icon://search" class="sapUiTinyMarginBegin sapUiTinyMarginEnd"/>
                <ToolbarSpacer/>
                <Button text="Excel 저장" press="onExport"
                        icon="sap-icon://excel-attachment" type="Ghost"
                        enabled="{view>/hasData}"/>
                <Button text="PDF 출력" press="onExportPdf"
                        icon="sap-icon://pdf-attachment" type="Ghost"
                        enabled="{view>/hasData}"/>
                <ToggleButton id="idApproxToggle"
                             text="≈ 조/억"
                             icon="sap-icon://number-sign"
                             press="onApproxToggle"
                             pressed="{view>/showApprox}"
                             enabled="{view>/hasData}"
                             type="Ghost"/>
                <ToolbarSeparator/>
                <Button id="idAiBtn"
                        text="AI 요약"
                        press="onAiReport"
                        icon="sap-icon://ai"
                        type="Emphasized"
                        enabled="{view>/hasData}"
                        class="fxAiBtn"/>
            </Toolbar>

            <!-- ══ AI 분석 리포트 패널 ══ -->
            <VBox id="idAiPanel"
                  visible="{= ${view>/ai/visible} || ${view>/ai/busy}}"
                  class="fxAiPanel">
                <HBox class="fxAiPanelHdr" justifyContent="SpaceBetween" alignItems="Center">
                    <HBox alignItems="Center">
                        <core:Icon src="sap-icon://ai" size="1.1rem" class="fxAiPanelIcon"/>
                        <Title text="AI 재무 분석 리포트" level="H5" class="fxAiPanelTitle"/>
                        <Text text="{= ${view>/gjahr} + '년  ·  회사코드 ' + ${view>/bukrs}}"
                              class="fxAiPanelMeta"/>
                    </HBox>
                    <HBox alignItems="Center">
                        <Button icon="sap-icon://print"
                                type="Transparent" press="onAiPrint"
                                tooltip="AI 요약 인쇄"
                                visible="{= !${view>/ai/busy} && !!${view>/ai/html}}"
                                class="fxAiCloseBtn"/>
                        <Button icon="{= ${view>/ai/collapsed} ? 'sap-icon://slim-arrow-down' : 'sap-icon://slim-arrow-up'}"
                                type="Transparent" press="onAiToggle"
                                tooltip="{= ${view>/ai/collapsed} ? '펼치기' : '접기'}"
                                class="fxAiCloseBtn"/>
                    </HBox>
                </HBox>
                <VBox class="fxAiPanelBody"
                      visible="{= !${view>/ai/collapsed}}"
                      busy="{view>/ai/busy}" busyIndicatorDelay="0">
                    <FormattedText htmlText="{view>/ai/html}"
                                   width="100%" class="fxAiText"/>
                </VBox>
            </VBox>

            <!-- ══ 빈 상태 ══ -->
            <VBox visible="{= !${view>/hasData} && !${view>/busy}}"
                  class="fxEmptyState" alignItems="Center" justifyContent="Center">
                <core:Icon src="sap-icon://accounting-document-verification" size="3rem" class="fxEmptyIcon"/>
                <Text text="회사코드와 회계연도를 입력하고 조회 버튼을 클릭하세요." class="fxEmptyText"/>
            </VBox>

            <!-- ══ 메인 탭 ══ -->
            <VBox visible="{view>/hasData}" class="fxDashboard">
                <IconTabBar id="idMainTab" select="onTabSelect" expandable="false">
                    <items>

                        <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════
                             BS  재무상태표
                        ══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
                        <IconTabFilter key="bs" text="재무상태표" icon="sap-icon://accounting-document-verification">

                            <MessageStrip
                                visible="{= ${view>/hasData} && ${view>/balanced}}"
                                text="{= '대차 일치  ✓   자산 합계 = 부채 + 자본  ( ' + ${view>/sumAssetFmt} + ' 원 )' }"
                                type="Success" showIcon="true" class="fxBalanceStrip"/>

                            <!-- KPI 4개 -->
                            <HBox wrap="Wrap" class="fxCardRow">
                                <VBox class="fxCard fxKpiCard fxKpiCard--blue">
                                    <HBox class="fxKpiTop" alignItems="Center">
                                        <core:Icon src="sap-icon://home" class="fxKpiIcon fxKpiIcon--blue"/>
                                        <VBox class="fxKpiInfo">
                                            <Text text="자산 총계" class="fxKpiLabel"/>
                                            <Text text="Total Assets" class="fxKpiSub"/>
                                        </VBox>
                                    </HBox>
                                    <Text text="{= ${view>/sumAssetFmt} + ' 원'}" class="fxKpiValue"/>
                                    <Text text="{= '≈ ' + ${view>/kpiAsset}}" class="fxKpiKrw"/>
                                    <Text text="{view>/assetDeltaText}"
                                          class="{= ${view>/assetDeltaPos} === true  ? 'fxDeltaPos'
                                                   : ${view>/assetDeltaPos} === false ? 'fxDeltaNeg'
                                                   :                                    'fxDeltaNone' }"/>
                                </VBox>
                                <VBox class="fxCard fxKpiCard fxKpiCard--orange">
                                    <HBox class="fxKpiTop" alignItems="Center">
                                        <core:Icon src="sap-icon://expense-report" class="fxKpiIcon fxKpiIcon--orange"/>
                                        <VBox class="fxKpiInfo">
                                            <Text text="부채 총계" class="fxKpiLabel"/>
                                            <Text text="Total Liabilities" class="fxKpiSub"/>
                                        </VBox>
                                    </HBox>
                                    <Text text="{= ${view>/sumLiabFmt} + ' 원'}" class="fxKpiValue"/>
                                    <Text text="{= '≈ ' + ${view>/kpiLiab}}" class="fxKpiKrw"/>
                                    <Text text="{view>/liabDeltaText}"
                                          class="{= ${view>/liabDeltaPos} === true  ? 'fxDeltaPos'
                                                   : ${view>/liabDeltaPos} === false ? 'fxDeltaNeg'
                                                   :                                   'fxDeltaNone' }"/>
                                </VBox>
                                <VBox class="fxCard fxKpiCard fxKpiCard--green">
                                    <HBox class="fxKpiTop" alignItems="Center">
                                        <core:Icon src="sap-icon://trend-up" class="fxKpiIcon fxKpiIcon--green"/>
                                        <VBox class="fxKpiInfo">
                                            <Text text="자본 총계" class="fxKpiLabel"/>
                                            <Text text="Total Equity" class="fxKpiSub"/>
                                        </VBox>
                                    </HBox>
                                    <Text text="{= ${view>/sumEquityFmt} + ' 원'}" class="fxKpiValue"/>
                                    <Text text="{= '≈ ' + ${view>/kpiEquity}}" class="fxKpiKrw"/>
                                    <Text text="{view>/equityDeltaText}"
                                          class="{= ${view>/equityDeltaPos} === true  ? 'fxDeltaPos'
                                                   : ${view>/equityDeltaPos} === false ? 'fxDeltaNeg'
                                                   :                                     'fxDeltaNone' }"/>
                                </VBox>
                                <VBox class="fxCard fxKpiCard fxKpiCard--purple">
                                    <HBox class="fxKpiTop" alignItems="Center">
                                        <core:Icon src="sap-icon://money-bills" class="fxKpiIcon fxKpiIcon--purple"/>
                                        <VBox class="fxKpiInfo">
                                            <Text text="순운전자본" class="fxKpiLabel"/>
                                            <Text text="Net Working Capital" class="fxKpiSub"/>
                                        </VBox>
                                    </HBox>
                                    <Text text="{= ${view>/nwcFmt} + ' 원'}" class="fxKpiValue"/>
                                    <Text text="{= '≈ ' + ${view>/kpiNwc}}" class="fxKpiKrw"/>
                                    <Text text="{= ${view>/nwcSign} ? '▲ 단기 지급 능력 충분' : '▼ 단기 지급 능력 부족'}"
                                          class="{= ${view>/nwcSign} ? 'fxDeltaPos' : 'fxDeltaNeg'}"/>
                                </VBox>
                            </HBox>

                            <!-- 재무 비율 (부채비율 · 자기자본비율) -->
                            <HBox wrap="Wrap" class="fxCardRow">
                                <VBox class="fxCard fxRatioCard fxRatioCard--orange">
                                    <HBox class="fxRatioHdr" alignItems="Center">

  customMiddleware:
    - name: fiori-tools-proxy
      afterMiddleware: compression
      configuration:
        ignoreCertErrors: false # If set to true, certificate errors will be ignored. E.g. self-signed certificates will be accepted
        ui5:
          path:
            - /resources
            - /test-resources
          url: https://ui5.sap.com
        backend:
          - path: /sap
            url: http://bgissap3.bgissap.co.kr:8000
            client: '100'
    - name: fiori-tools-appreload
      afterMiddleware: compression
      configuration:
        port: 35729
        path: webapp
        delay: 300
    - name: fiori-tools-preview
      afterMiddleware: fiori-tools-appreload
      configuration:
        flp:
          theme: sap_horizon

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING   pv_key
                        pv_field
                        pv_text
                        pv_ref_table
                        pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'ICON'.
      gs_fcat-icon    = 'X'.
    WHEN 'WRBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'FWAER'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DMBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
    WHEN 'EVAL_KRW' OR 'EVAL_DIFF'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
    WHEN 'UKURS' OR 'TCURR'.
      gs_fcat-decimals_o = '0'.
    WHEN 'KUNNR' OR 'LIFNR' OR 'BELNR'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.


*    WHEN 'KUNNR' OR 'LIFNR'.
*      gs_fcat-no_out = 'X'.

    WHEN 'PARTNER'.
      gs_fcat-no_out = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
