*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_tree  USING  pv_field
                           pv_text
                           pv_ref_table
                           pv_ref_field
                           pv_len.


  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-outputlen = pv_len.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'WRBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'FWAER'.

    WHEN 'DMBTR' OR 'EVAL_DIFF'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum = 'X'.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_tree.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.

  l_hierarchy_header-heading   = '거래처'.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_con_tree
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CON_TREE'
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS         = 1.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_tree
    EXPORTING
      parent              = gcl_con_tree
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      item_selection      = space
      no_html_header      = 'X'
      no_toolbar          = space
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS              = 1.

* 이벤트 등록
  CALL METHOD gcl_tree->get_registered_events
    IMPORTING
      events = gt_event.

  gs_event-eventid    = cl_gui_column_tree=>eventid_node_double_click.
  gs_event-appl_event = 'X'.
  APPEND gs_event TO gt_event.

  CALL METHOD gcl_tree->set_registered_events
    EXPORTING
      events = gt_event.

  gs_variant-report = sy-repid.

  SET HANDLER : lcl_event_handler=>handle_node_click   FOR gcl_tree.

  CALL METHOD gcl_tree->set_table_for_first_display
    EXPORTING
      i_save              = 'A'
      is_variant          = gs_variant
      is_hierarchy_header = l_hierarchy_header

      it_outtab           = gt_data
      it_fieldcatalog     = gt_fcat_tree.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form filter_detail
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> NODE_KEY
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM filter_detail USING pv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

  DATA ls_node LIKE gs_data.

  CALL METHOD gcl_tree->get_outtab_line
    EXPORTING
      i_node_key    = pv_node_key
    IMPORTING
      e_outtab_line = ls_node.

  REFRESH gt_data_disp.

  CASE pv_node_key.
    WHEN gv_all_node.
      LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_disp.
      ENDLOOP.

    WHEN gv_ar_node.
      LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE ar_ap = 'AR' AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_disp.
        gv_check_node = 'AR'.
      ENDLOOP.

    WHEN gv_ap_node.
      LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE ar_ap = 'AP' AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_disp.
        gv_check_node = 'AP'.
      ENDLOOP.

    WHEN OTHERS.
      IF ls_node-belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
        LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE belnr = ls_node-belnr.
          APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_disp.
        ENDLOOP.

      ELSEIF ls_node-name1 IS NOT INITIAL.
        LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data
          WHERE ar_ap = 'AR'
            AND name1 = ls_node-name1
            AND fwaer = ls_node-fwaer
            AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
          APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_disp.
          gv_check_node = 'AR'.
        ENDLOOP.

      ELSEIF ls_node-vennm IS NOT INITIAL.
        LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data
          WHERE ar_ap = 'AP'
            AND vennm = ls_node-vennm
            AND fwaer = ls_node-fwaer
            AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
          APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_disp.
          gv_check_node = 'AP'.
        ENDLOOP.

      ELSEIF ls_node-fwaer IS NOT INITIAL.
        LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data
          WHERE ar_ap = ls_node-ar_ap
            AND fwaer = ls_node-fwaer
            AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
          APPEND gs_data TO gt_data_disp.
        ENDLOOP.

      ENDIF.

  ENDCASE.

  SORT gt_data_disp BY ar_ap dmbtr DESCENDING belnr fwaer.

  gcl_grid_sim->refresh_table_display(
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space ).




ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot   USING   ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                              ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  READ TABLE gt_data_disp INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'BELNR'.
      call function 'ZFE3FI0006'
        EXPORTING
          iv_belnr = gs_data-belnr                 " [FI] 전표 번호
          iv_bukrs = '1000'           " [FI] 회사코드
          iv_gjahr = gs_data-gjahr.                 " [FI] 회계연도

    WHEN 'KUNNR'.
      call function 'ZFE3FI0004'
        EXPORTING
          iv_kunnr = gs_data-kunnr.                " [SD] 고객번호
    WHEN 'LIFNR'.
      call function 'ZFE3FI0005'
        EXPORTING
          iv_lifnr = gs_data-lifnr.                " [MM] 공급업체코드

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  REFRESH : gt_data, gt_data_disp.

  SELECT *
    FROM zcds_e3_fi_0001(
           p_usd = @gv_usd,
           p_eur = @gv_eur,
           p_jpy = @gv_jpy
         )
   WHERE budat <= @gv_evdat
     AND bukrs = @gv_bukrs
*     AND gjahr = ''
     AND  shkzg  =  'S'
     AND ( kunnr NE @space OR lifnr NE @space )
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data.


  IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '미결 외화전표가 없습니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM set_mapping_cds.

  DELETE gt_data WHERE ar_ap = 'GL'.
  SORT gt_data BY ar_ap dmbtr DESCENDING belnr fwaer.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data TO gt_data_disp.

  SELECT SINGLE butxt
    FROM zte3cm0001
    INTO gv_butxt
   WHERE bukrs = gv_bukrs.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_hierarchy
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_hierarchy .

  DATA: lv_all_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
        lt_temp     LIKE TABLE OF gs_data,
        lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

  lt_temp = gt_data.
*  REFRESH gt_data.

  "노드 delete
  gcl_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
  " 전체 루트 노드
  CLEAR gs_data.
  PERFORM add_node USING gs_data '전체' space lv_all_key.
  gv_all_node = lv_all_key.

  " AR (구분값, 텍스트, 부모키, 결과키, 원본데이터)
  PERFORM build_tree_section USING 'AR' 'AR (외화채권)' lv_all_key gv_ar_node lt_temp.

  " AP
  PERFORM build_tree_section USING 'AP' 'AP (외화채무)' lv_all_key gv_ap_node lt_temp.

  " 트리 업데이트
  gcl_tree->update_calculations( ).
  " 트리 확장
  gcl_tree->expand_node( gv_all_node ).
  gcl_tree->expand_node( gv_ap_node ).
  gcl_tree->expand_node( gv_ar_node ).
  gcl_tree->frontend_update( ).
*  gcl_tree->column_optimize( ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_chart
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_chart .

  CHECK gcl_chart IS BOUND.

  DATA : BEGIN OF gs_top,
           name  TYPE string,
           dmbtr TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           ar_ap TYPE c LENGTH 2,
         END OF gs_top.

  DATA: lt_ar    LIKE TABLE OF gs_top,
        lt_ap    LIKE TABLE OF gs_top,
        ls_top   LIKE LINE OF lt_ar,
        lv_xdata TYPE xstring,
        lv_val   TYPE string.

  DATA: lv_root  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_cats  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_cat   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_ser   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_point TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_value TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element.

  DATA: lcl_ixml    TYPE REF TO if_ixml,
        lcl_sf      TYPE REF TO if_ixml_stream_factory,
        lcl_enc     TYPE REF TO if_ixml_encoding,
        lv_cust_doc TYPE REF TO if_ixml_document,
        lv_cust_os  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_ostream,
        lv_cust_str TYPE xstring,
        lv_data_doc TYPE REF TO if_ixml_document,
        lv_data_os  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_ostream,
        lv_croot    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_gs       TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_def      TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_vals     TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_elems    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_celems   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_title    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_ttext    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_pt       TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element.

  "======================================================
  " AR Top5 집계
  "======================================================
  LOOP AT gt_data INTO DATA(ls) WHERE ar_ap = 'AR' AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    READ TABLE lt_ar ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fa>)
      WITH KEY name = CONV string( ls-name1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR ls_top.
      ls_top-name  = ls-name1.
      ls_top-ar_ap = 'AR'.
      APPEND ls_top TO lt_ar.
      READ TABLE lt_ar ASSIGNING <fa> WITH KEY name = CONV string( ls-name1 ).
    ENDIF.
    <fa>-dmbtr += ls-dmbtr.
  ENDLOOP.

  "======================================================
  " AP Top5 집계
  "======================================================
  LOOP AT gt_data INTO ls WHERE ar_ap = 'AP' AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    READ TABLE lt_ap ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fp>)
      WITH KEY name = CONV string( ls-vennm ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR ls_top.
      ls_top-name  = ls-vennm.
      ls_top-ar_ap = 'AP'.
      APPEND ls_top TO lt_ap.
      READ TABLE lt_ap ASSIGNING <fp> WITH KEY name = CONV string( ls-vennm ).
    ENDIF.
    <fp>-dmbtr += ls-dmbtr.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT lt_ar BY dmbtr DESCENDING.
  SORT lt_ap BY dmbtr DESCENDING.
  DELETE lt_ar FROM 6.
  DELETE lt_ap FROM 6.

  IF lt_ar IS INITIAL AND lt_ap IS INITIAL. RETURN. ENDIF.

  "======================================================
  " iXML 공용 초기화
  "======================================================
  lcl_ixml = cl_ixml=>create( ).
  lcl_sf   = lcl_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
  lcl_enc  = lcl_ixml->create_encoding(
               byte_order    = if_ixml_encoding=>co_little_endian
               character_set = 'utf-8' ).

  "======================================================
  " 1. Customizing XML  (3D + Title + Point 색상)
  "======================================================
  lv_cust_doc = lcl_ixml->create_document( ).
  lv_cust_doc->set_encoding( lcl_enc ).

  lv_croot = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
               name = 'SAPChartCustomizing' parent = lv_cust_doc ).
  lv_croot->set_attribute( name = 'version' value = '1.1' ).

  " GlobalSettings
  lv_gs = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
            name = 'GlobalSettings' parent = lv_croot ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_gs
    name = 'Dimension' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'Three' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_gs
    name = 'Width'     )->if_ixml_node~set_value( '900' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_gs
    name = 'Height'    )->if_ixml_node~set_value( '450' ).

  lv_def = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
             name = 'Defaults' parent = lv_gs ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_def
    name = 'FontFamily' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'Arial' ).

  " Title
  lv_elems  = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
                name = 'Elements'      parent = lv_croot ).
  lv_celems = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
                name = 'ChartElements' parent = lv_elems ).
  lv_title  = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
                name = 'Title'         parent = lv_celems ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_title
    name = 'Caption' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'AR / AP 미결잔액 Top5' ).
  lv_ttext = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
               name = 'Text' parent = lv_title ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_ttext
    name = 'Size' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( '14' ).

  " Point 레벨 색상 (AR=파랑, AP=빨강)
  lv_vals = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
              name = 'Values' parent = lv_croot ).

  lv_pt = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Point' parent = lv_vals ).
  lv_pt->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = 'AR' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_pt
    name = 'Color' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'RGB(65,105,225)' ).

  lv_pt = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Point' parent = lv_vals ).
  lv_pt->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = 'AP' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_pt
    name = 'Color' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'RGB(248,80,60)' ).

  " Customizing 렌더링
  lv_cust_os = lcl_sf->create_ostream_xstring( lv_cust_str ).
  lv_cust_doc->render( lv_cust_os ).

  "======================================================
  " 2. Data XML  (단일 Series, 0값 Point 없음)
  "======================================================
  lv_data_doc = lcl_ixml->create_document( ).
  lv_data_doc->set_encoding( lcl_enc ).

  lv_root = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element(
              name = 'ChartData'  parent = lv_data_doc ).
  lv_cats = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element(
              name = 'Categories' parent = lv_root ).
  lv_ser  = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element(
              name = 'Series'     parent = lv_root ).

  lv_ser->set_attribute( name = 'label' value = 'AR / AP 미결잔액' ).

  " AR 포인트
  LOOP AT lt_ar INTO ls_top.
    lv_cat = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element(
               name = 'Category' parent = lv_cats ).
    lv_cat->if_ixml_node~set_value( ls_top-name ).

    lv_val   = |{ ls_top-dmbtr * 100 NUMBER = RAW }|.
    lv_point = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Point' parent = lv_ser ).
    lv_value = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type'        value = 'y' ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'customizing' value = 'AR' ).
    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).
  ENDLOOP.

  " AP 포인트
  LOOP AT lt_ap INTO ls_top.
    lv_cat = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element(
               name = 'Category' parent = lv_cats ).
    lv_cat->if_ixml_node~set_value( ls_top-name ).

    lv_val   = |{ ls_top-dmbtr * 100 NUMBER = RAW }|.
    lv_point = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Point' parent = lv_ser ).
    lv_value = lv_data_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type'        value = 'y' ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'customizing' value = 'AP' ).
    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).
  ENDLOOP.

  lv_data_os = lcl_sf->create_ostream_xstring( lv_xdata ).
  lv_data_doc->render( lv_data_os ).

  "======================================================
  " 3. 차트 엔진 주입
  "======================================================
  gcl_chart->set_customizing( xdata = lv_cust_str ).
  gcl_chart->set_data(        xdata = lv_xdata     ).
  gcl_chart->render( ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_mapping_cds
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_mapping_cds .

  " 전표유형 텍스트
  SELECT domvalue_l AS key, ddtext
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_blart)
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_BLART'.
  SORT lt_blart BY key.

  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).

    PERFORM set_field_data   CHANGING <fs_data>.  "필드명 매핑
    PERFORM set_rate_data    CHANGING <fs_data>.   "계산로직
    PERFORM set_field_design CHANGING <fs_data>.    "필드 색깔, 아이콘 바꾸기

  ENDLOOP.

  IF gv_check = 'X'.
    gv_status = icon_led_green.
    gv_status_text = '활성화'.
  ELSE.
    gv_status = icon_led_red.
    gv_status_text = '비활성화'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_field_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_DATA>
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_field_data  CHANGING ps_data LIKE gs_data.

  " AR/AP 구분
  ps_data-ar_ap = SWITCH #( ps_data-koart
                               WHEN 'D' THEN 'AR'
                               WHEN 'K' THEN 'AP'
                               ELSE          'GL' ).
  "거래처 매핑
  IF ps_data-kunnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    ps_data-name1 = VALUE #( gt_kunnr[ kunnr = ps_data-kunnr ]-name1 OPTIONAL ).
    ps_data-partner = ps_data-kunnr.
    "공급업체 이름 매핑
  ELSEIF ps_data-lifnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    ps_data-vennm = VALUE #( gt_lifnr[ lifnr = ps_data-lifnr ]-vennm OPTIONAL ).
    ps_data-partner = ps_data-lifnr.

  ENDIF.

  "계정명 매핑
  ps_data-stext = VALUE #( gt_saknr[ saknr = ps_data-saknr ]-stext OPTIONAL ).


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_rate_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_DATA>
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_rate_data  CHANGING ps_data LIKE gs_data.

  DATA(lv_gdatu) = 99999999 - gv_evdat.

  DATA : lv_eval_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 9,
         lv_base_krw  TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  " 평가환율 및 평가금액 계산
  READ TABLE gt_rate INTO DATA(ls_rate)
    WITH KEY fcurr = ps_data-fwaer BINARY SEARCH.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    "SIMFACTOR 는 CDS 에서 계산
    lv_eval_rate    = ls_rate-ukurs * ps_data-simfactor.
    ps_data-tcurr = lv_eval_rate.

    IF ps_data-ukurs > 0.
      ps_data-eval_krw = ps_data-dmbtr * lv_eval_rate / ps_data-ukurs.
    ELSE.
      ps_data-eval_krw = ps_data-dmbtr.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

  "평가손익 계산
  IF ps_data-ar_ap = 'AP'.
    ps_data-eval_diff = ps_data-dmbtr - ps_data-eval_krw.
*    ps_data-base_diff = ps_data-dmbtr - lv_base_krw.
  ELSE. "AR
    ps_data-eval_diff = ps_data-eval_krw - ps_data-dmbtr.
*    ps_data-base_diff = lv_base_krw - ps_data-dmbtr.
  ENDIF.

  ps_data-waers = 'KRW'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_field_design
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_DATA>
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_field_design  CHANGING ps_data LIKE gs_data.

  DATA : ls_color TYPE lvc_s_scol.
  CLEAR ps_data-color.
*ICON_WARNING
  IF ps_data-eval_diff > 0.
    ps_data-icon = icon_led_green.
*    ps_data-icon = icon_next_value.
    ps_data-status_text = '이익'.
    CLEAR ls_color.
    ls_color-fname = 'TCURR'.
    ls_color-color-col = 5.
    ls_color-color-int = 0.
    ls_color-color-inv = 0.
    APPEND ls_color TO ps_data-color.

    ls_color-fname = 'EVAL_DIFF'.
    ls_color-color-col = 5.
    ls_color-color-int = 0.
    ls_color-color-inv = 0.
    APPEND ls_color TO ps_data-color.

  ELSEIF ps_data-eval_diff < 0.

    ps_data-icon = icon_led_red.
    ps_data-status_text = '손실'.
    ls_color-fname = 'TCURR'.
    ls_color-color-col = 6.
    ls_color-color-int = 0.
    ls_color-color-inv = 0.
    APPEND ls_color TO ps_data-color.

    ls_color-fname = 'EVAL_DIFF'.
    ls_color-color-col = 6.
    ls_color-color-int = 0.
    ls_color-color-inv = 0.
    APPEND ls_color TO ps_data-color.

  ELSE.
    ps_data-icon = icon_led_inactive.
    ps_data-status_text = '동일'.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_check = 'X' AND ps_data-simfactor NE 1.
*    ps_data-icon = icon_led_green.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&      --> P_

*&      --> LV_ALL_KEY
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_node  USING ps_data      LIKE gs_data
                     pv_text
                     pv_relat_key TYPE lvc_nkey
                     pv_node_key  TYPE lvc_nkey.

*  DATA: lt_item_layout TYPE lvc_t_layi,
*        ls_item_layout TYPE lvc_s_layi,
*        ls_node_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

  DATA lv_node_text TYPE lvc_value.

  lv_node_text = pv_text.

  IF gv_usd_text2 IS NOT INITIAL OR
  gv_eur_text2 IS NOT INITIAL OR
  gv_jpy_text2 IS NOT INITIAL.

  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD gcl_tree->add_node
    EXPORTING
      i_relat_node_key = pv_relat_key
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
*     is_node_layout   = ls_node_layout               " 행 전체 스타일
*     it_item_layout   = lt_item_layout               " 셀별 스타일

    IMPORTING

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form build_tree_section
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> LV_ALL_KEY
*&      --> GV_AR_NODE
*&      --> LT_TEMP
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM build_tree_section USING pv_type  TYPE c        "AP, AP
                              pv_text  TYPE string   "폴더 이름
                              pv_p_key TYPE lvc_nkey "부모 노드키
                              pv_key   TYPE lvc_nkey "출력 헤더 키 (AP, AP)
                              pt_data  LIKE gt_data.

  DATA: lv_curr_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
        lv_ptnr_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
        lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

  DATA: lt_curr    TYPE TABLE OF waers,
        lv_curr    TYPE waers,
        lv_ptnr_nm TYPE string,
        lv_prev_nm TYPE string.

  DATA: ls_node  LIKE gs_data,
        lt_local LIKE gt_data.   " 로컬 정렬용

  REFRESH: gt_curr, gt_curr_sum, gt_ptnr_sum.

  " 로컬 복사 후 거래처명 기준 정렬
  lt_local = pt_data.
  IF pv_type = 'AR'.
    SORT lt_local BY fwaer kunnr name1.
  ELSE.
    SORT lt_local BY fwaer lifnr vennm.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT lt_local INTO gs_data WHERE ar_ap = pv_type.
    CLEAR gs_curr_sum.
    gs_curr_sum-fwaer = gs_data-fwaer.
    gs_curr_sum-wrbtr = gs_data-wrbtr.
    COLLECT gs_curr_sum INTO gt_curr_sum.

    CLEAR gs_ptnr_sum.
    gs_ptnr_sum-fwaer = gs_data-fwaer.
    gs_ptnr_sum-ptnr  = COND #( WHEN pv_type = 'AR'
                                THEN gs_data-name1 ELSE gs_data-vennm ).
    gs_ptnr_sum-wrbtr = gs_data-wrbtr.
    COLLECT gs_ptnr_sum INTO gt_ptnr_sum.

    APPEND gs_data-fwaer TO lt_curr.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT lt_curr.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_curr.

  CLEAR ls_node.
  PERFORM add_node USING ls_node pv_text pv_p_key pv_key.

  LOOP AT lt_curr INTO lv_curr.
    CLEAR ls_node.
    ls_node-ar_ap = pv_type.
    ls_node-fwaer = lv_curr.

    READ TABLE gt_curr_sum INTO gs_curr_sum WITH KEY fwaer = lv_curr.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_node-wrbtr = gs_curr_sum-wrbtr.
    ENDIF.

    PERFORM add_node USING ls_node lv_curr pv_key lv_curr_key.

    CLEAR lv_prev_nm.

    LOOP AT lt_local INTO gs_data WHERE ar_ap = pv_type AND fwaer = lv_curr.
      lv_ptnr_nm = COND #( WHEN pv_type = 'AR' THEN gs_data-name1 ELSE gs_data-vennm ).

      IF lv_ptnr_nm NE lv_prev_nm.
        CLEAR ls_node.
        ls_node-ar_ap = pv_type.
        ls_node-fwaer = lv_curr.
        IF pv_type = 'AR'. ls_node-name1 = lv_ptnr_nm. ELSE. ls_node-vennm = lv_ptnr_nm. ENDIF.

        READ TABLE gt_ptnr_sum INTO gs_ptnr_sum WITH KEY fwaer = lv_curr ptnr = lv_ptnr_nm.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ls_node-wrbtr = gs_ptnr_sum-wrbtr.
        ENDIF.

        PERFORM add_node USING ls_node lv_ptnr_nm lv_curr_key lv_ptnr_key.
        lv_prev_nm = lv_ptnr_nm.
      ENDIF.

      PERFORM add_node USING gs_data gs_data-belnr lv_ptnr_key lv_node_key.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_hold
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_hold  USING pv_key
                           pv_field
                           pv_text
                           pv_ref_table
                           pv_ref_field
                           pv_cfield.

  gs_fcat-key = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  IF pv_cfield IS NOT INITIAL.
    gs_fcat-cfieldname = pv_cfield.
  ENDIF.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'WRBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'FWAER'.
*      gs_fcat-do_sum = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DMBTR' OR 'EVAL_DIFF'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum = 'X'.

    WHEN 'EVAL_KRW'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
*      gs_fcat-decimals_o = '0'.
    WHEN 'UKURS' OR 'TCURR'.
      gs_fcat-decimals_o = '0'.
      gs_fcat-no_sum     = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.


  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_hold.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.

*& Form calc_summary
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM calc_summary .

  CLEAR: gv_ar_krw_sum, gv_ar_profit, gv_ar_loss, gv_ar_net,
         gv_ap_krw_sum, gv_ap_profit, gv_ap_loss, gv_ap_net,
         gv_before, gv_after, gv_change.

  PERFORM sum_sim_data.
  PERFORM get_before_data.

  gv_ar_net = gv_ar_profit + gv_ar_loss.  " 이익 + 손실 = 순손익
  gv_ap_net = gv_ap_profit + gv_ap_loss.
  gv_change = gv_after - gv_before.        " 시뮬 후 - 시뮬 전 = 변화량

  " 시뮬레이션 OFF 상태면 gv_after 표시 안 함
  CHECK gv_check IS INITIAL.
  CLEAR gv_after.

ENDFORM.

FORM get_bank_data .

  "원화 환산 및 평가손익 계산
  DATA lv_eval_krw TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  REFRESH gt_hold.
  CLEAR: gv_usd_wrbtr, gv_usd_krw,
         gv_eur_wrbtr, gv_eur_krw,
         gv_jpy_wrbtr, gv_jpy_krw.

  SELECT *
    FROM zcds_e3_fi_0004(
           p_evdat = @gv_evdat,
           p_usd   = @gv_usd,
           p_eur   = @gv_eur,
           p_jpy   = @gv_jpy
         )
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_bank_bal).

  DATA : ls_bal   LIKE LINE OF lt_bank_bal,
         ls_color TYPE lvc_s_scol.

  LOOP AT lt_bank_bal INTO ls_bal.

    CLEAR gs_hold.
    gs_hold-category = '우리은행'.
    gs_hold-fwaer    = ls_bal-fwaer.
    gs_hold-waers    = 'KRW'.
    gs_hold-wrbtr    = ls_bal-wrbtr.
    gs_hold-dmbtr    = ls_bal-dmbtr.

    READ TABLE gt_rate INTO DATA(ls_rate)
      WITH KEY fcurr = ls_bal-fwaer BINARY SEARCH.

    gs_hold-ukurs = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN ls_rate-ukurs ELSE 1 ).

    APPEND gs_hold TO gt_hold.
    PERFORM sum_hold_total.  " wrbtr 합산만

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form build_eval
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GV_CHECK
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM build_eval  USING pv_check.

  DATA: ls_header     TYPE zte3fi0002,
        lt_items      TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        ls_item       TYPE zte3fi0003,
        lv_belnr      TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
        ls_rev_header TYPE zte3fi0002,
        lt_rev_items  TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        lv_rev_belnr  TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
        lv_rev_date   TYPE sy-datum.

  DATA: lv_ar_diff TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_ap_diff TYPE p DECIMALS 2.


  LOOP AT gt_data INTO DATA(ls_data) WHERE belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    IF ls_data-ar_ap = 'AR'.
      lv_ar_diff += ls_data-eval_diff.
    ELSEIF ls_data-ar_ap = 'AP'.
      lv_ap_diff += ls_data-eval_diff.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  CHECK lv_ar_diff NE 0 OR lv_ap_diff NE 0.

  REFRESH lt_items.
  " 헤더 세팅
  CLEAR ls_header.
  ls_header-bukrs = '1000'.
  ls_header-gjahr = gv_evdat(4).
  ls_header-blart = 'SA'.
  ls_header-budat = gv_evdat.
  ls_header-bldat = gv_evdat.
  ls_header-monat = gv_evdat+4(2).
  ls_header-waers = 'KRW'.
  ls_header-bltxt = |{ gv_evdat(4) }년 { gv_evdat+4(2) }월 외화환산평가|.

  " 1. AR (외화채권) 전표 라인 생성
  IF lv_ar_diff NE 0.
    CLEAR ls_item.
    ls_item-buzei = 1.
    ls_item-saknr = '1100000001'. " AR 채권 계정
    ls_item-koart = 'D'.
    ls_item-waers = 'KRW'.
    ls_item-dmbtr = abs( lv_ar_diff ).
    ls_item-shkzg = COND #( WHEN lv_ar_diff > 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'H' ).
    APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

    CLEAR ls_item.
    ls_item-buzei = 2.
    ls_item-saknr = COND #( WHEN lv_ar_diff > 0 THEN '4200000003' ELSE '5300000003' ).
    ls_item-koart = 'S'.
    ls_item-waers = 'KRW'.
    ls_item-kostl = 'CC_FIN'.
    ls_item-dmbtr = abs( lv_ar_diff ).
    ls_item-shkzg = COND #( WHEN lv_ar_diff > 0 THEN 'H' ELSE 'S' ).
    APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.
  ENDIF.

  " 2. AP (외화채무) 전표 라인 생성
  IF lv_ap_diff NE 0.
    DATA(lv_idx) = lines( lt_items ).
    CLEAR ls_item.
    ls_item-buzei = lv_idx + 1.
    ls_item-saknr = '2100000001'. " AP 채무 계정
    ls_item-koart = 'K'.
    ls_item-waers = 'KRW'.
    ls_item-dmbtr = abs( lv_ap_diff ).
    ls_item-shkzg = COND #( WHEN lv_ap_diff > 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'H' ).
    APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

    CLEAR ls_item.
    ls_item-buzei = lv_idx + 2.
    ls_item-saknr = COND #( WHEN lv_ap_diff > 0 THEN '4200000003' ELSE '5300000003' ).
    ls_item-koart = 'S'.
    ls_item-waers = 'KRW'.
    ls_item-kostl = 'CC_FIN'.
    ls_item-dmbtr = abs( lv_ap_diff ).
    ls_item-shkzg = COND #( WHEN lv_ap_diff > 0 THEN 'H' ELSE 'S' ).
    APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.
  ENDIF.

  " 실제 전표 생성
  IF pv_check NE 'X'.
    " 말일 평가 전표 생성
    zcl_e3_fi_document=>post_document(
      EXPORTING is_header = ls_header
                it_items  = lt_items
      IMPORTING ev_belnr  = lv_belnr ).

    IF lv_belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      " 익월 1일 자 환입 전표 자동 생성
      lv_rev_date         = gv_evdat + 1.
      ls_rev_header       = ls_header.
      ls_rev_header-gjahr = lv_rev_date(4).
      ls_rev_header-budat = lv_rev_date.
      ls_rev_header-bldat = lv_rev_date.
      ls_rev_header-monat = lv_rev_date+4(2).
      ls_rev_header-bltxt = |{ gv_evdat(4) }년 { gv_evdat+4(2) }월 외화환산환입|.
      ls_rev_header-xblnr = lv_belnr. " 참조 필드에 평가 전표번호

      " 환입 아이템 복사
      lt_rev_items = lt_items.

      LOOP AT lt_rev_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_rev>).
        <fs_rev>-shkzg = COND #( WHEN <fs_rev>-shkzg = 'S' THEN 'H' ELSE 'S' ).

        IF <fs_rev>-koart = 'S'.
          <fs_rev>-saknr = COND #( WHEN <fs_rev>-saknr = '4200000003' THEN '5300000003'
                                   WHEN <fs_rev>-saknr = '5300000003' THEN '4200000003'
                                   ELSE <fs_rev>-saknr ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      zcl_e3_fi_document=>post_document(
        EXPORTING is_header = ls_rev_header
                  it_items  = lt_rev_items
        IMPORTING ev_belnr  = lv_rev_belnr ).

      IF lv_rev_belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
        MESSAGE s000 WITH |평가 전표({ lv_belnr }) / 환입 전표({ lv_rev_belnr }) 생성되었습니다.|.
      ENDIF.

    ELSE.
      MESSAGE e000 WITH '평가전표 생성 실패.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

    FROM zte3fi0002 INTO lv_cnt
   WHERE monat = gv_evdat+4(2)
     AND blart = 'SA'
     AND gjahr = gv_evdat(4)
     AND budat = gv_evdat
     AND bltxt LIKE '%외화환산평가%'.

  IF lv_cnt > 0.
    pv_error = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*    ENDIF.
*    lv_val = |{ lv_acc_eur * 100 NUMBER = RAW }|.
*
*    lv_point = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
*                 name = 'Point' parent = lv_ser_eur ).
*    lv_value = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
*                 name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
*    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'y' ).
*    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).
*
*    " --- JPY ---
*    READ TABLE lt_mon INTO ls_mon WITH KEY fwaer = 'JPY' monat = lv_month.
*    IF sy-subrc = 0.
*      lv_acc_jpy = lv_acc_jpy + ls_mon-dmbtr.
*    ENDIF.
*    lv_val = |{ lv_acc_jpy * 100 NUMBER = RAW }|.
*
*    lv_point = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
*                 name = 'Point' parent = lv_ser_jpy ).
*    lv_value = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
*                 name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
*    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'y' ).
*    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).
*
*    " --- USD ---
*    READ TABLE lt_mon INTO ls_mon WITH KEY fwaer = 'USD' monat = lv_month.
*    IF sy-subrc = 0.
*      lv_acc_usd = lv_acc_usd + ls_mon-dmbtr.
*    ENDIF.
*    lv_val = |{ lv_acc_usd * 100 NUMBER = RAW }|.
*
*    lv_point = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
*                 name = 'Point' parent = lv_ser_usd ).
*    lv_value = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(

*

*

*  gcl_chart2->render( ).

  CHECK gcl_chart2 IS BOUND.

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_mon,
          fwaer TYPE zte3fi0007-fwaer,
          monat TYPE c LENGTH 6,
          dmbtr TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        END OF ls_mon,
        lt_mon LIKE TABLE OF ls_mon.

  DATA: lv_month     TYPE c LENGTH 6,
        lt_months    LIKE TABLE OF lv_month,
        lv_from      TYPE sy-datum,
        lv_to        TYPE sy-datum,
        lv_work      TYPE sy-datum,
        lv_month_cnt TYPE i.

  " 누적용 변수
  DATA: lv_acc_eur TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_acc_jpy TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_acc_usd TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_pre_eur TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_pre_jpy TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_pre_usd TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  " ★ 변경: 12개월 롤링 → 올해 1월 1일 ~ 평가기준일
  lv_to        = gv_evdat.
  lv_from      = gv_evdat.
  lv_from+4(4) = '0101'.  " 올해 1월 1일 고정

  " ★ 올해 시작 이전(작년 말까지) 기초잔액 계산
  SELECT fwaer, shkzg, dmbtr
    FROM zte3fi0007
   WHERE valut < @lv_from
     AND ( fwaer = 'EUR' OR fwaer = 'JPY' OR fwaer = 'USD' )
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_pre).

  DATA lv_amt_pre TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  LOOP AT lt_pre INTO DATA(ls_pre).
    IF ls_pre-shkzg = 'S'.
      lv_amt_pre = ls_pre-dmbtr.
    ELSE.
      lv_amt_pre = ls_pre-dmbtr * -1.
    ENDIF.
    CASE ls_pre-fwaer.
      WHEN 'EUR'. lv_pre_eur += lv_amt_pre.
      WHEN 'JPY'. lv_pre_jpy += lv_amt_pre.
      WHEN 'USD'. lv_pre_usd += lv_amt_pre.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 올해 1월 ~ 평가기준일까지 월별 순입출금 집계
  SELECT fwaer, valut, shkzg, dmbtr
    FROM zte3fi0007
   WHERE valut BETWEEN @lv_from AND @lv_to
     AND ( fwaer = 'EUR' OR fwaer = 'JPY' OR fwaer = 'USD' )
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw).

  LOOP AT lt_raw INTO DATA(ls_raw).
    CLEAR ls_mon.
    ls_mon-fwaer = ls_raw-fwaer.
    ls_mon-monat = ls_raw-valut(6).
    ls_mon-dmbtr = COND #( WHEN ls_raw-shkzg = 'S'
                            THEN  ls_raw-dmbtr
                            ELSE  ls_raw-dmbtr * -1 ).
    COLLECT ls_mon INTO lt_mon.
  ENDLOOP.

  " ★ 변경: 12개월 고정 DO → 올해 1월부터 현재월까지 동적 개월 수
  lv_month_cnt = lv_to+4(2) - '01' + 1.

  lv_work = lv_from.
  DO lv_month_cnt TIMES.
    lv_month = lv_work(6).
    APPEND lv_month TO lt_months.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RP_CALC_DATE_IN_INTERVAL'
      EXPORTING
        date      = lv_work
        days      = 0
        months    = 1
        years     = 0
        signum    = '+'
      IMPORTING
        calc_date = lv_work.
  ENDDO.

  DATA: lv_xdata   TYPE xstring,
        lv_xcustom TYPE xstring,
        lv_val     TYPE string.

  DATA: lv_root    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_cats    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_cat     TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_ser_eur TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_ser_jpy TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_ser_usd TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_point   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_value   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element.

  " ① Customizing XML (꺾은선)
  DATA: lo_ixml   TYPE REF TO if_ixml,
        lo_sf     TYPE REF TO if_ixml_stream_factory,
        lo_enc    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_encoding,
        lo_doc_c  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_document,
        lo_root_c TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lo_global TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element.

  lo_ixml  = cl_ixml=>create( ).
  lo_sf    = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
  lo_enc   = lo_ixml->create_encoding(
               byte_order    = if_ixml_encoding=>co_little_endian
               character_set = 'utf-8' ).
  lo_doc_c = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
  lo_doc_c->set_encoding( lo_enc ).

  lo_root_c = lo_doc_c->create_simple_element(
                name = 'SAPChartCustomizing' parent = lo_doc_c ).
  lo_root_c->set_attribute( name = 'version' value = '3.0' ).
  lo_global = lo_doc_c->create_simple_element(
                name = 'GlobalSettings' parent = lo_root_c ).
  lo_doc_c->create_simple_element(
    name = 'ChartType' parent = lo_global )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'Lines' ).

  lo_doc_c->render( ostream = lo_sf->create_ostream_xstring( lv_xcustom ) ).
  gcl_chart2->set_customizing( xdata = lv_xcustom ).

  " ② Data XML
  gcl_ixml          = cl_ixml=>create( ).
  gcl_ixml_sf       = gcl_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
  gcl_ixml_data_doc = gcl_ixml->create_document( ).
  gcl_encoding      = gcl_ixml->create_encoding(
                        byte_order    = if_ixml_encoding=>co_little_endian
                        character_set = 'utf-8' ).
  gcl_ixml_data_doc->set_encoding( gcl_encoding ).

  lv_root = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
              name = 'ChartData' parent = gcl_ixml_data_doc ).
  lv_cats = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
              name = 'Categories' parent = lv_root ).

  lv_ser_eur = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Series' parent = lv_root ).
  lv_ser_jpy = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Series' parent = lv_root ).
  lv_ser_usd = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Series' parent = lv_root ).

  lv_ser_eur->set_attribute( name = 'label' value = 'EUR' ).
  lv_ser_jpy->set_attribute( name = 'label' value = 'JPY' ).
  lv_ser_usd->set_attribute( name = 'label' value = 'USD' ).

  " ③ 월별 누적잔액 XML 포인트 생성
  lv_acc_eur = lv_pre_eur.
  lv_acc_jpy = lv_pre_jpy.
  lv_acc_usd = lv_pre_usd.

  LOOP AT lt_months INTO lv_month.
    lv_cat = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
               name = 'Category' parent = lv_cats ).
    lv_cat->if_ixml_node~set_value( |{ lv_month(4) }.{ lv_month+4(2) }| ).

    " --- EUR ---
    READ TABLE lt_mon INTO ls_mon WITH KEY fwaer = 'EUR' monat = lv_month.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_acc_eur = lv_acc_eur + ls_mon-dmbtr.
    ENDIF.
    lv_val = |{ lv_acc_eur * 100 NUMBER = RAW }|.

    lv_point = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Point' parent = lv_ser_eur ).
    lv_value = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'y' ).
    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).

    " --- JPY ---
    READ TABLE lt_mon INTO ls_mon WITH KEY fwaer = 'JPY' monat = lv_month.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_acc_jpy = lv_acc_jpy + ls_mon-dmbtr.
    ENDIF.
    lv_val = |{ lv_acc_jpy * 100 NUMBER = RAW }|.

    lv_point = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Point' parent = lv_ser_jpy ).
    lv_value = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'y' ).
    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).

    " --- USD ---
    READ TABLE lt_mon INTO ls_mon WITH KEY fwaer = 'USD' monat = lv_month.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_acc_usd = lv_acc_usd + ls_mon-dmbtr.
    ENDIF.
    lv_val = |{ lv_acc_usd * 100 NUMBER = RAW }|.

    lv_point = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Point' parent = lv_ser_usd ).
    lv_value = gcl_ixml_data_doc->create_simple_element(
                 name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'y' ).
    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).

  ENDLOOP.

  gcl_ixml_data_doc->render(
    ostream = gcl_ixml_sf->create_ostream_xstring( lv_xdata ) ).

  gcl_chart2->set_data( xdata = lv_xdata ).
  gcl_chart2->render( ).

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form week_tcurr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM week_fcurr .

  DATA: lv_date_from  TYPE sy-datum,
        lv_date_to    TYPE sy-datum,
        lv_gdatu_from TYPE zte3fi0008-gdatu,
        lv_gdatu_to   TYPE zte3fi0008-gdatu.
  " 1주일 평균
  lv_date_to    = sy-datum.
  lv_date_from  = sy-datum - 6.
  lv_gdatu_from = 99999999 - lv_date_to.
  lv_gdatu_to   = 99999999 - lv_date_from.

  SELECT *
    FROM zte3fi0008
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_rate_disp
   WHERE fcurr IN ( 'USD', 'EUR' ,'JPY' )
     AND gdatu BETWEEN lv_gdatu_from AND lv_gdatu_to.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_init_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_init_data .

  DATA(lv_gdatu) = 99999999 - gv_evdat.

  SELECT saknr stext
    INTO TABLE gt_saknr
    FROM zte3fi0001
   WHERE bukrs = gv_bukrs.

  SORT gt_saknr BY saknr.

  SELECT kunnr name1
    FROM zte3sd0001
    INTO TABLE gt_kunnr.

  SORT gt_kunnr BY kunnr.

  SELECT lifnr vennm
    FROM zte3mm0002
    INTO TABLE gt_lifnr.
  SORT gt_lifnr BY lifnr.

  SELECT DISTINCT fcurr gdatu ukurs ffact erdat
    INTO TABLE gt_rate
    FROM zte3fi0008
   WHERE tcurr = 'KRW'
     AND fcurr IN ( 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY' )  " ← 필요한 통화만
     AND gdatu >= lv_gdatu.

  " gdatu 오름차순 = 숫자 작은 것 = 가장 최신 유효일자
  SORT gt_rate BY fcurr gdatu ASCENDING.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM gt_rate COMPARING fcurr.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form weeK_fcurr_sum
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM week_fcurr_sum .

  DATA: lv_usd_sum TYPE wrbtr,
        lv_usd_cnt TYPE i,
        lv_eur_sum TYPE wrbtr,
        lv_eur_cnt TYPE i,
        lv_jpy_sum TYPE wrbtr,
        lv_jpy_cnt TYPE i.

  LOOP AT gt_rate_disp INTO DATA(ls).
    CASE ls-fcurr.
      WHEN 'USD'.
        lv_usd_sum += ls-ukurs.
        lv_usd_cnt += 1.
      WHEN 'EUR'.
        lv_eur_sum += ls-ukurs.
        lv_eur_cnt += 1.
      WHEN 'JPY'.
        lv_jpy_sum += ls-ukurs.
        lv_jpy_cnt += 1.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF lv_usd_cnt > 0.
    gv_usd_avg = lv_usd_sum / lv_usd_cnt.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_eur_cnt > 0.
    gv_eur_avg = lv_eur_sum / lv_eur_cnt.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_jpy_cnt > 0.
    gv_jpy_avg = lv_jpy_sum / lv_jpy_cnt.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form curr_fcurr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM curr_fcurr .

  DATA: lv_sum  TYPE p DECIMALS 5,
        lv_cnt  TYPE i,
        ls_rate LIKE LINE OF gt_rate,
        lv_pct  TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  READ TABLE gt_rate INTO ls_rate WITH KEY fcurr = 'USD'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_rate-ukurs > 0 AND gv_usd_avg > 0.
    gv_usd = ( gv_usd_avg - ls_rate-ukurs ) / ls_rate-ukurs * 100.

  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_rate INTO ls_rate WITH KEY fcurr = 'EUR'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_rate-ukurs > 0 AND gv_eur_avg > 0.
    gv_eur = ( gv_eur_avg - ls_rate-ukurs ) / ls_rate-ukurs * 100.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE gt_rate INTO ls_rate WITH KEY fcurr = 'JPY'.

  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_rate-ukurs > 0 AND gv_jpy_avg > 0.
    gv_jpy = ( gv_jpy_avg - ls_rate-ukurs ) / ls_rate-ukurs * 100.
*    gv_jpy = ( gv_jpy_avg - ls_rate-ukurs ) / ls_rate-ukurs.

  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form sum_sim_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM sum_sim_data .

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO DATA(ls) WHERE belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    gv_after += ls-eval_diff.

    IF ls-ar_ap = 'AR'.
      gv_ar_krw_sum += ls-eval_krw.
      IF ls-eval_diff >= 0.
        gv_ar_profit += ls-eval_diff.
      ELSE.
        gv_ar_loss   += ls-eval_diff.
      ENDIF.

    ELSEIF ls-ar_ap = 'AP'.
      gv_ap_krw_sum += ls-eval_krw.
      IF ls-eval_diff >= 0.
        gv_ap_profit += ls-eval_diff.
      ELSE.
        gv_ap_loss   += ls-eval_diff.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_before_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_before_data .

  DATA: ls_rate      LIKE LINE OF gt_rate,
        lv_base_eval TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO DATA(ls) WHERE belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    READ TABLE gt_rate INTO ls_rate WITH KEY fcurr = ls-fwaer BINARY SEARCH.
    lv_base_eval = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 AND ls-ukurs > 0
                           THEN ls-dmbtr * ls_rate-ukurs / ls-ukurs
                           ELSE ls-dmbtr ).  " 환율 없으면 금액 그대로

    " AR: 재환산액 - 장부 = 이익(+)/손실(-)
    " AP: 장부 - 재환산액 = 이익(+)/손실(-) (부채는 반대)
    gv_before += COND #( WHEN ls-ar_ap = 'AR' THEN lv_base_eval - ls-dmbtr
                         WHEN ls-ar_ap = 'AP' THEN ls-dmbtr - lv_base_eval
                         ELSE 0 ).
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form base_ukurs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM base_ukurs .
  "기존 환율 계산
  gv_base_usd = VALUE #( gt_rate[ fcurr = 'USD' ]-ukurs OPTIONAL ).
  gv_base_eur = VALUE #( gt_rate[ fcurr = 'EUR' ]-ukurs OPTIONAL ).
  gv_base_jpy = VALUE #( gt_rate[ fcurr = 'JPY' ]-ukurs OPTIONAL ).
  " USD 필드 매핑
  gv_usd_text = |{ gv_base_usd NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.
  gv_eur_text = |{ gv_base_eur NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.
  gv_jpy_text = |{ gv_base_jpy NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form change_sim_ukurs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM change_sim_ukurs .

  "USD 매핑
  IF gv_usd IS NOT INITIAL AND gv_usd NE 0.
    gv_sim_usd    = gv_base_usd * ( 1 + ( gv_usd / 100 ) ).
    gv_usd_text2 = |{ gv_sim_usd NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.
  ELSE.
    gv_sim_usd   = gv_base_usd. " 변동률 없으면 기본 환율 유지
    gv_usd_text2 = |{ gv_base_usd NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.
  ENDIF.

  " EUR 매핑
  IF gv_eur IS NOT INITIAL AND gv_eur NE 0.
    gv_sim_eur   = gv_base_eur * ( 1 + ( gv_eur / 100 ) ).
    gv_eur_text2 = |{ gv_sim_eur NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.
  ELSE.
    gv_sim_eur   = gv_base_eur.
    gv_eur_text2 = |{ gv_base_eur NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.
  ENDIF.

  " JPY 매핑
  IF gv_jpy IS NOT INITIAL AND gv_jpy NE 0.
    gv_sim_jpy   = gv_base_jpy * ( 1 + ( gv_jpy / 100 ) ).
    gv_jpy_text2 = |{ gv_sim_jpy NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.
  ELSE.
    gv_sim_jpy   = gv_base_jpy.
    gv_jpy_text2 = |{ gv_base_jpy NUMBER = USER DECIMALS = 0 }|.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form sum_sim_hold
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM sum_sim_hold .
***
  DATA : ls_color TYPE lvc_s_scol,
         lv_col   TYPE i.

  " 1. 오버플로우 방지용 넉넉한 임시 합산 변수 선언 (길이 16 = 31자리)
  DATA : lv_sum_usd TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
         lv_sum_eur TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
         lv_sum_jpy TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.

  CLEAR: lv_sum_usd, lv_sum_eur, lv_sum_jpy.

  LOOP AT gt_hold ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_hold>).

    READ TABLE gt_rate INTO DATA(ls_rate)
      WITH KEY fcurr = <fs_hold>-fwaer BINARY SEARCH.

    DATA(lv_ffact) = COND zte3fi0008-ffact(
                      WHEN sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_rate-ffact > 0
                      THEN ls_rate-ffact ELSE 1 ).

    DATA(lv_ukurs) = COND zte3fi0008-ukurs(
      WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN
        SWITCH zte3fi0008-ukurs( <fs_hold>-fwaer
          WHEN 'USD' THEN COND #( WHEN gv_sim_usd > 0 THEN gv_sim_usd ELSE ls_rate-ukurs )
          WHEN 'EUR' THEN COND #( WHEN gv_sim_eur > 0 THEN gv_sim_eur ELSE ls_rate-ukurs )
          WHEN 'JPY' THEN COND #( WHEN gv_sim_jpy > 0 THEN gv_sim_jpy ELSE ls_rate-ukurs )
          ELSE ls_rate-ukurs )
      ELSE 1 ).

    <fs_hold>-ukurs     = lv_ukurs.
    <fs_hold>-eval_krw  = ( <fs_hold>-wrbtr * lv_ukurs ) / lv_ffact.

    IF <fs_hold>-fwaer = 'JPY'.
      " JPY: /ffact(100) 했으므로 *100 복원 후 보정
      <fs_hold>-eval_krw = <fs_hold>-eval_krw * 100.
    ENDIF.

    <fs_hold>-eval_diff = <fs_hold>-eval_krw - <fs_hold>-dmbtr * 100.

    " 색상 처리
    CLEAR <fs_hold>-color.
    IF <fs_hold>-eval_diff <> 0.
      lv_col = COND #( WHEN <fs_hold>-eval_diff > 0 THEN 5 ELSE 6 ).
      CLEAR ls_color.
      ls_color-color-col = lv_col.
      ls_color-color-int = 0.
      ls_color-color-inv = 0.
      ls_color-fname = 'EVAL_DIFF'. APPEND ls_color TO <fs_hold>-color.
      ls_color-fname = 'UKURS'.     APPEND ls_color TO <fs_hold>-color.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. 메인 루프 안에서 각 통화별로 원화 환산액(eval_krw) 누적
    CASE <fs_hold>-fwaer.
      WHEN 'USD'.
        lv_sum_usd = lv_sum_usd + <fs_hold>-eval_krw.
      WHEN 'EUR'.
        lv_sum_eur = lv_sum_eur + <fs_hold>-eval_krw.
      WHEN 'JPY'.
        lv_sum_jpy = lv_sum_jpy + <fs_hold>-eval_krw.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

  " 3. 누적된 최종 금액을 글로벌 변수에 할당
  gv_usd_krw = lv_sum_usd.
  gv_eur_krw = lv_sum_eur.
  gv_jpy_krw = lv_sum_jpy.

  " 4. KRW 소수점 보정
  CALL FUNCTION 'CURRENCY_AMOUNT_IDOC_TO_SAP'
    EXPORTING
      currency    = 'KRW'
      idoc_amount = gv_usd_krw
    IMPORTING
      sap_amount  = gv_usd_krw.

  CALL FUNCTION 'CURRENCY_AMOUNT_IDOC_TO_SAP'
    EXPORTING
      currency    = 'KRW'
      idoc_amount = gv_eur_krw
    IMPORTING
      sap_amount  = gv_eur_krw.

  CALL FUNCTION 'CURRENCY_AMOUNT_IDOC_TO_SAP'
    EXPORTING
      currency    = 'KRW'
      idoc_amount = gv_jpy_krw
    IMPORTING
      sap_amount  = gv_jpy_krw.



ENDFORM.

*& Form modify_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM modify_screen .

  LOOP AT SCREEN.

    IF screen-group1 = 'GR1'.
      IF gv_change IS NOT INITIAL.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 가능
        screen-invisible = 0. " 화면에 보임
      ELSE.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 불가
        screen-invisible = 1. " (선택사항) 아예 안 보이게 하려면 1로 설정

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF screen-group1 = 'GR3'.
      IF gv_usd IS NOT INITIAL.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 가능
        screen-invisible = 0. " 화면에 보임
      ELSE.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 불가
        screen-invisible = 1. " (선택사항) 아예 안 보이게 하려면 1로 설정

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF screen-group1 = 'GR4'.
      IF gv_eur IS NOT INITIAL AND gv_check IS NOT INITIAL.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 가능
        screen-invisible = 0. " 화면에 보임
      ELSE.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 불가
        screen-invisible = 1. " (선택사항) 아예 안 보이게 하려면 1로 설정

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.


    IF screen-group1 = 'GR5'.
      IF gv_jpy IS NOT INITIAL AND gv_check IS NOT INITIAL.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 가능
        screen-invisible = 0. " 화면에 보임
      ELSE.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 불가
        screen-invisible = 1. " (선택사항) 아예 안 보이게 하려면 1로 설정

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF screen-group1 = 'GR2'. "테스트 실행
      IF gv_check = 'X'.
        screen-input     = 1. " 입력 가능
        screen-invisible = 0. " 화면에 보임
*        CLEAR gv_after.
      ELSE.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 불가
        screen-invisible = 0. " (선택사항) 아예 안 보이게 하려면 1로 설정

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY SCREEN.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_prev_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_prev_data .
*
*  REFRESH gt_prev.
*
*  DATA: lv_seq      TYPE i,
*        lv_rev_date TYPE sy-datum,
*        lt_items    TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
*        ls_item     TYPE zte3fi0003,
*        lt_rev      TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003.
*
*  DATA: lv_total_diff TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
*
*  LOOP AT gt_data_disp INTO gs_data WHERE belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
*    lv_total_diff += gs_data-eval_diff.
*  ENDLOOP.
*
*  " 평가 대상 금액이 없으면 전표 생성 불가
*  CHECK lv_total_diff NE 0.


  REFRESH gt_prev.

  DATA: lv_seq      TYPE i,
        lv_rev_date TYPE sy-datum,
        lt_items    TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        ls_item     TYPE zte3fi0003,
        lt_rev      TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003.

  DATA: lv_total_diff TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  " ★ 수정: gt_data_disp(트리 필터링된 화면용) → gt_data(전체 원본)로 변경
  LOOP AT gt_data INTO gs_data WHERE belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    lv_total_diff += gs_data-eval_diff.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 평가 대상 금액이 없으면 전표 생성 불가
  CHECK lv_total_diff NE 0.


  lv_rev_date = gv_evdat + 1.

  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-buzei = 1.
  ls_item-saknr = '2100000001'. " 예시: 계정번호
  ls_item-koart = 'K'.
  ls_item-waers = 'KRW'.
  ls_item-dmbtr = abs( lv_total_diff ).
  ls_item-shkzg = COND #( WHEN lv_total_diff < 0 THEN 'H' ELSE 'S' ).
  APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-buzei = 2.
  ls_item-saknr = COND #( WHEN lv_total_diff < 0 THEN '5300000003' ELSE '4200000003' ).
  ls_item-koart = 'S'.
  ls_item-waers = 'KRW'.
  ls_item-dmbtr = abs( lv_total_diff ).
  ls_item-shkzg = COND #( WHEN lv_total_diff < 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'H' ).
  ls_item-kostl = 'CC_FIN'.
  APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

  "환입전표
  lt_rev = lt_items.
  LOOP AT lt_rev ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>).
    <fs>-shkzg = COND #( WHEN <fs>-shkzg = 'S' THEN 'H' ELSE 'S' ).
    IF <fs>-koart = 'S'.
      <fs>-saknr = COND #( WHEN <fs>-saknr = '4200000003' THEN '5300000003'
                           WHEN <fs>-saknr = '5300000003' THEN '4200000003'
                           ELSE <fs>-saknr ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  "평가 전표
  LOOP AT lt_items INTO ls_item.
    lv_seq += 1.
    CLEAR gs_prev.
    gs_prev-seq     = lv_seq.
    gs_prev-remark  = '평가'.
    gs_prev-budat   = gv_evdat.
    gs_prev-blart   = 'SA'.
    gs_prev-bltxt   = |{ gv_evdat(4) }년 { gv_evdat+4(2) }월 외화환산평가|.
    gs_prev-saknr   = ls_item-saknr.
    gs_prev-stext   = VALUE #( gt_saknr[ saknr = ls_item-saknr ]-stext OPTIONAL ).
    gs_prev-kostl   = ls_item-kostl.
    gs_prev-shkzg   = ls_item-shkzg.
    gs_prev-dmbtr_s = COND #( WHEN ls_item-shkzg = 'S' THEN ls_item-dmbtr ELSE 0 ).
    gs_prev-dmbtr_h = COND #( WHEN ls_item-shkzg = 'H' THEN ls_item-dmbtr ELSE 0 ).
    gs_prev-waers_s = COND #( WHEN ls_item-shkzg = 'S' THEN ls_item-waers ELSE space ).
    gs_prev-waers_h = COND #( WHEN ls_item-shkzg = 'H' THEN ls_item-waers ELSE space ).
    APPEND gs_prev TO gt_prev.
  ENDLOOP.

  "환입 전표
  LOOP AT lt_rev INTO ls_item.
    lv_seq += 1.
    CLEAR gs_prev.
    gs_prev-seq     = lv_seq.
    gs_prev-remark  = '환입'.
    gs_prev-budat   = lv_rev_date.
    gs_prev-blart   = 'SA'.
    gs_prev-bltxt   = |{ gv_evdat(4) }년 { gv_evdat+4(2) }월 외화환산환입|.
    gs_prev-saknr   = ls_item-saknr.
    gs_prev-stext   = VALUE #( gt_saknr[ saknr = ls_item-saknr ]-stext OPTIONAL ).
    gs_prev-kostl   = ls_item-kostl.
    gs_prev-shkzg   = ls_item-shkzg.
    gs_prev-dmbtr_s = COND #( WHEN ls_item-shkzg = 'S' THEN ls_item-dmbtr ELSE 0 ).
    gs_prev-dmbtr_h = COND #( WHEN ls_item-shkzg = 'H' THEN ls_item-dmbtr ELSE 0 ).
    gs_prev-waers_s = COND #( WHEN ls_item-shkzg = 'S' THEN ls_item-waers ELSE space ).
    gs_prev-waers_h = COND #( WHEN ls_item-shkzg = 'H' THEN ls_item-waers ELSE space ).
    APPEND gs_prev TO gt_prev.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT gt_prev BY remark ASCENDING seq.
  PERFORM set_prev_color.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_hist_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_hist_data .

  REFRESH gt_hist.

  DATA: lt_header TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0002,
        ls_header TYPE zte3fi0002,
        lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        ls_item   TYPE zte3fi0003.

  " COLLECT 집계용 구조체
  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_sum,
          belnr TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
          dmbtr TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr,
        END OF ls_sum.
  DATA lt_sum LIKE TABLE OF ls_sum.

  DATA lv_from TYPE sy-datum.

  " 12개월 전 날짜 계산
  CALL FUNCTION 'RP_CALC_DATE_IN_INTERVAL'
    EXPORTING
      date      = sy-datum
      days      = 0
      months    = 12
      years     = 0
      signum    = '-'
    IMPORTING
      calc_date = lv_from.

  " 외화환산평가 전표 헤더 조회
  SELECT *
    INTO TABLE lt_header
    FROM zte3fi0002
   WHERE bukrs = gv_bukrs
     AND bltxt LIKE '%외화환산평가%'
     AND budat > lv_from.

  CHECK lt_header IS NOT INITIAL.
  SORT lt_header BY belnr.

  " 차변 아이템 전체 조회
  SELECT *
    INTO TABLE lt_item
    FROM zte3fi0003
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_header
   WHERE bukrs = lt_header-bukrs
     AND gjahr = lt_header-gjahr
     AND belnr = lt_header-belnr
     AND shkzg = 'S'.

  " COLLECT로 전표번호 기준 금액 합산
  LOOP AT lt_item INTO ls_item.
    CLEAR ls_sum.
    ls_sum-belnr = ls_item-belnr.
    ls_sum-dmbtr = ls_item-dmbtr.
    COLLECT ls_sum INTO lt_sum.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT lt_sum BY belnr.

  " 헤더 + 합계 매핑
  LOOP AT lt_header INTO ls_header.
    CLEAR gs_hist.
    gs_hist-budat = ls_header-budat.
    gs_hist-bltxt = ls_header-bltxt.
    gs_hist-belnr = ls_header-belnr.
    gs_hist-waers = 'KRW'.

    READ TABLE lt_sum INTO ls_sum
      WITH KEY belnr = ls_header-belnr BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      gs_hist-dmbtr = ls_sum-dmbtr.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND gs_hist TO gt_hist.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 최신순 정렬
  SORT gt_hist BY budat DESCENDING.

ENDFORM.

      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'GCL_DOCUMENT_0103'.
  ENDIF.

  IF gcl_document_top_pop IS BOUND.
    gcl_document_top_pop->initialize_document( ).
  ELSE.
    CREATE OBJECT gcl_document_top_pop
      EXPORTING
        style            = 'ALV_TO_HTML'
        background_color = 1
        no_margins       = space.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_pop_title
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_pop_title .

  DATA: lcl_table TYPE REF TO cl_dd_table_element,
        lcl_icon  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_icon2 TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c1    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c2    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_gap   TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c3    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c4    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area.

  gcl_document_top_pop->initialize_document( ).

  " 타이틀
  gcl_document_top_pop->add_text(
    text         = '외화평가 예정전표 현황'
    sap_fontsize = 'LARGE'
    sap_emphasis = 'STRONG' ).
  gcl_document_top_pop->new_line( ).
  gcl_document_top_pop->new_line( ).

  " 테이블 (11컬럼)
  gcl_document_top_pop->add_table(
    EXPORTING no_of_columns = 11 border = '0'
    IMPORTING table = lcl_table ).

  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_icon ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '10' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c1 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '15' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c2 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '30' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_icon2 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '10' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c3 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '15' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c4 ).

  " 1행: 회사코드 | AR 미결
  lcl_icon->add_icon(  'ICON_USERGROUP' ).
  lcl_c1->add_text( text = '회사코드' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c2->add_text( text = |{ gv_bukrs }| ).
  lcl_icon2->add_icon( 'ICON_PARTNER' ).
  lcl_c3->add_text( text = 'AR 미결' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c4->add_text( text = |{ gv_ar_cnt } 건| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  " 2행: 평가기준일 | AP 미결
  lcl_icon->add_icon(  'ICON_DATE' ).
  lcl_c1->add_text( text = '평가기준일' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c2->add_text( text = |{ gv_evdat(4) }년 { gv_evdat+4(2) }월 { gv_evdat+6(2) }일| ).
  lcl_icon2->add_icon( 'ICON_CUSTOMER' ).
  lcl_c3->add_text( text = 'AP 미결' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c4->add_text( text = |{ gv_ap_cnt } 건| ).

  gcl_document_top_pop->merge_document( ).
  gcl_document_top_pop->display_document(
    EXPORTING
      reuse_control = 'X'
      parent        = gcl_container_0103 ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form post_save
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM post_save .

  DATA : lv_error(1),
         lv_answer(1).

  " 테스트 모드에서는 실제 전기 불가
  IF gv_check EQ 'X'.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '테스트 화면에서는 전표 생성이 불가합니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_evdat NE sy-datum.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH | 전표는 { gv_evdat+4(2) }월 { gv_evdat+6(2) }일에 생성할 수 있습니다. | DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM check_post USING lv_error.

  IF lv_error EQ 'X'.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH |{ gv_evdat(4) }년 { gv_evdat+4(2) }월 데이터는 이미 생성되었습니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.


  DATA(lv_text) = | { gv_evdat+4(2) }월 평가/환입 전표를 생성하시겠습니까? |.
  _popup_to_confirm '평가 전표' lv_text lv_answer.

  IF lv_answer EQ '1'.
    PERFORM build_eval USING gv_check.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH |{ gv_evdat+4(2) }월 전표 생성이 취소되었습니다.|.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_subtotal_text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ES_SUBTOTTXT_INFO
*&      --> EP_SUBTOT_LINE
*&      --> E_EVENT_DATA
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_subtotal_text USING ps_info      TYPE lvc_s_stxt
                                po_line      TYPE REF TO data
                                po_event     TYPE REF TO cl_alv_event_data.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF gt_data_disp,
                 <fs_text> TYPE any.

  DATA: lv_partner TYPE zte3sd0001-kunnr,
        lv_name    TYPE char40,
        lv_text    TYPE lvc_value.

  DATA: lv_kunnr TYPE zte3sd0001-kunnr,
        lv_lifnr TYPE zte3mm0002-lifnr,
        lv_arrow TYPE string.

  IF po_line IS NOT BOUND OR po_event IS NOT BOUND.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  ASSIGN po_line->* TO <fs_line>.
  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CASE ps_info-criteria.

    WHEN 'PARTNER'.
      " gv_expand 기준으로 화살표 결정
      lv_arrow = COND #( WHEN gv_expand = 'X'
                         THEN '▶'
                         ELSE '▼' ).

      lv_kunnr = <fs_line>-partner.
      SELECT SINGLE name1 FROM zte3sd0001
        WHERE kunnr EQ @lv_kunnr
        INTO @DATA(lv_name1).

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND lv_name1 IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_text = |{ lv_arrow } 고객: { lv_kunnr } { lv_name1 }|.
      ELSE.
        lv_lifnr = <fs_line>-partner.
        SELECT SINGLE vennm FROM zte3mm0002
          WHERE lifnr EQ @lv_lifnr
          INTO @DATA(lv_vennm).
        lv_text = |{ lv_arrow } 공급업체: { lv_lifnr } { lv_vennm }|.
      ENDIF.

  ENDCASE.

  IF lv_text IS INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  ASSIGN po_event->m_data->* TO <fs_text>.
  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    <fs_text>                 = lv_text.
    po_event->m_event_handled = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form data_clear
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM data_clear .

  DATA: lv_answer(1).
  DATA(lv_text) = | 입력된 환율 정보를 취소하고 초기화하시겠습니까? |.

  IF gv_eur IS INITIAL AND gv_usd IS INITIAL AND gv_jpy IS INITIAL. "환율이 입력되지 않으면 return
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '초기화할 변경 내역이 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.

  ELSE.

    _popup_to_confirm '초기화' lv_text lv_answer.

    CHECK lv_answer EQ '1'.

    PERFORM clear_data.
    PERFORM get_data.
    PERFORM make_hierarchy.
    PERFORM get_bank_data.
    PERFORM calc_sim.
    PERFORM refresh_grid.


  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form load_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM load_data .

  PERFORM get_bank_data.
  PERFORM get_data.

  PERFORM make_hierarchy.
  PERFORM calc_summary.
  PERFORM calc_sim.
  PERFORM refresh_grid.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_sort
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_sort .

  DATA: ls_sort TYPE lvc_s_sort.

  ls_sort-fieldname = 'PARTNER'.  " KUNNR/LIFNR 통합 필드
  ls_sort-spos      = 1.
  ls_sort-up        = 'X'.
  ls_sort-subtot    = 'X'.
  ls_sort-expa     = space.
  APPEND ls_sort TO gt_sort.
  CLEAR ls_sort.

  ls_sort-fieldname = 'EVAL_KRW'.
  ls_sort-spos      = 2.
  ls_sort-down      = 'X'.
  APPEND ls_sort TO gt_sort.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_sim_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_sim_data .

  PERFORM check_sim. "팝업 체크
  CHECK gv_answer_check EQ space.

  PERFORM get_data. "변경값이 없을때도 아래 로직을 타게해야할까? 막야아할듯
  PERFORM make_hierarchy.

  PERFORM calc_summary.   "시뮬이랑 ap, ap 화면 업데이트
  "TAB2
  PERFORM get_bank_data.  "외화 보유액을 가져옴
  PERFORM calc_sim.

  PERFORM refresh_grid.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form change_sim_top
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM change_sim_top .
  "환율값 변동 방어로직 있으면 좋을듯
  PERFORM change_sim_ukurs. "변경 환율 매핑
  PERFORM calc_summary.

ENDFORM.

FUNCTION zfe3fi0006.
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------
*"*"Local Interface:
*"  IMPORTING
*"     REFERENCE(IV_BELNR) TYPE  ZTE3FI0002-BELNR
*"     REFERENCE(IV_BUKRS) TYPE  ZTE3FI0002-BUKRS DEFAULT '1000'
*"     REFERENCE(IV_GJAHR) TYPE  ZTE3FI0002-GJAHR
*"     REFERENCE(IV_START_COL) TYPE  INT4 DEFAULT 20
*"     REFERENCE(IV_START_ROW) TYPE  INT4 DEFAULT 5
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------

*       Global data declarations

  " 키값 없으면 리턴
  CHECK iv_bukrs IS NOT INITIAL
    AND iv_belnr IS NOT INITIAL
    AND iv_gjahr IS NOT INITIAL.

  " DB 존재 여부 확인
  SELECT SINGLE belnr
    INTO gv_iv_belnr
    FROM zte3fi0002
   WHERE bukrs = iv_bukrs
     AND belnr = iv_belnr
     AND gjahr = iv_gjahr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '전표가 존재하지 않습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  gv_iv_bukrs = iv_bukrs.
  gv_iv_belnr = iv_belnr.
  gv_iv_gjahr = iv_gjahr.

  FREE gcl_grid_belnr_item.
  FREE gcl_con_belnr_item.
  CALL SCREEN '0500' STARTING AT iv_start_col
                                 iv_start_row.
ENDFUNCTION.
