*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          SAPMZE3QM0001_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form upload_file
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM upload_file .
*
*  DATA: lt_excel     TYPE TABLE OF alsmex_tabline,
*        ls_excel     TYPE alsmex_tabline,
*        lv_begin_row TYPE i VALUE 1,
*        lv_row       TYPE kcd_ex_row_n VALUE 0,
*        lt_ins_table TYPE TABLE OF zte3qm0004,
*        ls_ins_table TYPE zte3qm0004,
*        lv_skip_cnt  TYPE i,
*        lv_lot_cnt   TYPE i,
*        lv_msg       TYPE string,
*        lv_answer    TYPE c.
*
*  " 헤더 한글 텍스트 체크용 구조체
*  DATA: ls_hdr       TYPE alsmex_tabline.
*  " 사용자가 체크 해제한(MARK = 빈칸) 검수 로트 번호 수집
*  DATA: lt_del_lot TYPE TABLE OF zte3qm0004-prueflos.
*
*  CLEAR: gs_data.
*  REFRESH: gt_data.
*
*  IF gv_fname IS INITIAL.
*    MESSAGE s000 WITH '파일을 선택해주세요' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  " 1. 엑셀 데이터 로드
*  CALL FUNCTION 'ALSM_EXCEL_TO_INTERNAL_TABLE'
*    EXPORTING
*      filename    = gv_fname
*      i_begin_col = 1
*      i_begin_row = lv_begin_row
*      i_end_col   = 7
*      i_end_row   = 10000
*    TABLES
*      intern      = lt_excel
*    EXCEPTIONS
*      OTHERS      = 3.
*
*  CLEAR : gv_fname.
*  IF sy-subrc NE 0 OR lt_excel IS INITIAL.
*    MESSAGE s000 WITH '데이터가 없거나 파일을 읽을 수 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  "헤더검사
*  SORT lt_excel BY row col.
*
*  READ TABLE lt_excel INTO ls_hdr WITH KEY row = 1 col = 1.
*  IF ls_hdr-value <> '검수번호'.
*    MESSAGE s000 WITH '검수결과 업로드 양식이 아닙니다. 지정된 양식을 사용하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  READ TABLE lt_excel INTO ls_hdr WITH KEY row = 1 col = 2.
*  IF ls_hdr-value <> '자재코드'.
*    MESSAGE s000 WITH '검수결과 업로드 양식이 아닙니다. 지정된 양식을 사용하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  " 2. 데이터 파싱 루프
*  LOOP AT lt_excel INTO ls_excel.
*
*    " 1행 헤더 타이틀은 스킵
*    IF ls_excel-row = 1.
*      CONTINUE.
*    ENDIF.
*    IF lv_row <> 0 AND lv_row <> ls_excel-row.
*      IF gs_data-prueflos IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*        " 마스터 테이블 존재 여부 검사
*        SELECT SINGLE matnr INTO @DATA(lv_matnr_chk)
*          FROM zte3qm0002
*         WHERE prueflos = @gs_data-prueflos.
*
*        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
*          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 존재하지 않는 검사 ({ gs_data-prueflos }) 번호입니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*          RETURN.
*        ENDIF.
*
*        IF lv_matnr_chk <> gs_data-matnr.
*          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): { gs_data-prueflos }의 자재정보가 일치하지 않습니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*          RETURN.
*        ENDIF.
*
*        " 에러가 없으면 무조건 추가
*        APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
*      ENDIF.
*      CLEAR gs_data.
*    ENDIF.
*
*    lv_row = ls_excel-row.
*    CONDENSE ls_excel-value.
*
*    CASE ls_excel-col.
*      WHEN 1. gs_data-prueflos = |{ ls_excel-value ALPHA = IN }|.
*      WHEN 2. gs_data-matnr    = |{ ls_excel-value ALPHA = IN }|.
*      WHEN 3. gs_data-insp_cd  = ls_excel-value.
*      WHEN 4. gs_data-insp_nm  = ls_excel-value.
*      WHEN 5. " 수량: 음수 체크 및 숫자 체크
*        " 1) 음수(-) 기호가 포함되어 있는지 확인
*        IF ls_excel-value CA '-'.
*          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 폐기 수량에 음수({ ls_excel-value })를 입력할 수 없습니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*          RETURN.
*
*          " 2) 정상적인 숫자/소수점인지 확인
*        ELSEIF ls_excel-value CO '0123456789. '.
*          gs_data-fail_qty = ls_excel-value.
*        ELSE.
*          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 수량에 올바른 숫자를 입력하세요.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*          RETURN.
*        ENDIF.
*      WHEN 6. gs_data-meins    = ls_excel-value.
*      WHEN 7. " 사번: 숫자 체크
*        IF ls_excel-value CO '0123456789 '.
*          gs_data-pernr = |{ ls_excel-value ALPHA = IN }|.
*
*          " 1. 해당 검수번호(로트)의 검사유형 조회
*          SELECT SINGLE insp_type
*            INTO @DATA(lv_up_insp_type)
*            FROM zte3qm0001
*           WHERE prueflos = @gs_data-prueflos.
*          " 2. 검사 유형에 따른 부서(BTRTL) 결정
*          DATA: lv_up_team TYPE zte3cm0005-btrtl.
*          IF lv_up_insp_type = '02'.
*            lv_up_team = 'QM_QA'. " ★ 반품 부서
*          ELSE.
*            lv_up_team = 'QM_QC'. " ★ 일반 검수 부서
*          ENDIF.
*
*          SELECT SINGLE pernr
*            INTO @DATA(lv_up_chk)
*            FROM zte3cm0005
*           WHERE pernr = @gs_data-pernr
*             AND btrtl = @lv_up_team.
*
*          IF sy-subrc NE 0.
*            MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 잘못된 사번({ ls_excel-value })입니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*            RETURN.
*          ENDIF.
*
*        ELSE.
*          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 사번에 올바른 숫자를 입력하세요.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*          RETURN.
*        ENDIF.
*    ENDCASE.
*
*  ENDLOOP.
*
*  " 마지막 행 처리
*  IF gs_data-prueflos IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*    SELECT SINGLE matnr INTO @DATA(lv_last_chk)
*      FROM zte3qm0002
*     WHERE prueflos = @gs_data-prueflos.
*
*    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
*      MESSAGE s000 WITH |마지막 행({ lv_row }): 존재하지 않는 검사 번호입니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*      RETURN.
*    ENDIF.
*
*    IF lv_last_chk <> gs_data-matnr.
*      MESSAGE s000 WITH |마지막 행({ lv_row }): 검사로트 정보 오류| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*      RETURN.
*    ENDIF.
*
*    APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  " 3. 키 값 기준 중복 제거 및 완료 건(stats = '3') 필터링
*  SORT gt_data BY prueflos insp_cd.
*  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM gt_data COMPARING prueflos insp_cd.
*
*  IF gt_data IS NOT INITIAL.
*    " 3-1. 엑셀에 있는 검수번호 중 이미 완료('3')된 번호만 한 번에 DB에서 조회
*    SELECT prueflos
*      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_completed)
*      FROM zte3qm0001
*       FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @gt_data
*     WHERE prueflos = @gt_data-prueflos
*       AND stats = '3'.
*
*    " 3-2. 완료된 건이 존재하면 gt_data에서 안전하게 일괄 삭제
*    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lt_completed IS NOT INITIAL.
*      " 삭제 건수 정확히 카운트하기 위해 중복 제거
*      SORT lt_completed BY prueflos.
*      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_completed COMPARING prueflos.
*      lv_skip_cnt = lines( lt_completed ).
*
*      " 별도로 수집한 완료 리스트(lt_completed)를 기준으로 메인 데이터에서 지움
*      LOOP AT lt_completed INTO DATA(ls_comp).
*        DELETE gt_data WHERE prueflos = ls_comp-prueflos.
*      ENDLOOP.
*    ENDIF.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  " 3-3. ★ 방어 로직: 엑셀 파일 안의 모든 건이 이미 완료 처리되어 남은 데이터가 없다면?
*  IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
*    MESSAGE s000 WITH |업로드한 파일의 모든 항목이 이미 검수 완료되었습니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
*    RETURN. " 빈 팝업을 띄우지 않고 종료
*  ENDIF.
*
*  REFRESH gt_upload_pop.
*
*  " 1) 엑셀 상세 아이템(gt_data)에서 고유한 검수번호(PRUEFLOS) 목록만 추출
*  DATA(lt_tmp_lot) = gt_data.
*  SORT lt_tmp_lot BY prueflos.
*  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_tmp_lot COMPARING prueflos.
*
*  " 2) DB에서 기본 정보(총수량, 자재코드 등)만 가져오기
*  IF lt_tmp_lot IS NOT INITIAL.
*    SELECT a~prueflos, a~insp_type, a~aufnr, a~budat, a~stats,
*           b~matnr,    b~charg,     b~qi_qty,  b~meins,
*           c~gltrp
*      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_upload_pop
*      FROM zte3qm0001 AS a
*     INNER JOIN zte3qm0002 AS b ON a~prueflos = b~prueflos
*      LEFT OUTER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS c ON a~aufnr = c~aufnr
*       FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_tmp_lot
*     WHERE a~prueflos = @lt_tmp_lot-prueflos
*       AND b~pruef_pos = '0001'.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  " 3) 엑셀에서 입력받은 항목(gt_data)의 폐기 수량을 합산하여 팝업에 반영
*  LOOP AT gt_upload_pop ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_pop>).
*    <fs_pop>-mark = ' '. " 기본 전체 선택 해제
*
*    " 폐기 수량 누적 변수 초기화
*    <fs_pop>-fail_qty = 0.
*
*    " 해당 검수번호(로트)의 엑셀 데이터(gt_data)를 순회하며 폐기 수량 누적
*    LOOP AT gt_data INTO DATA(ls_tmp_data) WHERE prueflos = <fs_pop>-prueflos.
*      <fs_pop>-fail_qty = <fs_pop>-fail_qty + ls_tmp_data-fail_qty.
*    ENDLOOP.
*
*    " 합격 수량 = 총수량(qi_qty) - 엑셀에 적힌 총 폐기수량(fail_qty)
*    <fs_pop>-pass_qty = <fs_pop>-qi_qty - <fs_pop>-fail_qty.
*  ENDLOOP.
*
*  " 4) 모달 팝업 호출 (팝업 내 PAI에서 승인 시 gv_okcode = 'SAVE' 할당 후 닫힘)
*  CALL SCREEN '0200' STARTING AT 20 5.
*
*  " ==========================================================
*  " 저장 처리 로직
*  " ==========================================================
*  IF gv_okcode = 'SAVE'.
*
*    " PAI에서 체크된 건수 방어를 했지만, 이중 체크
*    LOOP AT gt_upload_pop INTO gs_upload_pop WHERE mark = space.
*      APPEND gs_upload_pop-prueflos TO lt_del_lot.
*    ENDLOOP.
*
*    " 실제 저장할 엑셀 아이템 데이터(gt_data)에서 선택 안 된 로트를 삭제
*    IF lt_del_lot IS NOT INITIAL.
*      LOOP AT lt_del_lot INTO DATA(lv_del_prueflos).
*        DELETE gt_data WHERE prueflos = lv_del_prueflos.
*      ENDLOOP.
*    ENDIF.
*
*    " 전부 체크 해제하고 눌렀을 경우 방어
*    IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
*      MESSAGE s000 WITH '선택된 검수 항목이 없어 취소되었습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
*      RETURN.
*    ENDIF.
*
*    " 최종 건수 다시 계산
*    DATA(lt_popup_count) = gt_data.
*    SORT lt_popup_count BY prueflos.
*    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_popup_count COMPARING prueflos.
*    lv_lot_cnt = lines( lt_popup_count ).
*
*    " 실제 DB 반영
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data TO lt_ins_table.
*    MODIFY zte3qm0004 FROM TABLE lt_ins_table.
*
*    IF sy-subrc = 0.
*      PERFORM calc_update.
*      PERFORM get_excel_data USING lv_skip_cnt.
*      MESSAGE s000 WITH |선택한 { lv_lot_cnt }건의 검수 내역이 성공적으로 저장되었습니다.|.
*    ELSE.
*      ROLLBACK WORK.
*      MESSAGE s000 WITH '저장 중 데이터베이스 오류 발생' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ELSE.
*    " 팝업에서 취소/종료(CANC)를 누른 경우
*    MESSAGE s000 WITH '엑셀 업로드가 취소되었습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
*    RETURN.
*  ENDIF.

  DATA: lt_excel     TYPE TABLE OF alsmex_tabline,
        ls_excel     TYPE alsmex_tabline,
        lv_begin_row TYPE i VALUE 1,
        lv_row       TYPE kcd_ex_row_n VALUE 0,
        lt_ins_table TYPE TABLE OF zte3qm0004,
        ls_ins_table TYPE zte3qm0004,
        lv_skip_cnt  TYPE i,
        lv_lot_cnt   TYPE i,
        lv_msg       TYPE string,
        lv_answer    TYPE c.

  " 헤더 한글 텍스트 체크용 구조체
  DATA: ls_hdr       TYPE alsmex_tabline.
  " 사용자가 체크 해제한(MARK = 빈칸) 검수 로트 번호 수집
  DATA: lt_del_lot TYPE TABLE OF zte3qm0004-prueflos.

  " ==========================================================
  " ★ 1. 두 번째 업로드 시 꼬임 방지를 위한 강력한 초기화
  " ==========================================================
  CLEAR: gs_data, lv_skip_cnt, lv_lot_cnt, lv_answer, gv_okcode.
  REFRESH: gt_data, lt_del_lot, gt_upload_pop.

  IF gv_fname IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '파일을 선택해주세요' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 1. 엑셀 데이터 로드
  CALL FUNCTION 'ALSM_EXCEL_TO_INTERNAL_TABLE'
    EXPORTING
      filename    = gv_fname
      i_begin_col = 1
      i_begin_row = lv_begin_row
      i_end_col   = 7
      i_end_row   = 10000
    TABLES
      intern      = lt_excel
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS      = 3.

  CLEAR : gv_fname.
  IF sy-subrc NE 0 OR lt_excel IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '데이터가 없거나 파일을 읽을 수 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  "헤더검사
  SORT lt_excel BY row col.

  READ TABLE lt_excel INTO ls_hdr WITH KEY row = 1 col = 1.
  IF ls_hdr-value <> '검수번호'.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '검수결과 업로드 양식이 아닙니다. 지정된 양식을 사용하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_excel INTO ls_hdr WITH KEY row = 1 col = 2.
  IF ls_hdr-value <> '자재코드'.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '검수결과 업로드 양식이 아닙니다. 지정된 양식을 사용하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 2. 데이터 파싱 루프
  LOOP AT lt_excel INTO ls_excel.

    " 1행 헤더 타이틀은 스킵
    IF ls_excel-row = 1.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_row <> 0 AND lv_row <> ls_excel-row.
      IF gs_data-prueflos IS NOT INITIAL.

        " 마스터 테이블 존재 여부 검사
        SELECT SINGLE matnr INTO @DATA(lv_matnr_chk)
          FROM zte3qm0002
         WHERE prueflos = @gs_data-prueflos.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 존재하지 않는 검사 ({ gs_data-prueflos }) 번호입니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        IF lv_matnr_chk <> gs_data-matnr.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): { gs_data-prueflos }의 자재정보가 일치하지 않습니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " 에러가 없으면 무조건 추가
        APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR gs_data.
    ENDIF.

    lv_row = ls_excel-row.
    CONDENSE ls_excel-value.

    CASE ls_excel-col.
      WHEN 1. gs_data-prueflos = |{ ls_excel-value ALPHA = IN }|.
      WHEN 2. gs_data-matnr    = |{ ls_excel-value ALPHA = IN }|.
      WHEN 3. gs_data-insp_cd  = ls_excel-value.
      WHEN 4. gs_data-insp_nm  = ls_excel-value.
      WHEN 5. " 수량: 음수 체크 및 숫자 체크
        " 1) 음수(-) 기호가 포함되어 있는지 확인
        IF ls_excel-value CA '-'.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 폐기 수량에 음수({ ls_excel-value })를 입력할 수 없습니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          RETURN.

          " 2) 정상적인 숫자/소수점인지 확인
        ELSEIF ls_excel-value CO '0123456789. '.
          gs_data-fail_qty = ls_excel-value.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 수량에 올바른 숫자를 입력하세요.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 6. gs_data-meins    = ls_excel-value.
      WHEN 7. " 사번: 숫자 체크
        IF ls_excel-value CO '0123456789 '.
          gs_data-pernr = |{ ls_excel-value ALPHA = IN }|.

          " 1. 해당 검수번호(로트)의 검사유형 조회
          SELECT SINGLE insp_type
            INTO @DATA(lv_up_insp_type)
            FROM zte3qm0001
           WHERE prueflos = @gs_data-prueflos.
          " 2. 검사 유형에 따른 부서(BTRTL) 결정
          DATA: lv_up_team TYPE zte3cm0005-btrtl.
          IF lv_up_insp_type = '02'.
            lv_up_team = 'QM_QA'. " ★ 반품 부서
          ELSE.
            lv_up_team = 'QM_QC'. " ★ 일반 검수 부서
          ENDIF.

          SELECT SINGLE pernr
            INTO @DATA(lv_up_chk)
            FROM zte3cm0005
           WHERE pernr = @gs_data-pernr
             AND btrtl = @lv_up_team.

          IF sy-subrc NE 0.
            MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 잘못된 사번({ ls_excel-value })입니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.

        ELSE.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH |행({ lv_row }): 사번에 올바른 숫자를 입력하세요.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

  " 마지막 행 처리
  IF gs_data-prueflos IS NOT INITIAL.

    SELECT SINGLE matnr INTO @DATA(lv_last_chk)
      FROM zte3qm0002
     WHERE prueflos = @gs_data-prueflos.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH |마지막 행({ lv_row }): 존재하지 않는 검사 번호입니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_last_chk <> gs_data-matnr.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH |마지막 행({ lv_row }): 검사로트 정보 오류| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND gs_data TO gt_data.
  ENDIF.

  " 3. 키 값 기준 중복 제거 및 완료 건(stats = '3') 필터링
  SORT gt_data BY prueflos insp_cd.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM gt_data COMPARING prueflos insp_cd.

  IF gt_data IS NOT INITIAL.
    " 3-1. 엑셀에 있는 검수번호 중 이미 완료('3')된 번호만 한 번에 DB에서 조회
    SELECT prueflos
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_completed)
      FROM zte3qm0001
       FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @gt_data
     WHERE prueflos = @gt_data-prueflos
       AND stats = '3'.

    " 3-2. 완료된 건이 존재하면 gt_data에서 안전하게 일괄 삭제
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lt_completed IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT lt_completed BY prueflos.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_completed COMPARING prueflos.
      lv_skip_cnt = lines( lt_completed ).

      LOOP AT lt_completed INTO DATA(ls_comp).
        DELETE gt_data WHERE prueflos = ls_comp-prueflos.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  " 3-3. 방어 로직: 남은 데이터가 없다면 빈 팝업을 띄우지 않고 종료
  IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH |업로드한 파일의 모든 항목이 이미 검수 완료되었습니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 1) 엑셀 상세 아이템(gt_data)에서 고유한 검수번호(PRUEFLOS) 목록만 추출
  DATA(lt_tmp_lot) = gt_data.
  SORT lt_tmp_lot BY prueflos.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_tmp_lot COMPARING prueflos.

  " 2) DB에서 기본 정보(총수량, 자재코드 등)만 가져오기
  IF lt_tmp_lot IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT a~prueflos, a~insp_type, a~aufnr, a~budat, a~stats,
           b~matnr,    b~charg,     b~qi_qty,  b~meins,
           c~gltrp
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_upload_pop
      FROM zte3qm0001 AS a
     INNER JOIN zte3qm0002 AS b ON a~prueflos = b~prueflos
      LEFT OUTER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS c ON a~aufnr = c~aufnr
       FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_tmp_lot
     WHERE a~prueflos = @lt_tmp_lot-prueflos
       AND b~pruef_pos = '0001'.
  ENDIF.

  " 3) 엑셀에서 입력받은 항목(gt_data)의 폐기 수량을 합산하여 팝업에 반영
  LOOP AT gt_upload_pop ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_pop>).
    <fs_pop>-mark = 'X'. " ★ 2. 팝업 진입 시 기본으로 전체 선택

    " 폐기 수량 누적 변수 초기화
    <fs_pop>-fail_qty = 0.

    " 해당 검수번호(로트)의 엑셀 데이터(gt_data)를 순회하며 폐기 수량 누적
    LOOP AT gt_data INTO DATA(ls_tmp_data) WHERE prueflos = <fs_pop>-prueflos.
      <fs_pop>-fail_qty = <fs_pop>-fail_qty + ls_tmp_data-fail_qty.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 합격 수량 = 총수량(qi_qty) - 엑셀에 적힌 총 폐기수량(fail_qty)
    <fs_pop>-pass_qty = <fs_pop>-qi_qty - <fs_pop>-fail_qty.
  ENDLOOP.

  " ==========================================================
  " ★ 3. ALV 그리드가 이미 메모리에 떠있다면, 최신 데이터로 화면 즉시 갱신!
  " ==========================================================
  IF gcl_grid_popup IS BOUND.
    gcl_grid_popup->refresh_table_display(
      EXPORTING
        is_stable      = gs_stable
        i_soft_refresh = space ).
  ENDIF.

  " 4) 모달 팝업 호출
  CALL SCREEN '0200' STARTING AT 20 5.

  " ==========================================================
  " 저장 처리 로직
  " ==========================================================
  IF gv_okcode = 'SAVE'.

    " 체크 안 된 항목 수집
    LOOP AT gt_upload_pop INTO gs_upload_pop WHERE mark = space.
      APPEND gs_upload_pop-prueflos TO lt_del_lot.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 실제 저장할 엑셀 아이템 데이터(gt_data)에서 선택 안 된 로트를 삭제
    IF lt_del_lot IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT lt_del_lot INTO DATA(lv_del_prueflos).
        DELETE gt_data WHERE prueflos = lv_del_prueflos.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " 전부 체크 해제하고 눌렀을 경우 방어
    IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '선택된 검수 항목이 없어 취소되었습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 최종 건수 다시 계산
    DATA(lt_popup_count) = gt_data.
    SORT lt_popup_count BY prueflos.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_popup_count COMPARING prueflos.
    lv_lot_cnt = lines( lt_popup_count ).

    " 실제 DB 반영
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gt_data TO lt_ins_table.
    MODIFY zte3qm0004 FROM TABLE lt_ins_table.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      PERFORM calc_update.
      PERFORM get_excel_data USING lv_skip_cnt.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH |선택한 { lv_lot_cnt }건의 검수 내역이 성공적으로 저장되었습니다.|.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '저장 중 데이터베이스 오류 발생' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    " 팝업에서 취소/종료(CANC)를 누른 경우
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '엑셀 업로드가 취소되었습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> TEXT_T04
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING    pv_key
                         pv_field
                         pv_text
                         pv_ref_table
                         pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat = VALUE #(
                    key       = pv_key
                    fieldname = pv_field
                    coltext   = pv_text
                    ref_table = pv_ref_table
                    ref_field = pv_ref_field
                    ).

  CASE pv_field.

    WHEN 'ICON'.
      gs_fcat-icon = 'X'.
      gs_fcat-just = 'C'.
    WHEN 'QI_QTY' OR 'FAIL_QTY' OR 'PASS_QTY'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.
    WHEN 'STATS_TXT'.
      gs_fcat-just = 'C'.
    WHEN 'AUFNR'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.

    WHEN 'MATNR'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_title
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_title .

  CLEAR: gv_total, gv_wait, gv_done, gv_rate, gv_fail_amt.

  DATA: lv_pass  TYPE p DECIMALS 3,
        lv_qi    TYPE p DECIMALS 3,
        lv_perid TYPE zte3co0014-perid,
        lv_c(10).

  REFRESH gt_cnt.

  SELECT prueflos, stats, matnr, qi_qty, budat,
         pass_qty, fail_qty, charg, meins
    FROM zcds_e3_qm_0001
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_cnt.

  gv_total = lines( gt_cnt ).

  LOOP AT gt_cnt INTO gs_cnt.

    CASE gs_cnt-stats.
      WHEN '1'. " 검수대기
        gv_wait = gv_wait + 1.

      WHEN '3'. " 결과조회(완료)
        gv_done = gv_done + 1.
        lv_pass = lv_pass + gs_cnt-pass_qty.
        lv_qi   = lv_qi   + gs_cnt-qi_qty.

        " 폐기금액 계산 — 표준원가(gt_price)에서 월별 단가 매핑
        IF gs_cnt-fail_qty > 0.
          lv_perid = gs_cnt-budat+4(2). " 전기일자(budat)에서 '월' 2자리 추출

          READ TABLE gt_price INTO DATA(ls_price)
            WITH KEY matnr = gs_cnt-matnr
                     perid = lv_perid.

          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
            " 폐기수량 * 표준원가 총액
            gv_fail_amt += gs_cnt-fail_qty * ls_price-total.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

  " 합격률 및 폐기율 계산
  IF lv_qi > 0.
    gv_rate = ( lv_pass / lv_qi ) * 100.
  ENDIF.
  gv_fail_rate = 100 - gv_rate.

  " UI 화면 출력용 문자열 포맷팅 및 공백 제거 (CONDENSE)
  lv_c = gv_total.
  CONDENSE lv_c.
  WRITE lv_c TO gv_total.
  lv_c = gv_done.
  CONDENSE lv_c.
  WRITE lv_c TO gv_done.
  lv_c = gv_wait.
  CONDENSE lv_c.
  WRITE lv_c TO gv_wait.

  " 6. 대시보드 화면 갱신을 위한 커맨드 강제 유발
  cl_gui_cfw=>set_new_ok_code( new_code = 'A' ).

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form calc_update
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM calc_update .

  DATA: lv_total_fail TYPE zte3qm0004-fail_qty,
        lv_total_pass TYPE p DECIMALS 3,
        lv_qi_qty     TYPE zte3qm0002-qi_qty,
        lv_charg      TYPE zte3qm0002-charg,
        lv_upd_pernr  TYPE zte3cm0005-pernr,
        lv_subrc      TYPE sy-subrc.

  DATA: ls_price_key  LIKE LINE OF gt_price.

  SORT gt_data BY prueflos.

  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).

    AT NEW prueflos.
      CLEAR: lv_total_fail, lv_qi_qty.
    ENDAT.

    lv_total_fail = lv_total_fail + <fs_data>-fail_qty.

    AT END OF prueflos.
      " 1. 헤더 정보 조회
      SELECT SINGLE qi_qty, charg
        FROM zte3qm0002
        INTO (@lv_qi_qty, @lv_charg)
       WHERE prueflos = @<fs_data>-prueflos.


      lv_total_pass = lv_qi_qty - lv_total_fail.

      " 담당자 결정
      lv_upd_pernr = COND #( WHEN <fs_data>-pernr IS NOT INITIAL
                             THEN <fs_data>-pernr
                             ELSE gv_insp_pernr ).

      " 2. DB 업데이트
      PERFORM update_process USING <fs_data> lv_qi_qty lv_charg
                                    lv_total_pass lv_total_fail lv_upd_pernr.

      " 3. 폐기 자재 전표 생성
      IF lv_total_fail > 0.
        READ TABLE gt_price INTO ls_price_key
             WITH KEY matnr = <fs_data>-matnr.

        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
          CLEAR lv_subrc.
          PERFORM post_fi_document USING    <fs_data>
                                           lv_total_fail
                                           ls_price_key
                                  CHANGING lv_subrc.

          IF lv_subrc = 0.
            PERFORM post_mm_document USING    <fs_data>
                                              lv_charg
                                              lv_total_fail
                                              ls_price_key
                                     CHANGING lv_subrc.
          ENDIF.

          " 오류 발생 시 롤백 및 종료
          IF lv_subrc NE 0.
            ROLLBACK WORK.
            MESSAGE '전표 생성 중 오류가 발생하여 취소되었습니다.' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

    ENDAT.
  ENDLOOP.

  COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  CLEAR gv_insp_pernr.

ENDFORM.

*& Form show_html

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_HEADER_PRUEFLOS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form show_html_empty
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM show_html_empty .

  DATA: lt_content  TYPE TABLE OF w3html,
        lv_url      TYPE swk_url,
        lv_html_all TYPE string.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* 1. 템플릿 로드 및 String 합치기
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
  CALL FUNCTION 'WWW_GET_SCRIPT_AND_HTML'
    EXPORTING
      obj_name = 'ZPE3QM_HTML2'
    TABLES
      html     = lt_content.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

  " 안전한 치환을 위해 전체를 하나의 String으로 합침
  CONCATENATE LINES OF lt_content INTO lv_html_all.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* 2. 빈 테이블 행(Row) 정의
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
  DATA(lv_empty_row) =
    |<tr><td colspan="5" class="ok-row" style="color:#95a5a6;background:#fafbfc;text-align:center;">|
 && |● 좌측 LOT 목록에서 행을 선택하면 검사 결과가 표시됩니다 ●|
 && |</td></tr>|.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* 3. 모든 Placeholder를 기본값('-')으로 치환
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@LOT_NO'     IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@MAKTX'      IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@AUFNR'      IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@BUDAT'      IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@QI_QTY'     IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@PASS_QTY'   IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@FAIL_QTY'   IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@PASS_RATE'  IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@MEINS'      IN lv_html_all WITH ''.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@RATE_CLS'   IN lv_html_all WITH ''.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@INSP_NM' IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@AEDAT'      IN lv_html_all WITH '-'.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@AEZET'      IN lv_html_all WITH ''.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@ITEM_ROWS'  IN lv_html_all WITH lv_empty_row.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@ACTION_BTN' IN lv_html_all WITH ''.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* 4. 다시 테이블로 변환하여 출력
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
  CLEAR lt_content.
  CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_FTEXT'
    EXPORTING
      text      = lv_html_all
    TABLES
      ftext_tab = lt_content.

  CALL METHOD gcl_html->load_data
    EXPORTING
      type         = 'text'
      subtype      = 'html'
      charset      = 'UTF-8'
    IMPORTING
      assigned_url = lv_url
    CHANGING
      data_table   = lt_content.

  gcl_html->show_url( url = lv_url ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_qi_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PV_GETDATA
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_qi_data  USING pt_query TYPE cnht_query_table.

  DATA: ls_hdr1    TYPE zte3qm0001,
        ls_hdr2    TYPE zte3qm0002,
        ls_data    TYPE zte3qm0004,
        lt_data    TYPE TABLE OF zte3qm0004,
        lv_qty     TYPE zte3qm0004-fail_qty,
        lv_insp_nm TYPE zte3cm0005-pernam,
        lv_pernr   TYPE zte3cm0005-pernr.

  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_insp,
           key     TYPE string,
           insp_cd TYPE string,
           insp_nm TYPE string,
         END OF ty_insp.

  DATA: lt_insp TYPE TABLE OF ty_insp,
        ls_insp TYPE ty_insp.

  DATA lv_answer(1).

  lt_insp = VALUE #(
    ( key = 'Q1'  insp_cd = '1'  insp_nm = '색상' )
    ( key = 'Q2'  insp_cd = '2'  insp_nm = '이물질' )
    ( key = 'Q10' insp_cd = '10' insp_nm = 'PH' )
    ( key = 'Q11' insp_cd = '11' insp_nm = '용량' )
    ( key = 'Q12' insp_cd = '12' insp_nm = '납/수은' )
    ( key = 'Q20' insp_cd = '20' insp_nm = '방부제' )
    ( key = 'Q21' insp_cd = '21' insp_nm = '밀봉/상태' )
    ( key = 'Q31' insp_cd = '31' insp_nm = '라벨/LOT' ) ).


  LOOP AT pt_query ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_q>).
    IF <ls_q>-name EQ 'PERNR'.
      lv_pernr = <ls_q>-value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF lv_pernr IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '검사자 사번을 입력하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE prueflos, stats, insp_type
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_hdr1
    FROM zte3qm0001
   WHERE prueflos = @gv_save_prueflos.

  DATA: lv_team TYPE zte3cm0005-btrtl.

  CASE ls_hdr1-insp_type.
    WHEN '02'.         " 반품 입고 검사
      lv_team = 'QM_RT'.
    WHEN OTHERS.       " 그 외 일반 검사 (01, 03 등)
      lv_team = 'QM_QC'.
  ENDCASE.

  " 3. 사번 존재 여부 및 분기된 부서(lv_team) 일치 여부 체크
  SELECT SINGLE pernr FROM zte3cm0005
    INTO @DATA(lv_chk)
   WHERE pernr EQ @lv_pernr
     AND btrtl EQ @lv_team.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH |해당 부서({ lv_team })에 소속된 검사자가 아닙니다: { lv_pernr }| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE prueflos, stats
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_hdr1
    FROM zte3qm0001
   WHERE prueflos = @gv_save_prueflos.

  SELECT SINGLE prueflos, matnr, qi_qty, meins
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_hdr2
    FROM zte3qm0002
   WHERE prueflos = @gv_save_prueflos.

  LOOP AT pt_query ASSIGNING <ls_q>.
    READ TABLE lt_insp INTO ls_insp WITH KEY key = <ls_q>-name.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      lv_qty = <ls_q>-value.
      CLEAR ls_data.
      ls_data-prueflos = gv_save_prueflos.
      ls_data-matnr    = ls_hdr2-matnr.
      ls_data-insp_cd  = ls_insp-insp_cd.
      ls_data-insp_nm  = ls_insp-insp_nm.
      ls_data-fail_qty = lv_qty.
      ls_data-meins    = ls_hdr2-meins.
      APPEND ls_data TO lt_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 불량합계 > 총수량 체크
  DATA lv_total_fail TYPE p DECIMALS 3.
  LOOP AT lt_data INTO ls_data.
    lv_total_fail += ls_data-fail_qty.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF lv_total_fail > ls_hdr2-qi_qty.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '불량수량 합계가 총수량을 초과합니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      titlebar              = '검사 결과 저장'
      text_question         = |{ gv_save_prueflos } 검사 결과를 저장하시겠습니까?|
      text_button_1         = '예'
      icon_button_1         = '@01@'
      text_button_2         = '아니오'
      icon_button_2         = '@0W@'
      default_button        = '1'
      display_cancel_button = ' '
    IMPORTING
      answer                = lv_answer.

  IF lv_answer NE '1'. RETURN. ENDIF.

  IF lt_data IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zte3qm0004 FROM TABLE lt_data.
  ENDIF.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    gv_insp_pernr = lv_pernr.

    DELETE gt_data WHERE prueflos = gv_save_prueflos.

    SELECT prueflos matnr insp_cd insp_nm fail_qty meins
      APPENDING CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
       FROM zte3qm0004
      WHERE prueflos = gv_save_prueflos
      ORDER BY insp_cd ASCENDING.

    PERFORM calc_update.
    PERFORM show_html USING gv_save_prueflos.
    PERFORM set_title.
    MESSAGE '검사 결과가 저장되었습니다.' TYPE 'S'.

  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE '저장 실패.' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_sapevent
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ACTION
*&      --> QUERY_TABLE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_sapevent  USING  pv_action     TYPE c
                             pt_query      TYPE cnht_query_table.
  CASE pv_action.
    WHEN 'SAVE_QI'.

      PERFORM save_qi_data USING pt_query.       " 테이블 저장 받을 수 있음
      PERFORM refresh_grid.

    WHEN 'PRINT_PDF'.

      SET PARAMETER ID 'QM1' FIELD gs_header-aufnr.
      SET PARAMETER ID 'QM2' FIELD gs_header-budat+4(2).

      CALL TRANSACTION 'ZRE3CO0001' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_header_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_header_data USING pv_filter.

  REFRESH gt_header.
  " 1. 상태값 필터 조건 변환
  DATA: lr_stats     TYPE RANGE OF zte3qm0001-stats,
        lr_insp_type TYPE RANGE OF zte3qm0001-insp_type.

  IF pv_filter NE 'ALL'.
    lr_stats = VALUE #( ( low = pv_filter sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' ) ).
  ENDIF.

  " 검수유형 조건 - AL이면 전체
  IF gv_insp_type NE 'AL' AND gv_insp_type IS NOT INITIAL.
    lr_insp_type = VALUE #( ( low = gv_insp_type sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' ) ).
  ELSE.
    " 전체: 존재하는 유형 다 담기
    SELECT DISTINCT domvalue_l
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_types)
      FROM dd07t
     WHERE domname = 'ZDE3_QM_INSP_TYPE'.

    lr_insp_type = VALUE #( FOR ls_t IN lt_types
                            ( low = ls_t-domvalue_l sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' ) ).
  ENDIF.

  SELECT prueflos,  insp_type,  ebeln,   aufnr,   budat,
         stats,     pernr,     matnr,   charg,   qi_qty,
         pass_qty,  fail_qty,   meins,   gltrp,   icon,
         stats_txt
    FROM zcds_e3_qm_0001
   WHERE stats IN @lr_stats
         AND insp_type IN @lr_insp_type
     AND ( @gv_aufnr IS INITIAL OR aufnr = @gv_aufnr )
     AND ( @gv_matnr IS INITIAL OR matnr = @gv_matnr )
     AND ( @gv_charg IS INITIAL OR charg = @gv_charg )
     AND ( ( @gv_min_date IS INITIAL AND @gv_max_date IS INITIAL )
      OR gltrp BETWEEN @gv_min_date AND @gv_max_date )
   ORDER BY stats ASCENDING, budat DESCENDING, gltrp DESCENDING, prueflos ASCENDING
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_header.

  " 3. 조회 결과 메시지 처리
  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '선택한 조건에 해당되는 데이터가 없습니다.'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_fname
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_fname .

  CALL FUNCTION 'WS_FILENAME_GET'
    EXPORTING
      def_path         = 'C:/'
      mask             = ',*.xls;*.xlsx,*.xls;*.xlsx,'
      mode             = 'O'
    IMPORTING
      filename         = gv_fname
    EXCEPTIONS
      inv_winsys       = 1
      no_batch         = 2
      selection_cancel = 3
      selection_error  = 4
      OTHERS           = 5.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH TEXT-m03. "파일선택이 취소 되었습니다.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form search_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM search_data .

  DATA: lv_text TYPE string.

  CASE 'X'.
    WHEN gv_rb1. " 총건수
      PERFORM get_header_data USING 'ALL'.
      lv_text = '전체 데이터'.

    WHEN gv_rb2. " 검수완료
      PERFORM get_header_data USING '3'.
      lv_text = '검수 완료'.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '3' ) TO gr_stats.


    WHEN gv_rb3. " 대기중
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '1' ) TO gr_stats.
      PERFORM get_header_data USING '1'.
      lv_text = '검수 대기'.
  ENDCASE.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_excel_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_excel_data  USING pv_del_cnt TYPE i.

  DATA: lv_msg_text TYPE string.

  " 중복 제거로 성능 최적화
  SORT gt_data BY prueflos.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM gt_data COMPARING prueflos.

  REFRESH gt_header.

  IF gt_data IS NOT INITIAL.

    SELECT a~prueflos, a~insp_type, a~aufnr, a~budat, a~stats,
           b~matnr,    b~charg,     b~qi_qty,  b~pass_qty, b~fail_qty, b~meins,
           c~gltrp
      FROM zte3qm0001 AS a
      INNER JOIN zte3qm0002 AS b ON a~prueflos = b~prueflos
      LEFT OUTER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS c ON a~aufnr = c~aufnr
     WHERE a~prueflos IN ( SELECT prueflos FROM @gt_data AS t )
       AND b~pruef_pos = '0001'
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_header.
  ENDIF.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR gt_header IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '조회된 데이터가 없습니다.'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM set_icon.

  " 메시지 처리
  IF pv_del_cnt > 0.
    lv_msg_text = |저장 완료. (이미 완료된 { pv_del_cnt }건은 제외됨)|.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_msg_text.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '데이터 집계 및 저장이 완료되었습니다.'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_icon
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_icon .

  LOOP AT gt_header ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_header>).

    CASE <fs_header>-stats.
      WHEN '1'.
        <fs_header>-icon      = '@5D@'.
        <fs_header>-stats_txt = '검수대기'.
      WHEN '3'.
        <fs_header>-icon      = '@5B@'.
        <fs_header>-stats_txt = '결과조회'.

    ENDCASE.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_top_content
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_top_content .

  DATA: lcl_table TYPE REF TO cl_dd_table_element,
        lcl_col1  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col2  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col3  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_gap   TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col5  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col6  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col7  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lv_c      TYPE sdydo_text_element,
        lv_a      TYPE sdydo_text_element.

  " 타이틀
  gcl_document_top->add_text(
    text         = '완제품 검수 현황'
    sap_fontsize = 'LARGE'
    sap_emphasis = 'STRONG' ).
  gcl_document_top->new_line( ).
  gcl_document_top->new_line( ).

  " 테이블 생성 (7컬럼)
  gcl_document_top->add_table(
    EXPORTING no_of_columns = 7 border = '0'
    IMPORTING table         = lcl_table ).

  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_col1 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_col2 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width  = '10'
                        IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_col3 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width  = '100'
                          IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_col5 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_col6 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_col7 ).

  " [1행] 총건수 / 합격률
  lv_c = gv_total. CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col1->add_icon( 'ICON_FOLDER' ).
  lcl_col2->add_text( text = |총건수| sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col3->add_text( text = |{ lv_c }건| ).

  lv_c = gv_rate.  CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col5->add_icon( 'ICON_CHECKED' ).
  lcl_col6->add_text( text = '합격률' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col7->add_text( text = |{ lv_c } %| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  " [2행] 검수완료 / 폐기율
  lv_c = gv_done.  CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col1->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_GREEN' ).
  lcl_col2->add_text( text = '검수완료' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col3->add_text( text = |{ lv_c } 건| ).

  lv_c = gv_fail_rate. CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col5->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_RED' ).
  lcl_col6->add_text( text = '폐기율' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col7->add_text( text = |{ lv_c } %| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  " [3행] 대기중 / 폐기금액
  lv_c = gv_wait. CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col1->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_YELLOW' ).
  lcl_col2->add_text( text = '대기중' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col3->add_text( text = |{ lv_c }건| ).

  WRITE gv_fail_amt TO lv_a CURRENCY 'KRW'. CONDENSE lv_a.
  lcl_col5->add_icon( 'ICON_PAYMENT' ).
  lcl_col6->add_text( text = '폐기금액' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col7->add_text( text = |{ lv_a } 원| ).

  " 렌더링
  gcl_document_top->merge_document( ).
  gcl_document_top->display_document(
    EXPORTING
      reuse_control = 'X'
      parent        = gcl_top_container ).

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form load_html_template
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      <-- LT_CONTENT
*&      <-- LV_HTML_ALL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM load_html_template  CHANGING ct_content TYPE table
                                  cv_html_all TYPE string.
  DATA: lv_obj_name TYPE wwwdataid-objid VALUE 'ZPE3QM_HTML2'.

  CALL FUNCTION 'WWW_GET_SCRIPT_AND_HTML'
    EXPORTING
      obj_name         = lv_obj_name
    TABLES
      html             = ct_content
    EXCEPTIONS
      object_not_found = 1
      OTHERS           = 2.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form build_html_rows
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DETAIL
*&      <-- LV_ROWS_ALL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM build_html_rows    USING  it_detail TYPE table
                     CHANGING  cv_rows_all TYPE string.

  DATA: ls_detail       TYPE zte3qm0004,
        lv_fail_qty(20) TYPE c,
        lv_tag          TYPE string,
        lv_row          TYPE string.

  " --- HTML 행 정렬을 위한 임시 테이블 선언 ---
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_html_sort,
           insp_cd_num TYPE i,            " 숫자로 정렬하기 위한 Integer 필드
           detail      TYPE zte3qm0004,
         END OF ty_html_sort.

  DATA: lt_html_sort TYPE TABLE OF ty_html_sort,
        ls_html_sort TYPE ty_html_sort.

  " 1. 들어온 데이터를 임시 테이블에 넣으면서 검사코드를 숫자로 자동 변환
  LOOP AT it_detail INTO ls_detail.
    CLEAR ls_html_sort.
    ls_html_sort-insp_cd_num = ls_detail-insp_cd. " 알파벳/공백 제외한 숫자가 캐스팅됨
    ls_html_sort-detail      = ls_detail.
    APPEND ls_html_sort TO lt_html_sort.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 2. 텍스트 기준이 아닌 숫자 기준으로 오름차순 정렬 (1, 2, 10, 11...)
  SORT lt_html_sort BY insp_cd_num ASCENDING.

  " 3. 정렬된 임시 테이블을 가지고 HTML <tr> 태그 생성
  LOOP AT lt_html_sort INTO ls_html_sort.
    ls_detail = ls_html_sort-detail.

    WRITE ls_detail-fail_qty TO lv_fail_qty DECIMALS 0.

    IF ls_detail-fail_qty > 0.
      lv_tag = |<span style="color:#FF0000;font-weight:600">폐기</span>|.
    ELSE.
      lv_tag = |<span style="color:#0a7f2e;font-weight:600">합격</span>|.
    ENDIF.

    lv_row = |<tr><td>{ ls_detail-insp_cd }</td>|
          && |<td>{ ls_detail-insp_nm }</td>|
          && |<td class="num">{ lv_fail_qty }</td>|
          && |<td>{ ls_detail-meins }</td>|
          && |<td>{ lv_tag }</td></tr>|.

    cv_rows_all = cv_rows_all && lv_row.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF it_detail IS INITIAL.
    cv_rows_all = |<tr><td colspan="5" class="ok-row">● 전량 합격 - 불량 없음</td></tr>|.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_html_display_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PV_PRUEFLOS
*&      <-- LS_HDR
*&      <-- LS_HDR1
*&      <-- LT_DETAIL
*&      <-- LV_MAKTX
*&      <-- LV_INSP_NM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_html_display_data USING    pv_prueflos TYPE zte3qm0004-prueflos
                           CHANGING cs_hdr      TYPE zte3qm0002
                                    cs_hdr1     TYPE zte3qm0001
                                    ct_detail   TYPE table
                                    cv_maktx    TYPE zte3mm0001-maktx
                                    cv_insp_nm  TYPE zte3cm0005-pernam.

  SELECT SINGLE prueflos aufnr budat stats pernr aedat aezet
    FROM zte3qm0001
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF cs_hdr1
   WHERE prueflos = pv_prueflos.

  " 2. Item(0002) 조회: 자재코드(MATNR) 및 수량 정보
  SELECT SINGLE prueflos matnr charg qi_qty pass_qty fail_qty meins
    FROM zte3qm0002
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF cs_hdr
   WHERE prueflos = pv_prueflos.

  " 3. 자재명 조회 (cs_hdr-matnr 사용)
  CLEAR cv_maktx.
  IF cs_hdr-matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE maktx FROM zte3mm0001 INTO cv_maktx
     WHERE matnr = cs_hdr-matnr.
  ENDIF.

  " 4. 검사자 성명 조회 (QM_QC 조건 추가)
  CLEAR cv_insp_nm.
  IF cs_hdr1-pernr IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE pernam FROM zte3cm0005 INTO cv_insp_nm
     WHERE pernr = cs_hdr1-pernr
       AND btrtl = 'QM_QC'.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT prueflos matnr insp_cd insp_nm fail_qty meins
    FROM zte3qm0004
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ct_detail
   WHERE prueflos = pv_prueflos.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form replace_and_display_html
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PV_PRUEFLOS
*&      --> LS_HDR
*&      --> LS_HDR1
*&      --> LV_MAKTX
*&      --> LV_INSP_NM
*&      --> LV_ROWS_ALL
*&      <-- LV_HTML_ALL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM replace_and_display_html USING    pv_prueflos TYPE zte3qm0004-prueflos
                                       is_hdr      TYPE zte3qm0002
                                       is_hdr1     TYPE zte3qm0001
                                       iv_maktx    TYPE zte3mm0001-maktx
                                       iv_insp_nm  TYPE zte3cm0005-pernam
                                       iv_rows_all TYPE string
                              CHANGING cv_html_all TYPE string.

  DATA: lv_rate     TYPE p DECIMALS 1,
        lv_rate_cls TYPE string,
        lv_btn_html TYPE string,
        lv_url      TYPE swk_url,
        lt_content  TYPE TABLE OF w3html,
        lv_tmp      TYPE char50.

  " 합격률 계산
  IF is_hdr-qi_qty > 0.
    lv_rate = ( is_hdr-pass_qty / is_hdr-qi_qty ) * 100.
  ENDIF.

  " 클래스 결정
  IF lv_rate >= 95.
    lv_rate_cls = 'rate-ok'.
  ELSE.
    lv_rate_cls = 'rate-ng'.
  ENDIF.

  " 버튼 로직
  IF is_hdr1-stats = '3'.
    CONCATENATE '<div class="btn-area">'
                '<a class="btn-pdf" href="sapevent:PRINT_PDF">제조원가 확인</a>'
                '</div>' INTO lv_btn_html.
  ENDIF.

  " 값 치환
  REPLACE FIRST OCCURRENCE OF '@ITEM_ROWS' IN cv_html_all WITH iv_rows_all.

  lv_tmp = pv_prueflos.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@LOT_NO' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.

  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@MAKTX' IN cv_html_all WITH iv_maktx.

  lv_tmp = is_hdr1-aufnr.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@AUFNR' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.

  " 일자 치환 (사용자 포맷)
  IF is_hdr1-budat IS NOT INITIAL.
    WRITE is_hdr1-budat TO lv_tmp.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@BUDAT' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.
  ELSE.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@BUDAT' IN cv_html_all WITH ' '.
  ENDIF.

  " 수량 및 합격률
  WRITE is_hdr-qi_qty TO lv_tmp DECIMALS 0.
  CONDENSE lv_tmp.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@QI_QTY' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.

  WRITE is_hdr-pass_qty TO lv_tmp DECIMALS 0.
  CONDENSE lv_tmp.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@PASS_QTY' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.

  WRITE is_hdr-fail_qty TO lv_tmp DECIMALS 0.
  CONDENSE lv_tmp.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@FAIL_QTY' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.

  WRITE lv_rate TO lv_tmp DECIMALS 1.
  CONDENSE lv_tmp.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@PASS_RATE' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.

  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@MEINS'    IN cv_html_all WITH is_hdr-meins.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@RATE_CLS' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_rate_cls.

  " 검사자 정보
  CONCATENATE iv_insp_nm '(' is_hdr1-pernr ')' INTO lv_tmp SEPARATED BY space.
  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@INSP_NM' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.

  " 확정 일자/시간
  IF is_hdr1-aedat IS NOT INITIAL.
    WRITE is_hdr1-aedat TO lv_tmp.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@AEDAT' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.
  ELSE.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@AEDAT' IN cv_html_all WITH ' '.
  ENDIF.

  IF is_hdr1-aezet IS NOT INITIAL.
    WRITE is_hdr1-aezet TO lv_tmp.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@AEZET' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_tmp.
  ELSE.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@AEZET' IN cv_html_all WITH ' '.
  ENDIF.

  REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '@ACTION_BTN' IN cv_html_all WITH lv_btn_html.

  " HTML 출력
  CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_FTEXT'
    EXPORTING
      text      = cv_html_all
    TABLES
      ftext_tab = lt_content.

  CALL METHOD gcl_html->load_data
    EXPORTING
      url          = 'ZPE3QM_HTML2'
      type         = 'text'
      subtype      = 'html'
      charset      = 'UTF-8'
    IMPORTING
      assigned_url = lv_url
    CHANGING
      data_table   = lt_content.

  CALL METHOD gcl_html->show_url( lv_url ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form post_mm_document
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_DATA>
*&      --> LV_CHARG
*&      --> LV_TOTAL_FAIL
*&      --> LS_PRICE_KEY
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM post_mm_document  USING    ps_data      STRUCTURE gs_data
                                iv_charg     TYPE zte3qm0002-charg
                                iv_fail_qty  TYPE p
                                is_price     LIKE LINE OF gt_price
                       CHANGING pv_subrc TYPE sy-subrc.

  DATA: lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF zse3mm0001,
        ls_item   TYPE zse3mm0001,
        lv_mblnr  TYPE zte3mm0006-mblnr,

        lv_amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  lv_amount = iv_fail_qty * is_price-total.

  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-matnr = ps_data-matnr.
  ls_item-charg = iv_charg.
  ls_item-menge = iv_fail_qty.
  ls_item-netpr = lv_amount.
  ls_item-meins = ps_data-meins.
  ls_item-waers = is_price-waers.
  APPEND ls_item TO lt_item.

  zcl_e3_mm_document=>post_mm_document(
    EXPORTING
      iv_bwart =  '552'             " [MM] 이동유형
      iv_xblnr = ps_data-prueflos                 " [MM] 참조문서번호
      it_item  = lt_item                " [MM] 자재문서 Table type
      iv_belnr = gv_belnr                " [FI] 전표 번호
      iv_gjahr = sy-datum(4)                " [FI] 회계연도
    IMPORTING
      ev_mblnr = lv_mblnr                " [MM] 자재문서번호
  ).

  IF lv_mblnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    pv_subrc = 0.
  ELSE.
    pv_subrc = 4.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form post_fi_document
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_DATA>
*&      --> LV_TOTAL_FAIL
*&      --> LS_PRICE_KEY
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM post_fi_document USING    ps_data      STRUCTURE gs_data
                               iv_fail_qty  TYPE zte3qm0004-fail_qty
                               is_price     LIKE LINE OF gt_price
                      CHANGING pv_subrc     TYPE sy-subrc.

  DATA: ls_fi_head TYPE zte3fi0002,
        lt_fi_item TYPE ztte3fi0003,
        ls_fi_item TYPE zte3fi0003,
        lv_belnr   TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
        lv_fi_msg  TYPE char50,
        lv_amount  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_kostl   TYPE zte3fi0003-kostl.

  lv_amount = iv_fail_qty * is_price-total.

  SELECT SINGLE insp_type
    INTO @DATA(lv_insp_type)
    FROM zte3qm0001
   WHERE prueflos = @ps_data-prueflos.

  CASE lv_insp_type.
    WHEN '02'.         " 반품 입고 검사
      lv_kostl = 'CC_QM_QA'.
    WHEN OTHERS.
      lv_kostl = 'CC_QM_QC'.
  ENDCASE.

  CLEAR ls_fi_head.
  ls_fi_head-blart = 'SA'.
  ls_fi_head-budat = sy-datum.
  ls_fi_head-bldat = sy-datum.
  ls_fi_head-waers = is_price-waers.
  ls_fi_head-bltxt = |QM폐기 { ps_data-prueflos }|.
  ls_fi_head-pernr = ps_data-pernr.
  ls_fi_head-xblnr = ps_data-prueflos.

  ls_fi_item-shkzg = 'S'.
  ls_fi_item-saknr = '5300000004'.
  ls_fi_item-dmbtr = lv_amount.
  ls_fi_item-kostl = lv_kostl.
  APPEND ls_fi_item TO lt_fi_item.
  CLEAR ls_fi_item.

  ls_fi_item-shkzg = 'H'.
  ls_fi_item-saknr = '1100000013'.
  ls_fi_item-dmbtr = lv_amount.
  APPEND ls_fi_item TO lt_fi_item.

  " FI 전표 생성 클래스 호출
  zcl_e3_fi_document=>post_document(
    EXPORTING
      is_header = ls_fi_head
      it_items  = lt_fi_item
    IMPORTING
      ev_msg    = lv_fi_msg
       ev_belnr = lv_belnr
  ).

  gv_belnr = lv_belnr.


  IF lv_belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    pv_subrc = 0.
  ELSE.
    pv_subrc = 4.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form update_process
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_DATA>
*&      --> LV_QI_QTY
*&      --> LV_CHARG
*&      --> LV_TOTAL_PASS
*&      --> LV_TOTAL_FAIL
*&      --> LV_UPD_PERNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM update_process USING ps_data     STRUCTURE gs_data
                          iv_qi_qty   TYPE zte3qm0002-qi_qty
                          iv_charg    TYPE zte3qm0002-charg
                          iv_pass_qty TYPE p
                          iv_fail_qty TYPE p
                          iv_pernr    TYPE zte3cm0005-pernr.

  DATA: ls_qm0002    TYPE zte3qm0002,
        lv_chk_pernr TYPE zte3cm0005-pernr,
        lv_ts        TYPE timestamp.

  SELECT SINGLE pernr
    FROM zte3cm0005
    INTO lv_chk_pernr
   WHERE pernr = iv_pernr.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    CLEAR lv_chk_pernr.
  ELSE.
    lv_chk_pernr = iv_pernr.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR ls_qm0002.
  ls_qm0002-prueflos  = ps_data-prueflos.
  ls_qm0002-pruef_pos = '0001'.
  ls_qm0002-matnr     = ps_data-matnr.
  ls_qm0002-charg     = iv_charg.
  ls_qm0002-qi_qty    = iv_qi_qty.
  ls_qm0002-fail_qty  = iv_fail_qty.
  ls_qm0002-pass_qty  = iv_pass_qty.
  ls_qm0002-meins     = ps_data-meins.
  ls_qm0002-aedat     = sy-datum.
  ls_qm0002-aezet     = sy-uzeit.
  ls_qm0002-aenam     = sy-uname.

  MODIFY zte3qm0002 FROM ls_qm0002.

  GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_ts.

  UPDATE zte3qm0001
     SET stats    = '3'            " 상태
         budat    = sy-datum       " 검사일자 (오늘 날짜)
         aedat    = sy-datum
         aezet    = sy-uzeit
         aenam    = sy-uname
         pernr    = lv_chk_pernr   " 검사자 사번 기록
   WHERE prueflos = ps_data-prueflos.

  UPDATE zte3mm0003
     SET clabs = clabs + iv_pass_qty "가용수량 = 가용수량 + 합격
         labst = labst - iv_fail_qty
         insme = insme - iv_qi_qty   "QI 수량 /
         aedat = sy-datum
         aezet = sy-uzeit
         aenam = sy-uname
   WHERE matnr = ps_data-matnr
     AND charg = iv_charg.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_data.

  CLEAR gv_error.

  IF gv_aufnr    IS INITIAL AND
     gv_matnr    IS INITIAL AND
     gv_charg    IS INITIAL AND
     gv_min_date IS INITIAL AND
     gv_max_date IS INITIAL.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH '검색 조건을 하나 이상 입력해주세요' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_aufnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE aufnr
      FROM zte3qm0001
      INTO @DATA(lv_aufnr)
     WHERE aufnr = @gv_aufnr.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '존재하지 않는 생산번호입니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      gv_error = 'X'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE matnr FROM zte3mm0001 INTO @DATA(lv_matnr)
     WHERE matnr = @gv_matnr.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '존재하지 않는 자재코드입니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      gv_error = 'X'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_charg IS NOT INITIAL.

    SELECT SINGLE charg
      FROM zte3qm0002
      INTO @DATA(lv_charg)
     WHERE charg = @gv_charg.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '존재하지 않는 배치번호입니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      gv_error = 'X'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_min_date IS NOT INITIAL AND gv_max_date IS NOT INITIAL.
    IF gv_min_date > gv_max_date.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '시작일이 종료일보다 클 수 없습니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      gv_error = 'X'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_min_date IS INITIAL AND gv_max_date IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '날짜는 필수 입력입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    gv_error = 'X'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_max_date - gv_min_date > 31.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '조회 기간은 최대 1개월(31일)까지만 가능합니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    gv_error = 'X'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_date
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_date .

  CLEAR : gv_aufnr, gv_matnr, gv_charg, gv_min_date, gv_max_date.

  "오늘 날짜로 한달 전에만 조회
  gv_min_date = sy-datum - 30.
  gv_max_date = sy-datum.

  gv_insp_type = 'AL'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form excel_tem
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM excel_tem .

  DATA : lv_filename    TYPE string,
         lv_path        TYPE string,
         lv_fullpath    TYPE string,
         lv_user_action TYPE i,
         ls_key         TYPE wwwdatatab.

  SELECT SINGLE *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_key
    FROM wwwdata
   WHERE objid = 'ZPE3QM_EXCEL'.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '엑셀 템플릿 Object를 찾을 수 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog
    EXPORTING
      default_extension = 'XLSX'
      default_file_name = '검수결과_업로드_템플릿.xlsx'
      file_filter       = 'Excel 파일 (*.xlsx)|*.xlsx|'
    CHANGING
      filename          = lv_filename
      path              = lv_path
      fullpath          = lv_fullpath
      user_action       = lv_user_action
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS            = 1.

  IF lv_user_action = cl_gui_frontend_services=>action_cancel.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DOWNLOAD_WEB_OBJECT'
    EXPORTING
      key         = ls_key
      destination = CONV rlgrap-filename( lv_fullpath ).

  MESSAGE s000 WITH '검수결과 업로드 템플릿이 다운로드되었습니다.'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_html
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_html .

  DATA: lt_events TYPE cntl_simple_events,
        ls_event  TYPE cntl_simple_event.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_con_html
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CON_HTML'.

  " 3. HTML Viewer 생성
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_html
    EXPORTING
      parent = gcl_con_html.

  ls_event-eventid    = gcl_html->m_id_sapevent.
  ls_event-appl_event = space.
  APPEND ls_event TO lt_events.

  gcl_html->set_registered_events( events = lt_events ).

  SET HANDLER lcl_event_handler=>handle_sapevent FOR gcl_html.

  PERFORM show_html_empty.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot  USING    ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                              ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  READ TABLE gt_header INTO gs_header INDEX ps_row-index.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.


  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'MATNR'.
      call function 'ZFE3FI0007'
        EXPORTING
          iv_matnr = gs_header-matnr.                 " [MM] 자재코드

    WHEN 'AUFNR'.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0008'
        EXPORTING
          iv_aufnr = gs_header-aufnr.                 " [PP] 생산 오더 번호
  ENDCASE.
  IF gs_header-stats EQ '3'.

    CASE ps_col-fieldname.
      WHEN 'CHARG'. " 제품 배치 클릭 시
        call function 'ZFE3CO0001'
          EXPORTING
            iv_charg = gs_header-charg.

    ENDCASE.

  ELSE.

*    MESSAGE s000 WITH '완제품에 대해서만 조회 가능합니다.'.
    RETURN.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_aufnr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_aufnr .

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_val,
          aufnr TYPE zte3qm0001-aufnr,
          matnr TYPE zte3qm0002-matnr,
          maktx TYPE zte3mm0001-maktx,
          gltrp TYPE zte3pp0005-gltrp,
        END OF ls_val,
        lt_val LIKE TABLE OF ls_val.

  IF gv_min_date IS INITIAL OR gv_max_date IS INITIAL.

    SELECT a~aufnr b~matnr c~maktx p~gltrp
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_val
      FROM zte3qm0001 AS a
      INNER JOIN zte3qm0002 AS b ON b~prueflos = a~prueflos
      INNER JOIN zte3mm0001 AS c ON c~matnr    = b~matnr
      LEFT OUTER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS p ON p~aufnr = a~aufnr.


  ELSE.
    " 날짜 범위 조건
    SELECT a~aufnr b~matnr c~maktx p~gltrp
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_val
      FROM zte3qm0001 AS a
      INNER JOIN zte3qm0002 AS b ON b~prueflos = a~prueflos
      INNER JOIN zte3mm0001 AS c ON c~matnr    = b~matnr
      INNER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS p ON p~aufnr    = a~aufnr
     WHERE p~gltrp BETWEEN gv_min_date AND gv_max_date.

  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_val BY aufnr.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_val COMPARING aufnr.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield     = 'AUFNR'
      dynpprog     = sy-repid
      dynpnr       = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield  = 'GV_AUFNR'
      window_title = '생산번호'
      value_org    = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab    = lt_val.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_matnr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_matnr .

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_val,
          matnr TYPE zte3mm0001-matnr,
          maktx TYPE zte3mm0001-maktx,
        END OF ls_val,
        lt_val LIKE TABLE OF ls_val.

  IF gv_min_date IS INITIAL OR gv_max_date IS INITIAL.
    SELECT m~matnr m~maktx
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_val
      FROM zte3mm0001 AS m
      INNER JOIN zte3qm0002 AS b ON b~matnr    = m~matnr
      INNER JOIN zte3qm0001 AS q ON q~prueflos = b~prueflos
      LEFT OUTER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS p ON p~aufnr = q~aufnr
     WHERE m~mtart = 'FERT'.
  ELSE.
    SELECT m~matnr m~maktx
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_val
      FROM zte3mm0001 AS m
      INNER JOIN zte3qm0002 AS b ON b~matnr    = m~matnr
      INNER JOIN zte3qm0001 AS q ON q~prueflos = b~prueflos
      INNER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS p ON p~aufnr    = q~aufnr
     WHERE m~mtart   = 'FERT'
       AND p~gltrp BETWEEN gv_min_date AND gv_max_date.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_val BY matnr.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_val COMPARING matnr.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield     = 'MATNR'
      dynpprog     = sy-repid
      dynpnr       = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield  = 'GV_MATNR'
      window_title = '자재코드'
      value_org    = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab    = lt_val.

ENDFORM.

*& Form f4_charg

*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*& <--  p2        text

FORM f4_charg .

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_val,
          charg TYPE zte3qm0002-charg,
          matnr TYPE zte3qm0002-matnr,
          maktx TYPE zte3mm0001-maktx,
        END OF ls_val,
        lt_val LIKE TABLE OF ls_val.

  IF gv_min_date IS INITIAL OR gv_max_date IS INITIAL.

    IF gv_matnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT b~charg b~matnr a~maktx
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_val
        FROM zte3qm0002 AS b
        INNER JOIN zte3mm0001  AS a ON a~matnr  = b~matnr
        INNER JOIN zte3qm0001  AS q ON q~prueflos = b~prueflos
        LEFT OUTER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS p ON p~aufnr = q~aufnr
       WHERE b~matnr = gv_matnr.
    ELSE.

      SELECT b~charg b~matnr a~maktx
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_val
        FROM zte3qm0002 AS b
        INNER JOIN zte3mm0001  AS a ON a~matnr  = b~matnr
        INNER JOIN zte3qm0001  AS q ON q~prueflos = b~prueflos
        LEFT OUTER JOIN zte3pp0005 AS p ON p~aufnr = q~aufnr.

    ENDIF.

  ELSE.

    IF gv_matnr IS NOT INITIAL.

      SELECT b~charg b~matnr a~maktx
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_val
        FROM zte3qm0002 AS b
        INNER JOIN zte3mm0001  AS a ON a~matnr    = b~matnr
        INNER JOIN zte3qm0001  AS q ON q~prueflos = b~prueflos
        INNER JOIN zte3pp0005  AS p ON p~aufnr    = q~aufnr
       WHERE b~matnr  =  gv_matnr
         AND p~gltrp BETWEEN gv_min_date AND gv_max_date.

    ELSE.

      SELECT b~charg b~matnr a~maktx
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_val
        FROM zte3qm0002 AS b
        INNER JOIN zte3mm0001  AS a ON a~matnr    = b~matnr
        INNER JOIN zte3qm0001  AS q ON q~prueflos = b~prueflos
        INNER JOIN zte3pp0005  AS p ON p~aufnr    = q~aufnr
       WHERE p~gltrp BETWEEN gv_min_date AND gv_max_date.

    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_val BY charg.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_val COMPARING charg.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield     = 'CHARG'
      dynpprog     = sy-repid
      dynpnr       = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield  = 'GV_CHARG'
      window_title = '배치번호'
      value_org    = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab    = lt_val.

ENDFORM.

FORM create_alv_0200 .

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_con_pop_top
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CON_POP_TOP'.

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_con_pop_bot
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_CON_POP_BOT'.


  PERFORM create_top_document_pop.

  gcl_doc_popup_top->display_document(
  EXPORTING parent = gcl_con_pop_top ).

  " 3. 하단 컨테이너: 헤더 ALV 그리드 생성
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_grid_popup
    EXPORTING
      i_parent = gcl_con_pop_bot.


  " 5. 메인 화면의 헤더용 필드카탈로그(gt_fcat)를 재사용하여 출력
  gcl_grid_popup->set_table_for_first_display(
    EXPORTING
      is_layout       = gs_layout_pop
    CHANGING
      it_outtab       = gt_upload_pop
      it_fieldcatalog = gt_fcat_pop ).

  gcl_grid_popup->refresh_table_display( ).

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_layout_0200 .

  gs_layout_pop = VALUE #(
                      zebra      = 'X'
                      sel_mode   = 'D'
                      cwidth_opt = 'A'
                      box_fname = 'MARK'
                      no_toolbar = 'X'
*                      ctab_fname = 'COLOR'
*                      grid_title = TEXT-t02
*                      stylefname   = 'STYLE'
  ).

  gs_stable-row = 'X'.
  gs_stable-col = 'X'.

* 왼쪽
  PERFORM make_fcat_pop USING :
      'X'  'MARK'       '선택'      ' '              'X' ,
      'X'  'PRUEFLOS'   ' '           'ZTE3QM0001'   ' ' ,
      ' '  'MATNR'      ' '           'ZTE3QM0002'   ' ' ,
      ' '  'CHARG'      ' '           'ZTE3QM0002'   ' ' ,
      ' '  'AUFNR'      ' '           'ZTE3QM0001'   ' ' ,
      ' '  'GLTRP'      '생산 일자'   'ZTE3PP0005'   ' ' ,
      ' '  'QI_QTY'     '총수량'      'ZTE3QM0002'   ' ' ,
      ' '  'PASS_QTY'   '합격 수량'   'ZTE3QM0002'   ' ' ,
      ' '  'FAIL_QTY'   '폐기 수량'   'ZTE3QM0002'   ' ' ,
      ' '  'MEINS'      '수량'        'ZTE3QM0002'   ' ' .

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_pop
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_pop USING    pv_key
                         pv_field
                         pv_text
                         pv_ref_table
                         pv_edit.

  gs_fcat = VALUE #(
                    key       = pv_key
                    fieldname = pv_field
                    coltext   = pv_text
                    ref_table = pv_ref_table
                    edit  = pv_edit
                    ).

  CASE pv_field.

    WHEN 'MARK'.
      gs_fcat-checkbox = 'X'.
*      gs_fcat-icon = 'X'.
*      gs_fcat-just = 'C'.
    WHEN 'QI_QTY' OR 'FAIL_QTY' OR 'PASS_QTY'.
      gs_fcat-qfieldname = 'MEINS'.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_pop.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_top_document_pop
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_top_document_pop .

  " 2. 상단 컨테이너: 요약 정보 (HTML Document)
  CREATE OBJECT gcl_doc_popup_top
    EXPORTING
      style = 'ALV_TO_HTML'.

  gcl_doc_popup_top->add_text( text         = 'Master Pack 엑셀 업로드 항목'
                             sap_fontsize = 'LARGE'
                             sap_emphasis = 'STRONG' ).
  gcl_doc_popup_top->new_line( ).
  gcl_doc_popup_top->add_text( text = | 업로드 대상 검수 항목: { lines( gt_upload_pop ) } 건| ).
  gcl_doc_popup_top->new_line( ).
  gcl_doc_popup_top->add_text( text = ' 완료 처리할 검수 항목만 선택 후 [확인] 버튼을 누르세요.' ).

ENDFORM.

    WHEN 'REFRESH'.

*      PERFORM search_data.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0200  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
MODULE user_command_0200 INPUT.

*  CASE gv_okcode.
*    WHEN 'SAVE'.
*      IF gcl_grid_popup IS BOUND.
*        gcl_grid_popup->check_changed_data( ).
*      ENDIF.
*    WHEN OTHERS.
*  ENDCASE.

  DATA: lv_answer  TYPE c,
        lv_chk_cnt TYPE i.

  " ALV 그리드의 변경사항을 인터널 테이블에 반영
  IF gcl_grid_popup IS BOUND.
    gcl_grid_popup->check_changed_data( ).
  ENDIF.

  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'SAVE'.
      " 1) 체크된 항목이 있는지 검사
      CLEAR lv_chk_cnt.
      LOOP AT gt_upload_pop TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE mark = 'X'.
        lv_chk_cnt = lv_chk_cnt + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_chk_cnt = 0.
        MESSAGE s000 WITH '선택된 검수 항목이 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        CLEAR sy-ucomm.
        EXIT. " 화면을 닫지 않고 빠져나감
      ENDIF.

      " 2) 0200 화면이 떠 있는 상태에서 확인 팝업 호출
      CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
        EXPORTING
          titlebar              = '검사 결과 저장'
          text_question         = |선택하신 { lv_chk_cnt }건의 검사 결과를 저장하시겠습니까?|
          text_button_1         = '예'
          icon_button_1         = '@01@'
          text_button_2         = '아니오'
          icon_button_2         = '@0W@'
          default_button        = '1'
          display_cancel_button = ' '
        IMPORTING
          answer                = lv_answer.

      " 3) 팝업 응답 처리
      IF lv_answer EQ '1'.
        " '예'를 누르면 확인 코드를 세팅하고 0200 팝업 종료
        gv_okcode = 'SAVE'.
        LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
      ELSE.
        " '아니오'를 누르면 아무 동작 없이 0200 화면 유지
        MESSAGE s000 WITH '저장이 취소되었습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
        CLEAR sy-ucomm.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN 'CANC' OR 'EXIT' OR 'BACK'.
      " 0200 팝업창 닫기 버튼 클릭 시
      gv_okcode = 'CANC'.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include ZE3QM0001_TOP                        - Module Pool      ZE3QM0001
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zre3qm0001 MESSAGE-ID zmce3.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------"
* 1. 시스템 선언 및 TYPE-POOLS
*----------------------------------------------------------------------"
TABLES : sscrfields.
TYPE-POOLS: truxs, slis, soi, icon, vrm.
INCLUDE officeintegrationinclude.

DATA : gv_error(2).
DATA : gv_belnr     TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
       gv_insp_type TYPE zte3qm0001-insp_type.

DATA: gr_stats TYPE RANGE OF zte3qm0001-stats,
      gs_stats LIKE LINE OF gr_stats.

DATA: gcl_con_pop_top   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container, " 상단 헤더 컨테이너 (CC_POP_TOP)
      gcl_con_pop_bot   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container, " 하단 ALV 컨테이너 (CC_POP_BOT)
      gcl_grid_popup    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
      gcl_doc_popup_top TYPE REF TO cl_dd_document,
      gs_layout_pop     TYPE lvc_s_layo,
      gt_fcat_pop       TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

** 조회조건 레인지 변수
DATA : gv_aufnr    TYPE zte3qm0001-aufnr, "생산오더번호
       gv_matnr    TYPE zte3mm0001-matnr, "자재번호
* gv_maktx    TYPE zte3mm0001-maktx,
       gv_charg    TYPE zte3qm0002-charg, "배치번호
       gv_min_date TYPE zte3pp0005-gltrp,
       gv_max_date TYPE zte3pp0005-gltrp.
"----------------------------------------------------------------------"
" 2. 비즈니스 데이터 구조 (Internal Tables & Structures)
"----------------------------------------------------------------------"
" 2-1. 표준원가 및 분석용
DATA : BEGIN OF gs_price.
         include structure zte3co0014. " 표준원가 테이블 구조 포함
DATA : END OF gs_price,
gt_price LIKE TABLE OF gs_price.

" 2-2. 차트 분석용 (불량 항목별 집계)
DATA: BEGIN OF gs_analysis,
        insp_nm    TYPE zte3qm0004-insp_nm,
        total_fail TYPE i,
        prev_fail  TYPE p DECIMALS 3,
      END OF gs_analysis.
DATA gt_analysis LIKE TABLE OF gs_analysis.

" 2-3. 메인 ALV 헤더 데이터 (품질검사 마스터/상세 결합)
DATA: BEGIN OF gs_header.
        include structure zcds_e3_qm_0001.

DATA: gt_excel TYPE TABLE OF alsmex_tabline,

      icon_button_2         = '@0W@'
      default_button        = '1'
      display_cancel_button = ' '
    IMPORTING
      answer                = &3.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
