title: ZRE3FI0001_F01
body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZRE3FI0001_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_api
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_api .

  gv_date = sy-datum.

  DO 5 TIMES.
    CLEAR: gv_json_data, gt_json.

    gv_url = |https://oapi.koreaexim.go.kr/site/program/financial/exchangeJSON?| &&
             |authkey={ gc_key }&searchdate={ gv_date }&data=AP01|.

    CALL METHOD cl_http_client=>create_by_url
      EXPORTING
        url    = gv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = go_http_client.

    go_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_get ).
    go_http_client->send( ).
    go_http_client->receive( ).
    gv_json_data = go_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    go_http_client->close( ).


    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING json = gv_json_data
      CHANGING  data = gt_json ).

    " 결과 확인 (성공 코드: 1)
    READ TABLE gt_json INTO gs_json INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND gs_json-result = 1.
      EXIT.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 0 AND gs_json-result = 3.
      MESSAGE 'API 인증 오류: 키를 확인하세요.' TYPE 'E'.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.

    gv_date = gv_date - 1. " 하루 전으로 재시도
  ENDDO.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data.
  REFRESH gt_save.

*  IF gv_json_data IS INITIAL OR gv_json_data = '[]'.
*    MESSAGE '수신된 환율 데이터가 없습니다. (최근 5일 영업일 확인 필요)' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
*    STOP.
*  ENDIF.

  " 인버전 데이트 계산 (SAP 환율 테이블 표준 방식)
  gv_gdatu_inv = 99999999 - sy-datum.

  LOOP AT gt_json INTO gs_json.
    " 1. 통화 필터링 (본인 요청: USD, EUR, JPY)
    CHECK gs_json-cur_unit = 'USD' OR
          gs_json-cur_unit = 'EUR' OR
          gs_json-cur_unit CS 'JPY'.

    " 2. 콤마 제거 및 공백 정리
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',' IN gs_json-deal_bas_r WITH ''.
    CONDENSE gs_json-deal_bas_r NO-GAPS.

    " 3. 데이터 매핑 시작
    CLEAR gs_save.
    gs_save-mandt = sy-mandt.
    gs_save-kurst = 'M'.
    gs_save-tcurr = 'KRW'.
    gs_save-gdatu = gv_gdatu_inv.

    " 4. 통화 단위 및 Factor 처리 (가장 중요)
    IF gs_json-cur_unit CS '(100)'.
      gs_save-fcurr = gs_json-cur_unit+0(3). " JPY 등
      gs_save-ffact = 100.
    ELSE.
      gs_save-fcurr = gs_json-cur_unit.
      gs_save-ffact = 1.
    ENDIF.
    gs_save-tfact = 1.

    " 5. 환율값 대입 (trunc 제거하여 소수점 정확도 유지)
    IF gs_json-deal_bas_r CO '0123456789. '.
      gs_save-ukurs = trunc( gs_json-deal_bas_r ).
    ELSE.
      CONTINUE. " 숫자가 아니면 해당 건은 Skip (덤프 방지)
    ENDIF.

    " 타임스탬프
    gs_save-erdat = sy-datum.
    gs_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
    gs_save-ernam = sy-uname.

    APPEND gs_save TO gt_save.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 6. DB 반영
  IF gt_save IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zte3fi0008 FROM TABLE gt_save. " 본인 테이블명 유지

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      MESSAGE |환율 { lines( gt_save ) }건 저장 완료 (기준일: { gv_date })| TYPE 'S'.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      MESSAGE 'DB 저장 중 오류가 발생했습니다.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include ZRE3FI0001_TOP                           - Report ZRE3FI0001
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zre3fi0001.

*DATA: BEGIN OF gs_json,
*        result     TYPE i,
*        cur_unit   TYPE string,
*        cur_nm     TYPE string,
*        deal_bas_r TYPE string,
*      END OF gs_json,
*      gt_json LIKE TABLE OF gs_json.
*
*DATA: gt_save TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0008,
*      gs_save TYPE zte3fi0008.
*
*DATA: lo_http TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
*      gv_url  TYPE string,
*      gv_json TYPE string,
*      gv_date TYPE zte3fi0008-gdatu.
*
*DATA: lv_rate  TYPE p DECIMALS 5.
*
*CONSTANTS: gc_key TYPE string VALUE 'BWgD9miFvpBC81MwODUO1q6SkTvDhbk7'.

" 1. API 수신용 구조체 및 인터널 테이블
DATA: BEGIN OF gs_json,
        result     TYPE i,          " 결과 코드 (1: 성공, 3: 인증오류 등)
        cur_unit   TYPE string,     " 통화코드 (예: USD, JPY(100))
        cur_nm     TYPE string,     " 국가/통화명
        deal_bas_r TYPE string,     " 매매기준율 (문자열로 수신)
      END OF gs_json,
      gt_json LIKE TABLE OF gs_json.

" 2. DB 저장용 구조체 및 인터널 테이블
DATA: gt_save TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0008, " 본인 테이블명
      gs_save TYPE zte3fi0008.

" 3. HTTP 통신 및 JSON 처리용 변수
DATA: go_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client, " 변수명 통일
      gv_url         TYPE string,
      gv_json_data   TYPE string.

" 4. 날짜 및 계산용 변수
DATA: gv_date      TYPE d,              " API 조회용 실제 날짜
      gv_gdatu_inv TYPE zte3fi0008-gdatu. " SAP 표준 인버전 날짜 (99999999-일자)

" 5. 상수 선언
CONSTANTS: gc_key   TYPE string VALUE 'BWgD9miFvpBC81MwODUO1q6SkTvDhbk7',
           gc_kurst TYPE kurst  VALUE 'M',   " 환율 유형 (평균환율 등)
           gc_tcurr TYPE tcurr  VALUE 'KRW'. " 대상 통화 (원화 고정)

FORM set_init_value .

  pa_bukrs = '1000'.
  pa_gjahr = sy-datum(4).

  pa_buk2  = '1000'.
  pa_gja2  = sy-datum(4).

  pa_buk3  = '1000'.
  pa_gja3  = sy-datum(4).

  pa_blart = 'SA'. "일반전표를 기본값으로.

  PERFORM set_date.   "날짜
  PERFORM start_icon. "전표 생성
  PERFORM set_butxt.
  PERFORM set_tab_ui.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_header_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_header_data .

  REFRESH gt_header.

  CASE gv_tab.

    WHEN 'COMM1'.  " 전체 전표
      gv_mode = 'ALL'.

    WHEN 'COMM2'.  " 고객 전표
      gv_mode = COND #( WHEN rb_all = 'X' THEN 'AR_A'
                        WHEN rb_opn = 'X' THEN 'AR_O'
                        WHEN rb_clr = 'X' THEN 'AR_C' ).

    WHEN 'COMM3'.  " 공급업체
      gv_mode = COND #( WHEN rb_all2 = 'X' THEN 'AP_A'
                        WHEN rb_opn2 = 'X' THEN 'AP_O'
                        WHEN rb_clr2 = 'X' THEN 'AP_C' ).

    WHEN 'COMM4'.  " GL 전표
      gv_mode = 'GL'.

    WHEN OTHERS.   "탭이 기본일때
      gv_mode = 'ALL'.
      gv_tab = 'COMM1'.

  ENDCASE.

  gv_top_flag = gv_tab. "상단 정보 표시용 플래그 저장
  "데이터 조회 및 후행 작업
  PERFORM get_data  USING gv_mode.
  PERFORM set_icon.
  PERFORM set_sort.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_icon
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_icon .

  LOOP AT gt_header ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_header>).
    " 역분개
    IF <fs_header>-stblg IS NOT INITIAL OR <fs_header>-blart EQ 'AB'.
      <fs_header>-icon = icon_led_red.      " 역분개/취소됨
      <fs_header>-icon_text = '역분개'.
      CONTINUE. " 역분개된 전표는 아래 로직을 타지 않고 다음 loop로 이동
    ENDIF.
    " SA 전표 (일반 전표) 처리
    IF <fs_header>-blart EQ 'SA'.
      <fs_header>-icon = icon_led_inactive.
      <fs_header>-icon_text = '일반'.

      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.
    " 그 외 전표 상태 설정
    IF <fs_header>-bstat EQ 'C'.
      <fs_header>-icon = icon_led_green.    " 반제(완료)
      <fs_header>-icon_text = '반제'.
    ELSEIF <fs_header>-open_flag EQ 'X'.
      <fs_header>-icon = icon_led_yellow.   " 미결
      <fs_header>-icon_text = '미결'.
    ELSE.
      <fs_header>-icon = icon_led_green.    " 일반
      <fs_header>-icon_text = '정상'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

*&      --> PCL_DOCUMENT

*&      <-- LCL_COL2
*&      <-- LCL_COL3
*&      <-- LCL_GAP
*&      <-- LCL_COL5
*&      <-- LCL_COL6
*&      <-- LCL_COL7
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM build_doc_table
  USING    pcl_document TYPE REF TO cl_dd_document
  CHANGING pcl_table    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_table_element
           pcl_col1     TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area
           pcl_col2     TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area
           pcl_col3     TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area
           pcl_gap      TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area
           pcl_col5     TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area
           pcl_col6     TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area
           pcl_col7     TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area.

  pcl_document->add_table(
    EXPORTING no_of_columns = 9 border = '0'
    IMPORTING table = pcl_table ).

  pcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = pcl_col1 ).

  pcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = pcl_col2 ).
  pcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '30' IMPORTING column = pcl_gap ).
  pcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = pcl_col3 ).
  pcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '150' IMPORTING column = pcl_gap ).
  pcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = pcl_col5 ).
  pcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = pcl_col6 ).
  pcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '30' IMPORTING column = pcl_gap ).
  pcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = pcl_col7 ).

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat_item
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat_item  USING  pv_key pv_field pv_text
                            pv_ref_table pv_ref_field.

  CLEAR gs_fcat.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'STATUS'.
      gs_fcat-icon = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DMBTR_S'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS_S'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
*      gs_fcat-no_zero    = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DMBTR_H'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS_H'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
*      gs_fcat-no_zero    = 'X'.
    WHEN 'SHKZG_TXT'.
*      gs_fcat-style = 'STYLE'.
    WHEN 'WRBTR'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'FWAER'.
    WHEN 'AUGBL'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat2.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot  USING   ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                             ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

  READ TABLE gt_header INTO gs_header INDEX ps_row-index.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.

    WHEN 'XBLNR'.
      PERFORM xblnr_popup USING gs_header-xblnr gs_header-gjahr.

    WHEN 'BELNR'.
      PERFORM get_data_item USING gs_header-belnr.

    WHEN 'KUNNR'.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0004'
        EXPORTING
          iv_kunnr = gs_header-kunnr.

    WHEN 'LIFNR'.

      IF gs_header-lifnr IS INITIAL.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0005'
        EXPORTING
          iv_lifnr = gs_header-lifnr.          " [MM] 공급업체코드

    WHEN 'STBLG'.
      call function 'ZFE3FI0006'
        EXPORTING
          iv_belnr = gs_header-stblg           " [FI] 전표 번호
          iv_bukrs = '1000'                    " [FI] 회사코드
          iv_gjahr = gs_header-gjahr.          " [FI] 회계연도

    WHEN 'AUGBL'.
      READ TABLE gt_item_data INTO gs_item_data INDEX ps_row-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
      call function 'ZFE3FI0006'
        EXPORTING
          iv_belnr = gs_item_data-augbl        " [FI] 전표 번호
          iv_bukrs = '1000'                    " [FI] 회사코드
          iv_gjahr = gs_header-gjahr.          " [FI] 회계연도

  ENDCASE.

  PERFORM refresh_grid_bot.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data_item
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_HEADER_BELNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data_item  USING  pv_belnr TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr.

  CLEAR : gv_dmbtr_h, gv_dmbtr_s.
  REFRESH gt_item_data.

  SELECT belnr buzei saknr kostl shkzg sgtxt
         wrbtr fwaer dmbtr waers augbl augdt
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_item_data
    FROM zte3fi0003
   WHERE belnr EQ pv_belnr
     AND gjahr EQ gs_header-gjahr
   ORDER BY belnr buzei shkzg.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '아이템 데이터가 없습니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 역분개 전표 아이템 추가 (stblg가 있을 경우)
  IF gs_header-stblg IS NOT INITIAL AND
     gs_header-blart NE 'AB'.
    " APPENDING TABLE을 사용하면 기존 테이블 뒤에 바로 붙음
    SELECT belnr buzei saknr kostl shkzg sgtxt
           wrbtr fwaer dmbtr waers augbl augdt
      APPENDING CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_item_data
      FROM zte3fi0003
     WHERE belnr EQ gs_header-stblg
       AND gjahr EQ gs_header-stjah "추가
     ORDER BY belnr buzei.

  ENDIF.

  PERFORM sum_dmbtr_sh. "차/대 분리
  PERFORM set_sort.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_MODE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data  USING   pv_mode TYPE c.

  DATA : lr_blart TYPE RANGE OF zte3fi0002-blart.

  IF pa_blart IS NOT INITIAL.
    lr_blart = VALUE #( BASE lr_blart

                       ( low    = pa_blart
                         sign   = 'I'
                         option = 'EQ' )

                        ).
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR gt_header.

  CASE pv_mode.

    WHEN 'ALL'.  " 전체
      SELECT bukrs gjahr belnr blart budat bldat waers
             kunnr lifnr pernr stblg stjah stgrd
             xblnr bltxt bstat open_flag rev_date kursf
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_header
        FROM zte3fi0002
       WHERE bukrs EQ pa_bukrs
         AND gjahr EQ pa_gjahr
         AND budat IN so_budat
         AND bstat NE 'T'
         AND belnr NOT LIKE '9%'
         AND belnr IN so_belnr
         AND blart IN lr_blart.        " 전체 = 공백이면 조건 없음

    WHEN 'AR_A'.  " 고객 전체
      SELECT bukrs gjahr belnr blart budat bldat waers
             kunnr lifnr pernr stblg stjah stgrd
             xblnr bltxt bstat open_flag rev_date kursf
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_header
        FROM zte3fi0002
       WHERE bukrs EQ pa_buk2
         AND gjahr EQ pa_gja2
         AND kunnr IN so_kun
         AND kunnr NE space
         AND bstat NE 'T'
         AND lifnr EQ space
         AND budat IN so_bud2
         AND belnr NOT LIKE '9%'
         AND blart IN ('DR', 'DZ')
         AND blart NE 'AB'.            " 역분개 제외

    WHEN 'AR_O'.  " 고객 미결 — 승인(A)됐는데 반제(C) 아닌 것
      SELECT bukrs gjahr belnr blart budat bldat waers
             kunnr lifnr pernr stblg stjah stgrd
             xblnr bltxt bstat open_flag rev_date kursf
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_header
        FROM zte3fi0002
       WHERE bukrs EQ pa_buk2
         AND gjahr EQ pa_gja2
         AND kunnr IN so_kun
         AND budat IN so_bud2
         AND open_flag EQ 'X'
         AND lifnr EQ space
         AND bstat EQ ' '
         AND belnr NOT LIKE '9%'
         AND stblg EQ space
         AND blart NE 'AB'.

    WHEN 'AR_C'.  " 고객 반제
      SELECT bukrs gjahr belnr blart budat bldat waers
             kunnr lifnr pernr stblg stjah stgrd
             xblnr bltxt bstat open_flag rev_date kursf
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_header
        FROM zte3fi0002
       WHERE bukrs EQ pa_buk2
         AND gjahr EQ pa_gja2
         AND kunnr IN so_kun
         AND lifnr EQ space
         AND budat IN so_bud2
         AND belnr NOT LIKE '9%'
         AND stblg EQ space
         AND bstat EQ 'C'.             " 반제

    WHEN 'AP_A'.  " 공급업체 전체
      SELECT bukrs gjahr belnr blart budat bldat waers
             kunnr lifnr pernr stblg stjah stgrd
             xblnr bltxt bstat open_flag rev_date kursf
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_header
        FROM zte3fi0002
       WHERE bukrs EQ pa_buk3
         AND gjahr EQ pa_gja3
         AND lifnr IN so_lif
         AND lifnr NE space
         AND bstat NE 'T'
         AND belnr NOT LIKE '9%'
         AND kunnr EQ space
         AND budat IN so_bud3
        AND blart IN ('KR', 'RE', 'KZ', 'PR' )
         AND blart NE 'AB'.

    WHEN 'AP_O'.  " 공급업체 미결
      SELECT bukrs gjahr belnr blart budat bldat waers
             kunnr lifnr pernr stblg stjah stgrd
             xblnr bltxt bstat open_flag rev_date kursf
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_header
        FROM zte3fi0002
       WHERE bukrs EQ pa_buk3
         AND gjahr EQ pa_gja3
         AND lifnr IN so_lif
         AND lifnr NE space
         AND budat IN so_bud3
         AND bstat EQ ' '  "빈값
         AND bstat NE 'T'
         AND belnr NOT LIKE '9%'
         AND stblg EQ space
         AND open_flag EQ 'X'
         AND blart NE 'AB'.

    WHEN 'AP_C'.  " 공급업체 반제
      SELECT bukrs gjahr belnr blart budat bldat waers
             kunnr lifnr pernr stblg stjah stgrd
             xblnr bltxt bstat open_flag rev_date kursf
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_header
        FROM zte3fi0002
       WHERE bukrs EQ pa_buk3
         AND gjahr EQ pa_gja3
         AND lifnr IN so_lif
         AND lifnr NE space
         AND belnr NOT LIKE '9%'
         AND stblg EQ space
         AND budat IN so_bud3
         AND bstat EQ 'C'.            " 반제

  ENDCASE.

  IF gt_header IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '조회된 데이터가 없습니다.'.
    LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
  ENDIF.


  IF gv_rev_confirm IS INITIAL.  " CHECK 반대조건으로
    PERFORM set_msg USING pv_mode.
  ENDIF.


  SORT gt_header BY stblg ASCENDING
                    bstat ASCENDING
                    budat DESCENDING
                    belnr DESCENDING
                   .

  PERFORM set_rev_item.
  PERFORM set_domain_text.
  PERFORM set_master_data.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form go_rev
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM go_rev .

  DATA: lv_belnr     TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
        lv_answer(1),
        lt_row       TYPE lvc_t_row,
        ls_row       TYPE lvc_s_row.

  gcl_grid->get_selected_rows( IMPORTING et_index_rows = lt_row ).

  IF lt_row IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '행을 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF lines( lt_row ) GT 1.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '행을 1건만 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_row INTO ls_row INDEX 1.
  READ TABLE gt_header INTO gs_header INDEX ls_row-index.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  " 이미 역분개된 전표 체크
  IF gs_header-stblg IS NOT INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '이미 역분개된 전표입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  gv_sel_belnr = gs_header-belnr.
  gv_sel_gjahr = gs_header-gjahr.
  gv_sel_bukrs = gs_header-bukrs.

  PERFORM popup_reverse.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form popup_reverse
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM popup_reverse .

  CALL SCREEN '0101' STARTING AT 20 3.

  IF gv_rev_confirm = 'X'.
    PERFORM save_rev.
  ELSE.
    " 0101 화면에서 취소를 누른 경우
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '역분개 정보 입력이 취소되었습니다.'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_rev
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_rev .

  DATA: lv_belnr  TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
        lt_rev_db TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        ls_rev_db TYPE zte3fi0003.
  " 채번
  CALL FUNCTION 'NUMBER_GET_NEXT'
    EXPORTING
      nr_range_nr = '02'
      object      = 'ZNRE3FI01'
    IMPORTING
      number      = lv_belnr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '전표 채번 실패.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT buzei, bukrs, belnr, gjahr, saknr,
         koart, bschl, shkzg, kostl, wrbtr,
         fwaer, dmbtr, waers, ukurs, sgtxt,
         kunnr, lifnr, invno, pdnum, ebeln,
         matnr, augbl, augdt
    FROM zte3fi0003
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_item
   WHERE bukrs = @gv_sel_bukrs
     AND gjahr = @gv_sel_gjahr
     AND belnr = @gv_sel_belnr.

  IF gt_item IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '원본 아이템 없음.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 전표유형별 역분개 아이템 생성
  CASE gs_header-blart.
    WHEN 'DZ' OR 'KZ'.
      PERFORM set_clear.

  ENDCASE.

  PERFORM reverse_items USING lv_belnr.

  " 역분개 헤더 준비
  CLEAR gs_rev.
  gs_rev = CORRESPONDING #( gs_header ).
  gs_rev-belnr    = lv_belnr.
  gs_rev-bstat    = space.
  gs_rev-blart    = 'AB'.
  gs_rev-kursf    = gs_header-kursf.
  gs_rev-budat    = sy-datum.
  gs_rev-bldat    = sy-datum.
  gs_rev-stblg    = gv_sel_belnr.        " 원본 전표번호
  gs_rev-stjah    = gv_sel_gjahr.        " 원본 회계연도
  gs_rev-stgrd    = gv_stgrd.            " 역분개 사유코드
  gs_rev-rev_date = sy-datum.           " 역분개 처리일
  gs_rev-pernr    = gs_emp-pernr.        " 요청자 사번

  " 헤더 INSERT
  INSERT zte3fi0002 FROM @gs_rev.
  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '역분개 헤더 저장 실패.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  " gt_rev_item → zte3fi0003 타입 변환 후 INSERT
  LOOP AT gt_rev_item INTO DATA(ls_rev).
    CLEAR ls_rev_db.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_rev TO ls_rev_db.
    APPEND ls_rev_db TO lt_rev_db.

  ENDLOOP.

  INSERT zte3fi0003 FROM TABLE @lt_rev_db.
  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '역분개 아이템 저장 실패.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 원본 전표 STBLG + STGRD 업데이트
  UPDATE zte3fi0002
     SET stblg    = lv_belnr
         stjah    = gv_sel_gjahr
         stgrd    = gv_stgrd
         rev_date = sy-datum
         pernr    = gs_emp-pernr
  WHERE bukrs EQ gv_sel_bukrs
    AND gjahr EQ gv_sel_gjahr
    AND belnr EQ gv_sel_belnr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '원본 전표 업데이트 실패.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ROLLBACK WORK. RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

  " 8. UI 데이터 갱신
  PERFORM refresh_save USING lv_belnr.

  MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_belnr '번 역분개 전표가 생성되었습니다.'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_clear
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_BELNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_clear. "반제 정보 변경

  " 현재 전표 아이템 정보 초기화 및 원전표 정보 업데이트
  LOOP AT gt_item ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).

    IF <fs_item>-augbl IS NOT INITIAL.
      " 원전표(상대방)의 아이템/헤더 상태를 바로 미결로 되돌림
      UPDATE zte3fi0003 SET augbl = ' '
             augdt = '00000000'
       WHERE bukrs = gv_sel_bukrs
         AND gjahr = gv_sel_gjahr
         AND belnr = <fs_item>-augbl.

      UPDATE zte3fi0002 SET bstat = ' '
       WHERE bukrs = gv_sel_bukrs
         AND gjahr = gv_sel_gjahr
         AND belnr = <fs_item>-augbl.
    ENDIF.

    " 현재 아이템 데이터 초기화 (메모리 상의 gt_item 변경)
    CLEAR: <fs_item>-augbl, <fs_item>-augdt.

  ENDLOOP.

  " 메모리에서 수정된 현재 전표 아이템들을 DB에 일괄 반영
  UPDATE zte3fi0003 FROM TABLE gt_item.

  " 현재 역분개되는 전표 자체의 헤더 상태 복원
  UPDATE zte3fi0002 SET bstat = ' '
   WHERE bukrs = gv_sel_bukrs
     AND gjahr = gv_sel_gjahr
     AND belnr = gv_sel_belnr.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form refresh_save
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_BELNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM refresh_save  USING  pv_belnr TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr.

  READ TABLE gt_header ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_head>)
    WITH KEY belnr = gv_sel_belnr.

  IF <fs_head> IS ASSIGNED.

    <fs_head>-stblg     = pv_belnr.       " 역분개 전표번호
    <fs_head>-stjah     = gv_sel_gjahr.   " 역분개 연도
    <fs_head>-stgrd     = gv_stgrd.       " 사유 코드
    <fs_head>-stgrd_txt = gv_stgrd_txt.   " 사유 텍스트
    <fs_head>-rev_date  = sy-datum.       " 처리일자
    <fs_head>-icon      = icon_led_red.   " 아이콘 변경 (역분개 완료 표시)
    <fs_head>-pdf_down  = icon_pdf.
    <fs_head>-pernr     = gs_emp-pernr.

    gs_header = <fs_head>.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM get_data_item USING gv_sel_belnr.            " 아이템 내역 다시 읽기
  PERFORM calc_doc_count.                              " 합계/건수 재계산
  PERFORM set_document USING gcl_document_top gv_mode. " 상단 패널 갱신
  PERFORM refresh_grid.                                " ALV 새로고침

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form reverse_items
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_BELNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM reverse_items  USING   pv_belnr TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr.

  CLEAR gt_rev_item.

  "역분개 로직
  LOOP AT gt_item INTO DATA(ls_orig).

    APPEND VALUE #( BASE CORRESPONDING #( ls_orig )
      belnr   = pv_belnr
      blart   = 'AB'
      shkzg   = ls_orig-shkzg
      dmbtr   = ls_orig-dmbtr * -1
      wrbtr   = ls_orig-wrbtr * -1
      dmbtr_s = COND #( WHEN ls_orig-shkzg = 'S'
                         THEN abs( ls_orig-dmbtr ) ELSE 0 )
      dmbtr_h = COND #( WHEN ls_orig-shkzg = 'H'
                         THEN abs( ls_orig-dmbtr ) ELSE 0 )
    ) TO gt_rev_item.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_sort
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_sort .

  DATA: ls_sort TYPE lvc_s_sort.

  CLEAR gt_sort.

  ls_sort-fieldname = 'SHKZG_TXT'.
  ls_sort-spos      = 1.
  ls_sort-up        = ' '.  " 내림차순
  ls_sort-down      = 'X'.
  ls_sort-subtot    = 'X'.
  APPEND ls_sort TO gt_sort.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form create_alv_rev
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_alv_rev .

  " 컨테이너 최초 1회 생성

  CREATE OBJECT gcl_container_pop
    EXPORTING
      container_name = 'GCL_DOCUMENT_POP'.

  " document는 PBO마다 초기화
  IF gcl_document_top_pop IS BOUND.
    gcl_document_top_pop->initialize_document( ).
  ELSE.
    CREATE OBJECT gcl_document_top_pop
      EXPORTING
        style            = 'ALV_TO_HTML'
        background_color = 1
        no_margins       = space.
  ENDIF.


  " 역분개 일자 자동 세팅
  IF gv_rev_date IS INITIAL.
    gv_rev_date = sy-datum.
  ENDIF.

  " 역분개 코드 입력 시 텍스트 자동 조회
  CLEAR gv_stgrd_txt.
  CHECK gv_stgrd IS NOT INITIAL.

  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO gv_stgrd_txt
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_STGRD'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gv_stgrd
     AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_pop_title
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_pop_title .

  DATA: lv_dmbtr_s TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_dmbtr_h TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_a_s     TYPE sdydo_text_element,
        lv_a_h     TYPE sdydo_text_element.

  DATA: lcl_table TYPE REF TO cl_dd_table_element,
        lcl_ic1   TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_ic2   TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c1    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c2    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_gap   TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c3    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c4    TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area.

  " 1. 데이터 조회
  SELECT SUM( CASE shkzg WHEN 'S' THEN dmbtr ELSE 0 END ),
         SUM( CASE shkzg WHEN 'H' THEN dmbtr ELSE 0 END )
    INTO (@lv_dmbtr_s, @lv_dmbtr_h)
    FROM zte3fi0003
   WHERE belnr EQ @gs_header-belnr
     AND bukrs EQ @gs_header-bukrs
     AND gjahr EQ @gs_header-gjahr.

  WRITE lv_dmbtr_s TO lv_a_s CURRENCY gs_header-waers. CONDENSE lv_a_s.
  WRITE lv_dmbtr_h TO lv_a_h CURRENCY gs_header-waers. CONDENSE lv_a_h.

  gcl_document_top_pop->initialize_document( ).

  " 2. 제목
  gcl_document_top_pop->add_text(
    text         = |역분개 대상 전표: { gs_header-belnr }|
    sap_fontsize = cl_dd_document=>large
    sap_emphasis = cl_dd_document=>strong ).
  gcl_document_top_pop->new_line( ).
  gcl_document_top_pop->new_line( ).

  " 3. 테이블 생성 (11열)
  gcl_document_top_pop->add_table(
    EXPORTING no_of_columns = 11 border = '0'
    IMPORTING table = lcl_table ).

  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_ic1 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '8'  IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c1 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '12' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c2 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '30' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_ic2 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '8'  IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c3 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '12' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c4 ).

  " 1행: 전표유형 | 전기일자
  lcl_ic1->add_icon( 'ICON_FOLDER' ).
  lcl_c1->add_text( text = '전표유형' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c2->add_text( text = |{ gs_header-blart }| ).
  lcl_ic2->add_icon( 'ICON_DATE' ).
  lcl_c3->add_text( text = '전기일자' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c4->add_text(
    text = |{ gs_header-budat(4) }.{ gs_header-budat+4(2) }.{ gs_header-budat+6(2) }| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  " 2행: 차변합계 | 대변합계
  lcl_ic1->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_GREEN' ).
  lcl_c1->add_text( text = '차변합계' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c2->add_text( text = |{ lv_a_s } { gs_header-waers }| ).
  lcl_ic2->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_RED' ).
  lcl_c3->add_text( text = '대변합계' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c4->add_text( text = |{ lv_a_h } { gs_header-waers }| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  " 3행: 통화 | 적요
  lcl_ic1->add_icon( 'ICON_PAYMENT' ).
  lcl_c1->add_text( text = '통화'     sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c2->add_text( text = |{ gs_header-waers }| ).
  lcl_ic2->add_icon( 'ICON_COPY_OBJECT' ).
  lcl_c3->add_text( text = '적요'     sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c4->add_text( text = |{ gs_header-bltxt }| ).

  " 4. 출력
  gcl_document_top_pop->merge_document( ).
  gcl_document_top_pop->display_document(
    EXPORTING
      reuse_control = 'X'
      parent        = gcl_container_pop ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_rev_popup
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_rev_popup .

  DATA: lv_answer(2).

  IF gs_emp-pernr IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '요청자 사번을 입력하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_stgrd IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '역분개 코드를 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 도메인 코드 유효성 체크
  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO gv_stgrd_txt
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_STGRD'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gv_stgrd.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '존재하지 않는 역분개 코드입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  DATA(lv_text) = |{ gv_sel_belnr } 번 전표를 역분개하시겠습니까?|.

  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      titlebar              = '역분개 확인'
      text_question         = lv_text
      text_button_1         = '예'
      icon_button_1         = '@01@'
      text_button_2         = '아니오'
      icon_button_2         = '@0W@'
      default_button        = '1'
      display_cancel_button = ' '
    IMPORTING
      answer                = lv_answer.

  IF lv_answer NE '1'.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '역분개 작업이 사용자에 의해 취소되었습니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.


  cl_gui_cfw=>set_new_ok_code( new_code = space ).
  gv_rev_confirm = 'X'.

  IF gcl_container_pop IS BOUND.
    gcl_container_pop->free( ).
    FREE gcl_container_pop.
  ENDIF.

  IF gcl_document_top_pop IS NOT INITIAL.
    CLEAR gcl_document_top_pop.
  ENDIF.

  LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_domain_text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_domain_text .

  " 역분개 사유 텍스트
  SELECT domvalue_l AS key, ddtext
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_stgrd)
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_STGRD'.
  SORT lt_stgrd BY key.

  " 전표유형 텍스트
  SELECT domvalue_l AS key, ddtext
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_blart)
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_BLART'.
  SORT lt_blart BY key.

  LOOP AT gt_header ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_h>).

    IF <fs_h>-stgrd IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stgrd INTO DATA(ls_stgrd)
        WITH KEY key = <fs_h>-stgrd BINARY SEARCH.

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        <fs_h>-stgrd_txt = ls_stgrd-ddtext.
      ENDIF.

    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_h>-blart IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_blart INTO DATA(ls_blart)
        WITH KEY key = <fs_h>-blart BINARY SEARCH.

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        <fs_h>-blart_txt = ls_blart-ddtext.
      ENDIF.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_rev_item
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_rev_item .

  DATA: lt_temp_header LIKE gt_header.

  LOOP AT gt_header INTO DATA(ls_hdr).

    "데이터가 있는지 확인
    IF line_exists( lt_temp_header[ belnr = ls_hdr-belnr ] ).
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_hdr TO lt_temp_header.

    " 역분개 전표 처리
    IF ls_hdr-stblg IS NOT INITIAL.

      READ TABLE gt_header INTO DATA(ls_rev) WITH KEY belnr = ls_hdr-stblg.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.

        IF NOT line_exists( lt_temp_header[ belnr = ls_rev-belnr ] ).
          APPEND ls_rev TO lt_temp_header.
        ENDIF.

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.
  "재배치
  gt_header = lt_temp_header.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_master_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_master_data .
  " 사원 마스터
  SELECT pernr, pernam
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_emp)
    FROM zte3cm0005.
  SORT lt_emp BY pernr.

  " 고객 마스터
  SELECT kunnr, name1
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_kunnr)
    FROM zte3sd0001.
  SORT lt_kunnr BY kunnr.

  " 공급업체 마스터
  SELECT lifnr, vennm
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_lifnr)
    FROM zte3mm0002.
  SORT lt_lifnr BY lifnr.

  "READ 대신 사용
  LOOP AT gt_header ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_h>).

    IF <fs_h>-pernr IS NOT INITIAL.
      <fs_h>-pernr = VALUE #( lt_emp[ pernr = <fs_h>-pernr ]-pernam OPTIONAL ).
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_h>-kunnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      <fs_h>-name1 = VALUE #( lt_kunnr[ kunnr = <fs_h>-kunnr ]-name1 OPTIONAL ).
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_h>-lifnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      <fs_h>-vennm = VALUE #( lt_lifnr[ lifnr = <fs_h>-lifnr ]-vennm OPTIONAL ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_on_button_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ES_ROW_NO
*&      --> ES_COL_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_on_button_click  USING   ps_row TYPE lvc_s_roid
                                     ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  DATA lv_answer(1).

  " 헤더 데이터 읽기
  READ TABLE gt_header INTO gs_header INDEX ps_row-row_id.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  " 팝업 질문
  DATA(lv_text) = |{ gs_header-belnr } 번 전표를 다운로드 받으시겠습니까?|.

  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      titlebar              = '전표 PDF 다운'
      text_question         = lv_text
      text_button_1         = '예'
      icon_button_1         = '@01@'
      text_button_2         = '아니오'
      icon_button_2         = '@0W@'
      default_button        = '1'
      display_cancel_button = ' '
    IMPORTING
      answer                = lv_answer.

  IF lv_answer = '1'.

    PERFORM get_data_item USING gs_header-belnr.

    IF gt_item_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      PERFORM download_pdf.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '데이터가 없어 생성할 수 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.

    MESSAGE s000 WITH |{ gs_header-belnr } 번 PDF 생성이 취소되었습니다.|.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_style
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_style .

  LOOP AT gt_header ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_header>).

    <fs_header>-pdf_down = icon_pdf.

    INSERT VALUE #( fieldname = 'PDF_DOWN'
                    style     = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_button )
    INTO TABLE <fs_header>-style.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form download_template
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GV_FORM
*&      --> GV_TEMP_FILENAME
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM download_template  USING pv_zform pv_filename.

  DATA: ls_wwwdata_item TYPE wwwdatatab,
        lv_rc           TYPE i.

  CLEAR: ls_wwwdata_item, lv_rc.

  gv_file = pv_filename.

  SELECT SINGLE *
    FROM wwwdata
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_wwwdata_item
   WHERE relid = 'MI'
     AND objid = pv_zform.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DOWNLOAD_WEB_OBJECT'
    EXPORTING
      key         = ls_wwwdata_item
      destination = gv_file.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form fill_voucher
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_voucher .

  DATA: lv_line      TYPE i,
        lv_val       TYPE char100,
        lv_sheet     TYPE i VALUE 1,
        lv_blart_txt TYPE dd07t-ddtext,
        lv_item_cnt  TYPE i,
        lv_del_from  TYPE i,
        ls_pagesetup TYPE ole2_object.

  CONSTANTS: lc_start_row    TYPE i VALUE 12.
  CONSTANTS: lc_template_end TYPE i VALUE 31.
  CONSTANTS: lc_max_rows     TYPE i VALUE 20.

  " 전표유형 도메인 텍스트
  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO lv_blart_txt
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_BLART'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gs_header-blart
     AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.

  IF lv_blart_txt IS INITIAL.
    lv_blart_txt = gs_header-blart.
  ENDIF.

  " 헤더 매핑
  PERFORM fill_cells USING 6 3 'Masterpack'.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING 7 3 gs_header-gjahr.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING 8 3 lv_blart_txt.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING 9 3 gs_header-waers.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING 6 6 gs_header-belnr.

  lv_val = |{ gs_header-budat(4) }.{ gs_header-budat+4(2) }.{ gs_header-budat+6(2) }|.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING 7 6 lv_val.

  lv_val = |{ gs_header-bldat(4) }.{ gs_header-bldat+4(2) }.{ gs_header-bldat+6(2) }|.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING 8 6 lv_val.

  PERFORM fill_cells USING 9 6 gs_header-bltxt.

  lv_item_cnt = lines( gt_item_data ).

  " 데이터가 20행 초과 → 13행에 행 삽입
  IF lv_item_cnt > lc_max_rows.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Rows' = gs_row_e
      EXPORTING #1 = 13.
    DO lv_item_cnt - lc_max_rows TIMES.
      CALL METHOD OF gs_row_e 'Insert'
        EXPORTING
          #1 = -4121.
    ENDDO.
  ENDIF.

  " 아이템 매핑
  lv_line = lc_start_row.

  LOOP AT gt_item_data INTO DATA(ls_item).
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 2 ls_item-saknr.
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 3 ls_item-saknr_txt.
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 6 'KRW'.

    CLEAR lv_val.
    " [수정] DMBTR은 항상 원화(KRW) 기준이므로 'KRW'로 하드코딩
    WRITE ls_item-dmbtr TO lv_val CURRENCY 'KRW'.
    CONDENSE lv_val.

    IF ls_item-shkzg = 'S'.
      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 4 lv_val.
    ELSEIF ls_item-shkzg = 'H'.
      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 5 lv_val.
    ENDIF.

    lv_line = lv_line + 1.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 데이터가 20행 미만 → 남은 빈 행 삭제
  IF lv_item_cnt < lc_max_rows.
    lv_del_from = lv_line.

    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Cells' = gs_cell
      EXPORTING #1 = lv_del_from #2 = 1.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Cells' = gs_cell2
      EXPORTING #1 = lc_template_end #2 = 1.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Range' = gs_range
      EXPORTING #1 = gs_cell #2 = gs_cell2.
    GET PROPERTY OF gs_range 'EntireRow' = gs_row_e.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_row_e 'Delete'.
  ENDIF.

  " 합계행
  PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 6 'KRW'.

  CLEAR lv_val.
  " [수정] 합계 금액도 동일하게 'KRW' 기준 적용
  WRITE gv_popup_dmbtr_s TO lv_val CURRENCY 'KRW'. CONDENSE lv_val.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 4 lv_val.

  CLEAR lv_val.
  WRITE gv_popup_dmbtr_h TO lv_val CURRENCY 'KRW'. CONDENSE lv_val.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 5 lv_val.

  " 페이지 설정
  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'SHEETS' = gs_sheet
    EXPORTING #1 = 1.
  GET PROPERTY OF gs_sheet 'PageSetup' = ls_pagesetup.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'PrintTitleRows' = '$1:$11'.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'PaperSize'      = 9.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'Orientation'    = 1.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'FitToPagesWide' = 1.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'FitToPagesTall' = 0.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'Zoom'           = 100.

  DATA lv_footer_row TYPE i.
  lv_footer_row = lv_line + 2.

  lv_val = |출력일: { sy-datum(4) }.{ sy-datum+4(2) }.{ sy-datum+6(2) }  ·  Masterpack ERP System|.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_footer_row 2 lv_val.

  FREE OBJECT: ls_pagesetup, gs_cell, gs_cell2, gs_range, gs_row_e.

  PERFORM make_pdf USING lv_sheet.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form fill_cells
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_3
*&      --> P_2
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_cells   USING pv_i pv_j pv_val.

  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'CELLS' = gs_cell
    EXPORTING
      #1 = pv_i
      #2 = pv_j.

  SET PROPERTY OF gs_cell 'VALUE' = pv_val.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_pdf
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_SHEET
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_pdf USING pv_sheet.

  DATA: lv_rc TYPE i.

  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'SHEETS' = gs_sheet
    EXPORTING #1 = 1.
  CALL METHOD OF gs_sheet 'SELECT' NO FLUSH.

  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Cells' = gs_cell
    EXPORTING #1 = 1  #2 = 1.
  CALL METHOD OF gs_cell 'Select'.

  SET PROPERTY OF gs_excel 'VISIBLE' = 1.

  GET PROPERTY OF gs_excel 'Workbooks' = gs_workbook
    EXPORTING #1 = pv_sheet.

  CALL METHOD OF gs_workbook 'ExportAsFixedFormat'
    EXPORTING
      #1 = '0'
      #2 = gv_temp_filename_pdf.

  CALL METHOD OF gs_workbook 'Close'
    EXPORTING
      #1 = 0.

  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Quit'.

  CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_delete
    EXPORTING
      filename             = CONV #( gv_temp_filename )
    CHANGING
      rc                   = lv_rc
    EXCEPTIONS
      file_delete_failed   = 1
      cntl_error           = 2
      error_no_gui         = 3
      not_supported_by_gui = 4
      OTHERS               = 5.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form open_excel_template
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM open_excel_template .

  IF gs_excel IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT gs_excel 'EXCEL.APPLICATION'.
  ENDIF.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH sy-msgli DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'WORKBOOKS' = gs_workbook.
  SET PROPERTY OF gs_excel 'VISIBLE' = 0.
  CALL METHOD OF gs_workbook 'OPEN' EXPORTING #1 = gv_temp_filename.

  GET PROPERTY OF gs_workbook    'Application' = gs_application.
  GET PROPERTY OF gs_application 'ActiveSheet' = gs_activesheet.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_tab_ui
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_tab_ui .

  tab1 = '전표 통합 조회'.

  tab3 = '매입채무 (AP)'.

    WHEN 'COMM2'.
      tab_block-dynnr = '1200'.

    WHEN 'COMM3'.
      tab_block-dynnr = '1300'.
      tab_block-prog  = sy-repid.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_blart
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_blart .

  DATA : ls_list TYPE vrm_value,
         lt_list TYPE vrm_values.

  SELECT domvalue_l AS key, ddtext
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_blart)
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_BLART'.

  SORT lt_blart BY key.

*  ls_list-key  = 'ALL'.
*  ls_list-text = '전체 조회'.
*  APPEND ls_list TO lt_list.

  LOOP AT lt_blart ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_blart>).
    CLEAR ls_list.

    ls_list-key = <fs_blart>-key.
    ls_list-text = <fs_blart>-ddtext.

    APPEND  ls_list TO lt_list.
  ENDLOOP.

  CALL FUNCTION 'VRM_SET_VALUES'
    EXPORTING
      id     = 'PA_BLART'
      values = lt_list.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_tab
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_tab .

  CASE sscrfields-ucomm.

    WHEN 'COMM1' OR 'COMM2' OR 'COMM3'.
      gv_tab = sscrfields-ucomm.
      EXPORT gv_tab TO MEMORY ID gc_mem_tab.
      PERFORM set_tab_ui.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_layout .

  LOOP AT gt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fc>).
    CASE <fs_fc>-fieldname.
      WHEN 'KUNNR' OR 'NAME1'.
        " COMM3(공급업체 탭) → 고객 컬럼 숨김
        " COMM1(전체) → 둘 다 보임
        <fs_fc>-no_out = COND #(
          WHEN gv_tab EQ 'COMM3' THEN 'X'
          ELSE space ).

      WHEN 'LIFNR' OR 'VENNM'.
        " COMM2(고객 탭) → 공급업체 컬럼 숨김
        " COMM1(전체) → 둘 다 보임
        <fs_fc>-no_out = COND #(
          WHEN gv_tab EQ 'COMM2' THEN 'X'
          ELSE space ).

    ENDCASE.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_date
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_date .
  " 탭별 입력 날짜 범위 우선 적용
  CASE gv_tab.
    WHEN 'COMM1'.
      IF so_budat[] IS NOT INITIAL.
        gv_min_date = so_budat-low.
        gv_max_date = COND #( WHEN so_budat-high IS INITIAL
                              THEN so_budat-low ELSE so_budat-high ).
      ENDIF.
    WHEN 'COMM2'.
      IF so_bud2[] IS NOT INITIAL.
        gv_min_date = so_bud2-low.
        gv_max_date = COND #( WHEN so_bud2-high IS INITIAL
                              THEN so_bud2-low ELSE so_bud2-high ).
      ENDIF.
    WHEN 'COMM3'.
      IF so_bud3[] IS NOT INITIAL.
        gv_min_date = so_bud3-low.
        gv_max_date = COND #( WHEN so_bud3-high IS INITIAL
                              THEN so_bud3-low ELSE so_bud3-high ).
      ENDIF.
  ENDCASE.
  " 날짜 입력 없으면 실제 데이터에서 min/max 계산
  IF gv_min_date IS INITIAL.
    LOOP AT gt_header INTO DATA(ls_date).
      IF gv_min_date IS INITIAL OR ls_date-budat LT gv_min_date.
        gv_min_date = ls_date-budat.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_date-budat GT gv_max_date.
        gv_max_date = ls_date-budat.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form count_header
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM count_header .

  LOOP AT gt_header INTO DATA(ls_h).

    IF ls_h-blart EQ 'AB'.
      " 역분개 취소 전표
      gv_cnt_reverse += 1.

    ELSEIF ls_h-stblg IS NOT INITIAL.
      " 역분개 대상 전표 (원천 전표)
      gv_cnt_reversed += 1.

    ELSEIF ls_h-bstat EQ 'C'.
      " 반제 완료 전표
      gv_cnt_cleared += 1.

    ELSEIF ls_h-bstat EQ space AND ls_h-open_flag EQ 'X'.
      " 미결 전표 (역분개/반제 아님)
      gv_cnt_pending += 1.

    ELSE.
      " 일반 전표 (위에 다 해당 X)
      gv_cnt_normal += 1.
    ENDIF.

    " 고객(AR) 관련
    IF ls_h-kunnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      gv_cnt_kunner += 1.
      IF ls_h-stblg IS NOT INITIAL.
        gv_kunner_rev += 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " 공급업체(AP) 관련
    IF ls_h-lifnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      gv_cnt_lifnr += 1.
      IF ls_h-stblg IS NOT INITIAL.
        gv_lifnr_rev += 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form sum_amt
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM sum_amt .

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_raw,
          belnr TYPE zte3fi0003-belnr,
          bukrs TYPE zte3fi0003-bukrs,
          gjahr TYPE zte3fi0003-gjahr,
          dmbtr TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr,
        END OF ls_raw.

  DATA lt_raw LIKE TABLE OF ls_raw.
  DATA lt_sum LIKE TABLE OF ls_raw.

  DATA lv_doc_amt TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  CLEAR: gv_amt_total, gv_amt_pending, gv_amt_cleared,
         gv_amt_kunnr, gv_amt_kunnr_pnd,
         gv_amt_lifnr, gv_amt_lifnr_pnd.

  CHECK gt_header IS NOT INITIAL.

  "차변 아이템 금액 조회
  SELECT belnr bukrs gjahr dmbtr
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_raw
    FROM zte3fi0003
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN gt_header
   WHERE bukrs EQ gt_header-bukrs
     AND gjahr EQ gt_header-gjahr
     AND belnr EQ gt_header-belnr
     AND shkzg EQ 'S'.

  " belnr+bukrs+gjahr 기준 dmbtr 합산
  LOOP AT lt_raw INTO ls_raw.
    COLLECT ls_raw INTO lt_sum.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT lt_sum BY belnr bukrs gjahr.

  LOOP AT gt_header INTO DATA(ls_header).
    CLEAR lv_doc_amt.
    " 전표 합계 금액 취득 (없으면 0)
    lv_doc_amt = VALUE #( lt_sum[ belnr = ls_header-belnr
                                  bukrs = ls_header-bukrs
                                  gjahr = ls_header-gjahr ]-dmbtr OPTIONAL ).
    " 역분개(AB) / 역분개 대상 전표 제외
    CHECK ls_header-blart NE 'AB' AND ls_header-stblg EQ space.

    gv_amt_total += lv_doc_amt.
    " 미결 금액
    IF ls_header-bstat EQ space AND ls_header-open_flag EQ 'X'.
      gv_amt_pending += lv_doc_amt.
    ENDIF.
    " 반제 금액
    IF ls_header-bstat EQ 'C'.
      gv_amt_cleared += lv_doc_amt.
    ENDIF.
    " AR 금액
    IF ls_header-kunnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      gv_amt_kunnr += lv_doc_amt.
      IF ls_header-bstat EQ space AND ls_header-open_flag EQ 'X'.
        gv_amt_kunnr_pnd += lv_doc_amt.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    " AP 금액
    IF ls_header-lifnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      gv_amt_lifnr += lv_doc_amt.
      IF ls_header-bstat EQ space AND ls_header-open_flag EQ 'X'.
        gv_amt_lifnr_pnd += lv_doc_amt.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_doc_title
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_doc_title .

  DATA: lv_kunnr_nm TYPE zte3sd0001-name1,
        lv_lifnr_nm TYPE zte3mm0002-vennm,
        lv_kun_part TYPE string,
        lv_lif_part TYPE string,
        lv_belnr    TYPE string,
        lv_blart_nm TYPE string, "전표유형 텍스트
        lv_title    TYPE sdydo_text_element.

  IF so_kun-low IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE name1
      INTO lv_kunnr_nm
      FROM zte3sd0001
     WHERE kunnr EQ so_kun-low.
  ENDIF.

  IF so_lif-low IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE vennm
      INTO lv_lifnr_nm
      FROM zte3mm0002
     WHERE lifnr EQ so_lif-low.
  ENDIF.

  " 고객 파트
  IF so_kun-low IS NOT INITIAL.
    lv_kun_part = COND #(
      WHEN so_kun-high IS NOT INITIAL
        THEN |{ so_kun-low } ~ { so_kun-high }|
      WHEN lv_kunnr_nm IS NOT INITIAL
        THEN |{ so_kun-low } { lv_kunnr_nm }|
      ELSE |{ so_kun-low }| ).
  ENDIF.

  " 공급업체 파트
  IF so_lif-low IS NOT INITIAL.
    lv_lif_part = COND #(
      WHEN so_lif-high IS NOT INITIAL
        THEN |{ so_lif-low } ~ { so_lif-high }|
      WHEN lv_lifnr_nm IS NOT INITIAL
        THEN |{ so_lif-low } { lv_lifnr_nm }|
      ELSE |{ so_lif-low }| ).
  ENDIF.


  IF so_belnr-low IS NOT INITIAL.
    lv_belnr = COND #(
    WHEN so_belnr-high IS NOT INITIAL
       THEN |{ so_belnr-low } ~ { so_belnr-high }|
    WHEN so_belnr-high IS INITIAL
       THEN so_belnr-low
       ).
  ENDIF.

  IF pa_blart IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE ddtext
      INTO @lv_blart_nm
      FROM dd07t
     WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_BLART'
       AND domvalue_l EQ @pa_blart.
  ENDIF.

  lv_title = SWITCH #( gv_top_flag
    WHEN 'COMM1' THEN COND #(
      WHEN so_belnr-low IS NOT INITIAL THEN |전표 { lv_belnr } 요약|
      WHEN pa_blart     IS NOT INITIAL THEN |{ lv_blart_nm } 요약|
      )
    WHEN 'COMM2' THEN COND #(
      WHEN lv_kun_part IS NOT INITIAL THEN |{ lv_kun_part } 전표 요약|
      ELSE '고객 전표 요약' )
    WHEN 'COMM3' THEN COND #(
      WHEN lv_lif_part IS NOT INITIAL THEN |{ lv_lif_part } 전표 요약|
      ELSE '공급업체 전표 요약' ) ).

  gcl_document_top->add_text(
    text = lv_title sap_fontsize = 'LARGE' sap_emphasis = 'STRONG' ).
  gcl_document_top->new_line( ).
  gcl_document_top->new_line( ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_doc_body
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PCL_DOCUMENT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_doc_body  USING pcl_document TYPE REF TO cl_dd_document.

  DATA: lcl_table TYPE REF TO cl_dd_table_element,
        lcl_col1  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col2  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col3  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_gap   TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col5  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col6  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_col7  TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area.

  " 탭별 금액/건수 변수 결정
  DATA: lv_cnt_top TYPE i,    " 총전표수
        lv_amt_top TYPE p DECIMALS 2,  " 총금액
        lv_amt_pnd TYPE p DECIMALS 2.  " 미결금액

  CASE gv_top_flag.
    WHEN 'COMM1'.
      lv_cnt_top = gv_cnt_total.
      lv_amt_top = gv_amt_total.
      lv_amt_pnd = gv_amt_pending.
    WHEN 'COMM2'.
      lv_cnt_top = gv_cnt_kunner.
      lv_amt_top = gv_amt_kunnr.
      lv_amt_pnd = gv_amt_pending.
    WHEN 'COMM3'.
      lv_cnt_top = gv_cnt_lifnr.
      lv_amt_top = gv_amt_lifnr.
      lv_amt_pnd = gv_amt_lifnr_pnd.
  ENDCASE.

  PERFORM build_doc_table USING pcl_document
    CHANGING lcl_table lcl_col1 lcl_col2 lcl_col3
             lcl_gap   lcl_col5 lcl_col6 lcl_col7.

  DATA: lv_c TYPE sdydo_text_element,
        lv_a TYPE sdydo_text_element,
        lv_p TYPE sdydo_text_element.

  lv_p = |{ gv_min_date+0(4) }.{ gv_min_date+4(2) }.{ gv_min_date+6(2) } ~ | &&
         |{ gv_max_date+0(4) }.{ gv_max_date+4(2) }.{ gv_max_date+6(2) }|.

  " [1행] 총전표수 / 일반전표
  lv_c = lv_cnt_top. CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col1->add_icon( 'ICON_DOC' ).
  lcl_col2->add_text( text = '총 전표수' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col3->add_text( text = |{ lv_c } 건| ).

  lv_c = gv_cnt_normal. " 루프에서 직접 세어온 정확한 값 사용
  CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col5->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_INACTIVE' ).
  lcl_col6->add_text( text = '일반 전표' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col7->add_text( text = |{ lv_c } 건| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  " [2행] 총금액 / 역분개
  WRITE lv_amt_top TO lv_a CURRENCY 'KRW'. CONDENSE lv_a.
  lcl_col1->add_icon( 'ICON_PAYMENT' ).
  lcl_col2->add_text( text = '총 금액' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col3->add_text( text = |{ lv_a } 원| ).

  DATA(lv_rev) = |{ gv_cnt_reverse } / { gv_cnt_reversed }|.
  lcl_col5->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_RED' ).
  lcl_col6->add_text( text = '역분개 전표' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col7->add_text( text = |{ lv_rev } 건 (취소/대상)| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  " [3행] 미결금액 / 반제
  WRITE lv_amt_pnd TO lv_a CURRENCY 'KRW'. CONDENSE lv_a.
  lcl_col1->add_icon( 'ICON_PAYMENT' ).
  lcl_col2->add_text( text = '미결 금액' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col3->add_text( text = |{ lv_a } 원| ).

  lv_c = gv_cnt_cleared. CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col5->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_GREEN' ).
  lcl_col6->add_text( text = '반제 전표' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col7->add_text( text = |{ lv_c } 건| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  " [4행] 조회기간 / 미결
  lcl_col1->add_icon( 'ICON_DATE' ).
  lcl_col2->add_text( text = '조회기간' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col3->add_text( text = lv_p ).

  lv_c = gv_cnt_pending. CONDENSE lv_c.
  lcl_col5->add_icon( 'ICON_LED_YELLOW' ).
  lcl_col6->add_text( text = '미결 전표' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_col7->add_text( text = |{ lv_c } 건| ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form sum_dmbtr_sh
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM sum_dmbtr_sh .

  SELECT saknr, stext
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_saknr)
    FROM zte3fi0001
   WHERE bukrs EQ @gs_header-bukrs.
  SORT lt_saknr BY saknr.

* 금액 분리 + 아이콘
  LOOP AT gt_item_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).

    CASE <fs_item>-shkzg.

      WHEN 'S'.
        <fs_item>-dmbtr_s = <fs_item>-dmbtr.
        <fs_item>-waers_s = <fs_item>-waers.
        <fs_item>-shkzg_txt = '차변'.

      WHEN 'H'.
        <fs_item>-dmbtr_h = <fs_item>-dmbtr.
        <fs_item>-waers_h = <fs_item>-waers.
        <fs_item>-shkzg_txt = '대변'.

    ENDCASE.
    " 아이콘
    IF <fs_item>-belnr EQ gs_header-stblg.         " 역분개 전표 아이템 자체
      <fs_item>-status = icon_led_red.
      <fs_item>-status_text = '역분개전표'.
    ELSE.
      <fs_item>-status = icon_led_green.
      <fs_item>-status_text = '정상전표'.
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_item>-saknr IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_saknr INTO DATA(ls_saknr)
        WITH KEY saknr = <fs_item>-saknr BINARY SEARCH.
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        <fs_item>-saknr_txt = ls_saknr-stext.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  CHECK gv_dmbtr_s EQ gv_dmbtr_h. "차대변

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_msg
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_msg USING pv_mode.

  DATA lv_tab_name TYPE string.

  CASE pv_mode.
    WHEN 'ALL'.
      lv_tab_name = '전체'.
    WHEN 'AR_A'.
      lv_tab_name = '고객 전체'.
    WHEN 'AR_O'.
      lv_tab_name = '고객 미결'.
    WHEN 'AR_C'.
      lv_tab_name = '고객 반제'.
    WHEN 'AP_A'.
      lv_tab_name = '공급업체 전체'.
    WHEN 'AP_O'.
      lv_tab_name = '공급업체 미결'.
    WHEN 'AP_C'.
      lv_tab_name = '공급업체 반제'.
  ENDCASE.

  MESSAGE s000 WITH |{ lv_tab_name } 전표 { lines( gt_header ) }건이 조회되었습니다.|.

  CLEAR pv_mode.

ENDFORM.
