*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form download_pdf
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM download_pdf .

  DATA: lv_sheet TYPE i.

  IF gt_item_data IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '출력할 아이템 데이터가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR: gv_popup_dmbtr_s, gv_popup_dmbtr_h.
  LOOP AT gt_item_data INTO DATA(ls_sum).
    gv_popup_dmbtr_s = gv_popup_dmbtr_s + ls_sum-dmbtr_s.
    gv_popup_dmbtr_h = gv_popup_dmbtr_h + ls_sum-dmbtr_h.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 3. 폴더 선택 로직
  PERFORM select_folder_path.

  IF gv_pfolder IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'PDF 다운이 취소되었습니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 4. 파일명 생성 및 경로 설정
  PERFORM set_file_names.

  " 5. 엑셀/PDF 생성 실행
  PERFORM download_template USING 'ZPE3FI_POST_PDF2' gv_temp_filename.
  PERFORM open_excel_template.

  lv_sheet = 1.
  PERFORM fill_voucher.   " 여기서 gt_item_data를 사용하여 엑셀을 채움
  PERFORM make_pdf USING lv_sheet.

  MESSAGE s000 WITH |{ gs_header-belnr } 번 PDF 생성이 완료되었습니다.|.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form select_folder_path
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM select_folder_path .

  CLEAR gv_pfolder.

  IF gcl_objfile IS NOT BOUND.
    CREATE OBJECT gcl_objfile.
  ENDIF.

  " 초기 폴더 설정
  IF gv_pfolder IS NOT INITIAL.
    gv_initialfolder = gv_pfolder.
  ELSE.
    gcl_objfile->get_temp_directory( CHANGING temp_dir = gv_initialfolder ).
  ENDIF.

  " 폴더 선택 전 변수 초기화 (취소 여부 확인용)
  CLEAR gv_pickedfolder.

  " 폴더 선택 팝업
  gcl_objfile->directory_browse(
    EXPORTING initial_folder  = gv_initialfolder
    CHANGING  selected_folder = gv_pickedfolder
    EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).

  " sy-subrc가 0이더라도 경로가 없으면 취소로 간주
  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND gv_pickedfolder IS NOT INITIAL.
    gv_pfolder = gv_pickedfolder.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH 'PDF 다운이 취소되었습니다.'.
  ENDIF.

  " 객체 해제
  IF gcl_objfile IS BOUND.
    gcl_objfile->free( ).
    FREE gcl_objfile.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_file_names
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_file_names .

  DATA(lv_timestamp) = |{ sy-datum }{ sy-uzeit }|.

  CLEAR: gv_temp_filename, gv_temp_filename_pdf.

  gv_filename     = |\\회계전표_{ gs_header-belnr }_{ lv_timestamp }.XLS|.
  gv_filename_pdf = |\\회계전표_{ gs_header-belnr }_{ lv_timestamp }.PDF|.

  CONDENSE: gv_filename, gv_filename_pdf.

  gv_temp_filename     = gv_pfolder && gv_filename.
  gv_temp_filename_pdf = gv_pfolder && gv_filename_pdf.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form update_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_EMP_PERNAM
*&      --> GS_EMP_BTRTL
*&      --> GS_EMP_GRADE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM update_screen  USING pv_name pv_btrtl pv_grade.

  DATA: lt_dynp TYPE TABLE OF dynpread,
        ls_dynp TYPE dynpread.


  lt_dynp = VALUE #(
    ( fieldname = 'GS_EMP-PERNAM' fieldvalue = pv_name  )
    ( fieldname = 'GS_EMP-BTRTL'  fieldvalue = pv_btrtl )
    ( fieldname = 'GS_EMP-GRADE'  fieldvalue = pv_grade )
  ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE'
    EXPORTING
      dyname     = sy-repid
      dynumb     = sy-dynnr
    TABLES
      dynpfields = lt_dynp
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS     = 0.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form pdf_down_all
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM pdf_down_all .

  DATA: lv_answer TYPE c.

  " 1. 데이터 존재 체크
  IF gt_header IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '출력할 데이터가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 2. 다운로드 확인 팝업
  DATA(lv_text) = |{ lines( gt_header ) }개의 전표 리스트를 다운로드 하시겠습니까?|.

  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      titlebar              = '전체 리스트 PDF 다운로드'
      text_question         = lv_text
      text_button_1         = '예'
      icon_button_1         = '@01@'
      text_button_2         = '아니오'
      icon_button_2         = '@0W@'
      default_button        = '1'
      display_cancel_button = ' '
    IMPORTING
      answer                = lv_answer.

  IF lv_answer = '1'.
    " '예'를 눌렀을 때 실행 로직을 PERFORM으로 분리
    PERFORM pdf_download.
  ELSE.
    " '아니오'를 눌렀을 때 메시지 출력 (요청사항)
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '전체 PDF 다운로드가 취소되었습니다.'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form pdf_download
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM pdf_download .
*
*  DATA: lv_line        TYPE i,
*        lv_val         TYPE char100,
*        lv_sheet       TYPE i VALUE 1,
*        lv_total_dmbtr TYPE dmbtr,
*        lv_total_wrbtr TYPE wrbtr,
*        lv_sep         TYPE char1,
*        ls_pagesetup   TYPE ole2_object,
*        lv_data_cnt    TYPE i,
*        lv_blart_txt   TYPE dd07t-ddtext,
*        lv_footer_row  TYPE i,
*        lv_insert_row  TYPE i,
*        lv_jpy_wrbtr   TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
*
*  " 폴더 선택
*  PERFORM select_folder_path.
*  CHECK gv_pfolder IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*  CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_file_separator
*    CHANGING
*      file_separator = lv_sep.
*
*  gv_temp_filename     = |{ gv_pfolder }{ lv_sep }전표리스트_{ sy-datum }_{ sy-uzeit }.xlsx|.
*  gv_temp_filename_pdf = |{ gv_pfolder }{ lv_sep }전표리스트_{ sy-datum }_{ sy-uzeit }.pdf|.
*
*  PERFORM download_template USING 'ZPE3FI_POST_PDFALL2' gv_temp_filename.
*  PERFORM open_excel_template.
*
*  " 대량 데이터 대응을 위한 행 삽입
*  lv_data_cnt   = lines( gt_header ).
*  lv_insert_row = 8.
*
*  IF lv_data_cnt > 1.
*    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Rows' = gs_row_e
*      EXPORTING #1 = lv_insert_row.
*    DO lv_data_cnt - 1 TIMES.
*      CALL METHOD OF gs_row_e 'Insert'
*        EXPORTING
*          #1 = -4121.
*    ENDDO.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  " 데이터 루프 (7행부터)
*  lv_line = 7.
*
*  LOOP AT gt_header INTO DATA(ls_out).
*
*    " 전표유형 도메인 텍스트
*    SELECT SINGLE ddtext
*      INTO lv_blart_txt
*      FROM dd07t
*     WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_BLART'
*       AND domvalue_l EQ ls_out-blart
*       AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.
*    IF lv_blart_txt IS INITIAL. lv_blart_txt = ls_out-blart. ENDIF.
*
*    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 2 ls_out-belnr.
*    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 3 ls_out-bukrs.
*    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 4 ls_out-gjahr.
*    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 5 lv_blart_txt.
*
*    lv_val = |{ ls_out-budat(4) }.{ ls_out-budat+4(2) }.{ ls_out-budat+6(2) }|.
*    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 6 lv_val.
*
*    " 외화총액 - 차변만
*    SELECT SUM( wrbtr )
*      INTO @lv_total_wrbtr
*      FROM zte3fi0003
*     WHERE belnr EQ @ls_out-belnr
*       AND bukrs EQ @ls_out-bukrs
*       AND gjahr EQ @ls_out-gjahr
*       AND shkzg EQ 'S'
*       AND fwaer NE 'KRW'.
*
*    " KRW 금액 - 차변만
*    SELECT SUM( dmbtr )
*      INTO @lv_total_dmbtr
*      FROM zte3fi0003
*     WHERE belnr EQ @ls_out-belnr
*       AND bukrs EQ @ls_out-bukrs
*       AND gjahr EQ @ls_out-gjahr
*       AND shkzg EQ 'S'.
*
*    IF lv_total_wrbtr <> 0.
*      CLEAR lv_val.
*      IF ls_out-waers = 'JPY'.
*        WRITE lv_total_wrbtr TO lv_val CURRENCY 'JPY'.
*      ELSE.
*        WRITE lv_total_wrbtr TO lv_val CURRENCY ls_out-waers.
*      ENDIF.
*      CONDENSE lv_val.
*      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 7 lv_val.
*      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 8 ls_out-waers.
*    ELSE.
*      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 7 ''.
*      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 8 ''.
*    ENDIF.
*
*    " KRW 금액
*    CLEAR lv_val.
*    WRITE lv_total_dmbtr TO lv_val CURRENCY 'KRW'. CONDENSE lv_val.
*    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 9 lv_val.
*    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 10 'KRW'.
*
*    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 11 ls_out-bltxt.
*
*    lv_line = lv_line + 1.
*  ENDLOOP.
*
*  " 잔여 행 삭제
*  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Cells' = gs_cell
*    EXPORTING #1 = lv_line #2 = 1.
*  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Cells' = gs_cell2
*    EXPORTING #1 = 5000 #2 = 1.
*  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Range' = gs_range
*    EXPORTING #1 = gs_cell #2 = gs_cell2.
*  GET PROPERTY OF gs_range 'EntireRow' = gs_row_e.
*  CALL METHOD OF gs_row_e 'Delete'.
*
*  " 출력일 footer
*  lv_footer_row = lv_line + 2.
*  lv_val = |출력일: { sy-datum(4) }.{ sy-datum+4(2) }.{ sy-datum+6(2) }  ·  Masterpack ERP System|.
*  PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_footer_row 2 lv_val.
*
*  " 페이지 설정
*  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'SHEETS' = gs_sheet
*    EXPORTING #1 = 1.
*  GET PROPERTY OF gs_sheet 'PageSetup' = ls_pagesetup.
*  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'PrintTitleRows' = '$1:$6'.
*  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'PaperSize'      = 9.
*  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'Orientation'    = 2.
*  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'Zoom'           = 85.
*
*  FREE OBJECT: ls_pagesetup, gs_cell, gs_cell2, gs_range, gs_row_e.
*
*  PERFORM make_pdf USING lv_sheet.
*
*  MESSAGE s000 WITH |총 { lv_data_cnt }건의 PDF 작업이 완료되었습니다.|.

  DATA: lv_line         TYPE i,
        lv_val          TYPE char100,
        lv_sheet        TYPE i VALUE 1,
        lv_total_dmbtr  TYPE dmbtr,
        lv_total_wrbtr  TYPE wrbtr,
        lv_sep          TYPE char1,
        ls_pagesetup    TYPE ole2_object,
        lv_data_cnt     TYPE i,
        lv_blart_txt    TYPE dd07t-ddtext,
        lv_footer_row   TYPE i,
        lv_insert_row   TYPE i,

        " [추가] 대량 Insert 및 삭제용 변수
        lv_end_row      TYPE i,
        lv_range_str    TYPE string,
        lv_template_max TYPE i VALUE 200. " 실제 템플릿의 여백 유지 가능 최대 라인수

  " 폴더 선택
  PERFORM select_folder_path.
  CHECK gv_pfolder IS NOT INITIAL.

  CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_file_separator
    CHANGING
      file_separator = lv_sep.

  gv_temp_filename     = |{ gv_pfolder }{ lv_sep }전표리스트_{ sy-datum }_{ sy-uzeit }.xlsx|.
  gv_temp_filename_pdf = |{ gv_pfolder }{ lv_sep }전표리스트_{ sy-datum }_{ sy-uzeit }.pdf|.

  PERFORM download_template USING 'ZPE3FI_POST_PDFALL2' gv_temp_filename.
  PERFORM open_excel_template.

  lv_data_cnt   = lines( gt_header ).
  lv_insert_row = 8.

  " [속도 개선] 대량 데이터 대응을 위한 행 삽입 (Range를 이용하여 한 번에 삽입)
  IF lv_data_cnt > 1.
    lv_end_row = lv_insert_row + lv_data_cnt - 2.
    lv_range_str = |A{ lv_insert_row }:A{ lv_end_row }|.

    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Range' = gs_range EXPORTING #1 = lv_range_str.
    GET PROPERTY OF gs_range 'EntireRow' = gs_row_e.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_row_e 'Insert' EXPORTING #1 = -4121.
  ENDIF.

  " 데이터 루프 (7행부터)
  lv_line = 7.

  LOOP AT gt_header INTO DATA(ls_out).

    " 전표유형 도메인 텍스트
    SELECT SINGLE ddtext
      INTO lv_blart_txt
      FROM dd07t
     WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_BLART'
       AND domvalue_l EQ ls_out-blart
       AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.
    IF lv_blart_txt IS INITIAL. lv_blart_txt = ls_out-blart. ENDIF.

    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 2 ls_out-belnr.
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 3 ls_out-bukrs.
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 4 ls_out-gjahr.
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 5 lv_blart_txt.

    lv_val = |{ ls_out-budat(4) }.{ ls_out-budat+4(2) }.{ ls_out-budat+6(2) }|.
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 6 lv_val.

    " 외화총액 - 차변만
    SELECT SUM( wrbtr )
      INTO @lv_total_wrbtr
      FROM zte3fi0003
     WHERE belnr EQ @ls_out-belnr
       AND bukrs EQ @ls_out-bukrs
       AND gjahr EQ @ls_out-gjahr
       AND shkzg EQ 'S'
       AND fwaer NE 'KRW'.

    " KRW 금액 - 차변만
    SELECT SUM( dmbtr )
      INTO @lv_total_dmbtr
      FROM zte3fi0003
     WHERE belnr EQ @ls_out-belnr
       AND bukrs EQ @ls_out-bukrs
       AND gjahr EQ @ls_out-gjahr
       AND shkzg EQ 'S'.

    " [수정] JPY 외화 표기 및 소수점 강제 치환 로직
    IF lv_total_wrbtr <> 0.
      CLEAR lv_val.
      IF ls_out-waers = 'JPY'.
        WRITE lv_total_wrbtr TO lv_val CURRENCY 'JPY' DECIMALS 0.
        CONDENSE lv_val.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '.00' IN lv_val WITH ''.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',00' IN lv_val WITH ''.
      ELSE.
        WRITE lv_total_wrbtr TO lv_val CURRENCY ls_out-waers.
        CONDENSE lv_val.
      ENDIF.

      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 7 lv_val.
      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 8 ls_out-waers.
    ELSE.
      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 7 ''.
      PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 8 ''.
    ENDIF.

    " KRW 금액
    CLEAR lv_val.
    WRITE lv_total_dmbtr TO lv_val CURRENCY 'KRW'. CONDENSE lv_val.
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 9 lv_val.
    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 10 'KRW'.

    PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_line 11 ls_out-bltxt.

    lv_line = lv_line + 1.
  ENDLOOP.

  " [서식 보호] 잔여 행 삭제 (템플릿 한계치 내에서만 삭제하여 하단 여백 및 서식 유지)
  IF lv_line < lv_template_max.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Cells' = gs_cell
      EXPORTING #1 = lv_line #2 = 1.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Cells' = gs_cell2
      EXPORTING #1 = lv_template_max #2 = 1.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'Range' = gs_range
      EXPORTING #1 = gs_cell #2 = gs_cell2.
    GET PROPERTY OF gs_range 'EntireRow' = gs_row_e.
    CALL METHOD OF gs_row_e 'Delete'.
  ENDIF.

  " 출력일 footer
  lv_footer_row = lv_line + 2.
  lv_val = |출력일: { sy-datum(4) }.{ sy-datum+4(2) }.{ sy-datum+6(2) }  ·  Masterpack ERP System|.
  PERFORM fill_cells USING lv_footer_row 2 lv_val.

  " 페이지 설정
  CALL METHOD OF gs_excel 'SHEETS' = gs_sheet
    EXPORTING #1 = 1.
  GET PROPERTY OF gs_sheet 'PageSetup' = ls_pagesetup.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'PrintTitleRows' = '$1:$6'.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'PaperSize'      = 9.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'Orientation'    = 2.
  SET PROPERTY OF ls_pagesetup 'Zoom'           = 85.

  FREE OBJECT: ls_pagesetup, gs_cell, gs_cell2, gs_range, gs_row_e.

  PERFORM make_pdf USING lv_sheet.

  MESSAGE s000 WITH |총 { lv_data_cnt }건의 PDF 작업이 완료되었습니다.|.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_double_click
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW
*&      --> E_COLUMN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_double_click  USING ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                               ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CHECK ps_row-rowtype IS INITIAL.

  READ TABLE gt_header INTO gs_header INDEX ps_row-index.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.
    WHEN 'BELNR' OR 'ICON' OR 'ICON_TEXT'.
      PERFORM get_data_item USING gs_header-belnr.
      PERFORM refresh_grid_bot.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form data_range
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM data_range .
  "6개월로 막아놓음.
  DATA : lv_limit TYPE sy-datum.

  check_date_range so_budat lv_limit. " SO_BUDAT 전기일 체크
  check_date_range so_bud2  lv_limit.  " SO_BUD2 전기일 체크

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_belnr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_belnr .

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_value,
          belnr TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
          blart TYPE zte3fi0002-blart,
          bldat TYPE zte3fi0002-bldat,
          bltxt TYPE zte3fi0002-bltxt,
        END OF ls_value,
        lt_value  LIKE TABLE OF ls_value,
        lt_fields TYPE TABLE OF dynpread,
        lv_blart  TYPE zte3fi0002-blart,
        lv_dynfld TYPE help_info-dynprofld.

  lv_dynfld = 'PA_BELNR'.

  " PA_BLART 화면값 읽기
  lt_fields = VALUE #( ( fieldname = 'PA_BLART' ) ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_READ'
    EXPORTING
      dyname     = sy-repid
      dynumb     = sy-dynnr
    TABLES
      dynpfields = lt_fields
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS     = 11.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '화면 필드 읽기 실패' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_field) WITH KEY fieldname = 'PA_BLART'.
  IF sy-subrc NE 0 OR ls_field-fieldvalue IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '전표 유형을 먼저 선택하세요' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  lv_blart = ls_field-fieldvalue.

  " 해당 BLART 전표번호 조회
  SELECT belnr blart bldat bltxt
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_value
    FROM zte3fi0002
   WHERE bukrs = pa_bukrs
     AND blart = lv_blart
     AND gjahr = pa_gjahr
     AND bstat NE 'T'
     AND budat IN so_budat.

  SORT lt_value BY belnr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_blart '전표 없음' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.


  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield     = 'BELNR'
      dynpprog     = sy-repid
      dynpnr       = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield  = lv_dynfld    " RANGES LOW 필드
      window_title = '전표 번호'
      value_org    = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab    = lt_value.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_kunnr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_kunnr .

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_cust,
          kunnr TYPE zte3sd0001-kunnr,
          name1 TYPE zte3sd0001-name1,
        END OF ls_cust,
        lt_cust   LIKE TABLE OF ls_cust,
        lt_fields TYPE TABLE OF dynpread,
        lr_budat  TYPE RANGE OF zte3fi0002-budat,
        ls_budat  LIKE LINE OF lr_budat,
        lv_dynfld TYPE help_info-dynprofld.

  DATA: lv_rb_all TYPE char1,
        lv_rb_opn TYPE char1,
        lv_rb_clr TYPE char1.

  lv_dynfld = 'PA_KUNNR'.
  " 2. 화면의 전기일(SO_BUD2) 및 라디오 버튼(RB_ALL, RB_OPN, RB_CLR) 값 한 번에 읽기
  lt_fields = VALUE #(
    ( fieldname = 'SO_BUD2-LOW' )
    ( fieldname = 'SO_BUD2-HIGH' )
    ( fieldname = 'RB_ALL' )
    ( fieldname = 'RB_OPN' )
    ( fieldname = 'RB_CLR' )
  ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_READ'
    EXPORTING
      dyname     = sy-repid
      dynumb     = sy-dynnr
    TABLES
      dynpfields = lt_fields
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS     = 1.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '화면 정보를 읽어오지 못했습니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 3. 읽어온 전기일 값을 Range 데이터로 변환
  ls_budat-sign   = 'I'.

  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_low) WITH KEY fieldname = 'SO_BUD2-LOW'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_low-fieldvalue IS NOT INITIAL.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '.' IN ls_low-fieldvalue WITH ''.
    ls_budat-low = ls_low-fieldvalue.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_high) WITH KEY fieldname = 'SO_BUD2-HIGH'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_high-fieldvalue IS NOT INITIAL.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '.' IN ls_high-fieldvalue WITH ''.
    ls_budat-high = ls_high-fieldvalue.
  ENDIF.

  IF ls_budat-low IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_budat-high IS NOT INITIAL.
    ls_budat-option = 'BT'.
    APPEND ls_budat TO lr_budat.
  ELSEIF ls_budat-low IS NOT INITIAL.
    ls_budat-option = 'EQ'.
    APPEND ls_budat TO lr_budat.
  ENDIF.

  " 4. 라디오 버튼 선택 값 변수에 할당 ('X'인지 체크)
  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_all) WITH KEY fieldname = 'RB_ALL'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_rb_all = ls_all-fieldvalue. ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_opn) WITH KEY fieldname = 'RB_OPN'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_rb_opn = ls_opn-fieldvalue. ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_clr) WITH KEY fieldname = 'RB_CLR'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_rb_clr = ls_clr-fieldvalue. ENDIF.


  IF lv_rb_opn = 'X'.       "미결 전표
    SELECT DISTINCT a~kunnr, a~name1
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_cust
      FROM zte3sd0001 AS a
     INNER JOIN zte3fi0002 AS b ON a~kunnr = b~kunnr
     WHERE b~bukrs = @pa_buk2
       AND b~gjahr = @pa_gja2
       AND b~budat IN @lr_budat
       AND b~blart IN ('DR', 'DZ')
       AND b~bstat = ''
       AND a~kunnr NE ''.

  ELSEIF lv_rb_clr = 'X'.   " 반제 전표] 도메인에 정의된 'C' 상태만 조회
    SELECT DISTINCT a~kunnr, a~name1
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_cust
      FROM zte3sd0001 AS a
     INNER JOIN zte3fi0002 AS b ON a~kunnr = b~kunnr
     WHERE b~bukrs = @pa_buk2
       AND b~gjahr = @pa_gja2
       AND b~budat IN @lr_budat
       AND b~blart IN ('DR', 'DZ')
       AND b~bstat = 'C'            " <-- 반제 조건: 'C' (반제)
       AND a~kunnr NE ''.

  ELSE.  " 전체 전표
    SELECT DISTINCT a~kunnr, a~name1
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_cust
      FROM zte3sd0001 AS a
     INNER JOIN zte3fi0002 AS b ON a~kunnr = b~kunnr
     WHERE b~bukrs = @pa_buk2
       AND b~gjahr = @pa_gja2
       AND b~budat IN @lr_budat
       AND b~blart IN ('DR', 'DZ')
       AND b~bstat NE 'T'
       AND a~kunnr NE ''.
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_cust BY kunnr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '조건에 부합하는 고객이 없습니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield     = 'KUNNR'
      dynpprog     = sy-repid
      dynpnr       = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield  = lv_dynfld
      window_title = '고객 번호 조회'
      value_org    = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab    = lt_cust.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_lifnr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_lifnr .

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_vend,
          lifnr TYPE zte3mm0002-lifnr,
          vennm TYPE zte3mm0002-vennm,
        END OF ls_vend,
        lt_vend   LIKE TABLE OF ls_vend,
        lt_fields TYPE TABLE OF dynpread,
        lr_budat  TYPE RANGE OF zte3fi0002-budat,
        ls_budat  LIKE LINE OF lr_budat,
        lv_rb_all TYPE char1,
        lv_rb_opn TYPE char1,
        lv_rb_clr TYPE char1.

  " 화면 필드 읽기
  lt_fields = VALUE #(
    ( fieldname = 'SO_BUD3-LOW'  )
    ( fieldname = 'SO_BUD3-HIGH' )
    ( fieldname = 'RB_ALL2'      )
    ( fieldname = 'RB_OPN2'      )
    ( fieldname = 'RB_CLR2'      )
  ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_READ'
    EXPORTING
      dyname     = sy-repid
      dynumb     = sy-dynnr
    TABLES
      dynpfields = lt_fields
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS     = 1.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '화면 정보를 읽어오지 못했습니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 전기일 Range 변환
  ls_budat-sign = 'I'.

  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_low)  WITH KEY fieldname = 'SO_BUD3-LOW'.
  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_high) WITH KEY fieldname = 'SO_BUD3-HIGH'.

  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_low-fieldvalue IS NOT INITIAL.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '.' IN ls_low-fieldvalue  WITH ''.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '.' IN ls_high-fieldvalue WITH ''.
    ls_budat-low  = ls_low-fieldvalue.
    ls_budat-high = ls_high-fieldvalue.
    IF ls_budat-high IS NOT INITIAL.
      ls_budat-option = 'BT'.
    ELSE.
      ls_budat-option = 'EQ'.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND ls_budat TO lr_budat.
  ENDIF.

  " 라디오 버튼 값 읽기
  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_all) WITH KEY fieldname = 'RB_ALL2'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_rb_all = ls_all-fieldvalue. ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_opn) WITH KEY fieldname = 'RB_OPN2'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_rb_opn = ls_opn-fieldvalue. ENDIF.

  READ TABLE lt_fields INTO DATA(ls_clr) WITH KEY fieldname = 'RB_CLR2'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_rb_clr = ls_clr-fieldvalue. ENDIF.

  " 조건별 공급업체 조회
  IF lv_rb_opn = 'X'.       " 미결
    SELECT DISTINCT a~lifnr, a~vennm
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_vend
      FROM zte3mm0002 AS a
     INNER JOIN zte3fi0002 AS b ON a~lifnr = b~lifnr
     WHERE b~bukrs  =  @pa_buk3
       AND b~gjahr  =  @pa_gja3
       AND b~budat  IN @lr_budat
       AND b~lifnr  NE @space
       AND b~kunnr  =  @space
       AND b~bstat  =  ' '
       AND b~stblg  =  @space
       AND b~open_flag = 'X'
       AND b~blart  NE 'AB'
       AND b~blart  IN ('KR', 'RE', 'KZ', 'PR').

  ELSEIF lv_rb_clr = 'X'.   " 반제
    SELECT DISTINCT a~lifnr, a~vennm
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_vend
      FROM zte3mm0002 AS a
     INNER JOIN zte3fi0002 AS b ON a~lifnr = b~lifnr
     WHERE b~bukrs  =  @pa_buk3
       AND b~gjahr  =  @pa_gja3
       AND b~budat  IN @lr_budat
       AND b~lifnr  NE @space
       AND b~kunnr  =  @space
       AND b~stblg  =  @space
       AND b~bstat  =  'C'
       AND b~blart  IN ('KR', 'RE', 'KZ', 'PR').

  ELSE.                      " 전체
    SELECT DISTINCT a~lifnr, a~vennm
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_vend
      FROM zte3mm0002 AS a
     INNER JOIN zte3fi0002 AS b ON a~lifnr = b~lifnr
     WHERE b~bukrs  =  @pa_buk3
       AND b~gjahr  =  @pa_gja3
       AND b~budat  IN @lr_budat
       AND b~lifnr  NE @space
       AND b~kunnr  =  @space
       AND b~bstat  NE 'T'
       AND b~blart  NE 'AB'
       AND b~blart  IN ('KR', 'RE', 'KZ', 'PR').
  ENDIF.

  SORT lt_vend BY lifnr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '조건에 부합하는 공급업체가 없습니다' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield     = 'LIFNR'
      dynpprog     = sy-repid
      dynpnr       = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield  = 'SO_LIF-LOW'
      window_title = '공급업체 조회'
      value_org    = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab    = lt_vend.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_date
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_date .

  DATA: lv_start_date TYPE sy-datum.
  " 3달 전으로 연산 처리
  CALL FUNCTION 'RP_CALC_DATE_IN_INTERVAL'
    EXPORTING
      date      = sy-datum
      days      = 0
      months    = 3
      signum    = '-' " 빼기
      years     = 0
    IMPORTING
      calc_date = lv_start_date.

  "연도 다를 경우 오류 방지
  IF lv_start_date(4) NE pa_gjahr.
    lv_start_date = |{ pa_gjahr }0101|. " 예: 20260101
  ENDIF.

  REFRESH: so_budat, so_bud2, so_bud3.

  " 탭1 기간 세팅
  so_budat-sign   = 'I'.
  so_budat-option = 'BT'.
  so_budat-low    = lv_start_date.
  so_budat-high   = sy-datum.
  APPEND so_budat.

  " 탭2 기간 세팅
  so_bud2-sign    = 'I'.
  so_bud2-option  = 'BT'.
  so_bud2-low     = lv_start_date.
  so_bud2-high    = sy-datum.
  APPEND so_bud2.

  " 탭3 기간 세팅
  so_bud3-sign    = 'I'.
  so_bud3-option  = 'BT'.
  so_bud3-low     = lv_start_date.
  so_bud3-high    = sy-datum.
  APPEND so_bud3.

ENDFORM.

    FROM zte3cm0001

   WHERE bukrs = pa_bukrs.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_belnr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_belnr .

  IF so_belnr[] IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF ( so_belnr-low  IS NOT INITIAL AND so_belnr-low  CN '0123456789 ' ) OR
       ( so_belnr-high IS NOT INITIAL AND so_belnr-high CN '0123456789 ' ).
      MESSAGE e000 WITH '전표 번호에 숫자가 아닌 문자가 포함되어 있습니다.'.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT SINGLE belnr
      FROM zte3fi0002
      INTO @DATA(lv_belnr_chk)
     WHERE belnr IN @so_belnr
       AND bukrs EQ @pa_bukrs
       AND gjahr EQ @pa_gjahr.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      MESSAGE e000 WITH '존재하지 않는 전표번호입니다. 다시 확인해 주세요.'.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_bp
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_bp .

  DATA: lv_gjahr_tmp  TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr,
        lv_budat_low  TYPE zte3fi0002-budat,
        lv_budat_high TYPE zte3fi0002-budat.

  CASE tab_block-activetab.
    WHEN 'COMM1'.
      lv_gjahr_tmp  = pa_gjahr.
      lv_budat_low  = so_budat-low.
      lv_budat_high = so_budat-high.

    WHEN 'COMM2'. " 고객
      lv_gjahr_tmp  = pa_gja2.
      lv_budat_low  = so_bud2-low.
      lv_budat_high = so_bud2-high.

      " 시작값(Low) 체크
      IF so_kun-low IS NOT INITIAL.
        SELECT SINGLE kunnr FROM zte3sd0001 INTO @DATA(lv_k_low) WHERE kunnr = @so_kun-low.
        IF sy-subrc NE 0.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH '잘못된 고객번호입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          STOP.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      " 종료값(High) 체크
      IF so_kun-high IS NOT INITIAL.
        SELECT SINGLE kunnr FROM zte3sd0001 INTO @DATA(lv_k_high) WHERE kunnr = @so_kun-high.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH '잘못된 고객번호입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          STOP.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN 'COMM3'. " 공급업체
      lv_gjahr_tmp = pa_gja3.
      lv_budat_low = so_bud3-low.
      lv_budat_high = so_bud3-high.

      " 시작값(Low) 체크
      IF so_lif-low IS NOT INITIAL.
        SELECT SINGLE lifnr FROM zte3mm0002 INTO @DATA(lv_l_low) WHERE lifnr = @so_lif-low.
        IF sy-subrc NE 0.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH '잘못된 공급업체번호입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          STOP.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      " 종료값(High) 체크
      IF so_lif-high IS NOT INITIAL.
        SELECT SINGLE lifnr FROM zte3mm0002 INTO @DATA(lv_l_high) WHERE lifnr = @so_lif-high.
        IF sy-subrc NE 0.
          MESSAGE s000 WITH '잘못된 공급업체번호입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
          STOP.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
  ENDCASE.

  IF gv_min_gjahr IS INITIAL.
    gv_min_gjahr = sy-datum(4).
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_gjahr_tmp IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '회계연도를 입력하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.

  ELSEIF lv_gjahr_tmp < gv_min_gjahr OR lv_gjahr_tmp > sy-datum(4).
    MESSAGE s000 WITH |{ gv_min_gjahr }년부터 현재까지만 조회 가능합니다.| DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_budat_low IS NOT INITIAL.
    " 기간 역전 체크
    IF lv_budat_high IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_budat_low > lv_budat_high.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '시작일이 종료일보다 클 수 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.
    " 연도 일치 체크 (Low와 High 둘 다 체크)
    IF lv_budat_low(4) NE lv_gjahr_tmp OR
       ( lv_budat_high IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_budat_high(4) NE lv_gjahr_tmp ).
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '전기일의 연도가 회계연도와 일치하지 않습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.
    " 오늘 날짜 체크
    IF lv_budat_low > sy-datum.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '오늘 이후 날짜는 조회할 수 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_stgrd
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_stgrd .
*
*  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_stgrd,
*          stgrd      TYPE zte3fi0002-stgrd,
*          ddtext(20),
*        END OF ls_stgrd.
*
*  DATA : lt_stgrd LIKE TABLE OF ls_stgrd,
*         lr_stgrd TYPE RANGE OF dd07t-domvalue_l.
*
*  DATA: lt_return TYPE TABLE OF ddshretval,
*        ls_return TYPE ddshretval,
*        lt_dynp   TYPE TABLE OF dynpread,
*        ls_dynp   TYPE dynpread.
*
*  lr_stgrd = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '01' )
*                      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '02' )
*                      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '03' ) ).
*
*  CASE gs_header-blart.
*    WHEN 'DR' OR 'KR'.
*      " 매출/매입 전표: 04(반품 처리), 05(월마감 전 수정) 추가
*      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '04' ) TO lr_stgrd.
*      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '05' ) TO lr_stgrd.
*
*    WHEN 'DZ' OR 'KZ'.
*      " 입금/지급 전표: 06(통화/환율 오류), 07(거래처 요청 취소) 추가
*      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '06' ) TO lr_stgrd.
*      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '07' ) TO lr_stgrd.
*
*    WHEN OTHERS.
*      " 일반 전표(SA 등): 05(월마감 전 수정) 정도만 추가
*      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '05' ) TO lr_stgrd.
*  ENDCASE.
*
*  " ── DB에서 필터링된 사유 읽기 ──────────────────────
*  SELECT domvalue_l AS stgrd, ddtext
*    FROM dd07t
*    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_stgrd
*   WHERE domname    = 'ZDE3_FI_STGRD'
*     AND domvalue_l IN @lr_stgrd
*     AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu
*   ORDER BY domvalue_l.
*
*  IF lt_stgrd IS INITIAL.
*    MESSAGE s000 WITH '해당 전표 유형에 사용 가능한 사유가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*    RETURN.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  CLEAR lt_return.
*
*  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
*    EXPORTING
*      retfield        = 'STGRD'
*      dynpprog        = sy-repid
*      dynpnr          = sy-dynnr
*      dynprofield     = 'GV_STGRD'
*      value_org       = 'S'
*    TABLES
*      value_tab       = lt_stgrd
*      return_tab      = lt_return
*    EXCEPTIONS
*      parameter_error = 1
*      no_values_found = 2
*      OTHERS          = 3.
*
*  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
*  READ TABLE lt_return INTO ls_return INDEX 1.
*  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
*
*  " 선택된 값 할당
*  gv_stgrd = ls_return-fieldval.
*
*  " 텍스트 자동 매핑
*  READ TABLE lt_stgrd INTO ls_stgrd WITH KEY stgrd = gv_stgrd.
*  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*    gv_stgrd_txt = ls_stgrd-ddtext.
*  ENDIF.
*
*  CLEAR lt_dynp.
*  APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'GV_STGRD'     fieldvalue = gv_stgrd )     TO lt_dynp.
*  APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'GV_STGRD_TXT' fieldvalue = gv_stgrd_txt ) TO lt_dynp.
*
*  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE'
*    EXPORTING
*      dyname     = sy-repid
*      dynumb     = sy-dynnr
*    TABLES
*      dynpfields = lt_dynp
*    EXCEPTIONS
*      OTHERS     = 1.

  " 1. 텍스트 필드의 타입을 표준 타입(60자)으로 변경하여 데이터 누락 방지
  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_stgrd,
          stgrd  TYPE zte3fi0002-stgrd,
          ddtext TYPE dd07t-ddtext, " <-- 기존 ddtext(20)에서 수정
        END OF ls_stgrd.

  DATA : lt_stgrd LIKE TABLE OF ls_stgrd,
         lr_stgrd TYPE RANGE OF dd07t-domvalue_l.

  DATA: lt_return TYPE TABLE OF ddshretval,
        ls_return TYPE ddshretval,
        lt_dynp   TYPE TABLE OF dynpread,
        ls_dynp   TYPE dynpread.

  " ── 기본 공통 사유 설정 ───────────────────────────
  lr_stgrd = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '01' )
                      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '02' )
                      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '03' ) ).

  " ── 전표 유형별 조건부 사유 추가 ───────────────────
  CASE gs_header-blart.
    WHEN 'DR' OR 'KR'.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '04' ) TO lr_stgrd.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '05' ) TO lr_stgrd.
    WHEN 'DZ' OR 'KZ'.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '06' ) TO lr_stgrd.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '07' ) TO lr_stgrd.
    WHEN OTHERS.
      APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '05' ) TO lr_stgrd.
  ENDCASE.

  " ── DB에서 로그인 언어 기준 도메인 텍스트 조회 ──────────
  SELECT domvalue_l AS stgrd, ddtext
    FROM dd07t
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_stgrd
   WHERE domname    = 'ZDE3_FI_STGRD'
     AND domvalue_l IN @lr_stgrd
     AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu
   ORDER BY domvalue_l.

  IF lt_stgrd IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '해당 전표 유형에 사용 가능한 사유가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " ── F4 팝업 창 호출 ───────────────────────────────
  CLEAR lt_return.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield        = 'STGRD'
      dynpprog        = sy-repid
      dynpnr          = sy-dynnr
*     dynprofield     = 'GV_STGRD' " 2. 화면 반영 충돌을 막기 위해 반드시 주석 처리!
      value_org       = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab       = lt_stgrd
      return_tab      = lt_return
    EXCEPTIONS
      parameter_error = 1
      no_values_found = 2
      OTHERS          = 3.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  READ TABLE lt_return INTO ls_return INDEX 1.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  " ── 선택된 값 및 텍스트 매핑 ───────────────────────
  gv_stgrd = ls_return-fieldval.

  READ TABLE lt_stgrd INTO ls_stgrd WITH KEY stgrd = gv_stgrd.
  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    gv_stgrd_txt = ls_stgrd-ddtext.
  ELSE.
    CLEAR gv_stgrd_txt.
  ENDIF.

  " ── 3. Dynpro 화면 필드 강제 업데이트 (코드 + 텍스트 동시 반영) ──
  CLEAR lt_dynp.

  " 사유 코드 반영
  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GV_STGRD'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gv_stgrd.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.

  " 사유 텍스트 반영
  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GV_STGRD_TXT'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gv_stgrd_txt.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE'
    EXPORTING
      dyname     = sy-repid
      dynumb     = sy-dynnr
    TABLES
      dynpfields = lt_dynp
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS     = 1.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_pernr_pop
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_pernr_pop .

  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_emp_f4,
           pernr  TYPE zte3cm0005-pernr,
           pernam TYPE zte3cm0005-pernam,
           btrtl  TYPE zte3cm0005-btrtl,
           grade  TYPE zte3cm0005-grade,
         END OF ty_emp_f4.

  DATA: lt_emp_f4 TYPE TABLE OF ty_emp_f4,
        ls_emp_f4 TYPE ty_emp_f4.

  DATA: lt_return TYPE TABLE OF ddshretval,
        ls_return TYPE ddshretval,
        lt_dynp   TYPE TABLE OF dynpread,
        ls_dynp   TYPE dynpread.

  " 데이터 추출 (회계팀 전용)
  SELECT pernr, pernam, btrtl, grade
    FROM zte3cm0005
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_emp_f4
   WHERE btrtl = 'ACCT'
   ORDER BY pernr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '등록된 회계팀 사원 정보가 없습니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST 호출
  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield        = 'PERNR'
      dynpprog        = sy-repid
      dynpnr          = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield     = 'GS_EMP-PERNR'
      window_title    = '사원 정보 조회'
      value_org       = 'S'
    TABLES
      value_tab       = lt_emp_f4
      return_tab      = lt_return
    EXCEPTIONS
      parameter_error = 1
      no_values_found = 2
      OTHERS          = 3.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
  CHECK lt_return IS NOT INITIAL.

  READ TABLE lt_return INTO ls_return INDEX 1.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  READ TABLE lt_emp_f4 INTO ls_emp_f4 WITH KEY pernr = ls_return-fieldval.
  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  gs_emp-pernr  = ls_emp_f4-pernr.
  gs_emp-pernam = ls_emp_f4-pernam.
  gs_emp-btrtl  = ls_emp_f4-btrtl.
  gs_emp-grade  = ls_emp_f4-grade.

  " 부서 텍스트
  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO gv_btrtl_text
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_CM_BTRTL'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gs_emp-btrtl
     AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.

  " 직급 텍스트
  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO gv_grade_text
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_CM_GRADE'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gs_emp-grade
     AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.

  " DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE 필드 매핑
  CLEAR lt_dynp.

  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GS_EMP-PERNR'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gs_emp-pernr.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.

  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GS_EMP-PERNAM'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gs_emp-pernam.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.

  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GS_EMP-BTRTL'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gs_emp-btrtl.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.

  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GS_EMP-GRADE'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gs_emp-grade.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.

  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GV_BTRTL_TEXT'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gv_btrtl_text.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.

  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GV_GRADE_TEXT'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gv_grade_text.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE'
    EXPORTING
      dyname     = sy-repid
      dynumb     = sy-dynnr
    TABLES
      dynpfields = lt_dynp
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS     = 1.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_pername
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_pername .

  IF gs_emp-pernr IS INITIAL.
    CLEAR: gs_emp-pernam, gs_emp-btrtl, gs_emp-grade.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE pernam btrtl grade
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF gs_emp
    FROM zte3cm0005
   WHERE pernr EQ gs_emp-pernr
    AND btrtl EQ 'ACCT'.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    CLEAR: gs_emp-pernam, gs_emp-btrtl, gs_emp-grade.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '존재하지 않는 회계팀 사원번호입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.


  " 부서 텍스트
  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO gv_btrtl_text
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_CM_BTRTL'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gs_emp-btrtl
     AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.

  " 직급 텍스트
  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO gv_grade_text
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_CM_GRADE'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gs_emp-grade
     AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout_rev
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout_rev .
  " 역분개 일자 자동 세팅
  IF gv_rev_date IS INITIAL.
    gv_rev_date = sy-datum.
  ENDIF.

  " 역분개 코드 입력 시 텍스트 자동 조회
  CLEAR gv_stgrd_txt.
  CHECK gv_stgrd IS NOT INITIAL.

  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO gv_stgrd_txt
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_STGRD'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gv_stgrd
     AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_stgrd
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_stgrd .

  IF gv_stgrd IS INITIAL.
    CLEAR gv_stgrd_txt.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE ddtext
    INTO gv_stgrd_txt
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    EQ 'ZDE3_FI_STGRD'
     AND domvalue_l EQ gv_stgrd
     AND ddlanguage EQ sy-langu.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    CLEAR gv_stgrd_txt.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '존재하지 않는 역분개 사유코드입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form close_rev
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM close_rev .

  CLEAR : gv_rev_confirm, gs_emp-pernr, gs_emp-pernam, gv_stgrd, gs_emp-btrtl,
gv_btrtl_text, gs_emp-grade, gv_grade_text.

  IF gcl_container_pop IS BOUND.
    gcl_container_pop->free( ).
    FREE gcl_container_pop.
  ENDIF.

  IF gcl_document_top_pop IS NOT INITIAL.
    CLEAR gcl_document_top_pop.
  ENDIF.

  LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form xblnr_popup
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_HEADER_XBLNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM xblnr_popup  USING  pv_xblnr TYPE zte3fi0002-xblnr
                         pv_gjahr TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr.

  DATA : lv_belnr TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr.

  CASE pv_xblnr(2).

    WHEN '30'.
      lv_belnr = pv_xblnr.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0006'
        EXPORTING
          iv_belnr = lv_belnr                " [FI] 전표 번호
          iv_bukrs = '1000'           " [FI] 회사코드
          iv_gjahr = pv_gjahr.                   " [FI] 회계연도

    WHEN '10'.
      lv_belnr = pv_xblnr.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0006'
        EXPORTING
          iv_belnr = lv_belnr                " [FI] 전표 번호
          iv_bukrs = '1000'           " [FI] 회사코드
          iv_gjahr = pv_gjahr.                   " [FI] 회계연도
    WHEN 'WO'.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0008'
        EXPORTING
          iv_aufnr = pv_xblnr.                 " [PP] 생산 오더 번호

    WHEN 'MM'.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0010'
        EXPORTING
          iv_prueflos = pv_xblnr.                 " [QM] 검수번호

    WHEN 'PP' OR 'QM'.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0010'
        EXPORTING
          iv_prueflos = CONV zte3qm0001( pv_xblnr ).                 " [QM] 검수번호

    WHEN 'OD'. "구매오더?

      DATA : lv_lfnum TYPE zte3sd0012-lfnum.

      lv_lfnum = pv_xblnr.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0009'
        EXPORTING
          iv_lfnum = lv_lfnum.                  " [SD] 납품번호
  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.

title: ZRE3FI0003_S01
body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZRE3FI0003_S01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
SELECTION-SCREEN FUNCTION KEY 1.
"TAB1
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 1100 AS SUBSCREEN.

  PARAMETERS:     pa_bukrs TYPE zte3fi0002-bukrs.
  SELECTION-SCREEN COMMENT 42(15) gv_butxt.
  PARAMETERS:     pa_gjahr TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr.
  PARAMETERS:     pa_blart TYPE zte3fi0002-blart AS LISTBOX VISIBLE LENGTH 17 OBLIGATORY.
  SELECT-OPTIONS: so_belnr FOR zte3fi0002-belnr,
                  so_budat FOR zte3fi0002-budat.

SELECTION-SCREEN END OF SCREEN 1100.
"TAB2 고객.
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 1200 AS SUBSCREEN.

  PARAMETERS:     pa_buk2 TYPE zte3fi0002-bukrs.
  SELECTION-SCREEN COMMENT 42(15) gv_txt2.
  PARAMETERS :     pa_gja2 TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr.

  SELECT-OPTIONS : so_bud2 FOR zte3fi0002-budat,
                   so_kun  FOR zte3sd0001-kunnr.

  SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF LINE.
    SELECTION-SCREEN COMMENT 1(20) TEXT-t02.
    SELECTION-SCREEN POSITION 35.
    PARAMETERS: rb_all RADIOBUTTON GROUP gr2 DEFAULT 'X'.
    SELECTION-SCREEN COMMENT (8) FOR FIELD rb_all.
    SELECTION-SCREEN POSITION 54.
    PARAMETERS: rb_opn RADIOBUTTON GROUP gr2.
    SELECTION-SCREEN COMMENT (8) FOR FIELD rb_opn.
    SELECTION-SCREEN POSITION 73.
    PARAMETERS: rb_clr RADIOBUTTON GROUP gr2.
    SELECTION-SCREEN COMMENT (8) FOR FIELD rb_clr.
  SELECTION-SCREEN END OF LINE.

SELECTION-SCREEN END OF SCREEN 1200.

*TAB3 공급업체
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 1300 AS SUBSCREEN.

  PARAMETERS:     pa_buk3 TYPE zte3fi0002-bukrs.
  SELECTION-SCREEN COMMENT 42(15) gv_txt3.
  PARAMETERS:     pa_gja3 TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr.
  SELECT-OPTIONS: so_bud3 FOR zte3fi0002-budat,

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include ZRE3FI0003_TOP                           - Report ZRE3FI0003
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
REPORT zre3fi0003 MESSAGE-ID zmce3.

TABLES: zte3fi0002, zte3fi0003, zte3cm0005,
        sscrfields, zte3sd0001, zte3mm0002, zte3co0002.


DATA : gv_min_gjahr TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr.
*DATA : gv_butxt TYPE zte3cm0001-butxt.
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 탭스트립 컨트롤 선언
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
CONTROLS gc_tab TYPE TABSTRIP.

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 탭 제어 변수
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gv_tab          TYPE sy-ucomm,   " 현재 활성 탭 ID (COMM1/COMM2/COMM3)
      gv_top_flag(10),                 " 상단 요약 도큐먼트 출력 기준 탭 ID
      gv_tab_sub      TYPE sy-dynnr.   " 탭별 서브스크린 다이너 번호

CONSTANTS gc_mem_tab TYPE char20 VALUE 'ZFI_TAB'. " MEMORY ID - 탭 상태 저장용

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 탭 타이틀 (선택화면 탭 라벨)
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: tab_all(10), " 전체 전표 탭 타이틀
      tab_kur(10), " 고객 전표 탭 타이틀
      tab_lif(10), " 공급업체 전표 탭 타이틀
      tab_gl(10).  " GL 전표 탭 타이틀

*INCLUDE <icon>. " SAP 표준 아이콘 심볼 선언

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 역분개 팝업 - 요청자 사원 정보
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: BEGIN OF gs_emp,
        pernr  TYPE zte3cm0005-pernr,  " 사번
        pernam TYPE zte3cm0005-pernam, " 성명
        btrtl  TYPE zte3cm0005-btrtl,  " 부서
        grade  TYPE zte3cm0005-grade,  " 직급
      END OF gs_emp.

DATA : gv_btrtl_text(10),
       gv_grade_text(5).

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 역분개 팝업 - 사유 텍스트 / 역분개 처리일
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gv_stgrd_txt TYPE char60,           " 역분개 사유 도메인 텍스트
      gv_rev_date  TYPE zte3fi0002-rev_date. " 역분개 처리일

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 역분개 저장용 헤더 구조체
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA gs_rev TYPE zte3fi0002. " 역분개 전표 헤더 (INSERT 대상)

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 팝업 차/대변 합계 (PDF 출력 및 팝업 표시용)
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gv_popup_dmbtr_s TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr, " 차변 합계 (Debit)
      gv_popup_dmbtr_h TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr. " 대변 합계 (Credit)

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 공통 변수
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gv_dmbtr_s     TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr,    " 아이템 차변 누계
      gv_dmbtr_h     TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr,    " 아이템 대변 누계
      gv_popup_xblnr TYPE zte3fi0002-xblnr,    " 팝업용 참조번호
      gv_stgrd       TYPE zte3fi0002-stgrd,    " 역분개 사유코드 (입력값)
      gv_rev_confirm TYPE c LENGTH 1,          " 역분개 팝업 확인 플래그 ('X': 확인)
      gv_mode(5),                              " 조회 모드 (ALL/AR_A/AR_O 등)
      gv_okcode      TYPE sy-ucomm,            " 화면 OK-CODE
      gv_text        TYPE sdydo_text_element,  " HTML 도큐먼트 텍스트 버퍼
      gv_sel_belnr   TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,    " 역분개 대상 전표번호
      gv_sel_gjahr   TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr,    " 역분개 대상 회계연도
      gv_sel_bukrs   TYPE zte3fi0002-bukrs.    " 역분개 대상 회사코드

DATA : gv_gjahr TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr.
DATA gv_amt_all TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr.         " 전체 금액 합계 (미사용 예비)

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 상단 요약 집계 변수
"   - 전체 집계
"   - 고객(AR) 집계
"   - 공급업체(AP) 집계
"   - 날짜 범위
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gv_cnt_total     TYPE i,              " 전체 전표 건수
      gv_amt_total     TYPE p DECIMALS 2,   " 전체 차변 합계 금액
      gv_cnt_normal    TYPE i,   " 전체 차변 합계 금액

      gv_cnt_temp      TYPE i,              " 임시 전표 건수 (예비)
      gv_amt_temp      TYPE p DECIMALS 2,   " 임시 전표 금액 (예비)

      gv_cnt_pending   TYPE i,              " 미결 전표 건수
      gv_amt_pending   TYPE p DECIMALS 2,   " 미결 전표 금액

      gv_cnt_cleared   TYPE i,              " 반제 전표 건수
      gv_amt_cleared   TYPE p DECIMALS 2,   " 반제 전표 금액

      gv_cnt_reverse   TYPE i,              " 역분개 전표 건수 (blart=AB)
      gv_cnt_reversed  TYPE i,              " 역분개 당한 원본 전표 건수

      " ── 고객(AR) 전표 집계
      gv_cnt_kunner    TYPE i,              " 고객 전표 건수 (AB 제외)
      gv_kunner_rev    TYPE i,              " 역분개 당한 고객 전표 건수
      gv_amt_kunnr     TYPE p DECIMALS 2,   " 고객 전표 총금액
      gv_amt_kunnr_pnd TYPE p DECIMALS 2,   " 고객 미결 금액

      " ── 공급업체(AP) 전표 집계
      gv_cnt_lifnr     TYPE i,              " 공급업체 전표 건수 (AB 제외)
      gv_lifnr_rev     TYPE i,              " 역분개 당한 공급업체 전표 건수
      gv_amt_lifnr     TYPE p DECIMALS 2,   " 공급업체 전표 총금액
      gv_amt_lifnr_pnd TYPE p DECIMALS 2,   " 공급업체 미결 금액

      " ── 조회 날짜 범위 (자동 산출)
      gv_min_date      TYPE d,              " 조회 기간 시작일
      gv_max_date      TYPE d.              " 조회 기간 종료일

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 헤더 내부 테이블 (ALV 출력용 확장 구조)
"   - zte3fi0002 기본 필드 + 아이콘/색상/마스터명 추가
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: BEGIN OF gs_header,
        icon          TYPE icon_d,          " LED 상태 아이콘
        icon_text(10),
        style         TYPE lvc_t_styl,      " ALV 셀 스타일 (버튼 등)
        stat_txt(20),                       " 상태 텍스트 (bstat 원본)
        stgrd_txt(50),                      " 역분개 사유 텍스트
        blart_txt(50),                      " 전표유형 텍스트
        pdf_down      TYPE icon_d,          " PDF 다운 버튼 아이콘
        color         TYPE lvc_t_scol,      " 행 색상 (핫스팟 클릭 시 하이라이트)
        name1         TYPE zte3sd0001-name1, " 고객명
        vennm         TYPE zte3mm0002-vennm, " 공급업체명
        expkz         TYPE zte3sd0001-expkz.
        include structure zte3fi0002.             " FI 전표 헤더 필드 전체 포함
DATA: END OF gs_header.

DATA gt_header LIKE TABLE OF gs_header. " 헤더 내부 테이블

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 아이템 내부 테이블 (원본 + 역분개 공용, ALV 출력용 확장 구조)
"   - zte3fi0003 기본 필드 + 차대변 분리 컬럼 + 계정명 추가
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: BEGIN OF gs_item_data,
        status          TYPE icon_d,           " LED 상태 아이콘 (초록/빨강)
        status_text(10) ,           " LED 상태 아이콘 (초록/빨강)
        shkzg_txt(2),
        style           TYPE lvc_t_styl,       " ALV 셀 스타일
        stblg           TYPE zte3fi0002-stblg, " 역분개 전표번호 (헤더에서 참조)
        dmbtr_s         TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr, " 차변 금액 (Debit 분리)
        dmbtr_h         TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr, " 대변 금액 (Credit 분리)
        waers_s         TYPE zte3fi0003-waers, " 차/대변 통화키
        waers_h         TYPE zte3fi0003-waers, " 차/대변 통화키
        blart           TYPE zte3fi0002-blart, " 전표유형
        blart_txt(20),                       " 전표유형 텍스트
        saknr_txt(40).                       " 계정코드 텍스트 (계정명)
        include structure zte3fi0003.             " FI 전표 아이템 필드 전체 포함
DATA: END OF gs_item_data.

DATA: gt_item_data LIKE TABLE OF gs_item_data, " 아이템 출력 테이블 (헤더 클릭 시 로드)
      gt_rev_item  LIKE TABLE OF gs_item_data. " 역분개 생성 아이템 테이블

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" DB INSERT/UPDATE 전용 zte3fi0003 구조체
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gs_item TYPE zte3fi0003,           " 아이템 단건 구조체
      gt_item LIKE TABLE OF gs_item.    " 원본 아이템 테이블 (역분개 처리용)

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" ALV 관련 객체 선언
"   - Docking Container / Splitter / 헤더 Grid / 아이템 Grid
"   - 상단 HTML Document
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gcl_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container, " Docking 컨테이너
      gcl_splitter          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container, " 3행 Splitter
      gcl_top_container     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,          " 상단 요약 영역
      gcl_alv_container     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,          " 헤더 ALV 영역
      gcl_bottom_container  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,          " 아이템 ALV 영역
      gcl_grid              TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,           " 헤더 ALV Grid
      gcl_grid_bot          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,           " 아이템 ALV Grid
      gcl_document_top      TYPE REF TO cl_dd_document.            " 상단 HTML 도큐먼트

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" ALV 설정 데이터
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gt_fcat    TYPE lvc_t_fcat,    " 헤더 ALV 필드카탈로그
      gt_fcat2   TYPE lvc_t_fcat,    " 아이템 ALV 필드카탈로그
      gs_fcat    TYPE lvc_s_fcat,    " 필드카탈로그 단건 작업용
      gs_layout  TYPE lvc_s_layo,    " ALV 레이아웃
      gs_variant TYPE disvariant,    " ALV 레이아웃 Variant
      gs_stable  TYPE lvc_s_stbl,    " ALV 스크롤 안정화 옵션
      gs_dyntxt  TYPE smp_dyntxt,    " 선택화면 아이콘 버튼 텍스트
      gt_sort    TYPE lvc_t_sort.    " 아이템 ALV 정렬 기준

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 역분개 팝업 화면 관련 객체
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gcl_container_pop    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container, " 팝업 커스텀 컨테이너
      gcl_grid_pop         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,         " 팝업 ALV Grid (예비)
      gt_fcat_pop          TYPE lvc_t_fcat,                     " 팝업 ALV 필드카탈로그 (예비)
      gcl_document_top_pop TYPE REF TO cl_dd_document.          " 팝업 상단 HTML 도큐먼트

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" OLE2 Excel 객체 선언 (PDF 다운 기능용)
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gs_excel        TYPE ole2_object, " Excel Application 객체
      gs_workbook     TYPE ole2_object, " Workbook 컬렉션
      gs_books        TYPE ole2_object, " Workbooks (예비)
      gs_book         TYPE ole2_object, " 단일 Workbook (예비)
      gs_sheets       TYPE ole2_object, " Sheets 컬렉션 (예비)
      gs_sheet        TYPE ole2_object, " 단일 Sheet
      gs_activesheet  TYPE ole2_object, " 현재 활성 Sheet
      gs_application  TYPE ole2_object, " Application 속성
      gs_pagesetup    TYPE ole2_object, " PageSetup (예비)
      gs_cells        TYPE ole2_object, " Cells 범위 (예비)
      gs_entirecolumn TYPE ole2_object, " EntireColumn (예비)
      gs_cell         TYPE ole2_object, " 개별 Cell
      gs_row_e        TYPE ole2_object, " 행 객체 (예비)
      gs_buffer       TYPE ole2_object, " 버퍼 (예비)
      gs_font         TYPE ole2_object, " Font 속성 (예비)
      gs_range        TYPE ole2_object, " Range 범위 (예비)
      gs_borders      TYPE ole2_object, " Borders 속성 (예비)
      gs_cell1        TYPE ole2_object, " 범위 시작 Cell (예비)
      gs_cell2        TYPE ole2_object. " 범위 종료 Cell (예비)

"----------------------------------------------------------------------
" 파일 경로 및 OLE 파일 서비스 관련 변수
"----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA: gcl_objfile          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_frontend_services, " FE 파일 서비스
      gv_pickedfolder      TYPE string,              " 사용자가 선택한 저장 폴더
      gv_initialfolder     TYPE string,              " 폴더 선택 초기 경로
      gv_fullinfo          TYPE string,              " 전체 경로 정보 (예비)
      gv_temp_filename     TYPE rlgrap-filename,     " 임시 XLS 파일 전체 경로
      gv_temp_filename_pdf TYPE rlgrap-filename,     " 저장 PDF 파일 전체 경로
      gv_form(40),                                   " SMW0 등록 템플릿 객체명
      gv_pfolder           TYPE rlgrap-filename,     " 마지막으로 선택한 폴더 (세션 유지)
      gv_filename          TYPE rlgrap-filename,     " XLS 파일명 (경로 제외)
      gv_filename_pdf      TYPE rlgrap-filename,     " PDF 파일명 (경로 제외)
      gv_file              TYPE rlgrap-filename.     " 다운로드 대상 파일 전체 경로


DEFINE check_date_range.

*  IF &1-low IS INITIAL OR &1-high IS INITIAL.
*    MESSAGE s000 WITH '조회기간을 입력하세요' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
*    STOP.
*  ENDIF.

  IF &1-low IS NOT INITIAL OR &1-high IS NOT INITIAL.
    CLEAR lv_limit.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RP_CALC_DATE_IN_INTERVAL'
      EXPORTING
        date      = &1-low
        days      = 0
        months    = 3
        signum    = '+'
        years     = 0
      IMPORTING
        calc_date = &2.

    IF &1-high > lv_limit.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '조회 기간은 최대 3개월까지만 가능합니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
END-OF-DEFINITION.

title: ZRE3FI0007
body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Report ZRE3FI0007
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& 감가상각 배치잡 프로그램
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

include zre3fi0007_top.    " Global Data
include zre3fi0007_f01.  " FORM-Routines

INITIALIZATION.
  PERFORM check_uname.

START-OF-SELECTION.

  PERFORM start_data.

  " 배치잡 완료 6월 30일부터


* LINR = 정액법 (Straight-Line) "
*  " 정액법: 취득원가 / 내용연수 / 12
*  "건물, 구축물 등
*
** DECL = 정률법 (Declining Balance) " 정률법: 장부가액 × (2/내용연수) / 12
*  " 기계장치 등


*Messages
*----------------------------------------------------------
*
* Message class: ZMCE3
*000   & & & &

title: ZRE3FI0007_F01
body:
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZRE3FI0007_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form start_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM start_data . "감가상각 실행

  DATA: lv_calc_depr TYPE p DECIMALS 4,
        lv_gjahr     TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr,
        lv_monat     TYPE zte3fi0002-monat.

  lv_gjahr = sy-datum(4).
  lv_monat = sy-datum+4(2).

  REFRESH: gt_data, gt_depr.

  SELECT *
    FROM zte3cm0002
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data
   WHERE bukrs = @gv_bukrs
     AND afasl NE 'NONE'.

  IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '상각 대상 데이터가 존재하지 않습니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

*  당월 중복 실행 체크
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM zte3cm0007
   WHERE bukrs = @gv_bukrs
     AND gjahr = @lv_gjahr
     AND monat = @lv_monat.

  IF sy-dbcnt > 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH lv_gjahr '년' lv_monat '월 감가상각이 이미 처리되었습니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 감가상각 계산 루프
  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_data>).

    CLEAR: lv_calc_depr, gs_depr.

    " 상각방법별 계산
    CASE <ls_data>-afasl.
      WHEN 'LINR'. " 정액법: 취득원가 / 내용연수 / 12
        IF <ls_data>-alife > 0.
          lv_calc_depr = <ls_data>-aprice / <ls_data>-alife / 12.
        ENDIF.

      WHEN 'DECL'. " 정률법: (취득원가 - 누계액) * (2 / 내용연수) / 12
        IF <ls_data>-alife > 0.
          lv_calc_depr = ( <ls_data>-aprice - <ls_data>-accum ) * ( 2 / <ls_data>-alife ) / 12.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

    " 잔액 초과 방지
    IF <ls_data>-accum + lv_calc_depr > <ls_data>-aprice.
      lv_calc_depr = <ls_data>-aprice - <ls_data>-accum.
    ENDIF.

    " 이력 테이블
    gs_depr-mandt = sy-mandt.
    gs_depr-bukrs = <ls_data>-bukrs.
    gs_depr-gjahr = lv_gjahr.
    gs_depr-monat = lv_monat.
    gs_depr-anln1 = <ls_data>-anln1.
    gs_depr-depr  = lv_calc_depr.                     " 당월 상각액
    gs_depr-accum = <ls_data>-accum + lv_calc_depr.   " 새로운 누계액
    gs_depr-waers = <ls_data>-waers.
    gs_depr-erdat = sy-datum.
    gs_depr-erzet = sy-uzeit.
    gs_depr-ernam = sy-uname.

    APPEND gs_depr TO gt_depr.

    " 마스터 테이블 갱신
    <ls_data>-accum = gs_depr-accum.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF gt_depr IS NOT INITIAL.

    MODIFY zte3cm0007 FROM TABLE gt_depr. " 이력 적재
    MODIFY zte3cm0002 FROM TABLE gt_data. " 마스터 갱신

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      "전표 생성
      PERFORM post_document USING lv_gjahr lv_monat.

      IF gv_belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
        MESSAGE s000 WITH | { lv_monat } 월 감가상각 처리 완료 |.
      ENDIF.

    ELSE.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '데이터 저장 실패' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      ROLLBACK WORK.

    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_uname
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_uname .

  gv_bukrs = '1000'.
  gv_pernr = '10000207'.

  IF sy-uname NE 'NCODE-E-05'.
    LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form post_document
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_GJAHR
*&      --> LV_MONAT
*&      --> LV_BELNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM post_document  USING    pv_gjahr TYPE zte3fi0002-gjahr
                             pv_monat TYPE zte3fi0002-monat.


  " 변수 선언 - LOOP 내 DATA() 인라인 금지
  DATA: lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        ls_item   TYPE zte3fi0003,
        ls_depr   TYPE zte3cm0007,   " ← LOOP INTO 대상 선언
        ls_master TYPE zte3cm0002,   " ← READ TABLE INTO 대상 선언
        ls_header TYPE zte3fi0002,
        lv_date   TYPE sy-datum.

  CALL FUNCTION 'RP_LAST_DAY_OF_MONTHS'
    EXPORTING
      day_in            = sy-datum                " Key date
    IMPORTING
      last_day_of_month = lv_date.                 " Date of last day of the month from key  date


  ls_header = VALUE zte3fi0002(
                  bukrs = gv_bukrs
                  blart = 'SA'
                  waers = 'KRW'
                  budat = lv_date   "월말일을 계산
                  bldat = lv_date
                  pernr = gv_pernr
                  bltxt = |{ pv_gjahr }년 { pv_monat }월 감가상각|
  ).

  LOOP AT gt_depr INTO ls_depr WHERE depr > 0.

    READ TABLE gt_data INTO ls_master WITH KEY anln1 = ls_depr-anln1.
    "차변
    ls_item = VALUE #(
      saknr = '5200000009' "감가상각비
      shkzg = 'S'
      dmbtr = ls_depr-depr
      kostl = ls_master-kostl
    ).
    APPEND ls_item TO lt_item.
    "대변
    ls_item = VALUE #(
      saknr = '1300000006' "감가상각누계액
      shkzg = 'H'
      dmbtr = ls_depr-depr
      anln1 = ls_depr-anln1
    ).
    APPEND ls_item TO lt_item.

  ENDLOOP.

  CHECK lt_item IS NOT INITIAL.

  zcl_e3_fi_document=>post_document(
      EXPORTING is_header = ls_header
                it_items  = lt_item
      IMPORTING
                ev_belnr  = gv_belnr
                ).

ENDFORM.
