*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include          ZRE3FI0008_F01
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_init_value
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_init_value .

  pa_bukrs = '1000'.
  pa_gjahr = sy-datum(4).

  SELECT SINGLE butxt
   FROM zte3cm0001
    INTO gv_butxt
   WHERE bukrs = pa_bukrs.

  pa_anlkl = 'ALL'. "기본값은 항상 전체

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  REFRESH : gr_anlkl, gt_data_disp.

  IF pa_anlkl NE 'ALL'.

    gr_anlkl = VALUE #( BASE gr_anlkl

                      ( low    = pa_anlkl
                        sign   = 'I'
                        option = 'EQ' )

                       ).
  ENDIF.

  SELECT bukrs anln1 anlnt anlkl afasl
         alife abudat aprice accum waers kostl belnr gjahr
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE gt_data
    FROM zte3cm0002
   WHERE bukrs EQ pa_bukrs
     AND anlkl IN gr_anlkl
     AND abflg NE 'X'. "처분 자산 플래그

  IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '조회된 자산이 없습니다.'.
    RETURN.

  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_data BY bukrs anlkl anln1.
  PERFORM data_mapping.
  PERFORM get_item_data. "zcds_e3_cm_0001

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_layout
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_layout .

  gs_layout = VALUE #(
                        zebra        = 'X'
                        cwidth_opt   = 'A'
                        sel_mode     = 'D'
                        totals_bef   = 'X'
                         ).

  PERFORM make_fcat USING:
    'X'  'ANLN1'  '자산코드' 'ZTE3CM0002'   ' ',
    ' '  'ANLNT'  '자산명'   'ZTE3CM0002'   ' ',
   ' '   'M01'    '1월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M02'    '2월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M03'    '3월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M04'    '4월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M05'    '5월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M06'    '6월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M07'    '7월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M08'    '8월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M09'    '9월'      'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M10'    '10월'     'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M11'    '11월'     'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'M12'    '12월'     'ZTE3CM0007' 'DEPR',
   ' '   'WAERS'  '통화'     'ZTE3CM0007' 'WAERS'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_tree_header
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_tree_header .

  PERFORM set_fcat_tree USING:
      'APRICE' '취득원가' 'ZTE3CM0002' 'APRICE' '10',
      'ACCUM'  '감가누계' 'ZTE3CM0002' 'ACCUM'  '10',
      'BOOK'   '장부가액' 'ZTE3CM0002' 'APRICE' '10',
      'WAERS'  '통화'     'ZTE3CM0002' 'WAERS' '10'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_fcat_tree
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_fcat_tree   USING   pv_field
                             pv_text
                             pv_ref_table
                             pv_ref_field
                             pv_len.

  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.
  gs_fcat-outputlen = pv_len.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'APRICE' OR 'ACCUM' OR 'BOOK'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.

  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat_tree.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_fcat
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_fcat  USING    pv_key
                         pv_field
                         pv_text
                         pv_ref_table
                         pv_ref_field.

  gs_fcat-key       = pv_key.
  gs_fcat-fieldname = pv_field.
  gs_fcat-coltext   = pv_text.
  gs_fcat-ref_table = pv_ref_table.
  gs_fcat-ref_field = pv_ref_field.

  CASE pv_field.
    WHEN 'ANLN1'.
      gs_fcat-hotspot = 'X'.

    WHEN 'M01' OR 'M02' OR 'M03' OR 'M04' OR 'M05' OR 'M06'
      OR 'M07' OR 'M08' OR 'M09' OR 'M10' OR 'M11' OR 'M12'.
      gs_fcat-cfieldname = 'WAERS'.
      gs_fcat-do_sum     = 'X'.
      gs_fcat-no_zero  = 'X'.
  ENDCASE.

  APPEND gs_fcat TO gt_fcat.
  CLEAR  gs_fcat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form make_hierarchy
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_hierarchy .

  IF gcl_tree IS BOUND.
    gcl_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
  ENDIF.

  DATA: lt_data_tmp LIKE TABLE OF gs_data,
        lt_sum      LIKE TABLE OF gs_data, " 합계 보관용 테이블
        ls_sum      LIKE gs_data,
        lv_all_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
        lv_cls_key  TYPE lvc_nkey,
        lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

  lt_data_tmp = gt_data.
  REFRESH: gt_make_tree, lt_sum.

  " 자산분류별 합계 집계
  LOOP AT lt_data_tmp ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data_tmp>).
    CLEAR ls_sum.
    ls_sum-anlkl  = <fs_data_tmp>-anlkl.
    ls_sum-aprice = <fs_data_tmp>-aprice.
    ls_sum-accum  = <fs_data_tmp>-accum.
    ls_sum-book   = <fs_data_tmp>-book.
    ls_sum-waers  = <fs_data_tmp>-waers.
    COLLECT ls_sum INTO lt_sum.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT lt_sum      BY anlkl.
  SORT lt_data_tmp BY anlkl anln1.

  " 전체(Root) 노드 생성 LV 0.
  PERFORM add_node USING ls_sum '전체' space lv_all_key.
  gv_all_node = lv_all_key.

  LOOP AT lt_sum INTO ls_sum.
    " LV 1 자산 분류 폴더
    PERFORM add_node USING ls_sum ls_sum-anlkl lv_all_key lv_cls_key.

    " LV 2 리프(자식) 노드
    LOOP AT lt_data_tmp INTO gs_data WHERE anlkl = ls_sum-anlkl.
      PERFORM add_node USING gs_data gs_data-anlnt lv_cls_key lv_node_key.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 트리 업데이트
  gcl_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = gv_all_node ).
  gcl_tree->update_calculations( ).
  gcl_tree->frontend_update( ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form add_node
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_EMPTY
*&      --> P_
*&      --> SPACE
*&      --> LV_ALL_KEY
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_node  USING  ps_data      LIKE gs_data "실제 데이터
                      pv_text                   "표시될 이름
                      pv_relat_key TYPE lvc_nkey"부모가 누구인지
                      pv_node_key  TYPE lvc_nkey."고유 번호, 추후 자식 있으면 거기에 연결
*
*  DATA: lt_item_layout TYPE lvc_t_layi,
*        ls_item_layout TYPE lvc_s_layi,
*        ls_node_layout TYPE lvc_s_layn.

  DATA lv_node_text TYPE lvc_value.
*
  lv_node_text = pv_text.
*  ls_node_layout-style = cl_gui_column_tree=>style_emphasized_a.

  CASE pv_text.
    WHEN 'BD'.
      lv_node_text = '건물'.
    WHEN 'MC'.
      lv_node_text = '기계장치'.
    WHEN 'VH'.
      lv_node_text = '운반구'.
    WHEN 'FE'.
      lv_node_text = '비품'.
    WHEN 'LD'.
      lv_node_text = '토지'.
  ENDCASE.

  CALL METHOD gcl_tree->add_node
    EXPORTING
      i_relat_node_key = pv_relat_key  "부모 노드키 -> 없으면 최상위
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child "관계 설정
*     is_node_layout   = ls_node_layout               " 행 전체 스타일
*     it_item_layout   = lt_item_layout               " 셀별 스타일
      i_node_text      = lv_node_text   "찍힐 글자 ->이름
      is_outtab_line   = ps_data        "실제 데이터행
    IMPORTING
      e_new_node_key   = pv_node_key.   " 노드가 생선된 후 고유 번호를 받아옴

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form filter_detail
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> NODE_KEY
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM filter_detail  USING pv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

  DATA : ls_node  LIKE gs_data,
         ls_item  LIKE LINE OF gt_item,
         lr_anlkl TYPE RANGE OF zte3cm0002-anlkl,
         lv_anlkl TYPE zte3cm0002-anlkl.

  CLEAR : gr_anln1, gr_anlkl.

  CALL METHOD gcl_tree->get_outtab_line
    EXPORTING
      i_node_key    = pv_node_key
    IMPORTING
      e_outtab_line = ls_node.

  IF pv_node_key NE gv_all_node.

    IF ls_node-anln1 IS NOT INITIAL.
      gr_anln1 = VALUE #(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls_node-anln1 )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_node-anlkl IS NOT INITIAL.
      CASE ls_node-anlkl.
        WHEN '건물'.
          lv_anlkl = 'BD'.
        WHEN '기계장치'.
          lv_anlkl = 'MC'.
        WHEN '운반구'.
          lv_anlkl = 'VH'.
        WHEN '비품'.
          lv_anlkl = 'FE'.
        WHEN '토지'.
          lv_anlkl = 'LD'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lv_anlkl = ls_node-anlkl.
      ENDCASE.
      gr_anlkl = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = lv_anlkl ) ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  APPEND LINES OF gr_anlkl TO lr_anlkl.
  IF pa_anlkl IS NOT INITIAL AND pa_anlkl NE 'ALL'.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = pa_anlkl ) TO lr_anlkl.
  ENDIF.

  REFRESH gt_item.

  IF lr_anlkl IS INITIAL.
*   전체/자산번호 클릭 → anlkl 조건 없음, anln1만
    SELECT anlkl, bukrs, anln1, anlnt, waers, abflg, kostl,
           aprice, accum, bookvalue, alife, abudat, afasl,
           m01, m02, m03, m04, m05, m06,
           m07, m08, m09, m10, m11, m12
      FROM zcds_e3_cm_0001( p_gjahr = @pa_gjahr )
     WHERE bukrs = @pa_bukrs
       AND anln1  IN @gr_anln1
       AND abflg  NE 'X'
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_item.
  ELSE.
*   자산분류 클릭 → anlkl + anln1 둘 다
    SELECT anlkl, bukrs, anln1, anlnt, waers, abflg, kostl,
           aprice, accum, bookvalue, alife, abudat, afasl,
           m01, m02, m03, m04, m05, m06,
           m07, m08, m09, m10, m11, m12
      FROM zcds_e3_cm_0001( p_gjahr = @pa_gjahr )
     WHERE bukrs = @pa_bukrs
       AND anln1  IN @gr_anln1
       AND anlkl  IN @lr_anlkl
       AND abflg  NE 'X'
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_item.
  ENDIF.

  SORT gt_item BY anln1.
  PERFORM set_chart.
  gcl_grid->refresh_table_display(
    EXPORTING
      is_stable      = gs_stable
      i_soft_refresh = space ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_top_page
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_top_page .

  CHECK pa_check NE 'X'.

  DATA: lcl_table      TYPE REF TO cl_dd_table_element,
        lcl_icon       TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c1         TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c2         TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_gap        TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c3         TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lcl_c4         TYPE REF TO cl_dd_area,
        lv_a           TYPE sdydo_text_element,
        lv_total_price TYPE zte3cm0002-aprice,
        lv_total_accum TYPE zte3cm0002-accum,
        lv_total_book  TYPE zte3cm0002-aprice,
        lv_curr_depr   TYPE zte3cm0002-aprice,
        lv_full_cnt    TYPE i,
        lv_depr_rate   TYPE p DECIMALS 1,
        lv_book_rate   TYPE p DECIMALS 1.

  "*-- 집계
  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) WHERE anln1 IS NOT INITIAL.
    lv_total_price += <fs_data>-aprice.
    lv_total_accum += <fs_data>-accum.
    lv_total_book  += <fs_data>-book.

    IF <fs_data>-alife > 0.
      lv_curr_depr += <fs_data>-aprice / <fs_data>-alife.
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_data>-aprice > 0 AND <fs_data>-book = 0.
      lv_full_cnt += 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  "*-- 비율 계산
  IF lv_total_price > 0.
    lv_depr_rate = lv_total_accum / lv_total_price * 100. "lv_depr_rate
    lv_book_rate = lv_total_book  / lv_total_price * 100.
  ENDIF.

  gcl_doc_top->initialize_document( ).

  " 타이틀
  gcl_doc_top->add_text(
    text         = |{ pa_gjahr }년 자산관리 현황|
    sap_fontsize = 'LARGE'
    sap_emphasis = 'STRONG' ).
  gcl_doc_top->new_line( ).
  gcl_doc_top->new_line( ).

  " 테이블
  gcl_doc_top->add_table(
    EXPORTING no_of_columns = 7 border = '0'
    IMPORTING table = lcl_table ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_icon ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c1 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( EXPORTING width = '20' IMPORTING column = lcl_gap ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c2 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c3 ).
  lcl_table->add_column( IMPORTING column = lcl_c4 ).

  "감가상각율 / 잔존가치비율
  lcl_icon->add_icon( 'ICON_DOC' ).
  lcl_c1->add_text( text = '감가상각율' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c2->add_text( text = |{ lv_depr_rate DECIMALS = 1 }%| ). " (감가누계 / 취득원가)
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  "당기 감가상각비 / 완전상각 자산
  WRITE lv_curr_depr TO lv_a CURRENCY 'KRW'.
  CONDENSE lv_a.
  lcl_icon->add_icon( 'ICON_DOC' ).
  lcl_c1->add_text( text = '당기 감가상각비' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c2->add_text( text = |{ lv_a } KRW| ).
  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  lcl_icon->add_icon( 'ICON_DOC' ).
  lcl_c1->add_text( text = '잔존가치비율' sap_emphasis = 'X' ).
  lcl_c2->add_text( text = |{ lv_book_rate DECIMALS = 1 }%| ). " (장부가액 / 취득원가)

  lcl_table->new_row( ).

  gcl_doc_top->merge_document( ).
  gcl_doc_top->display_document(
    EXPORTING
      reuse_control = 'X'
      parent        = gcl_top_con ).

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form handle_hotspot
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> E_ROW_ID
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_hotspot  USING   ps_row TYPE lvc_s_row
                             ps_col TYPE lvc_s_col.

  CASE ps_col-fieldname.

    WHEN 'ANLN1'.
      "로우를 읽고
      READ TABLE gt_item INTO gs_item INDEX ps_row-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
      "아래에서 다시 읽음
      READ TABLE gt_data INTO gs_data WITH KEY anln1 = gs_item-anln1.
      CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

      REFRESH gt_data_pop. "구조체 비우고 읽은것만 넣어준다.
      gt_data_pop = VALUE #( ( gs_data ) ).   " gs_data (마스터)
      " 팝업 열기 전 ATTACHE 체크
      SELECT SINGLE instid_a
        FROM srgbtbrel
        INTO @DATA(lv_dummy)
       WHERE typeid_a = @gc_typeid
         AND catid_a  = @gc_catid
         AND instid_a = @gs_data-anln1.

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        gt_data_pop[ 1 ]-attache = icon_pdf.
      ENDIF.

      CALL SCREEN '0101' STARTING AT 20 3.

    WHEN 'ATTACHE'.

      READ TABLE gt_data_pop INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

      PERFORM call_gos USING gs_data-anln1 'D'. "display 조회만
      "Create 생성
      " GOS 닫힌 후 아이콘 갱신
      SELECT SINGLE instid_a
        FROM srgbtbrel
        INTO @lv_dummy
       WHERE typeid_a = @gc_typeid
         AND catid_a  = @gc_catid
         AND instid_a = @gs_data-anln1.

      gt_data_pop[ 1 ]-attache = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc EQ 0
                                         THEN icon_pdf
                                         ELSE space ).

      gcl_grid_pop->refresh_table_display( ).

    WHEN 'BELNR'.

      READ TABLE gt_data_pop INTO gs_data INDEX ps_row-index.
      CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

*      CALL FUNCTION 'ZFE3FI0006'
*        EXPORTING
*          iv_belnr = gs_data-belnr
*          iv_bukrs = '1000'
*          iv_gjahr = gs_data-gjahr.

      call function 'ZFE3FI0006'
        EXPORTING
          iv_belnr     = gs_data-belnr
          iv_bukrs     = '1000'
          iv_gjahr     = gs_data-gjahr
          iv_start_col = 102               " 4 Byte Signed Integer
          iv_start_row = 3.                " 4 Byte Signed Integer

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_attache
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_attache .

  DATA : ls_attach TYPE srgbtbrel,
         lt_attach LIKE TABLE OF ls_attach.

  REFRESH lt_attach.

  SELECT brelguid reltype  instid_a typeid_a catid_a instid_b typeid_b
         catid_b  logsys_a arch_a   logsys_b arch_b  utctime  homesys
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_attach
    FROM srgbtbrel
   WHERE typeid_a = gc_typeid
     AND catid_a  = gc_catid.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  SORT lt_attach BY instid_a.

  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
*   ★ lv_instid = <fs_data>-anln1 불필요 대입 제거
    IF line_exists( lt_attach[ instid_a = <fs_data>-anln1 ] ).
      <fs_data>-attache = icon_xls.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form call_gos
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GS_DATA_ANLN1
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM call_gos  USING  pv_anln1 TYPE zte3cm0002-anln1
                      pv_mode.

*  DATA : ls_object TYPE sibflporb,
*         lv_cnt    TYPE i.
*
*  ls_object-typeid = gc_typeid. "모듈별조별 임의로 ID를 정한다
*  ls_object-catid  = gc_catid.
*
** Unique하게 INSTID 부여해야 업로드한 파일을 찾을 수 있음
**  CONCATENATE pv_carrid pv_connid INTO ls_object-instid.
*
*  ls_object-instid = pv_anln1.
*
** MODE : 'C' Create
** MODE : 'D' Display
** Mode : 'E' Edit
*
*  CALL FUNCTION 'GOS_ATTACHMENT_LIST_POPUP'
*    EXPORTING
*      is_object = ls_object
*      ip_mode   = pv_mode.
*
*  SELECT COUNT(*)
*    INTO lv_cnt
*    FROM srgbtbrel
*   WHERE instid_a = pv_anln1
*     AND typeid_a = gc_typeid
*     AND catid_a  = gc_catid.
*
*  IF lv_cnt > 0.
*    gv_check = 'X'.
*  ELSE.
*    CLEAR gv_check.
*  ENDIF.

  DATA : ls_object TYPE sibflporb,
         ls_link   TYPE srgbtbrel,
         ls_sood   TYPE sood,
         lv_cnt    TYPE i.

  ls_object-typeid = gc_typeid.
  ls_object-catid  = gc_catid.
  ls_object-instid = pv_anln1.

  CALL FUNCTION 'GOS_ATTACHMENT_LIST_POPUP'
    EXPORTING
      is_object = ls_object
      ip_mode   = pv_mode.

  " 팝업 닫힌 후 파일명 조회
  CLEAR gv_filename.
  SELECT SINGLE *
    FROM srgbtbrel
    INTO ls_link
   WHERE instid_a = pv_anln1
     AND typeid_a = gc_typeid
     AND catid_a  = gc_catid.

  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sood
      INTO ls_sood
     WHERE objtp = ls_link-typeid_b
       AND objyr = ls_link-instid_b(2)
       AND objno = ls_link-instid_b+2.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      gv_filename = ls_sood-objdes.  " 파일명
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  " 화면 필드 업데이트
  DATA: lt_dynp TYPE TABLE OF dynpread,
        ls_dynp TYPE dynpread.
  ls_dynp-fieldname  = 'GV_FILENAME'.
  ls_dynp-fieldvalue = gv_filename.
  APPEND ls_dynp TO lt_dynp.
  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE'
    EXPORTING
      dyname     = sy-repid
      dynumb     = sy-dynnr
    TABLES
      dynpfields = lt_dynp.

  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO lv_cnt
    FROM srgbtbrel
   WHERE instid_a = pv_anln1
     AND typeid_a = gc_typeid
     AND catid_a  = gc_catid.

  IF lv_cnt > 0.
    gv_check = 'X'.
  ELSE.
    CLEAR gv_check.
  ENDIF.

FORM get_item_data .
  "item 조회
  SELECT anlkl, bukrs, anln1, anlnt, waers, abflg, kostl,
         aprice, accum, bookvalue, alife, abudat, afasl, abtyp,
         m01, m02, m03, m04, m05, m06,
         m07, m08, m09, m10, m11, m12
      FROM zcds_e3_fi_0015( p_gjahr = @pa_gjahr )
   WHERE bukrs = @pa_bukrs
     AND anlkl IN @gr_anlkl

    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_item.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form data_mapping
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM data_mapping .

  "최신 누적상각액
  SELECT anln1, MAX( accum ) AS current_accum
    FROM zte3cm0007
   WHERE bukrs = @pa_bukrs
   GROUP BY anln1
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_accum).

  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).

    <fs_data>-accum = VALUE #( lt_accum[ anln1 = <fs_data>-anln1 ]-current_accum OPTIONAL ).
    "장부가액 계산
    <fs_data>-book  = <fs_data>-aprice - <fs_data>-accum.
    <fs_data>-waers = 'KRW'.
    "장부가액 = 취득가액 - 누적상각액
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

*& Form save_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_data .

  DATA : ls_save TYPE zte3cm0002,
         lt_save LIKE TABLE OF ls_save,
         lt_del  LIKE TABLE OF ls_save.

  CALL METHOD gcl_grid->check_changed_data.

  IF gs_asset-anlkl IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '자산분류를 입력하세요.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_asset-anln1 IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '자산번호를 입력하세요.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_asset-anlnt IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '자산명을 입력하세요.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.


  IF gs_asset-aprice LE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '취득가액은 0보다 커야 합니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_asset-pernr IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '담당자를 입력하세요.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_asset-abudat IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '취득일자를 입력하세요.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_asset-alife LE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '내용연수는 0보다 커야 합니다.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_asset-waers IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '통화를 입력하세요.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_asset-kostl IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '코스트센터를 입력하세요.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gv_check NE 'X'.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '증빙 파일을 업로드해주세요.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  ls_save-bukrs  = pa_bukrs.
  ls_save-gjahr  = sy-datum(4).
  ls_save-anln1  = gs_asset-anln1.
  ls_save-anlkl  = gs_asset-anlkl.
  ls_save-anlnt  = gs_asset-anlnt.
  ls_save-aprice = gs_asset-aprice.
  ls_save-waers  = gs_asset-waers.
  ls_save-abudat = gs_asset-abudat.
  ls_save-pernr  = gs_asset-pernr.
  ls_save-alife  = gs_asset-alife.
  ls_save-afasl  = gs_asset-afasl.
  ls_save-erdat = sy-datum.
  ls_save-erzet = sy-uzeit.
  ls_save-ernam = sy-uname.

  DATA : lv_answer(1).
  DATA(lv_text) = |{ gs_asset-anlnt } 자산을 생성하시겠습니까? |.

  _popup_to_confirm '자산생성' lv_text lv_answer.

  IF lv_answer EQ '1'.

    IF ls_save IS NOT INITIAL. "lt_save 가 초기값이 아니면 ~

      MODIFY zte3cm0002 FROM ls_save. " pk 있으면 update, 없으면 insert

      IF sy-dbcnt > 0 . "
        PERFORM post_asset_document.
        MESSAGE s000 WITH |{ gs_asset-anlnt }자산이 생성되었습니다.|.
        PERFORM refresh_grid.

        PERFORM get_data.
        PERFORM make_hierarchy.

        LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
      ELSE.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        MESSAGE s000 WITH |{ gs_asset-anlnt }자산 저장 실패|.
      ENDIF.

    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '자산 생성이 취소되었습니다'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_chart
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_chart.

  DATA: lv_root       TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_categories TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_category   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_series_ap  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_series_ac  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_series_bk  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_point      TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_value      TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_xdata      TYPE xstring,
        lv_val        TYPE string.

  DATA: lcl_ixml TYPE REF TO if_ixml,
        lcl_sf   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_stream_factory,
        lcl_doc  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_document,
        lcl_os   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_ostream,
        lcl_enc  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_encoding.

  DATA: lv_cust_doc TYPE REF TO if_ixml_document,
        lv_cust_os  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_ostream,
        lv_cust_str TYPE xstring.

  DATA: lv_croot  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_gs     TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_def    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_vals   TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_ser    TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_elems  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_celems TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_title  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element,
        lv_ttext  TYPE REF TO if_ixml_element.

  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart,
           key    TYPE char20,
           label  TYPE char40,
           aprice TYPE zte3cm0002-aprice,
           accum  TYPE zte3cm0002-accum,
           book   TYPE zte3cm0002-aprice,
         END OF ty_chart.

  DATA: lt_chart TYPE TABLE OF ty_chart,
        ls_chart LIKE LINE OF lt_chart.

  " 그룹 기준 결정
  DATA(lv_by_asset) = COND #(
    WHEN gr_anln1 IS NOT INITIAL THEN 'X'
    WHEN gr_anlkl IS NOT INITIAL THEN 'X'
    ELSE space ).

  LOOP AT gt_item INTO DATA(ls_data).

    IF lv_by_asset = 'X'.
      READ TABLE lt_chart ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fc>)
        WITH KEY key = ls_data-anln1.
      IF sy-subrc NE 0.
        ls_chart-key   = ls_data-anln1.
        ls_chart-label = ls_data-anlnt.
        CLEAR: ls_chart-aprice, ls_chart-accum, ls_chart-book.
        APPEND ls_chart TO lt_chart.
        READ TABLE lt_chart ASSIGNING <fc> WITH KEY key = ls_data-anln1.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      READ TABLE lt_chart ASSIGNING <fc>
        WITH KEY key = ls_data-anlkl.
      IF sy-subrc NE 0.
        ls_chart-key = ls_data-anlkl.

*       prefix → 한글 변환
        CASE ls_data-anlkl.
          WHEN 'BD'.
            ls_chart-label = '건물'.
          WHEN 'MC'.
            ls_chart-label = '기계장치'.
          WHEN 'VH'.
            ls_chart-label = '운반구'.
          WHEN 'FE'.
            ls_chart-label = '비품'.
          WHEN 'LD'.
            ls_chart-label = '토지'.
          WHEN OTHERS. ls_chart-label = ls_data-anlkl.
        ENDCASE.

        CLEAR: ls_chart-aprice, ls_chart-accum, ls_chart-book.
        APPEND ls_chart TO lt_chart.
        READ TABLE lt_chart ASSIGNING <fc> WITH KEY key = ls_data-anlkl.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    <fc>-aprice += ls_data-aprice    * 100.
    <fc>-accum  += ls_data-accum     * 100.
    <fc>-book   += ls_data-bookvalue * 100.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF lt_chart IS INITIAL.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " iXML 공용 초기화
  lcl_ixml = cl_ixml=>create( ).
  lcl_sf   = lcl_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
  lcl_enc  = lcl_ixml->create_encoding(
               byte_order    = if_ixml_encoding=>co_little_endian
               character_set = 'utf-8' ).

  "======================================================================
  " 1. Customizing XML
  "======================================================================
  lv_cust_doc = lcl_ixml->create_document( ).
  lv_cust_doc->set_encoding( lcl_enc ).

  lv_croot = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element(
               name = 'SAPChartCustomizing' parent = lv_cust_doc ).
  lv_croot->set_attribute( name = 'version' value = '1.1' ).

  " GlobalSettings
  lv_gs = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'GlobalSettings' parent = lv_croot ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_gs
    name = 'Dimension' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'PseudoThree' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_gs
    name = 'Width'     )->if_ixml_node~set_value( '800' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_gs
    name = 'Height'    )->if_ixml_node~set_value( '400' ).

  lv_def = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Defaults' parent = lv_gs ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_def
    name = 'FontFamily' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'Arial' ).

  " 타이틀
  lv_elems  = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Elements'      parent = lv_croot ).
  lv_celems = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'ChartElements' parent = lv_elems ).
  lv_title  = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Title'         parent = lv_celems ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_title
    name = 'Caption' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( '자산 현황 분석' ).
  lv_ttext = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Text' parent = lv_title ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_ttext
    name = 'Size' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( '15' ).

  " 시리즈 색상
  lv_vals = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Values' parent = lv_croot ).

  lv_ser = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Series' parent = lv_vals ).
  lv_ser->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = 'Series1' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_ser
    name = 'Color' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'RGB(65,105,225)' ).   " 파랑 - 취득원가

  lv_ser = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Series' parent = lv_vals ).
  lv_ser->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = 'Series2' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_ser
    name = 'Color' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'RGB(248,80,60)' ).    " 빨강 - 감가누계

  lv_ser = lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Series' parent = lv_vals ).
  lv_ser->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = 'Series3' ).
  lv_cust_doc->create_simple_element( parent = lv_ser
    name = 'Color' )->if_ixml_node~set_value( 'RGB(34,139,34)' ).    " 초록 - 장부가액

  " 렌더링
  lv_cust_os = lcl_sf->create_ostream_xstring( lv_cust_str ).
  lv_cust_doc->render( lv_cust_os ).

  "======================================================================
  " 2. Data XML
  "======================================================================
  lcl_doc = lcl_ixml->create_document( ).
  lcl_doc->set_encoding( lcl_enc ).

  lv_root       = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'ChartData'  parent = lcl_doc ).
  lv_categories = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Categories' parent = lv_root ).
  lv_series_ap  = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Series'     parent = lv_root ).
  lv_series_ac  = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Series'     parent = lv_root ).
  lv_series_bk  = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Series'     parent = lv_root ).

  lv_series_ap->set_attribute( name = 'label'       value = '취득원가' ).
  lv_series_ap->set_attribute( name = 'customizing' value = 'Series1' ).
  lv_series_ac->set_attribute( name = 'label'       value = '감가누계' ).
  lv_series_ac->set_attribute( name = 'customizing' value = 'Series2' ).
  lv_series_bk->set_attribute( name = 'label'       value = '장부가액' ).
  lv_series_bk->set_attribute( name = 'customizing' value = 'Series3' ).

  LOOP AT lt_chart INTO ls_chart.
    lv_category = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Category' parent = lv_categories ).
    lv_category->if_ixml_node~set_value( CONV string( ls_chart-label ) ).

    lv_val = ls_chart-aprice.
    lv_point = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Point' parent = lv_series_ap ).
    lv_value = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'y' ).
    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).

    lv_val = ls_chart-accum.
    lv_point = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Point' parent = lv_series_ac ).
    lv_value = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'y' ).
    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).

    lv_val = ls_chart-book.
    lv_point = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Point' parent = lv_series_bk ).
    lv_value = lcl_doc->create_simple_element( name = 'Value' parent = lv_point ).
    lv_value->set_attribute( name = 'type' value = 'y' ).
    lv_value->if_ixml_node~set_value( lv_val ).
  ENDLOOP.

  lcl_os = lcl_sf->create_ostream_xstring( lv_xdata ).
  lcl_doc->render( lcl_os ).

  "======================================================================
  " 3. 차트 엔진 주입
  "======================================================================
  IF gcl_chart IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT gcl_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = gcl_chart_con
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
  ENDIF.

  gcl_chart->set_customizing( xdata = lv_cust_str ).
  gcl_chart->set_data(        xdata = lv_xdata     ).
  gcl_chart->render( ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_pop_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_pop_data .
  "팝업 초기 데이터 정률법, 정액법
  SELECT domvalue_l AS key, ddtext
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_afasl)
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname EQ 'ZDE3_CM_AFASL'.
  SORT lt_afasl BY key.

  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).

    READ TABLE lt_afasl INTO DATA(ls_afasl) WITH KEY key = <fs_data>-afasl BINARY SEARCH.

    CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.
    <fs_data>-afasl = ls_afasl-ddtext.

    CASE  <fs_data>-anlkl.
      WHEN 'BD'.
        <fs_data>-anlkl = '건물'.
      WHEN 'LD'.
        <fs_data>-anlkl = '토지'.
      WHEN 'VH'.
        <fs_data>-anlkl = '운반구'.
      WHEN 'FE'.
        <fs_data>-anlkl = '비품'.
      WHEN 'MC'.
        <fs_data>-anlkl = '기계장치'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDLOOP.


ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form post_asset_document
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM post_asset_document . "전표 생성

  DATA: ls_header TYPE zte3fi0002,
        lt_items  TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        ls_item   TYPE zte3fi0003,
        lv_belnr  TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
        lv_saknr  TYPE zte3fi0003-saknr.

  CASE gs_asset-anlkl.
    WHEN 'LD'.  " 토지
      lv_saknr = '1300000001'.
    WHEN 'BD'.  " 건물
      lv_saknr = '1300000002'.
    WHEN 'MC'.  " 기계장치
      lv_saknr = '1300000003'.
    WHEN 'VH '.  " 운반구
      lv_saknr = '1300000004'.
    WHEN 'FE'.  " 비품
      lv_saknr = '1300000005'.

    WHEN OTHERS.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '자산분류 계정 매핑 없음:' gs_asset-anlkl.
      RETURN.
  ENDCASE.

  CLEAR ls_header.
  ls_header-blart = 'AA'.
  ls_header-budat = gs_asset-abudat.   " 취득일자
  ls_header-bldat = gs_asset-abudat.
  ls_header-waers = gs_asset-waers.
  ls_header-pernr = gs_asset-pernr.
  ls_header-bltxt = |자산취득 { gs_asset-anln1 } { gs_asset-anlnt }|.

  "차변
  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-saknr = lv_saknr.
  ls_item-shkzg = 'S'.
  ls_item-dmbtr = gs_asset-aprice.
  APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

  "대변
  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-saknr = '1100000002'.  " 보통예금
  ls_item-shkzg = 'H'.
  ls_item-dmbtr = gs_asset-aprice.
  APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

  zcl_e3_fi_document=>post_document(
    EXPORTING is_header = ls_header it_items = lt_items
    IMPORTING ev_belnr = lv_belnr ).

  IF lv_belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    UPDATE zte3cm0002
       SET belnr = lv_belnr
           gjahr = ls_header-budat(4)
     WHERE bukrs = pa_bukrs
       AND anln1 = gs_asset-anln1.
    gv_belnr = lv_belnr.

  ELSE.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form delete_asset
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM delete_asset .

  DATA : lv_answer(1).

  IF gs_dispose-abtyp IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '처분유형을 선택하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_dispose-abdat IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '처분일자를 입력하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF gs_dispose-pernr IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '담당자를 입력하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 매각인 경우 금액 필수
  IF gs_dispose-abtyp = 'S' AND gs_dispose-abamt IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '매각금액을 입력하세요.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  DATA(lv_text) = |{ gs_dispose_item-anlnt } 자산을 처분하시겠습니까? |.

  _popup_to_confirm '자산처분' lv_text lv_answer.

  IF lv_answer EQ '1'.

    PERFORM save_dispose.
    LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

  ELSE.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '자산 처분이 취소되었습니다'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form save_dispose
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM save_dispose .

  DATA ls_disp TYPE zte3cm0002.
  "데이터 조회
  SELECT SINGLE *
    FROM zte3cm0002
    INTO ls_disp
   WHERE bukrs = pa_bukrs
     AND anln1 = gs_dispose_item-anln1.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '자산 데이터 없음.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  ls_disp-abflg = 'X'.
  ls_disp-abtyp = gs_dispose-abtyp.
  ls_disp-abdat = gs_dispose-abdat.
  ls_disp-abamt = gs_dispose-abamt.
  ls_disp-kunnr = gs_dispose-kunnr.
  ls_disp-kostl = gs_dispose-kostl.
  ls_disp-pernr = gs_dispose-pernr.
  ls_disp-aedat = sy-datum.
  ls_disp-aezet = sy-uzeit.
  ls_disp-aenam = sy-uname.

  MODIFY zte3cm0002 FROM ls_disp.

  IF sy-dbcnt EQ 0.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '자산 마스터 저장 실패.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  " 전표 생성
  PERFORM post_dispose_doc.

  " ALV 갱신
  PERFORM get_data.
  PERFORM make_hierarchy.
  PERFORM refresh_grid.
  CLEAR gs_dispose.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_post_item
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_ITEM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_post_item USING pt_item  TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

  DATA: lv_gain_loss   TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_gain        TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        lv_buzei       TYPE zte3fi0003-buzei,
        lv_saknr_asset TYPE zte3fi0001-saknr,
        lv_saknr_cash  TYPE zte3fi0001-saknr.

  REFRESH pt_item.

  lv_gain_loss = gs_dispose-abamt - gs_dispose_item-bookvalue.

  PERFORM get_asset_account USING lv_saknr_asset lv_saknr_cash.

  CASE gs_dispose-abtyp.

    WHEN 'S'. "매각일때
      PERFORM post_item_sale     USING    lv_saknr_asset lv_saknr_cash lv_gain_loss
                                 CHANGING lv_buzei pt_item.

    WHEN 'P'. "폐기일때
      PERFORM post_item_scrap    USING    lv_saknr_asset
                                 CHANGING lv_buzei pt_item.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form append_post_item
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PV_BELNR
*&      --> LV_BUZEI
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> P_
*&      --> GS_ITEM_ACCUM
*&      <-- PT_ITEM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM append_post_item USING     pv_buzei TYPE zte3fi0003-buzei
                                pv_saknr TYPE zte3fi0001-saknr
                                pv_koart TYPE zte3fi0003-koart
                                pv_shkzg TYPE zte3fi0003-shkzg
                                pv_dmbtr TYPE zte3fi0003-dmbtr
                       CHANGING pt_item  TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

  APPEND VALUE zte3fi0003(
      bukrs = pa_bukrs
      gjahr = gs_dispose-abdat(4)
      buzei = pv_buzei
      saknr = pv_saknr
      koart = pv_koart
      shkzg = pv_shkzg
      kostl = gs_dispose-kostl
      dmbtr = pv_dmbtr
      waers = 'KRW'
      sgtxt = |자산처분 { gs_item-anln1 } { gs_item-anlnt }|
      kunnr = COND #( WHEN pv_saknr = '1100000004'
                      THEN gs_dispose-kunnr
                      ELSE space )
    ) TO pt_item.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_asset_account
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_SAKNR_ASSET
*&      --> LV_SAKNR_CASH
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_asset_account  USING   pv_asset
                                pv_cash.

  pv_asset = SWITCH #( gs_dispose_item-anlkl
      WHEN 'LD'       THEN '1300000001'
      WHEN 'BD'       THEN '1300000002'
      WHEN 'MC'       THEN '1300000003'
      WHEN 'VH'       THEN '1300000004'
      WHEN 'FE'       THEN '1300000005').

*고객 있으면 외상매출금, 없으면 보통예금
  pv_cash = COND #( WHEN gs_dispose-kunnr IS NOT INITIAL
                    THEN '1100000004'
                    ELSE '1100000002' ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form post_item_sale
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_SAKNR_ASSET
*&      --> LV_SAKNR_CASH
*&      --> LV_GAIN_LOSS
*&      --> LV_BUZEI
*&      --> PT_ITEM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM post_item_sale     USING    pv_asset pv_cash pv_gain_loss
                        CHANGING pv_buzei pt_item.

  DATA : lv_loss TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
  " 차변: 감가상각누계액 제거
  IF gs_dispose_item-accum > 0.
    pv_buzei += 1.
    PERFORM append_post_item USING pv_buzei '1300000006' 'A' 'S' gs_dispose_item-accum CHANGING pt_item.
  ENDIF.

  " 차변: 매각대금 (보통예금/외상매출금)
  IF gs_dispose-abamt > 0.
    pv_buzei += 1.
    PERFORM append_post_item USING pv_buzei pv_cash 'S' 'S' gs_dispose-abamt CHANGING pt_item.
  ENDIF.

  " 차변: 유형자산처분손실
  IF pv_gain_loss < 0.
    pv_buzei += 1.
    lv_loss = pv_gain_loss * -1.
    PERFORM append_post_item USING pv_buzei '5300000005' 'S' 'S' lv_loss CHANGING pt_item.
  ENDIF.

  " 대변: 취득원가 제거
  pv_buzei += 1.
  PERFORM append_post_item USING pv_buzei pv_asset 'A' 'H' gs_dispose_item-aprice CHANGING pt_item.

  " 대변: 유형자산처분이익
  IF pv_gain_loss > 0.
    pv_buzei += 1.
    PERFORM append_post_item USING pv_buzei '4200000004' 'S' 'H' pv_gain_loss CHANGING pt_item.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form post_item_scrap
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_SAKNR_ASSET
*&      <-- LV_BUZEI
*&      <-- PT_ITEM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM post_item_scrap      USING    pv_asset
                          CHANGING pv_buzei pt_item.
  " 차변: 감가상각누계액 제거
  IF gs_dispose_item-accum > 0.
    pv_buzei += 1.
    PERFORM append_post_item USING pv_buzei '1300000006' 'A' 'S'
                                   gs_dispose_item-accum CHANGING pt_item.
  ENDIF.

  " 차변: 유형자산처분손실 (장부가액 전체)
  IF gs_dispose_item-bookvalue > 0.
    pv_buzei += 1.
    PERFORM append_post_item USING pv_buzei '5300000005' 'S' 'S'
                                   gs_dispose_item-bookvalue CHANGING pt_item.
  ENDIF.

  " 대변: 취득원가 제거
  pv_buzei += 1.
  PERFORM append_post_item USING pv_buzei pv_asset 'A' 'H'
                                 gs_dispose_item-aprice CHANGING pt_item.

ENDFORM.

*        gs_dispose-

    ENDIF.

      IF gs_dispose-abtyp = 'P'.
        screen-input     = 1. " 입력 가능
        screen-invisible = 0. " 화면에 보임
      ELSE.
        screen-input     = 0. " 입력 불가
        screen-invisible = 1. " (선택사항) 아예 안 보이게 하려면 1로 설정
*        gs_dispose-
        CLEAR : gs_dispose-abamt, gs_dispose-kunnr.
      ENDIF.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form list_anlkl
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM list_anlkl .

  DATA : lv_prefix(10),
         lv_pattern(10).
  CHECK gs_asset-anlkl IS NOT INITIAL.

  " 클래스별 Prefix 설정
  CASE gs_asset-anlkl.
    WHEN 'BD'.
      lv_prefix = 'BD'.
      gs_asset-afasl = '정액법'. "정액법 " 정률법 DECL
      gv_text = '정액법'.
    WHEN 'FE'.
      lv_prefix = 'FE'.
      gs_asset-afasl = '정액법'.
    WHEN 'LD'.
      lv_prefix = 'LD'.
      gs_asset-afasl = '해당없음'.
    WHEN 'MC'.
      lv_prefix = 'MC'.
      gs_asset-afasl = '정률법'.
    WHEN 'VH'.
      lv_prefix = 'VH'.
      gs_asset-afasl = '정액법'.
    WHEN OTHERS.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '유효하지 않은 자산클래스입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CLEAR : gs_asset-anlkl, gs_asset-afasl, gs_asset-anln1.
      EXIT.
  ENDCASE.

  lv_pattern = |{ lv_prefix }%|.

  SELECT MAX( anln1 )
    FROM zte3cm0002
    INTO @DATA(lv_max_no)
   WHERE anln1 LIKE @lv_pattern.

  IF lv_max_no IS NOT INITIAL.
    DATA(lv_num_c) = lv_max_no+2(4).
    DATA(lv_num_i) = lv_num_c.
    lv_num_i = lv_num_i + 1.
    UNPACK lv_num_i TO lv_num_c.
    CONCATENATE lv_prefix lv_num_c INTO gs_asset-anln1.
  ELSE.
    CONCATENATE lv_prefix '0001' INTO gs_asset-anln1.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form f4_pernr
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM f4_pernr .

  DATA: lt_return TYPE TABLE OF ddshretval,
        ls_return TYPE ddshretval.

  CLEAR : gs_asset-pernr.

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_pernr,
          pernr  TYPE zte3cm0005-pernr,
          pernam TYPE zte3cm0005-pernam,
        END OF ls_pernr,
        lt_pernr LIKE TABLE OF ls_pernr.

  SELECT pernr pernam
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_pernr
    FROM zte3cm0005.

  CALL FUNCTION 'F4IF_INT_TABLE_VALUE_REQUEST'
    EXPORTING
      retfield    = 'PERNR'
      value_org   = 'S'
      dynpprog    = sy-repid
      dynpnr      = sy-dynnr
      dynprofield = 'GS_ASSET-PERNR'
    TABLES
      value_tab   = lt_pernr
      return_tab  = lt_return.

  READ TABLE lt_return INTO ls_return INDEX 1.

  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    gs_asset-pernr = ls_return-fieldval.
    gs_dispose-pernr = ls_return-fieldval.

    SELECT SINGLE pernam
      INTO @gv_text2
      FROM zte3cm0005
     WHERE pernr = @gs_asset-pernr.

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CLEAR gv_text2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  CALL FUNCTION 'SAPGUI_SET_FUNCTIONCODE'
    EXPORTING
      functioncode = 'A'.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form listbox_anlkl
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM listbox_anlkl .

  SELECT domvalue_l AS key,
         ddtext     AS text
    FROM dd07t
   WHERE domname    = 'ZDE3_CM_ANLKL'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_anlkl).

  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    SORT lt_anlkl BY key.
  ENDIF.

  DATA(lt_list) = VALUE vrm_values( ( key = 'ALL' text = '전체' ) ).
  lt_list = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( lt_list )
                             lt_anlkl ).

  CALL FUNCTION 'VRM_SET_VALUES'
    EXPORTING
      id     = 'PA_ANLKL'

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_fields
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_fields .

  " 감가상각방법 유효성
  IF gs_asset-afasl IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE domvalue_l FROM dd07t
      INTO @DATA(lv_chk)
     WHERE domname    = 'ZDE3_CM_AFASL'
       AND domvalue_l = @gs_asset-afasl.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '유효하지 않은 감가상각방법입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CLEAR gs_asset-afasl.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  " 담당자 유효성
  IF gs_asset-pernr IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE pernr FROM zte3cm0005
      INTO @DATA(lv_pernr)
     WHERE pernr = @gs_asset-pernr.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      MESSAGE s000 WITH '유효하지 않은 담당자입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CLEAR gs_asset-pernr.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_data .

  gs_asset-waers = 'KRW'.

  CHECK gs_asset-pernr IS NOT INITIAL.

  SELECT SINGLE pernam
    INTO @gv_text2
    FROM zte3cm0005
   WHERE pernr = @gs_asset-pernr.

  IF sy-subrc NE 0.
    CLEAR gv_text2.
*    CLEAR gs_asset-pernr.
    MESSAGE s000 WITH '존재하지 않는 사원번호입니다.' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_date .

  CLEAR: gv_usd, gv_eur, gv_jpy.

  CALL FUNCTION 'RP_LAST_DAY_OF_MONTHS'
    EXPORTING
      day_in            = sy-datum
    IMPORTING
      last_day_of_month = pa_evdat.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_init_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_init_data .

  DATA(lv_gdatu) = 99999999 - pa_evdat.

  " 계정 마스터
  SELECT saknr stext
    INTO TABLE gt_saknr
    FROM zte3fi0001
   WHERE bukrs = gv_bukrs.
  SORT gt_saknr BY saknr.

  " 고객 마스터
  SELECT kunnr name1
    FROM zte3sd0001
    INTO TABLE gt_kunnr.
  SORT gt_kunnr BY kunnr.

  " 공급업체 마스터
  SELECT lifnr vennm
    FROM zte3mm0002
    INTO TABLE gt_lifnr.
  SORT gt_lifnr BY lifnr.

  " 평가기준일 유효 환율
  SELECT DISTINCT fcurr gdatu ukurs ffact erdat
    INTO TABLE gt_rate
    FROM zte3fi0008
   WHERE tcurr = 'KRW'
     AND fcurr IN ( 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY' )
     AND gdatu >= lv_gdatu.

  SORT gt_rate BY fcurr gdatu ASCENDING.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM gt_rate COMPARING fcurr.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_before_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_before_data .

  DATA: ls_data      LIKE LINE OF gt_data,
        ls_rate      LIKE LINE OF gt_rate,
        lv_base_eval TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  CLEAR gv_before.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO ls_data WHERE belnr IS NOT INITIAL.

    READ TABLE gt_rate INTO ls_rate
      WITH KEY fcurr = ls_data-fwaer BINARY SEARCH.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND ls_data-ukurs > 0.
      lv_base_eval = ls_data-dmbtr * ls_rate-ukurs / ls_data-ukurs.
    ELSE.
      lv_base_eval = ls_data-dmbtr.
    ENDIF.

    " AR/AP별 평가손익 누적
    IF ls_data-ar_ap = 'AR'.
      gv_before = gv_before + lv_base_eval - ls_data-dmbtr.
    ELSEIF ls_data-ar_ap = 'AP'.
      gv_before = gv_before + ls_data-dmbtr - lv_base_eval.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form build_eval
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> GV_CHECK
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM build_eval  USING pv_check.

  DATA: ls_header     TYPE zte3fi0002,
        lt_items      TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        ls_item       TYPE zte3fi0003,
        lv_belnr      TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
        ls_rev_header TYPE zte3fi0002,
        lt_rev_items  TYPE TABLE OF zte3fi0003,
        lv_rev_belnr  TYPE zte3fi0002-belnr,
        lv_rev_date   TYPE sy-datum,
        lv_base       TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  CHECK gv_before NE 0.

  lv_base = gv_before.

  " 평가 전표 헤더
  CLEAR ls_header.
  ls_header-gjahr = pa_evdat(4).
  ls_header-blart = 'SA'.
  ls_header-budat = pa_evdat.
  ls_header-bldat = pa_evdat.
  ls_header-monat = pa_evdat+4(2).
  ls_header-waers = 'KRW'.
  ls_header-bltxt = |{ pa_evdat(4) }년 { pa_evdat+4(2) }월 외화환산평가|.

  " 외상매입금
  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-buzei = 1.
  ls_item-saknr = '2100000001'.
  ls_item-koart = 'K'.
  ls_item-waers = 'KRW'.
  ls_item-dmbtr = abs( lv_base ).
  ls_item-shkzg = COND #( WHEN lv_base < 0 THEN 'H' ELSE 'S' ).
  APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

  " 손익계정
  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-buzei = 2.
  ls_item-saknr = COND #( WHEN lv_base < 0 THEN '5300000003' ELSE '4200000003' ).
  ls_item-koart = 'S'.
  ls_item-waers = 'KRW'.
  ls_item-dmbtr = abs( lv_base ).
  ls_item-kostl = 'CC_FIN'.
  ls_item-shkzg = COND #( WHEN lv_base < 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'H' ).
  APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

  CHECK pv_check NE 'X'.

  " 평가 전표 생성
  zcl_e3_fi_document=>post_document(
    EXPORTING is_header = ls_header
              it_items  = lt_items
    IMPORTING ev_belnr  = lv_belnr ).

  IF lv_belnr IS INITIAL.
    WRITE : '평가전표 생성 실패.'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  WRITE: |평가전표 생성: { lv_belnr }|.

  " 익월 1일 환입 전표 생성
  lv_rev_date         = pa_evdat + 1.
  ls_rev_header       = ls_header.
  ls_rev_header-gjahr = lv_rev_date(4).
  ls_rev_header-budat = lv_rev_date.
  ls_rev_header-bldat = lv_rev_date.
  ls_rev_header-monat = lv_rev_date+4(2).
  ls_rev_header-bltxt = |{ pa_evdat(4) }년 { pa_evdat+4(2) }월 외화환산환입|.
  ls_rev_header-xblnr = lv_belnr.

  " 환입 = 평가 반대 분개
  lt_rev_items = lt_items.

  LOOP AT lt_rev_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_rev>).

    <fs_rev>-shkzg = COND #( WHEN <fs_rev>-shkzg = 'S' THEN 'H' ELSE 'S' ).
    IF <fs_rev>-koart = 'S'.
      <fs_rev>-saknr = COND #( WHEN <fs_rev>-saknr = '4200000003' THEN '5300000003'
                               WHEN <fs_rev>-saknr = '5300000003' THEN '4200000003'
                               ELSE <fs_rev>-saknr ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  zcl_e3_fi_document=>post_document(
    EXPORTING is_header = ls_rev_header
              it_items  = lt_rev_items
    IMPORTING ev_belnr  = lv_rev_belnr ).

  IF lv_rev_belnr IS NOT INITIAL.
    WRITE: / | 환입전표 생성: { lv_rev_belnr }|.
  ELSE.
    WRITE: / | 환입전표 생성 실패 (평가전표: { lv_belnr })|.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_data .

  REFRESH gt_data.

  SELECT *
    FROM zcds_e3_fi_0001(
           p_usd = @gv_usd,
           p_eur = @gv_eur,
           p_jpy = @gv_jpy
         )
   WHERE budat <= @pa_evdat
     AND bukrs  = '1000'
     AND shkzg  = 'S'
     AND ( kunnr NE @space OR lifnr NE @space )
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @gt_data.

  IF gt_data IS INITIAL.
    WRITE: / '미결 외화전표가 없습니다.'.
    LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDIF.

  " AR/AP 구분 + 거래처명 + 평가손익 계산
  LOOP AT gt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).

    <fs_data>-ar_ap = SWITCH #( <fs_data>-koart
                                    WHEN 'D' THEN 'AR'
                                    WHEN 'K' THEN 'AP'
                                    ELSE          'GL' ).

    IF <fs_data>-kunnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      <fs_data>-name1   = VALUE #( gt_kunnr[ kunnr = <fs_data>-kunnr ]-name1 OPTIONAL ).
    ELSEIF <fs_data>-lifnr IS NOT INITIAL.
      <fs_data>-vennm   = VALUE #( gt_lifnr[ lifnr = <fs_data>-lifnr ]-vennm OPTIONAL ).
    ENDIF.

    PERFORM set_rate_data CHANGING <fs_data>.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_rate_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      <-- <FS>
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_rate_data  CHANGING ps_data LIKE gs_data.

  DATA: lv_eval_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 9.

  READ TABLE gt_rate INTO DATA(ls_rate)
    WITH KEY fcurr = ps_data-fwaer BINARY SEARCH.

  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    lv_eval_rate = ls_rate-ukurs * ps_data-simfactor.

    IF ps_data-ukurs > 0.
      ps_data-eval_krw = ps_data-dmbtr * lv_eval_rate / ps_data-ukurs.
    ELSE.
      ps_data-eval_krw = ps_data-dmbtr.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  " AR: 평가금액 - 장부 / AP: 장부 - 평가금액
  IF ps_data-ar_ap = 'AP'.
    ps_data-eval_diff = ps_data-dmbtr - ps_data-eval_krw.
  ELSE.
    ps_data-eval_diff = ps_data-eval_krw - ps_data-dmbtr.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_post
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LV_ERROR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_post USING pv_error TYPE c.

  DATA lv_cnt TYPE i.

  SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM zte3fi0002 INTO lv_cnt
   WHERE monat = gv_evdat+4(2)
     AND blart = 'SA'
     AND gjahr = gv_evdat(4)
     AND budat = gv_evdat
     AND bltxt LIKE '%외화환산평가%'.

  IF lv_cnt > 0.
    pv_error = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_already_posted
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_already_posted .

  DATA lv_cnt TYPE i.

  SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM zte3fi0002 INTO lv_cnt
   WHERE monat = pa_evdat+4(2)
     AND blart = 'SA'
     AND gjahr = pa_evdat(4)
     AND budat = pa_evdat
     AND bltxt LIKE '%외화환산평가%'.

  IF lv_cnt > 0.
    WRITE: / |{ pa_evdat(4) }년 { pa_evdat+4(2) }월 평가전표가 이미 존재합니다. 배치 중단.|.
    LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form sum_eval_diff
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM sum_eval_diff .

  DATA: ls_rate      LIKE LINE OF gt_rate,
        lv_base_eval TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

  LOOP AT gt_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
    READ TABLE gt_rate INTO ls_rate WITH KEY fcurr = ls_data-fwaer BINARY SEARCH.

    lv_base_eval = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_data-ukurs > 0
                           THEN ls_data-dmbtr * ls_rate-ukurs / ls_data-ukurs
                           ELSE ls_data-dmbtr ).

    gv_before += COND #( WHEN ls_data-ar_ap = 'AR' THEN lv_base_eval - ls_data-dmbtr
                         WHEN ls_data-ar_ap = 'AP' THEN ls_data-dmbtr - lv_base_eval
                         ELSE 0 ).
  ENDLOOP.

  IF gv_before = 0.
    WRITE: / '평가손익이 0입니다. 전표 생성 대상 없음.'.
    LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_name
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_name .

  IF sy-uname NE 'NCODE-E-05'.
    LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

DATA: BEGIN OF gs_data,

        vennm     TYPE zte3mm0002-vennm,
        partner   TYPE zte3sd0001-kunnr.

DATA gt_data LIKE TABLE OF gs_data.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

FORM set_init .

  pa_bukrs = '1000'.
  pa_gjahr = '2026'.

  SELECT SINGLE butxt
   FROM zte3cm0001
    INTO gv_butxt
   WHERE bukrs = pa_bukrs.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
